dz: 用字级、字形和字面关系组织信息。
de: Organize information with type scale, letterform and optical size.

items.zh: 共同基线把两组日期连成一条
items.en: One baseline holds two date groups together
items.dz: 年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。
items.de: Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.
items.pz: 两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。
items.pe: Two number groups sit on one shared baseline. The repeating year shrinks below it so the changing month and day read first.

items.zh: 字形当窗口，一幅图案贯穿全词
items.en: Letters as a window: one pattern runs through the word
items.dz: 图案只在整词上铺一次，由字的轮廓裁切出来。
items.de: The pattern is laid down once across the whole word and the letterforms crop it.
items.pz: 各字里的条纹、星点相位必须彼此对得上；一旦对不上，一眼就看出是逐字各贴了一份。
items.pe: The stripes and stars have to hold one phase from letter to letter. The moment they do not line up, the fill reads as decoration pasted into each letter.

items.zh: 内线字：笔画里嵌一条细线
items.en: Inline: one hairline runs inside the stroke
items.dz: 粗笔画沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，字立刻透气。
items.de: A heavy stroke keeps one line of the ground showing along its centre, and the letter breathes again.
items.pz: 笔画照常填色，只沿中心轴留一条背景色的细线，两端各留一小段不切通。字越粗，这条线救回的呼吸越多。
items.pe: Fill the stroke as usual but leave one line of background along its centre axis, stopping short of both ends. The heavier the face, the more that line gives back.

items.zh: 大字号改空心，线宽与线图同值
items.en: Hollow type: stroke weight matched to the line art
items.dz: 大标题只描边不填色，描边粗细取画面线图的线宽。
items.de: A huge title is drawn as an outline only, at the same weight as the lines of the drawing.
items.pz: 字号一大，实心字就把插画压死；改成空心，并把描边粗细调成与线稿完全同一个值，字与图才落在同一层上。
items.pe: At display size a solid fill flattens the illustration. Switch the type to an outline and set its weight to exactly the drawing's line weight, and type and art sit on one layer.

items.zh: 虚词缩小，夹在两段实词之间
items.en: Function words shrink and bridge the two content words
items.dz: 虚词降到实词的三分之一，换成斜体，卡在两个实词之间的缝里。
items.de: The small words drop to a third of the content words, switch to italic, and sit in the gap between them.
items.pz: the cat 与 mermouse 一样大，中间的 and the 缩到约三分之一、换成斜体，落位略偏上，把上下两个实词缝成一个标题。
items.pe: THE CAT and MERMOUSE carry the same size; the and the in between drops to about a third, switches to italic and sits slightly high, stitching the two content words into one title.

items.en: Nest the sub-word in the big glyph's counter
items.dz: 主字占满画面，从属的小字缩到很小，住进它笔画围出的空当。
items.de: The main glyph fills the frame; the sub-word shrinks and moves into the void its strokes enclose.
items.pz: 一个超大数字先一个人占住整块版心，它笔画围出的那块负形正好塞得下一行小字。从属词不往版外跑，也不压在主字的笔画上。
items.pe: One oversized figure takes the whole field on its own, and the void its strokes enclose is exactly the size of a small line of type. The sub-word neither spills outside nor sits on top of a stroke.

items.zh: 硬断单词，用行数换宽度
items.en: Break the word up; trade width for lines
items.dz: 一个词被拆到三行，各行左齐，宽度是用高度换回来的。
items.de: One word split over three lines, each flush left, buys its width back with height.
items.pz: 长词在一行里占得太宽，就把它硬断成三行，每行从左边同一处起排。整块的字宽缩到原来的三分之一，腾出来的宽度用三行高度换。
items.pe: When a long word runs too wide on one line, break it across three lines, each starting at the same left edge. The block's width drops to roughly a third of the single line, paid for in height.

items.zh: 数字照词标的骨架重画一遍
items.en: Redraw the numeral in the wordmark's skeleton
items.dz: 数字不能直接打字，要按词标的笔画语言重画。
items.de: Do not just type the number: rebuild it in the stroke language of the wordmark.
items.pz: 词标的笔画端部收成尖角、转折带菱线，数字就得照这套重画：端头同样收尖，粗细节奏一致，两者才像同一个家族。
items.pe: If the wordmark ends its strokes in points and flashes diamonds at the joints, the number must be rebuilt the same way, with matching points and the same thick-thin rhythm. Only then do the two read as one family.

items.zh: 在规则阵列里改形，字就浮出来
items.en: Deform a few cells and the letters surface
items.dz: 规则排列的单元里，只改落在字形轮廓上的那几个。
items.de: In a regular array, change only the cells the letter outline crosses.
items.pz: 先把同样的圆顶单元等距铺满，再画出字形轮廓；轮廓压到的单元只改轮廓那一侧，其余一律不动。字因此半隐半现，退远才看得全。
items.pe: Tile identical domes at an even pitch, then lay the letter outline over them. Reshape only the cells the outline crosses and leave every other cell untouched, so the word stays half-hidden until you step back.

items.zh: 空心大字当底纹，小字压中线
items.en: Outline the numeral, center the small word
items.dz: 大数字只留描边做底纹，小字压在它的光学中线上。
items.de: The numeral keeps only its outline as a ground; the small word sits on its optical middle.
items.pz: 把数字放得极大但只描边不填色，退成一层底纹；词标缩到很小、只留一行，落在数字的光学中线上，靠颜色而不是字号抢回主角。
items.pe: Set the numeral enormous but stroke it only, so it drops back into a ground layer. Shrink the wordmark to one small line and land it on the numeral's optical middle, taking the lead back through color rather than size.

items.zh: 一行里逐字变字号，叠成斜阶梯
items.en: Size each letter differently, stack them into a slope
items.dz: 同一行的字母各用不同字号并互相叠压，越走越低。
items.de: Letters in one line take different sizes and overlap, stepping downward as they go.
items.pz: 一行字里每个字母的字号都不一样，后面的字母压住前面那个的一角，整行就斜着往下走；数字接着这条斜线，用同一副衬线收尾。
items.pe: Give every letter in the line its own size and let each overlap the corner of the one before it, so the line steps down on a slope. The numeral picks up that slope and closes it in the same serif.

items.zh: 用一整根等粗的线写字母
items.en: Draw the letters with one even-weight line
items.dz: 字母由一根等粗的连续线描出，笔画可以互相穿插。
items.de: The letters are traced by one continuous even-weight line whose strokes may cross.
items.pz: 字的骨架是一根从头走到尾的线，线宽始终不变、转角一律圆化；笔画之间可以互相穿过，整个字标看起来像一根弯过的铁丝。
items.pe: The whole letterform is one line walked end to end at a constant width, every corner rounded, strokes free to cross each other, so the wordmark reads as a single piece of bent wire.

items.zh: 同一串字逐档试排定字号
items.en: Size a line by test-setting it
items.dz: 字号不靠手感，靠这串字在栏里排成几行来定。
items.de: Size is not taste: it is how many lines the string takes inside the column.
items.pz: 把副标题按三档字号各排一遍，叠在同一栏宽里比：留下正好两行、两行都撑到栏线的那一档。
items.pe: Set the subtitle at three sizes, stack them inside one column and compare. Keep the step that fills the column in exactly two lines.

items.dz: 9W 是全表最小的参数，却放到整页最大；85% 与 20 倍退成右侧小字。
items.de: 9W is the smallest figure in the whole spec, yet it takes the page. The 85% and the 20x shrink into a small right-hand column.
items.pz: 最大的字先被读到，于是最容易被跳过的「9 瓦」成了主张；真正惊人的 85% 与 20 倍降级为佐证，主次被刻意掉了个头。
items.pe: The largest type is read first, so the easily skipped "9W" becomes the claim while the genuinely impressive 85% and 20x drop to evidence. The hierarchy is deliberately inverted.

items.en: Match Chinese and Latin at equal glyph height
items.dz: 同一字号下汉字看起来比大写字母大，混排时要按字面高对齐，不能按字号。
items.de: At one nominal size a hanzi looks larger than a capital. In mixed setting, match the two by glyph height instead of by font size.
items.pz: 用两条横线同时夹住汉字和大写字母：想让它们看起来一样高，就要把汉字那行的字号调小，直到汉字的字面高等于大写高；同字号直接并排，汉字一定冒头。
items.pe: Clamp a hanzi and a capital between the same two rules. To make them read equal, drop the hanzi's size until its glyph height matches the cap. Set both at one size and the hanzi overshoots.

items.en: Cut the cap height into equal type steps
items.dz: 把主标题的字面高等分成几格，辅助文字的字号取其中一格，整页字号从此能整除复核。
items.de: Divide the headline's glyph height into equal bands. The auxiliary type takes one band, so every size on the page is an integral fraction of that one height.
items.pz: 主标题排定后量出它的字面高，用等距横线把这个高切成等分格；小字正好占满其中一格。于是每个字号都是标题字面高的整数分之一，放大缩小都不散。
items.pe: Measure the headline's glyph height once it is set, then cut that single height with evenly spaced rules. The small type fills exactly one band, so every size on the page is an integral fraction of the headline's height and survives any scaling.

items.zh: 数字放大，汉字单位降成角标
items.en: Blow the figures up, demote the unit to a corner tag
items.dz: 汉字单位缩进方括号贴在数字右下角，主体只剩数字。
items.de: The unit shrinks into a bracketed tag at the figure's lower right; the figure carries the block.
items.pz: 把数字放到最大，月、日这类单位缩成方括号小标签贴在数字右下角，原来的整句话退成一行小字当前言。
items.pe: Set the figure at full size, shrink the unit into a small bracketed tag pinned to its lower right, and let the sentence it came from fall back to one small caption line.

items.zh: 描边字在笔画交汇处断开
items.en: Break the outline where strokes meet
items.dz: 空心字描边在交接处会糊成一团，断掉一小段就透气。
items.de: A hollow glyph clogs where strokes meet; cutting a short gap lets it breathe.
items.pz: 描边字在笔画交叉和转折处，轮廓会挤成一团黑；在这些位置删掉一小段轮廓，字腔重新透出来，远看仍是完整的描边字。
items.pe: Where strokes cross or turn, an outlined glyph jams into a blot; delete a short segment of the contour at each of those points so the counters open again, and the word still reads as outlined from a distance.

items.zh: 数字里的冒号连字符要上移
items.en: Lift the colon and hyphen inside figures
items.dz: 符号守在基线上会往下坠，抬到数字高度中线才平。
items.de: Marks left on the baseline sag; raised to the midline of the figures they read level.
items.pz: 20:00-22:00 里的冒号与连字符默认坐在基线上，比数字中心低一截；把它们上移到数字的高度中线，整串数字才在视觉上居中。
items.pe: In 20:00-22:00 the colon and hyphen sit on the baseline, a notch below the middle of the figures; raise them onto the figure midline and the whole run sits optically centred.

items.zh: 汉字占两格，西文占一格
items.en: Two units for the hanzi, one for the Latin
items.dz: 量汉字字面高记作 2A，西文字面取 A，两行才配得上。
items.de: Measure the hanzi face as 2A and set the Latin face to A; only then do the two lines match.
items.pz: 把汉字字面高度记作 2A，西文的字面高度取 A，两行各自落在自己的倍数上；中英并置时大小观感才一致，而不是都设同一个字号。
items.pe: Take the hanzi face height as 2A and the Latin face height as A, so each line sits on its own multiple; that is what makes the two scripts look the same size, not giving them one shared font size.

items.zh: 大字撑满整组文字的高度
items.en: Size the display line to the group height
items.dz: 先定整组的上下界，大字的高度就等于它。
items.de: Fix the group's top and bottom bounds first; the display line's height equals that distance.
items.pz: 整组文字先画出上下两条界：顶线取首行的字面顶，底线取末行的基线；大字的高度取这两条界之间的距离，字号由高度反推，不是另外挑一个。
items.pe: Draw the group's two bounds first: the top rule on the first line's cap height, the bottom rule on the last line's baseline. The display line's height is the distance between them, and its size is solved from that height instead of being picked separately.

items.zh: 整组尺寸由一个基数派生
items.en: One base size generates the whole group
items.dz: 主行定成基数，其余尺寸都是它的倍数或分数。
items.de: The main line becomes the base unit; every other size is a multiple or a fraction of it.
items.pz: 先定主行的字高 A，副行取 A×1.3，说明行取 A÷10，按钮高度取 A÷3；组里每个尺寸都是 A 的倍数或分数，不再各自另挑一个。
items.pe: Fix the main line's height as A. The secondary line takes A times 1.3, the caption A divided by 10, the button A divided by 3. Every size in the group is a multiple or a fraction of A instead of a fresh guess.

items.zh: 标题两端齐，行高由字数反推
items.en: Flush both ends: size follows line length
items.dz: 四行标题的左右边界完全重合，行高随字数反比。
items.de: All four heading lines share one left and one right edge, so the longer line has to be set smaller.
items.pz: 先让最长的一行撑满栏宽，再把其余每行缩放到同宽；字数多的行自动变小，四行落在同一条左右边界上。
items.pe: Measure the longest line to fill the column, then scale every other line to the same width. The line with more characters ends up smaller, and all lines land on one identical pair of left and right edges.

items.en: A circled headline glyph leads the block
items.dz: 从标题里挑一个字，套上圆圈，放在说明段左侧当字标，圆径与段落等高。
items.de: Pick one glyph out of the headline, set it in a circle and let that circle lead a paragraph, sizing it to the block's height.
items.pz: 从标题组里摘一个汉字套进圆，圆径按它标记的段落高度定：单行段用小圆，三行段用大圆；圆与段落共用一条左边界，字面撑满圆。全版这种字标不超过两个。
items.pe: Lift a glyph out of the headline, wrap it in a circle and let it lead a paragraph. Its diameter follows the block it marks, small circle for one line and large for three, and the circle shares the paragraph's left edge. Two marks per page at most.

dz: 从对齐、分组和阅读方向建立画面秩序。
de: Build order from alignment, grouping and reading direction.

items.zh: 同一个词跨色块反相重排
items.en: Repeat one word inverted across the split
items.dz: 一条水平线把画面切成两块，同一个词在上下各出现一次，颜色反过来。
items.de: A horizon splits the field in two; the same word appears in each half with its colour flipped.
items.pz: 画面被一条水平线切成上下两块，浅底在上、深底在下。同一个词出现两次：上边是黑字落在浅底上，下边是白字落在深底上，第二份向右错开半个词的宽度。
items.pe: A horizon cuts the field into a light upper half and a dark lower half. The same word appears twice: black on the light half, white on the dark half, with the second copy shifted right by about half its own width.

items.zh: 让主体跨在色块分界线上
items.en: Let the subject straddle the split line
items.dz: 分界线穿过主体，上下两块因此连成一个画面。
items.de: The split line runs through the subject, so the two fields read as one image.
items.pz: 一条水平线把画幅分成深浅两块。不要躲开它——把最大的字正压在线上，让字的上半用浅色、下半用深色，两块地就咬在了一起。
items.pe: One horizontal line cuts the frame into two fields of different value. Do not dodge it: set the largest word straight across the line and give its upper and lower halves the two contrasting colors.

items.zh: 重复单元沿一个中心放射排开
items.en: Repeat one unit around a single center
items.dz: 单元的角度决定文字的旋转角，越靠外条带越长。
items.de: The unit's angle sets the text's rotation; the farther out, the longer the bar.
items.pz: 所有条带从画面外的一个点放射出去，每条里放同一组词标与编号；文字跟着条带一起转，基线始终垂直于条带方向。
items.pe: Every bar radiates from one point outside the frame, each carrying the same wordmark and number. The text turns with its bar, so the baseline always stays perpendicular to the bar's axis.

items.en: Lock the grid, move the blocks
items.dz: 反推出的网格不动，只把色块搬去别的格位。
items.de: The grid stays exactly where it was read off the reference; only the blocks move to other cells.
items.pz: 把成品版面的元素压成色块，读出它们落在哪几条网格线上；网格锁死后，只把色块搬到别的格位，得到新构成而版面不散。
items.pe: Reduce a finished layout to blocks and read which grid lines it actually sits on. Lock that grid, then move the blocks into other cells: a new composition that still holds together.

items.zh: 小字柱拉字距，跟大字柱等高
items.en: Small column tracks out to match the tall one
items.dz: 同一行里各柱字的上下各贴一条线，字小的那柱靠拉字距撑到与大字柱等高。
items.de: Columns in a row share one top rule and one bottom rule; the small-type column reaches that height only by opening its letter spacing.
items.pz: 先把两柱的上下两条界线拉平：大字柱字面本就近等高，小字柱差多少按行数摊进字距。判断标准是两柱顶端、底端各成一条直线，小字柱在栏线之间看得出疏密差别。
items.pe: Level the top and bottom rules of two columns. The large-type column nearly fills the height; the small one makes up the rest by spreading it across its lines as letter spacing. Both tops form one line, both bottoms another, small column looser.

dz: 先确定边界与分区，再安排文字和图像。
de: Set the bounds and divisions first, then place text and image.

items.zh: 两组宽度按黄金比切分
items.en: Split the two groups at the golden ratio
items.dz: 左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。
items.de: The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.
items.pz: 左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。
items.pe: A vertical rule stands between the two groups. The span from the left margin to the rule and from the rule to the right margin measure roughly 1 to 0.618.

items.zh: 用引线把副行撑满主字宽度
items.en: Dashes stretch the sub-line to the main width
items.dz: 破折号当引线，让副行两端与主字两端重合。
items.de: Em dashes act as leaders so the sub-line matches the figure above.
items.pz: 主数字 12.30 下面一行小字，靠两根破折号把字距拉开，左右两端正好抵住主数字的左右边界，上下两行齐头齐尾。
items.pe: Under the main figure 12.30 runs a small line. Two em dashes spread it so its ends land exactly on the left and right edges of the figure above, making the two rows flush at both ends.

items.zh: 弧线基线：逐字转到切线角
items.en: Arc baseline: every glyph turns to the tangent
items.dz: 整行字沿一条圆弧走，每个字按所在位置的切线角自转。
items.de: The line rides an arc and each glyph rotates to the tangent at its own position.
items.pz: 先定圆弧，再把每个字绕自己的基线点转到该处的切线角；弯道外侧会拉开，必须补一点负字距，否则词在弧上散架。
items.pe: Fix the arc first, then rotate each glyph about its own baseline point to the tangent there. The outside of the curve opens up, so pull some of that gap back or the word falls apart along the arc.

items.zh: 标题按背景网格的模数分块落位
items.en: Title placed on the background grid's own modules
items.dz: 背景是菱形模数网格，标题不另起一层，直接占用其中的格子。
items.de: The background is a diamond module grid, and the title occupies its cells instead of sitting on a layer above.
items.pz: 实词各占一个大菱形格，虚词占中间嵌进凹口的半格，字不另起一层，看起来是从网格里长出来的。
items.pe: Each content word takes one large diamond and the function word takes the half-size diamond nested where the two meet. Nothing sits on a layer above; the title reads as if it grew out of the grid.

items.zh: 笔画与格线同粗并接上
items.en: Match the stroke weight to the ruling
items.dz: 字的笔画和背景格线一样粗，末端直接接在线上，读成一体。
items.de: Strokes take the weight of the ruling and meet it end to end, so the type reads as part of the grid.
items.pz: 背景是一组粗细一致的格线，字也用同样的线宽画出来，末端正好落在格线上，不重叠也不留缝。看过去分不清哪一段是线、哪一段是字。
items.pe: The ground is a set of rules all drawn at one weight. The type is drawn at that same weight, its ends landing exactly on the rules with no overlap and no gap. Nothing tells you where a rule stops and a letter starts.

items.zh: 把报幕做成可平铺的单元
items.en: Tile one unit to fill the frame
items.dz: 一个圆角色块装下词标、编号和剪影，错行铺满整张。
items.de: One rounded block holds wordmark, number and silhouette; offset rows tile the whole frame.
items.pz: 先把同一个单元做完整：词标、编号、剪影三件挤在一块圆角色块里。上下行错开半格铺开，靠单元之间的空隙维持节奏，四边一律出血不封口。
items.pe: Build one tile first: wordmark, issue number and a small silhouette packed into a single rounded block. Lay them in rows, offset each row by half a tile, let the gaps carry the rhythm, and bleed every edge.

items.zh: 旋转内缩的方框把视线收进去
items.en: Rotating frames spiral the eye inward
items.dz: 每层方框转一点、缩一圈，编号留在最内层的空白里。
items.de: Each frame rotates a few degrees and shrinks; the number waits in the innermost blank.
items.pz: 同一组方框一层层往内叠，每叠一层就旋转几度、缩小固定比例，四个角因此错开成一条旋转的隧道；最内一层不再画框，只留一块干净的矩形给编号。
items.pe: Repeat one frame inward, rotating a few degrees and shrinking by a fixed ratio each step, so the four corners stagger into a spinning tunnel. The innermost step is no frame, just a clean rectangle for the number.

items.zh: 下划线占位让著译同列
items.en: Leader gaps put the role words in one column
items.dz: 署名行先用等宽下划线占位，再把它们换成空白。
items.de: Reserve each gap with a fixed-width leader, then swap the leaders for blank space.
items.pz: 名字后面先打下等宽的下划线，把「著」「译」推到同一条竖线上；定稿时删掉下划线只留空白，列位不变。
items.pe: Type a fixed-width run of underscores after each name so the role words land on one vertical line, then delete the underscores for the final and keep the columns.

items.dz: 整组高度按 1.618 分成上下两段，上段占大份。
items.de: The whole stack splits at 1.618 into an upper and a lower block; the upper takes the larger share.
items.pz: 上线与下线之间是整组文字，中间一横把它切成 1.618 : 1；上段放主张与数字，下段放补充说明，比例即刻可读。
items.pe: One rule cuts the text stack at 1.618 : 1. The upper block carries the claim and its number, the lower the supporting note; the ratio alone orders them.

items.zh: 小字挂在主行的基线上
items.en: Hang the small marks on the main line's baseline
items.dz: 星期与年份不另起行，缩到小号后直接压在上一行数字的基线上。
items.de: Weekdays and years do not start a new line; they shrink and sit directly on the baseline of the digits beside them.
items.pz: 大数字先排定，小字缩到三分之一左右，下缘与大数字的下缘齐平，紧贴在数字右侧的空档里，整行看上去只有一条底线。
items.pe: Set the large digits first, shrink the small marks to about a third, align their lower edges with the digits' lower edge and tuck them into the gap at the right. The line then reads as one bottom edge.

items.en: Derive the column from the title's glyph edges
items.dz: 标题排好后，从它字面的左缘和右缘各引一条竖线，正文与信息块都起止在这对线上。
items.de: Put a vertical rule on the headline's left and right glyph edges, then let every element start and end on that pair. The column is measured, not chosen.
items.pz: 不定边距，先把标题排到你要的大小；量出标题字面的左右缘，各引一条通高竖线，正文、信息块、分隔线一律起止在这对线上，版心宽度就等于标题字面宽。
items.pe: Skip margins. Set the headline at the size you want, then drop a full-height rule from its left glyph edge and another from its right. Body rows, info blocks and dividers all start and end on that pair, so the column width is the headline's optical width.

items.zh: 侧标长度取大字字面高
items.en: Size a side caption to the cap height
items.dz: 两条横线夹出大写的字面高，旁边那列小字的长度就取这个高度，横排竖排都一样。
items.de: Two rules clamp the cap height of the large word, and the small caption beside it takes exactly that height as its length, set vertically or horizontally.
items.pz: 先用两条横线夹住大字字面的顶与底，得到一个高度；侧边的说明文字不另定长度——横排就量成这么宽，竖排就排成这么长，字号只留一档。
items.pe: Clamp the cap of the large word between two rules to get one height. The side caption gets no length of its own: set it horizontally to that width, or vertically to that height, and keep it on a single small step.

items.en: Split the page 1 : 1.618 into two columns
items.dz: 整幅宽度按 1.618 比 1 切成两栏，窄栏放竖排小字，宽栏放大标题，宽度差就是主次。
items.de: The full width splits into two columns at 1.618 to 1: the narrow one carries vertical small type, the wide one the headline. The width gap is the hierarchy.
items.pz: 别先想栏宽，先把整幅宽度按 1.618 比 1 切开：窄栏只放一列竖排小字，宽栏放主标题和一句主张。两栏的宽度差出来的量，就是主次关系的量。
items.pe: Do not pick column widths by eye. Split the full width at 1.618 to 1: the narrow column carries one vertical line of small type, the wide one the headline and a single claim. The width difference is the hierarchy.

items.en: Lock every line onto one band grid
items.dz: 标题每行用上下两条横线夹出一条行带，再按等距复制到全页，所有文字都落在同一批带里。
items.de: Each headline line is clamped top and bottom by two rules, and that band repeats at equal pitch down the page. Every element then lands in the same bands.
items.pz: 先给标题的每一行画出上下两条横线，得到一条行带；再按同样的高度和间距把这条带复制到整页。中英标题、正文、价格数字都吸附进这批带里，右端统一悬挂。
items.pe: Clamp each headline line between two horizontal rules to get one band, then repeat that band at equal height and pitch across the page. Chinese and Latin titles, body copy and the price all snap into the same set, hanging flush right.

items.zh: 重复小字沿等距基线铺开
items.en: Spread one repeated line across an even baseline grid
items.dz: 等距细线当基线，同一组小字逐行错开，主标题压在上面。
items.de: Evenly spaced hairlines act as baselines; the same small line drops onto each, offset, and the headline sits on top.
items.pz: 先拉出五条等距细线，把同一组小字逐行放上去并左右错开，形成疏密节奏；主标题的基线落在其中一条线上，整套网格立刻可见。
items.pe: Rule five hairlines at an even gap, drop the same small line onto each with a sideways offset to build rhythm, then set the headline's baseline on one of those lines so the grid shows through.

items.zh: 小字块宽度当缩进模数
items.en: Let the small block's width set the indent
items.dz: 两行小标签的宽度就是一个模数，主标题从这里起排。
items.de: The two-line label's width is one module; the headline and the line above it start there.
items.pz: 量出左侧两行小标签的宽度当作一个模数；主标题与上方副行都从这一段宽度之后起排，纵向控制线正好落在标题字面边缘上。
items.pe: Measure the two-line label on the left and take its width as one module; start both the headline and the line above it one module in, so the vertical rules land on the headline's face edges.

items.zh: 按视觉重心对齐，不按外框
items.en: Align to the optical centre, not the bounding box
items.dz: 带把手的杯子按外框居中会偏，把视觉重量摆平才稳。
items.de: Centre a handled mug by its box and it looks off; balance the visual mass instead.
items.pz: 左边按外接方框居中，把手把重量全拉到右侧；右边让把手与杯身的视觉重量各占一半，杯身自然左移，轴看着才正。
items.pe: On the left the bounding box is centred and the handle drags all the mass to the right; on the right the handle and the body each take half the weight, so the body shifts left and the axis reads straight.

items.zh: 有尖角的字母要探出左边界
items.en: Hang the pointed letter past the left margin
items.dz: 按外框对齐，尖角会显缩；让它探出去，边才齐。
items.de: Aligned by its box a pointed letter looks indented; let it hang and the margin reads straight.
items.pz: 两行字共用一条左控制线。上一行按 A 的方框对齐，尖角让首字母看着缩进去；下一行把 A 单独往左推，让它跨过控制线，其余字母不动。
items.pe: Two lines share one left rule. Align the top line by the A's box and its apex reads indented; on the bottom line push only the A left so it crosses the rule, and leave the rest of the word where it was.

items.zh: 按钮尺寸从字高按倍数推
items.en: Derive the button from the cap height
items.dz: 设字高为 a，上下留白取 1.5a，横向余量取 2a。
items.de: Take the cap height as a; the vertical padding is 1.5a and the sideways slack 2a.
items.pz: 先量出文字高度记作 a，把上下留白定成 a 的 1.5 倍，横向余量定成 a 的两倍，胶囊的圆角与总高都由这套倍数算出来，不再靠眼估。
items.pe: Measure the cap height as a, set the vertical padding to 1.5a and the sideways slack to 2a, and let those multiples produce the pill's height and radius instead of eyeballing them.

items.en: Stand three vertical axes, then hang the type
items.dz: 版面先立几根纵轴，每块字各贴一根，横竖混排就站得住。
items.de: Stand a few vertical axes first and hang each block on one; the mix of standing and running type holds.
items.pz: 先画三到四条纵向轴线，把标题、西文、说明字各吸到其中一条上：标题贴左轴，西文拆两行居中轴，说明字沿轴宽排满，横竖混排也不散。
items.pe: Draw three or four vertical axes, then snap each block to one: the title on the left axis, the Latin broken over two lines on the middle one, the credits filling an axis width. Even mixed upright and rotated type holds together.

items.zh: 每行都撑到同一条左右边界
items.en: Every line fills the same two side edges
items.dz: 最长的一行定宽，其余行补到同宽。
items.de: The longest line sets the width; every other line is stretched to match it.
items.pz: 先找出最长的一行，它的左右两端就是文字组的左右边界；其余行要么加字距、要么改字号，让每一行都顶住这两条边界，整组收成一个矩形。
items.pe: Find the longest line first: its two ends become the group's left and right edges. Every other line is stretched to reach them, by tracking or by resetting its size, until the whole group closes into a rectangle.

items.zh: 小字落在字面基准线上
items.en: Snap small type to the cap and baseline rules
items.dz: 位置从大字字面的几条边线里挑一条，不靠目测。
items.de: The small line's place comes from the display type's cap and baseline rules, not from guesswork.
items.pz: 先把大字字面的顶线、中线和基线画出来，小字只从这几条线里挑一条落位；换成另一条线，同一段小字的观感就换一次，而间距不是一个随手定的数值。
items.pe: Draw the display type's cap line, centre line and baseline first, then let the small line land on one of them. Move it to another rule and the same small text reads differently; the gap is never an arbitrary number typed in by hand.

items.zh: 正文折行宽度，跟着标题最宽行
items.en: The widest title line sets the body measure
items.dz: 标题最宽的一行正好等于栏宽，正文在同一宽度里折行。
items.de: The widest heading line is made to equal the column width; the body paragraph then breaks inside that same width.
items.pz: 三行标题左齐，其中最长的一行正好撑满栏宽；正文段落以同一条左边界起排，折行的右界也止于那条线，标题和正文共用同一个 measure。
items.pe: Three heading lines sit flush left and the longest of them exactly fills the column. The body starts on the same left edge and its ragged-right wrap stops at that same line, so heading and body share a single measure.

items.zh: 行距四等分，当最小纵向网格
items.en: Quarter the leading as the smallest grid step
items.dz: 一行行距切成四格，所有纵向位置都落在这格上。
items.de: One leading divides into four equal bands, and every vertical position snaps to that smallest band.
items.pz: 在一行行距的上下各画一条线，中间再等分三条，把它切成四格；下一行、下一组字、下一条分隔线的位置都吸到这四格上。
items.pe: Draw a line at the top and bottom of one leading, then divide the space between them into four equal bands. The next line, the next text group, the next rule: every vertical position snaps to one of those four steps.

items.zh: 小字组总高，对齐大字字面高
items.en: A small group totals the big face height
items.dz: 旁边两行小字的高，正好等于大字的字面高度。
items.de: The two small lines beside the display word measure exactly the same height as its face.
items.pz: 大字放左边，两行小字放右边；调小字的字号与行距，让两行小字的总高（含行距）等于大字的字面高，上下边界重合，两级字看着是一块。
items.pe: The display word sits on the left, two small lines on the right. Tune the small pair's size and leading until their total height equals the display word's cap height, so both share the top and bottom edge and the two levels read as one block.

items.zh: 标题字面拉三线，小字入带
items.en: Three rules off the title, every block banded
items.dz: 主标题的字面框拉出三条线，全版其余信息分成上下两条带，各自贴线。
items.de: Rules are pulled off the headline's face box, and every other block on the page drops into one of the two bands between them.
items.pz: 先量主标题字面高，用字面顶、中线、基线三条通栏线把它二等分；其余文字按带高选档，嵌进对应的带，上下贴线。带高一致，全版小字只有两档。
items.pe: Measure the headline's face height, then halve it with three full-width rules: face top, midline, baseline. Every other block picks a size from its band and sits flush to both rules, so equal bands leave the page with two small-type sizes.

items.zh: 字号从行高除出来，只取整数档
items.en: Every size is row height over a whole number
items.dz: 字号不是挑的，是行高除以整数得来的：标题占半行，小字三行占一行。
items.de: Sizes are not chosen but divided out of the row height: the headline takes half a row, and small type fits three lines into one row.
items.pz: 定好行高后只做除法：标题取行高一半，小字取三分之一，其余档位同理。字面要卡满切出来的带，上不越线、下不留空；三行小字的字面总高正好等于一个行高。
items.pe: Once the row height is fixed, sizes are pure division: headline a half row, small type a third, other levels the same. Each face must fill the band it was cut for, touching both rules, so three lines of small type add up to exactly one row.

dz: 用遮挡、起伏和阴影解释前后关系。
de: Explain front-to-back order with occlusion, relief and shadow.

items.zh: 字的透视和放射线共用一个消失点
items.en: Perspective type and rays share one vanishing point
items.dz: 文字做透视拉伸，底下的放射线必须收在同一个点。
items.de: The type stretches in perspective; the rays behind it must converge on the same point.
items.pz: 一行字沿纵深拉伸，近大远小；画面里的放射线不能自己找角度，必须和文字共用同一个消失点，两层才咬得死，否则字就像贴上去的。
items.pe: A line of type is stretched into depth, large near and small far. The rays behind it cannot pick their own angle: they must converge on the same vanishing point, or the layers never lock and the words look pasted on.

items.en: Drop the giant glyph to a pale ground
items.dz: 巨字与正文叠在一起时，把巨字压到浅灰，正文才读得出来。
items.de: When a giant glyph and body copy overlap, push the glyph down to pale grey so the copy can be read.
items.pz: 先是黑字压黑字，交叉处糊成一片；把巨字降到浅灰，它就从主角变成底纹，正文落在它上面，前后关系立刻分开。
items.pe: Black on black first: where they cross, both die. Drop the glyph to pale grey and it stops being the subject and becomes ground; the copy sits on top and the depth order is immediate.

dz: AI-Native 时代排版指南：远离 Inter 滥用，掌握高质量字体中英数字混排
de: Typography guide for AI builders: reject generic AI-slop fonts, adopt crafted typefaces

items.zh: Anthropic 官方人文衬线 (Tiempos & Instrument Serif)
items.dz: 【白名单 · 殿堂】Claude 标志性作家质感，打破科技冰冷的人文温度
items.de: [Whitelist] The iconic Anthropic/Claude voice: essayist authority and warmth
items.pz:
【Anthropic 官方心智解构】：
Claude 与 Anthropic 官网之所以能在一众冰冷科技公司中脱颖而出，核心就在于其放弃了无衬线套路，选用 Klim Type Foundry 的 Tiempos 衬线体作为回答正文，搭配 Styrene 几何 UI 字符，铺在暖米纸色（Warm Cream #fbf9f4）画卷上。
【免费与开源替代】：Instrument Serif、Newsreader、Source Serif 4。
【适用场景】：AI 思考界面、深度长文阅读、哲学/人文/研究型产品。
【混排准则】：西文用 Instrument Serif，中文回落至“思源宋体 / Songti SC”。
items.pe: Anthropic identity: Tiempos Serif by Klim on warm cream paper (#fbf9f4). Free web alternatives: Instrument Serif, Newsreader, Source Serif 4.

items.zh: Vercel Geist Sans（极客理性无衬线）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】Vercel 官方出品，专为硬核工具与高密度开发平台打造
items.de: [Whitelist] Vercel's flagship Swiss-style typeface for developer platforms
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
新瑞士国际主义排版典范。高精度几何骨架、严格对齐的基线、微量负字距优化。在中文字体（苹方 / 鸿蒙黑体）混排时衔接极度舒适，是 Next.js、Supabase 生态的招牌。
【适用场景】：开发者控制台、技术文档、现代云平台 SaaS、高密度数据看板。
【CSS 声明】：font-family: "Geist Sans", "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
items.pe: Geist Sans: Swiss-style precision engineered by Vercel for technical interfaces, documentation, and dense developer tooling.

items.zh: Plus Jakarta Sans（当代 B2B/Fintech 标杆）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】挺拔自信的现代几何，大字张力与小字清晰兼备
items.de: [Whitelist] The gold standard for clean, premium B2B SaaS and fintech
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
极具活力的现代几何无衬线，字身挺拔、转折干脆。被众多顶级独角兽与 Web3/Fintech 落地页选为主字体，高级感立竿见影。
【字阶搭配】：标题 semibold/extrabold 带 -0.02em 字距，正文 regular 保持默认。
【CSS 声明】：font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Manrope", -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
items.pe: Plus Jakarta Sans: crisp geometric grotesque favored by contemporary fintech, modern dashboards, and high-conversion landing pages.

items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】开放字腔与圆润终端，科技感与温润亲和并存
items.de: [Whitelist] Open apertures and softened terminals for human-centric tech
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
半封闭字腔极其开阔，大字号下有独特的雕塑感，小字号下可读性极佳，非常适合从标题到正文一用到底的单一字体家族项目。
【适用场景】：生活方式、协同工具、消费级科技、设计工作室官网。
【CSS 声明】：font-family: "Manrope", -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif;
items.pe: Manrope: warm geometric sans with open counters and gentle terminals. Ideal for single-font-family web applications.

items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】纯圆纯直的包豪斯几何韵律，大标题吸睛力极强
items.de: [Whitelist] Pure geometric Bauhaus circles and lines for punchy heroes
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
基于纯圆与直线的几何体，大字号标题（44px+）视觉冲击力巨大，具有浓郁的国际化视觉张力。
【注意点】：因为大写字母极度几何化，小字正文长篇阅读容易视觉疲劳，建议“大标题用 Poppins，正文配 Manrope 或系统无衬线”。
items.pe: Poppins: geometric sans with circular curves, powerful for heroes and branding headlines.

items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】Google 出品专业新闻与深度电子出版物字体
items.de: [Whitelist] Crafted specifically for long-form narrative reading
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
专为长篇阅读设计的光学字阶衬线体，笔画粗细过渡极其克制，在暗色背景或电子纸质感背景下长时间阅读不刺眼、不疲劳。
【适用场景】：博客长文、深度研报、知识库、电子杂志。
items.pe: Newsreader: optical-size serif tailored for continuous reading, articles, and long-form digital publishing.

items.zh: Playfair Display（高对比度轻奢衬线）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】极细发丝线与饱满笔画，浓郁杂志刊物封面感
items.de: [Whitelist] Transitional serif with high contrast for editorial luxury
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
18 世纪末启蒙运动时期的过渡衬线风格，主笔画饱满，发丝衬线极细，粗细对比鲜明。适合文化、时尚、深度策展或高端杂志风格的落地页大标题。
items.pe: Playfair Display: high-contrast transitional serif perfect for fashion, culture, and editorial covers.

items.zh: JetBrains Mono（极客编码与连字神器）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】扩大的小写字母高度，专为阅读代码与 Terminal 设计
items.de: [Whitelist] Generous x-height and distinctive symbols engineered for code
items.pz:
【核心亮点】：
字母形式高度区分（0 与 O、1 与 l 泾渭分明），内置极优秀的编程连字（ligatures：=> != === !==），是现代代码编辑器与终端高亮界面的行业天花板。
items.pe: JetBrains Mono: engineered for code comprehension with large x-height and expressive ligatures.

items.zh: Geist Mono & 表格防抖（Tabular Figures）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 数据面板基石
items.de: [Whitelist] Strict tabular figure alignment to eliminate jitter in live data
items.pe: Geist Mono paired with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums prevents horizontal shaking when counters or metrics update in real time.

items.zh: 中文字体现代无衬线栈（PingFang & HarmonyOS）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】苹方 / 鸿蒙黑体 / 思源黑体西文无缝搭配
items.de: [Whitelist] Balanced CJK sans stack with optimal Latin proportion
items.pz:
【排版准则】：
中文显示以苹果苹方（PingFang SC）和华为鸿蒙黑体（HarmonyOS Sans SC）为第一梯队，开源以思源黑体（Noto Sans SC）保底。
混排法则：永远在 font-family 声明中把西文字体写在前面、中文字体写在后面，利用浏览器字体回退机制，实现“西文用 Geist/Plus Jakarta，汉字用苹方”的完美融合。
items.pe: Chinese sans stack: PingFang SC, HarmonyOS Sans, Noto Sans SC. Always declare Latin fonts before CJK fallbacks.

items.zh: 中文人文宋体栈（Songti & Source Han Serif）
items.dz: 【白名单 · 推荐】宋体 / 思源宋体，东方文人墨客的清雅风骨
items.de: [Whitelist] Refined Chinese Song/Mincho serif typography
items.pz:
【排版准则】：
思源宋体（Source Han Serif / Noto Serif SC）与苹果苹方宋体（Songti SC）。与西文 Tiempos / Instrument Serif 混排时，呈现出顶级的学术、人文、出版物高级质感。
【适用场景】：传统文化数字化、哲学思考、精致美学策展。
items.pe: Chinese serif stack: Songti SC and Source Han Serif paired with classic editorial English serifs for literary resonance.

items.zh: Inter 字体（AI 泛滥重灾区）
items.dz: 【❌ 黑名单】v0/Cursor 默认泛滥，全网 90% 页面撞脸的冷淡灰字
items.de: [Blacklist] The default for v0 & Cursor. Ubiquitous, soulless, and generic
items.pz:
【为什么进黑名单】：
自 2023 年 AI 生成代码爆发以来，90% 的前端 Agent 默认都输出 Inter。铺天盖地的 Inter 搭配灰底黑卡片，成为当今最具辨识度的“AI 生成廉价感（AI Slop）”。做真正有品牌的现代 Web，第一步就是废黜默认 Inter，换用 Geist、Manrope 或 Plus Jakarta Sans。
items.pe: Inter is the universal tell of an AI-generated template. Swap it immediately for Geist, Manrope, or Plus Jakarta Sans.

items.dz: 【❌ 黑名单】十年前 Material Design 残留，缺乏现代 Web 呼吸感
items.de: [Blacklist] Relic of 2014 Material Design. Rigid, cold, and dated
items.pz:
【为什么进黑名单】：
早期安卓系统默认字体，在当下现代审美下笔画骨架过紧、缺乏字腔舒展度，常被旧代码库和缺乏审美的旧脚手架沿用。
items.pe: Roboto carries dated 2014 Android aesthetics with cramped counters. Replace with contemporary grotesque families.

items.zh: Arial / Helvetica（生硬系统无个性降级）
items.dz: 【❌ 黑名单】毫无温度的操作系统保底，数字与小写字母呆滞
items.de: [Blacklist] The sterile system fallback with zero brand warmth
items.pz:
【为什么进黑名单】：
粗暴的系统默认回退，标点与字距在现代屏幕显示中极端生硬。高质感产品必须指定专门调校过的现代 Web 字体。
items.pe: Arial is a default fallback that damages brand credibility on modern display screens.

items.dz: 【❌ 黑名单】2012 年 Bootstrap / WordPress 泛滥时代产物
items.de: [Blacklist] Reminiscent of 2012 corporate WordPress blogs
items.pz:
【为什么进黑名单】：
过大的 x 高与圆钝弧形在今天看起来迟钝沉重，已被新一代几何与新瑞士主义无衬线全面取代。
items.pe: Open Sans looks dated and heavy compared to modern tight-grotesque typefaces.

dz: 排版、着色与文字动效
de: Type, color & text motion

items.dz: 字体本身填充彩色渐变
items.de: Letters filled with a color gradient
items.pz: 用 background-image 渐变 + background-clip:text + 透明文字色实现。
items.pe: Use a gradient background-image with background-clip:text and transparent text color.

items.dz: 渐变在字里缓缓流动
items.de: The gradient drifts across the letters
items.pz: 把渐变做成 300% 宽，动画 background-position 循环平移。
items.pe: Make the gradient 300% wide and animate background-position in a loop.

items.dz: 只有轮廓、内部镂空
items.de: Only the outline, hollow inside
items.pz: 用 -webkit-text-stroke 描边，color 设为 transparent。
items.pe: Use -webkit-text-stroke with a transparent fill color.

items.dz: 实心字外再套一圈轮廓
items.de: A solid word wrapped in a second outline
items.pz: 文字实色，外层用 text-shadow 多方向堆叠或伪元素描边。
items.pe: Solid fill plus an offset outline built from a pseudo-element or layered text-shadow.

items.dz: 文字轻轻浮起一层
items.de: Text lifted by a soft shadow
items.pz: 用一到两层低透明度、大模糊的 text-shadow。
items.pe: One or two low-opacity, large-blur text-shadows.

items.dz: 像贴纸一样的实心错位影
items.de: A crisp, sticker-like offset shadow
items.pz: text-shadow 不带模糊，只给 x/y 偏移和实色。
items.pe: text-shadow with zero blur — pure offset and a solid color.

items.dz: 影子拉出一条长长的斜线
items.de: The shadow stretches into a long diagonal
items.pz: 叠加几十层每层递增 1px 的 text-shadow，形成连续长影。
items.pe: Stack dozens of 1px-stepped text-shadows to form a continuous ramp.

items.dz: 字有厚度，像立起来
items.de: Letters with real thickness
items.pz: 多层实色 text-shadow 沿同一方向递增，末层加暗投影。
items.pe: Many solid text-shadows stepping in one direction, ending with a dark cast shadow.

items.dz: 像霓虹灯管一样发亮
items.de: Glows like a neon tube
items.pz: 多层同色 text-shadow 由小到大叠加出光晕，深色背景更明显。
items.pe: Stack same-hue text-shadows from tight to wide; works best on a dark surface.

items.dz: 像压进纸里一样
items.de: Pressed into the paper
items.pz: 同色系背景上，一层浅色下偏移 + 一层深色上偏移的 text-shadow。
items.pe: On a tonal background, one light shadow below and one dark above.

items.dz: 红蓝分离的抖动故障感
items.de: Red/blue split with a nervous jitter
items.pz: 用两个伪元素副本分别染红/青并做微小随机位移动画。
items.pe: Two pseudo-element copies tinted red/cyan, each jittering by a few pixels.

items.dz: 一个字一个字敲出来，光标闪烁
items.de: Typed out character by character with a blinking caret
items.pz: 固定宽度容器 + steps() 动画改变 width，右侧加闪烁边框当光标。
items.pe: Animate width in steps() over a clipped container, with a blinking right border as caret.

items.dz: 文字从下方推上来露出
items.de: Text slides up out of a clipping mask
items.pz: 外层 overflow:hidden，内层 translateY(100%) → 0。
items.pe: Wrapper with overflow:hidden; inner text animates translateY(100%) → 0.

items.dz: 一个字母一个字母依次淡入上浮
items.de: Letters fade and rise one after another
items.pz: 拆分字符，每个字符按 index 加 delay 做 opacity + translateY。
items.pe: Split into characters and stagger opacity + translateY by index.

items.dz: 字母从模糊里聚焦出来
items.de: Letters resolve out of a blur
items.pz: 逐字动画 filter:blur(12px)→0，配合轻微放大。
items.pe: Per-letter filter:blur(12px)→0 with a slight scale-down.

items.dz: 字母像水面一样上下起伏
items.de: Letters bob like water
items.pz: 逐字 translateY 正弦循环，delay 按 index 递增。
items.pe: Per-letter looping translateY, delay stepped by index.

items.dz: 一道高光从字上扫过
items.de: A highlight sweeps across the word
items.pz: 在文字渐变里放一段白色亮带，循环平移 background-position。
items.pe: Put a white band inside the text gradient and loop background-position.

items.dz: 像荧光笔从左划过
items.de: A highlighter stroke swipes left to right
items.pz: 背景色带只覆盖文字下半部，动画 background-size 从 0 到 100%。
items.pe: A band covering the lower half of the line, animating background-size 0 → 100%.

items.dz: 悬停时下划线从左往右长出来
items.de: On hover the underline grows from the left
items.pz: 伪元素 scaleX(0)→1，transform-origin 左侧。
items.pe: Pseudo-element scaleX(0)→1 with transform-origin left.

items.dz: 悬停时空心字被填满
items.de: Hover floods the hollow letters
items.pz: 基础态 text-stroke + 透明填充，hover 时切换 color 并过渡。
items.pe: Base state uses text-stroke with transparent fill; hover transitions the color in.

items.dz: 文字与背景相撞产生反色
items.de: Text inverts against whatever is behind it
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:difference，文字白色压在彩色块上。
items.pe: mix-blend-mode:difference on white text over a colored block.

items.dz: 字里是一张图/一片纹理
items.de: The letters are a window onto a texture
items.pz: 把图片作为 background 并 background-clip:text。
items.pe: Set the image as background and clip it to the text.

items.dz: 字距由散到紧地收拢
items.de: Letter-spacing tightens as it lands
items.pz: 动画 letter-spacing 从 .4em 到正常，配合 opacity。
items.pe: Animate letter-spacing from .4em to normal along with opacity.

items.dz: 一个词位上不断换词
items.de: One slot cycles through words
items.pz: 固定容器高度，词组做 translateY 步进循环。
items.pe: Fixed-height slot, list of words stepping through translateY.

items.dz: 短促地抖一下，用于报错
items.de: A short nervous shake — good for errors
items.pz: 短时长 translateX 往复关键帧，2~3 个来回后停止。
items.pe: Short translateX keyframes, two or three passes then stop.

items.dz: 数字像里程表一样滚上去
items.de: Digits roll like an odometer
items.pz: 每位数字一列 0-9，用 translateY 定位到目标数字。
items.pe: One 0-9 column per digit, translateY into position.

items.dz: 上下两半错开合拢成字
items.de: Two halves slide together into one word
items.pz: 同一段文字两层，各裁一半，分别从左右滑入对齐。
items.pe: Two clipped copies of the same text sliding in from opposite sides.

items.dz: 先是涂黑块，再擦开露出字
items.de: A black bar wipes away to expose the word
items.pz: 覆盖层色块用 transform-origin:right 的 scaleX 收起。
items.pe: A covering bar collapses with scaleX and transform-origin right.

items.dz: 悬停时字变粗变宽
items.de: Hover thickens and widens the letters
items.pz: 用可变字体的 font-variation-settings 做 wght 过渡。
items.pe: Transition font-variation-settings wght on a variable font.

items.dz: 字从大到小“砸”定位
items.de: The word slams down into place
items.pz: scale(1.6)→1 配合 opacity 与短促的 out-quint 缓动。
items.pe: scale(1.6)→1 with opacity and a snappy out-quint ease.

items.de: Text scrolls endlessly like a ticker
items.pz: 内容复制两份，容器 translateX 到 -50% 无缝循环。
items.pe: Duplicate the content and loop translateX to -50%.

items.pz: 伪元素用 linear-gradient 从实色渐隐到透明。

items.dz: 首字下沉不改变读屏顺序，窄屏提供普通回退。
items.de: Drop caps do not alter reading order and have a narrow fallback.
items.pz: 首字下沉不改变读屏顺序，窄屏提供普通回退。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Drop caps do not alter reading order and have a narrow fallback. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 引用通过结构、边界和出处表达，不只依赖斜体或颜色。
items.de: Use structure, boundary, and attribution beyond italics or color.
items.pz: 引用通过结构、边界和出处表达，不只依赖斜体或颜色。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Use structure, boundary, and attribution beyond italics or color. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 代码块支持横向滚动或软换行，复制内容不被改写。
items.de: Offer scroll or soft wrap without changing copied code.
items.pz: 代码块支持横向滚动或软换行，复制内容不被改写。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Offer scroll or soft wrap without changing copied code. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 可编辑文本处理光标、组合输入、撤销和粘贴清理。
items.de: Handle caret, composition, undo, and paste cleanup.
items.pz: 可编辑文本处理光标、组合输入、撤销和粘贴清理。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Handle caret, composition, undo, and paste cleanup. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 自定义选中色保持对比，不阻止复制和键盘选择。
items.de: Keep selection contrast without blocking copy or keyboard selection.
items.pz: 自定义选中色保持对比，不阻止复制和键盘选择。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Keep selection contrast without blocking copy or keyboard selection. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 字体加载失败时避免布局跳变和不可读的隐藏文字。
items.de: Avoid layout shift and invisible text when fonts fail.
items.pz: 字体加载失败时避免布局跳变和不可读的隐藏文字。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Avoid layout shift and invisible text when fonts fail. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 文字渲染优先清晰和跨平台一致，不为微小差异牺牲性能。
items.de: Prioritize clarity and cross-platform stability.
items.pz: 文字渲染优先清晰和跨平台一致，不为微小差异牺牲性能。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Prioritize clarity and cross-platform stability. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 标题、正文、数字和 prompt 完全跟随全局语言。
items.de: Titles, body, numbers, and prompts follow locale.
items.pz: 标题、正文、数字和 prompt 完全跟随全局语言。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Titles, body, numbers, and prompts follow locale. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

items.dz: 发布前检查语言、方向、缩放、截断、字体回退和复制。
items.de: Audit locale, direction, zoom, truncation, fallback, and copying.
items.pz: 发布前检查语言、方向、缩放、截断、字体回退和复制。 在中英文、缩放、长内容和暗色主题下复核。
items.pe: Audit locale, direction, zoom, truncation, fallback, and copying. Validate Chinese/English, zoom, long content, and dark theme.

dz: 逐字、逐词、逐行：文字自己就是主角
de: Per letter, word and line — the type is the subject

items.dz: 大号 Slogan 随视口逐词从暗淡点亮成高光
items.de: Headline words power on from 28% to 100% opacity in reading order
items.pz: Linear、Apple、Anthropic 官网标志性排版：大号核心主张平时处于 28% 低饱和度暗淡状态，随着视口滚动步进，每个词以物理缓动 cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) 依次点亮成 100% 实色，引导深度阅读，杜绝整段粗暴淡入。
items.pe: Flagship editorial motion: tagline starts at 28% muted tone and illuminates word by word using cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1).

items.dz: 字从下沿滑出来
items.de: Letters slide up out of a hidden edge
items.pz: 每字外层 overflow:hidden、内层 translateY(110%)→0，错峰 40ms。
items.pe: Clip each letter and slide it from 110% with a 40ms stagger.

items.dz: 按词而不是按字
items.de: By word, not by letter
items.pz: 长句用逐词，逐字会显得幼稚且拖沓。
items.pe: For sentences go per word — per letter reads childish and slow.

items.dz: 一行一行掀开
items.de: One line at a time
items.pz: 每行独立 clip 容器，行间错峰 90ms。
items.pe: A clip wrapper per line, 90ms apart.

items.dz: 像镜头对焦
items.de: Like a lens focusing
items.pz: blur 12px→0 配 opacity，逐字错峰更像手写。
items.pe: blur 12px→0 with opacity; stagger reads like handwriting.

items.dz: 字化开消失
items.de: It dissolves
items.pz: 退出比进入快 30%，并加一点 scale(1.04)。
items.pe: Exit 30% faster, with a touch of scale(1.04).

items.dz: 乱码里逐字定住
items.de: Glyphs settle out of noise
items.pz: 每帧随机替换未定字符，用 steps 定住节奏。
items.pe: Randomise the unsettled glyphs per frame; steps sets the rhythm.

items.dz: 一格一格打出来
items.de: Typed one cell at a time
items.pz: ch 单位 + steps(n) 才准，等宽字体是前提。
items.pe: ch units with steps(n) — mono only.

items.dz: 打完又删掉重来
items.de: It types, deletes, retypes
items.pz: 删除比打字快一倍，切换词前停 600ms。
items.pe: Delete twice as fast; hold 600ms between words.

items.dz: 字重从细长到粗壮
items.de: Weight breathes thin to bold
items.pz: 动画 font-variation-settings 而不是 font-weight，才能连续。
items.pe: Animate font-variation-settings, not font-weight, for continuity.

items.dz: 粗细像波浪扫过
items.de: Weight ripples across the word
items.pz: 逐字错峰改字重，delay 决定波的方向与速度。
items.pe: Stagger the weight per letter — delay sets wave direction.

items.dz: 从松散收到正常
items.de: From loose to settled
items.pz: 字距 .4em→-.02em 配 opacity，非常适合标题入场。
items.pe: Tracking .4em→−.02em with opacity — a headline entrance.

items.dz: 字被推散
items.de: The letters push apart
items.pz: 退场用字距散开 + 淡出，比整体缩小更优雅。
items.pe: Tracking out plus fade beats scaling down on exit.

items.dz: 每个字翻一下落定
items.de: Each letter flips into place
items.pz: 父层 perspective，字 rotateX(-90°)→0，origin 在底部。
items.pe: Perspective parent, rotateX(−90°)→0 with a bottom origin.

items.dz: 像机场翻牌显示器
items.de: Airport split-flap board
items.pz: 每格上下两半，翻到一半交接内容并留中缝。
items.pe: Two halves per cell, content swapping at the seam.

items.dz: 旧字上移、新字顶上来
items.de: The old glyph rolls out, the new rolls in
items.pz: 两行叠放整体 translateY(-50%)，容器 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: Two stacked lines translating −50% inside a clip.

items.dz: 一道光扫过文字
items.de: A light sweeps the words
items.pz: 渐变 background-clip:text + position 平移，别用 opacity 闪。
items.pe: A panning gradient in background-clip:text — never a flash.

items.dz: 字里的颜色在跑
items.de: Colour runs through the letters
items.pz: background-size 300% + linear 平移，收尾色要回到起始色。
items.pe: 300% background panning; the last stop must equal the first.

items.dz: 字像水面一样起伏
items.de: The letters bob like water
items.pz: translateY 正弦错峰，幅度别超过 .1em。
items.pe: Sine-staggered translateY, under .1em of travel.

items.dz: 每字弹一下才停
items.de: Each letter bounces once
items.pz: scale 过冲 1.24 再回 1，用 back 曲线。
items.pe: Overshoot to 1.24 and settle with a back curve.

items.dz: 从上方掉下来砸住
items.de: They fall from above and land
items.pz: 落地时轻微压扁（scaleY .9）再回弹，才有重量。
items.pe: Squash to scaleY .9 on landing, then recover.

items.dz: 像挂着的牌子摇进来
items.de: It swings in like a hanging sign
items.pz: transform-origin 在顶部，rotate 阻尼衰减。
items.pe: Top origin with a damped rotation.

items.dz: 带斜度冲进来
items.de: It rushes in on a slant
items.pz: skewX(-12deg) + translateX，落位时归零，像惯性。
items.pe: skewX(−12deg) plus translateX, both back to zero on land.

items.dz: 同一个字上下两种颜色
items.de: One word, two colours
items.pz: 两层同字，上层 clip-path 只留上半。
items.pe: Two copies; clip the top one to its upper half.

items.dz: 描边字被逐渐填满
items.de: The outline fills with ink
items.pz: 两层：下层描边、上层实心用 clip-path 推进。
items.pe: Outline below, solid above, advanced by clip-path.

items.dz: 只有轮廓
items.de: Outline only
items.pz: -webkit-text-stroke 配足够大的字号，小字会糊。
items.pe: -webkit-text-stroke needs size — small type turns to mush.

items.dz: 像被笔一笔写出来
items.de: As if written stroke by stroke
items.pz: 真实书写要 SVG path + dashoffset，CSS 只能近似。
items.pe: Real handwriting needs SVG paths; CSS only approximates.

items.dz: 偶尔撕裂错位一下
items.de: It tears for a few frames
items.pz: 只在 5% 的时间里出现，常驻就成了噪音。
items.pe: Only for 5% of the loop — constant glitch is noise.

items.dz: 边缘泛红青
items.de: Red and cyan fringing
items.pz: 两层偏移 1–3px，混合模式用 screen 或 multiply。
items.pe: Two copies offset 1–3px in screen or multiply.

items.dz: 灯管通电的感觉
items.de: Glass tubing under current
items.pz: 内白外彩多层 shadow，加不规则闪烁才像真灯。
items.pe: White core, coloured halo, irregular flicker.

items.dz: 字有厚度
items.de: The letters have thickness
items.pz: 多层 text-shadow 逐像素偏移，最外层最深。
items.pe: Stack shadows a pixel apart, darkest at the back.

items.dz: 一道斜影拖很远
items.de: A long diagonal shadow
items.pz: 长影用一个 45° 的实色渐变阴影，别用模糊。
items.pe: One 45° solid shadow, no blur.

items.dz: 像马克笔刷了一道
items.de: Swiped with a marker
items.pz: 背景层从 0 到 100% 宽，色块略高于基线更像笔迹。
items.pe: Grow the band from zero; sit it slightly above the baseline.

items.dz: 线从左伸到右
items.de: The rule sweeps right
items.pz: scaleX + transform-origin:left，别动 width。
items.pe: scaleX from the left origin — never width.

items.dz: 鼠标经过的那个字跳起来
items.de: The letter under the pointer jumps
items.pz: 每字单独包一层，只动被悬停的那个。
items.pe: Wrap each letter; only the hovered one moves.

items.dz: 经过就翻一下
items.de: It flips as you pass
items.pz: 3D 翻转要给父层 perspective，否则像平面缩放。
items.pe: Without perspective on the parent it just looks squashed.

items.dz: 靠近的字被推开一点
items.de: Nearby letters make room
items.pz: 按到指针的距离给 margin 或 translateX 插值。
items.pe: Interpolate margin or translateX by pointer distance.

items.dz: 多行文字逐行掀开
items.de: Each wrapped line reveals in turn
items.pz: 用 box-decoration-break 或按行拆分，别用整块遮罩。
items.pe: Split by line rather than masking the whole block.

items.dz: 像播放进度扫过文字
items.de: Colour advances like playback
items.pz: 用 clip-path 推进上层彩色副本，比逐字改色省节点。
items.pe: Advance a clipped colour copy instead of recolouring each glyph.

items.dz: 字被横向拉开
items.de: The letters stretch wide
items.pz: 可变字宽（wdth 轴）比 scaleX 好，笔画不会变形。
items.pe: Use the wdth axis — scaleX distorts the strokes.

items.dz: 一条不断滚动的字带
items.de: An endlessly scrolling band
items.pz: 内容复制两份、平移 -50%，宽度必须整齐。
items.pe: Duplicate the content and translate −50%.

items.dz: 几行字叠着依次露出
items.de: Stacked lines reveal in order
items.pz: 行高锁定，用 clip 而不是高度动画，避免回流。
items.pe: Lock the line box and clip — never animate height.

items.dz: 两行长度差不多
items.de: Both lines about equal
items.pz: text-wrap:balance 给标题、pretty 给正文，一行代码的排版升级。
items.pe: text-wrap:balance for headings, pretty for body — a one-line upgrade.

items.dz: 大字要更紧、更细
items.de: Big type wants tighter, lighter
items.pz: 字号越大，字距越负、字重可略降，视觉才平衡。
items.pe: Larger size → tighter tracking and a slightly lower weight.

items.dz: 数字用等宽、文字用比例
items.de: Tabular figures, proportional text
items.pz: 会变的数字必须 tabular-nums，否则整行都在抖。
items.pe: Changing figures need tabular-nums or the line jitters.

items.dz: 小字大写压在标题上方
items.de: A small caps line above the headline
items.pz: 眉标是唯一允许全大写的地方，字距 .14em。
items.pe: The eyebrow is the one place caps are allowed — .14em tracking.

items.dz: 第一个字特别大
items.de: The first letter goes large
items.pz: ::first-letter 加 float 与负 margin，行数取 3 行。
items.pe: ::first-letter with float and negative margin, three lines deep.

items.dz: 字像墨在纸上洇开
items.de: Ink spreading into paper
items.pz: blur + contrast 制造粘连，再叠一层清晰字。
items.pe: Blur plus contrast to fuse, with a sharp copy on top.

items.dz: 字被素材填满
items.de: Letters filled with imagery
items.pz: background-clip:text 要求字重足够，细体会看不出内容。
items.pe: background-clip:text needs weight or the image vanishes.

items.dz: 文字向远处倒下去
items.de: The type lies away from you
items.pz: rotateX 配大 perspective，别超过 40° 否则不可读。
items.pe: rotateX under a wide perspective — past 40° it is unreadable.

items.dz: 滚动时标题变小固定
items.de: It shrinks and pins as you scroll
items.pz: 用 scroll-driven animation，别在 scroll 事件里改字号。
items.pe: Use a scroll-driven animation, not a scroll listener.

dz: 一个方块如何改变形状、尺寸与状态
de: How one block changes shape, size & state

items.dz: 外圆角 − 内间距 = 内圆角
items.de: Inner radius = max(0, Outer radius − Gap)
items.pz: 工业级 UI 几何法则：当内间距 < 32px 时，内圆角必须严格满足 R_inner = max(0, R_outer - gap)。若内外使用相同半径，拐角会发生拥挤变形与非平行畸变，呈现出典型的不专业套娃感。
items.pe: Industrial UI geometry rule: inner radius must equal max(0, outer radius − padding). Identical radii cause warped, crammed corners.

items.dz: 圆点横向拉长成胶囊
items.de: A dot stretches into a pill
items.pz: 同时过渡 width 与 border-radius（保持 radius = 高度的一半）。
items.pe: Transition width and border-radius together, keeping radius at half the height.

items.dz: 细长按钮展开成一张卡
items.de: A slim button unfolds into a card
items.pz: 同时过渡 height 与 border-radius，从 999px 收到 16px。
items.pe: Transition height and border-radius from 999px down to 16px.

items.dz: 整体等比放大缩小
items.de: The block scales up and back
items.pz: 优先用 transform:scale 而不是改 width/height，避免重排。
items.pe: Prefer transform:scale over animating width/height to avoid layout thrash.

items.dz: 方角到圆角连续变化
items.de: Sharp corners round off continuously
items.pz: 单独过渡 border-radius，四角可给不同值做不对称形状。
items.pe: Transition border-radius alone; per-corner values give asymmetric shapes.

items.dz: 方块化成柔和的超椭圆
items.de: The square softens into a squircle
items.pz: 用 border-radius 百分比 + 略微不同的横纵值模拟超椭圆。
items.pe: Percentage border-radius with slightly different h/v values fakes a squircle.

items.dz: 像水滴一样缓慢扭动
items.de: Slowly wobbles like a droplet
items.pz: 循环切换多组不对称 border-radius 百分比值。
items.pe: Loop between several asymmetric border-radius percentage sets.

items.dz: 1:1 变 16:9 再变回来
items.de: Goes 1:1 → 16:9 and back
items.pz: 过渡 aspect-ratio（或直接过渡 height），宽度固定。
items.pe: Transition aspect-ratio (or height) with a fixed width.

items.dz: 折叠内容向下展开
items.de: Folded content opens downward
items.pz: 用 grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr 实现无需固定高度的展开。
items.pe: Animate grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr so no fixed height is needed.

items.dz: 展开态干净地收回原位
items.de: The open state folds cleanly back
items.pz: 出场用比入场略短的时长和 ease-in，收得干脆。
items.pe: Exit slightly faster than enter, with ease-in, so it snaps shut.

items.dz: 容器变宽时内部从竖排变横排
items.de: Contents flip from stacked to side-by-side
items.pz: 容器宽度变化 + 内部 flex-direction 切换，用 FLIP 保证子元素平滑。
items.pe: Width change plus a flex-direction switch; use FLIP to keep children smooth.

items.dz: 小卡片飞到大位置，像同一个物体
items.de: A thumbnail flies into a hero — same object, new place
items.pz: 记录首末位置（First/Last），用 transform 反向补偿再播放，即 FLIP。
items.pe: Measure First and Last rects, invert with transform, then Play — the FLIP technique.

items.dz: 卡片翻转露出背面
items.de: The card turns to show its back
items.pz: 父级 perspective + 子级 rotateY(180deg)，两面 backface-visibility:hidden。
items.pe: Perspective on the parent, rotateY(180deg) on the child, backface-visibility hidden.

items.dz: 像纸一样从中间折开
items.de: Unfolds from the middle like paper
items.pz: rotateX 配合 transform-origin:top，父级加 perspective。
items.pe: rotateX with transform-origin:top and perspective on the parent.

items.dz: 内容从一个点圆形展开
items.de: Content opens as a growing circle
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0) → circle(140%)，圆心可设为点击位置。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0) → circle(140%), centred on the click point.

items.dz: 从一侧擦出内容
items.de: Content wipes in from one edge
items.pz: clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)，方向可换四边。
items.pe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0); swap sides for direction.

items.dz: 一块裂成两块分开
items.de: One block splits into two
items.pz: 两个子块共用同一背景，分别向两侧位移。
items.pe: Two halves share one background and translate apart.

items.dz: 两块靠拢粘成一块
items.de: Two blocks slide together and fuse
items.pz: 靠拢时把相邻圆角过渡到 0，视觉上就“粘”住了。
items.pe: As they meet, transition the touching corners to 0 so they read as fused.

items.dz: 有弹性的胖瘦变化
items.de: Elastic fat/thin deformation
items.pz: scaleX 与 scaleY 反向变化，总体积守恒，动画才有生命。
items.pe: scaleX and scaleY move inversely — conserving volume is what sells it.

items.dz: 容器倾斜出速度感
items.de: A lean that reads as speed
items.pz: transform:skewX，内部内容反向 skew 抵消文字变形。
items.pe: skewX the container and counter-skew the contents so text stays upright.

items.dz: 圆形按钮拉开成输入框
items.de: A round button pulls open into an input
items.pz: 宽度 + 圆角同时过渡，图标固定在左侧不动。
items.pe: Transition width and radius together while pinning the icon to the left.

items.dz: 点击后按钮收窄成转圈
items.de: The button shrinks into a spinner
items.pz: 宽度收到与高度相等，文字淡出、spinner 淡入。
items.pe: Shrink width to equal height, cross-fade label out and spinner in.

items.dz: 面板从底部推上来
items.de: A panel pushes up from the bottom
items.pz: translateY(100%) → 0，顶部圆角，配合遮罩渐显。
items.pe: translateY(100%) → 0 with rounded top corners and a fading scrim.

items.dz: 面板从右边滑入
items.de: A panel slides in from the right
items.pz: translateX(100%) → 0，主体内容同时轻微缩放后退。
items.pe: translateX(100%) → 0 while the page behind scales back slightly.

items.dz: 列表里的卡片放大成弹窗
items.de: A list card grows into a modal
items.pz: 共享元素 + 背景遮罩渐显，卡片位移到屏幕中心并放大。
items.pe: Shared element plus a fading scrim; the card translates to center and scales up.

items.dz: 小图扩张到通栏
items.de: A tile expands to full bleed
items.pz: 宽高与圆角同时到满屏值，注意用 will-change 稳定合成层。
items.pe: Animate width, height and radius to full-bleed values; will-change stabilises the layer.

items.dz: 方块转 45 度成菱形
items.de: The square turns 45° into a diamond
items.pz: rotate(45deg) 配合 scale 补偿，避免超出容器。
items.pe: rotate(45deg) with a compensating scale so it stays inside the frame.

items.dz: 一格变宽，其他格自动让位
items.de: One panel widens, the others give way
items.pz: 用 flex:1 与 flex:3 的过渡，兄弟元素自然被挤压。
items.pe: Transition flex-grow between 1 and 3; siblings compress automatically.

items.dz: 尺寸变化时轻微过冲再稳定
items.de: Size changes overshoot slightly, then settle
items.pz: 用 out-back 类缓动（cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)）做一次小过冲。
items.pe: Use an out-back curve (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)) for a single small overshoot.

items.dz: 两个圆靠近时像水银黏在一起
items.de: Two circles cling like mercury as they meet
items.pz: 父级 filter:blur + contrast 组成 gooey 滤镜，子元素为纯色圆。
items.pe: Parent filter blur+contrast makes the gooey filter; children are solid circles.

items.dz: 内容多少都能平滑展开
items.de: Opens smoothly whatever the content height
items.pz: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr（或 CSS calc-size），避免写死 max-height。
items.pe: grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr (or calc-size) instead of a hardcoded max-height.

dz: 元素怎么出现，又怎么退场
de: How things arrive, and how they leave

items.dz: 最基础的透明度渐显
items.de: The plainest opacity fade
items.pz: opacity 0→1，200–300ms，ease-out。
items.pe: opacity 0→1 over 200–300ms with ease-out.

items.dz: 轻轻往上抬一点点出现
items.de: Rises a little as it fades in
items.pz: opacity + translateY(16px)→0，位移别超过 24px。
items.pe: opacity plus translateY(16px)→0; keep the travel under 24px.

items.dz: 从上方落下出现
items.de: Drops in from above
items.pz: translateY(-20px)→0 配合 opacity，常用于顶部通知。
items.pe: translateY(-20px)→0 with opacity — good for top notifications.

items.dz: 从左侧滑入
items.de: Slides in from the left
items.pz: translateX(-32px)→0 + opacity。
items.pe: translateX(-32px)→0 with opacity.

items.dz: 从右侧滑入
items.de: Slides in from the right
items.pz: translateX(32px)→0 + opacity。
items.pe: translateX(32px)→0 with opacity.

items.dz: 由小到大出现
items.de: Grows into place
items.pz: scale(.92)→1 + opacity，起始别小于 .8 否则显廉价。
items.pe: scale(.92)→1 with opacity; starting below .8 looks cheap.

items.dz: 弹出时略微超过再回落
items.de: Overshoots a touch, then settles
items.pz: 用 out-back 缓动 cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)，只过冲一次。
items.pe: out-back easing cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — one overshoot only.

items.dz: 来回抖两下才停
items.de: Wobbles twice before it stops
items.pz: 用多关键帧模拟阻尼振荡，或用 spring 物理动画库。
items.pe: Fake damped oscillation with keyframes, or use a spring physics library.

items.dz: 从模糊里对焦出来
items.de: Focuses out of a blur
items.pz: filter:blur(14px)→0 配合轻微 scale，注意性能开销。
items.pe: filter blur(14px)→0 plus a slight scale; watch the paint cost.

items.dz: 像卷帘一样自下而上露出
items.de: Uncovers upward like a blind
items.pz: clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)→inset(0)。
items.pe: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0).

items.dz: 一块颜色扫过后留下内容
items.de: A color bar sweeps past and leaves the content
items.pz: 覆盖层从左进右出，内容在覆盖层经过时切换可见。
items.pe: An overlay enters left and exits right; the content appears as it passes.

items.dz: 从中心圆形张开
items.de: Opens as a circle from the centre
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0)→circle(75%)。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0) → circle(75%).

items.dz: 上下两条黑边向外拉开
items.de: Two bars pull apart, cinema style
items.pz: clip-path:inset(50% 0)→inset(0)，像电影开幕。
items.pe: clip-path inset(50% 0) → inset(0).

items.dz: 沿水平轴翻转进入
items.de: Flips in around the horizontal axis
items.pz: perspective + rotateX(-90deg)→0，transform-origin 居中。
items.pe: perspective with rotateX(-90deg)→0, origin centred.

items.dz: 沿竖直轴翻转进入
items.de: Flips in around the vertical axis
items.pz: perspective + rotateY(90deg)→0。
items.pe: perspective with rotateY(90deg)→0.

items.dz: 一边转一边出现
items.de: Spins as it appears
items.pz: rotate(-12deg)→0 + scale + opacity，角度要小。
items.pe: rotate(-12deg)→0 with scale and opacity; keep the angle small.

items.dz: 像挂牌一样晃两下
items.de: Swings like a hanging sign
items.pz: transform-origin:top center，rotate 阻尼递减。
items.pe: transform-origin top center with a decaying rotate.

items.dz: 从上方掉下来弹一下
items.de: Falls in and bounces once
items.pz: 下落用 ease-in，触底后 scaleY 压扁再恢复。
items.pe: ease-in on the fall, then a squash on landing.

items.dz: 像折纸一样打开
items.de: Unfolds like paper
items.pz: rotateX(90deg)→0，transform-origin:top，父级 perspective。
items.pe: rotateX(90deg)→0 with origin top and parent perspective.

items.dz: 像镜头猛推上来
items.de: Like a lens punching in
items.pz: scale(1.4)→1 配合 blur 递减，时长要短（<400ms）。
items.pe: scale(1.4)→1 with decreasing blur; keep it under 400ms.

items.dz: 带一点倾斜地冲进来
items.de: Slides in with a lean
items.pz: translateX 与 skewX 同步回零，落定瞬间摆正。
items.pe: translateX and skewX return to zero together.

items.dz: 一组元素依次出现
items.de: A group arrives one after another
items.pz: 每个元素 delay = index × 60~80ms，超过 8 个要压缩间隔。
items.pe: delay = index × 60–80ms; compress the step past eight items.

items.dz: 卡片像发牌一样甩出来
items.de: Cards are dealt onto the table
items.pz: 从同一堆叠位置出发，位移 + 旋转 + delay 展开。
items.pe: All start from one stack, then translate and rotate out with a delay.

items.dz: 边滚边进来
items.de: Rolls in from the side
items.pz: translateX 与 rotate 同步，模拟滚动的物体。
items.pe: translateX paired with rotate to fake rolling.

items.dz: 内容一行一行擦出来
items.de: The content reveals line by line
items.pz: 每行独立 mask 上移，delay 递增。
items.pe: Each row has its own mask sliding up, delayed by index.

items.dz: 安静地消失
items.de: Quietly disappears
items.pz: 出场比入场快 20–30%，用 ease-in。
items.pe: Exit 20–30% faster than the entrance, with ease-in.

items.dz: 往下沉着消失
items.de: Sinks away downward
items.pz: translateY(0→24px) + opacity→0，ease-in。
items.pe: translateY 0→24px with opacity→0, ease-in.

items.dz: 缩小并模糊地散掉
items.de: Shrinks and blurs away
items.pz: scale(1→.88) + blur(0→8px) + opacity→0。
items.pe: scale 1→.88, blur 0→8px, opacity→0.

items.dz: 被吸回原来的按钮位置
items.de: Sucked back into the button it came from
items.pz: 逆向 FLIP：缩放并位移回触发元素的中心。
items.pe: Reverse FLIP: scale and translate back to the trigger centre.

items.dz: 像沙子一样碎掉消失
items.de: Crumbles away like sand
items.pz: 用噪声 mask 配合 mask-position/opacity 动画做溶解。
items.pe: A noise mask animated over mask-position/opacity gives the dissolve.

dz: 从一屏到另一屏之间发生了什么
de: What happens between one screen and the next

items.dz: A 淡出的同时 B 淡入
items.de: A fades out while B fades in
items.pz: 用 View Transitions API 的默认过渡即可，200–300ms。
items.pe: The default View Transitions cross-fade, 200–300ms.

items.dz: B 从右侧盖在 A 上面
items.de: B slides in on top of A
items.pz: 新页 translateX(100%)→0，旧页不动，加一层暗色遮罩。
items.pe: New view translateX(100%)→0 over a static old view plus a scrim.

items.dz: B 把 A 推出屏幕
items.de: B pushes A off screen
items.pz: 两页同速同向位移 100%，像胶片一样连着走。
items.pe: Both views translate 100% at the same speed, like film frames.

items.dz: 旧页轻微后退，新页盖上
items.de: The old view recedes as the new one covers it
items.pz: 旧页 translateX(-30%) + 变暗，新页 translateX(100%)→0。
items.pe: Old view translateX(-30%) and dims; new view slides fully in.

items.dz: A 滑走，露出下面的 B
items.de: A slides away to uncover B
items.pz: B 固定在底层，A 位移出画，注意 z-index。
items.pe: B sits underneath; A translates out. Mind the z-index.

items.dz: 同一个元素跨页连续移动
items.de: One element carries across both views
items.pz: View Transitions 里给两侧同名 view-transition-name。
items.pe: Give both sides the same view-transition-name.

items.dz: 点哪张卡就从哪张放大进去
items.de: The tapped card expands into the detail view
items.pz: 以点击点为 transform-origin 做 scale + 淡入。
items.pe: scale and fade with transform-origin at the click point.

items.dz: 从点击处圆形扩开新页
items.de: The new view opens as a circle from the tap
items.pz: clip-path:circle(0 at 点击点)→circle(150%)。
items.pe: clip-path circle(0 at click) → circle(150%).

items.dz: 画面从中间分开露出新页
items.de: The old view parts down the middle
items.pz: A 用两半 clip-path 向两侧移出。
items.pe: Clip A into two halves and move them apart.

items.dz: 一道斜线扫过换页
items.de: A diagonal edge sweeps the page over
items.pz: 用带角度的 clip-path polygon 做扫除。
items.pe: An angled clip-path polygon does the wipe.

items.dz: 像卡片一样翻到背面
items.de: The whole view flips like a card
items.pz: 容器 perspective，A/B 分别 rotateY 0/180 并隐藏背面。
items.pe: Perspective on the wrapper; A and B at rotateY 0/180 with hidden backfaces.

items.dz: 弹窗从 96% 放大浮现
items.de: The dialog scales up from 96%
items.pz: 遮罩淡入 + 弹窗 scale(.96)→1，退出更快。
items.pe: Scrim fades in; dialog scale(.96)→1. Exit faster than enter.

items.dz: 从底部拉起的半屏面板
items.de: A half-height panel pulled up from the bottom
items.pz: translateY(100%)→0，支持拖拽回落与惯性。
items.pe: translateY(100%)→0, with drag-to-dismiss and momentum.

items.dz: 下划线滑到新标签
items.de: The indicator slides to the new tab
items.pz: 一个共享指示条，用 transform 移动到目标 tab 的位置和宽度。
items.pe: One shared bar, moved and resized with transform to the active tab.

items.dz: 内容换的同时轻微上移
items.de: Panels cross-fade with a small rise
items.pz: 旧内容 fade+下移出，新内容 fade+上移入，错开 60ms。
items.pe: Old panel fades down and out, new one rises in, offset by 60ms.

items.dz: 下一步从右进，上一步从左回
items.de: Next slides in from the right, back returns from the left
items.pz: 记录方向，正反向用同一套动画传入 direction 参数。
items.pe: Track direction and feed it into one shared animation.

items.dz: 换页时轻轻上抬淡入
items.de: Routes fade up gently
items.pz: 页面级过渡 300–360ms，位移别超过 16px。
items.pe: Page-level 300–360ms, travel under 16px.

items.dz: 中间闪过一块品牌色再进新页
items.de: A brand-color panel bridges the two views
items.pz: 色块从下方覆盖再撤走，两段动画之间切换路由。
items.pe: A panel covers, the route swaps behind it, then it leaves.

items.dz: 点击的行原地长成整页
items.de: The tapped row grows into the full page
items.pz: 行的 rect 作为起点，FLIP 到详情页的 rect。
items.pe: Use the row rect as the FLIP origin for the detail page.

items.dz: 当前卡甩出，下一张顶上来
items.de: The top card flies out and the next steps up
items.pz: 甩出用 translateX + rotate，下层卡 scale 从 .94 到 1。
items.pe: Fling with translateX + rotate; the card below scales .94 → 1.

items.dz: 一个收起、另一个同时展开
items.de: One collapses exactly as the other opens
items.pz: 两段动画共用时长，收起用 ease-in、展开用 ease-out。
items.pe: Shared duration; ease-in on the collapse, ease-out on the open.

items.dz: 旧页虚掉，新页对焦
items.de: The old view blurs out, the new one focuses
items.pz: A blur+scale 放大淡出，B blur→0 缩回，营造纵深。
items.pe: A blurs and scales up out; B focuses and scales down in.

items.dz: 上下两块向外拉开
items.de: Two halves pull apart top and bottom
items.pz: 两个覆盖层分别向上下移出，中间露出内容。
items.pe: Two covers move out vertically, exposing the content.

items.dz: 旧页缩小退到后面
items.de: The old view shrinks back into depth
items.pz: A scale(.9)+圆角+变暗，B 从底部升起。
items.pe: A scales to .9 with rounded corners and dims; B rises from below.

items.dz: 换页时先出骨架再填内容
items.de: A skeleton bridges the wait before content lands
items.pz: 路由切换先渲染 skeleton，数据到位后交叉淡入。
items.pe: Render the skeleton on navigation, cross-fade when data lands.

items.dz: 状态切换用短淡入淡出表达连续性，不隐藏内容。
items.de: Use a short crossfade to express continuity without hiding content.
items.pz: 状态切换用短淡入淡出表达连续性，不隐藏内容。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Use a short crossfade to express continuity without hiding content. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 路由切换保留标题和焦点上下文，失败时不留空白。
items.de: Keep title and focus context through route transitions.
items.pz: 路由切换保留标题和焦点上下文，失败时不留空白。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep title and focus context through route transitions. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 共享元素保持身份连续，尺寸变化不遮挡操作。
items.de: Keep shared identity without covering actions during resize.
items.pz: 共享元素保持身份连续，尺寸变化不遮挡操作。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep shared identity without covering actions during resize. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 共享元素命名稳定，列表重排不产生错误配对。
items.de: Use stable names so reorders do not pair the wrong elements.
items.pz: 共享元素命名稳定，列表重排不产生错误配对。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Use stable names so reorders do not pair the wrong elements. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 进入动画从可解释的空间起点开始，减少方向迷惑。
items.de: Enter from an understandable spatial origin.
items.pz: 进入动画从可解释的空间起点开始，减少方向迷惑。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Enter from an understandable spatial origin. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 退出方向与进入方向成对，用户知道内容去了哪里。
items.de: Pair exit direction with entry direction.
items.pz: 退出方向与进入方向成对，用户知道内容去了哪里。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Pair exit direction with entry direction. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 高度过渡处理内容变化和测量，避免跳动和裁切。
items.de: Measure content changes without jumps or clipping.
items.pz: 高度过渡处理内容变化和测量，避免跳动和裁切。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Measure content changes without jumps or clipping. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 折叠后内容不可聚焦，动画完成状态与语义同步。
items.de: Collapsed content is unfocusable and semantics match completion.
items.pz: 折叠后内容不可聚焦，动画完成状态与语义同步。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Collapsed content is unfocusable and semantics match completion. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 展开时焦点和屏幕阅读顺序保持稳定。
items.de: Keep focus and reading order stable while expanding.
items.pz: 展开时焦点和屏幕阅读顺序保持稳定。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep focus and reading order stable while expanding. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 筛选结果变化保留用户视线，不把项目随机推开。
items.de: Keep visual context when filter results change.
items.pz: 筛选结果变化保留用户视线，不把项目随机推开。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep visual context when filter results change. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 排序只移动变化项目并保留当前选中项。
items.de: Move changed items while preserving selection.
items.pz: 排序只移动变化项目并保留当前选中项。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Move changed items while preserving selection. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 分页切换更新范围和焦点，不用动画掩盖数据变化。
items.de: Update range and focus without masking data changes.
items.pz: 分页切换更新范围和焦点，不用动画掩盖数据变化。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Update range and focus without masking data changes. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 抽屉过渡配合焦点锁定和背景遮罩。
items.de: Coordinate drawer motion with focus lock and scrim.
items.pz: 抽屉过渡配合焦点锁定和背景遮罩。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Coordinate drawer motion with focus lock and scrim. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 对话框打开关闭顺序清楚，关闭后回到触发点。
items.de: Keep dialog order clear and return focus to the trigger.
items.pz: 对话框打开关闭顺序清楚，关闭后回到触发点。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep dialog order clear and return focus to the trigger. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 弹出层根据翻转方向调整起点，不从错误方向飞入。
items.de: Adjust origin when placement flips.
items.pz: 弹出层根据翻转方向调整起点，不从错误方向飞入。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Adjust origin when placement flips. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 提示过渡短且可取消，键盘出现不延迟。
items.de: Keep tooltip motion short and immediate on keyboard focus.
items.pz: 提示过渡短且可取消，键盘出现不延迟。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep tooltip motion short and immediate on keyboard focus. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: Toast 进出不挤压页面，多个消息有稳定队列。
items.de: Toast motion does not reflow the page and queues predictably.
items.pz: Toast 进出不挤压页面，多个消息有稳定队列。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Toast motion does not reflow the page and queues predictably. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 新增项明确插入位置和原因，不制造跳跃。
items.de: Show insertion position and reason.
items.pz: 新增项明确插入位置和原因，不制造跳跃。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。

items.dz: 拖放结束后项目回到正确轨道并保留焦点。

items.pz: 拖放结束后项目回到正确轨道并保留焦点。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。

items.dz: 滚动揭示只用于辅助层次，内容不依赖动画才能看见。
