items.pe: Use scroll reveal for hierarchy, never for essential content. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 粘性标题切换时不闪烁且不遮挡锚点。
items.de: Keep sticky headers stable without covering anchors.
items.pz: 粘性标题切换时不闪烁且不遮挡锚点。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep sticky headers stable without covering anchors. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 视差限制距离和速度，并在 reduced-motion 下静态化。
items.de: Bound parallax distance and speed with static fallback.
items.pz: 视差限制距离和速度，并在 reduced-motion 下静态化。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Bound parallax distance and speed with static fallback. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 惯性滚动不干扰点击、焦点和页面滚动。
items.de: Keep inertial motion from interfering with click and focus.
items.pz: 惯性滚动不干扰点击、焦点和页面滚动。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep inertial motion from interfering with click and focus. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 手势跟手，取消时回弹到明确状态。
items.de: Keep gesture motion attached and settle clearly on cancel.
items.pz: 手势跟手，取消时回弹到明确状态。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Keep gesture motion attached and settle clearly on cancel. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 新操作可以中断旧动画并从当前值继续。
items.de: New actions interrupt and continue from current value.
items.pz: 新操作可以中断旧动画并从当前值继续。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: New actions interrupt and continue from current value. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 取消不触发完成事件或错误副作用。
items.de: Cancellation does not fire completion side effects.
items.pz: 取消不触发完成事件或错误副作用。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Cancellation does not fire completion side effects. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 过渡中的标签、提示和状态完全跟随语言。
items.de: Labels, tips, and states during transitions follow locale.
items.pz: 过渡中的标签、提示和状态完全跟随语言。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Labels, tips, and states during transitions follow locale. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 主题切换不让过渡闪现错误颜色或字体。
items.de: Theme switches do not flash wrong colors or fonts.
items.pz: 主题切换不让过渡闪现错误颜色或字体。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Theme switches do not flash wrong colors or fonts. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

items.dz: 发布前检查中断、焦点、性能、reduced-motion 和语言。
items.de: Audit interruption, focus, performance, reduced motion, and locale.
items.pz: 发布前检查中断、焦点、性能、reduced-motion 和语言。 在快速操作、键盘、移动端和减少动效下复核。
items.pe: Audit interruption, focus, performance, reduced motion, and locale. Validate rapid actions, keyboard, mobile, and reduced motion.

dz: 同样的位移，快慢曲线决定气质
de: Same move — the curve decides the character

items.dz: 机械、没有生命感
items.de: Mechanical, lifeless
items.pz: linear 只适合无限循环（旋转、跑马灯），别用在 UI 位移上。
items.pe: linear suits endless loops (spinners, tickers) — not UI movement.

items.dz: 浏览器默认，安全但平庸
items.de: The browser default — safe, unremarkable
items.pz: ease = cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1)，够用但没有性格。
items.pe: ease = cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1): fine, but characterless.

items.dz: 起步慢、越走越快，适合退场
items.de: Starts slow, speeds up — good for exits
items.pz: 元素离开画面时用 ease-in，符合“加速离去”的直觉。
items.pe: Use ease-in when something leaves the screen.

items.dz: 冲出来再稳稳停下，适合入场
items.de: Bursts in and settles — the entrance curve
items.pz: 90% 的界面动效都应该是 ease-out，元素进入要“到位即停”。
items.pe: Most UI motion should be ease-out: arrive fast, land softly.

items.dz: 两头慢中间快，适合往返
items.de: Slow at both ends — good for round trips
items.pz: 用于同一元素在两个状态间来回，比如开关、折叠。
items.pe: For elements moving between two states, like toggles.

items.dz: 非常干脆的减速，高级感
items.de: A very decisive deceleration — feels expensive
items.pz: cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)，Savimbo 的默认曲线。
items.pe: cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) — the house curve.

items.dz: 开头极快，尾巴极长
items.de: Explosive start, very long tail
items.pz: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)，适合大位移的入场。
items.pe: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) — good for large entrances.

items.dz: 冲过头一点再退回来
items.de: Overshoots, then pulls back
items.pz: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)，只用于小元素、小幅度。
items.pe: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — small elements, small amounts.

items.dz: 先后撤一点再出发
items.de: Pulls back before it goes
items.pz: 起手反向 8–10%，动画立刻有了重量。
items.pe: A reverse of 8–10% at the start gives the move weight.

items.dz: 来回振荡逐渐停住
items.de: Oscillates and damps out
items.pz: 用物理弹簧（stiffness/damping）而不是固定时长，交互跟手。
items.pe: Physical spring (stiffness/damping) instead of a fixed duration.

items.dz: 夸张的弹性，卡通感
items.de: Exaggerated elasticity — cartoon energy
items.pz: 振幅大、频率高，慎用，只适合玩具型产品。
items.pe: High amplitude and frequency — reserve it for playful products.

items.dz: 掉下来弹几下
items.de: Drops and bounces a few times
items.pz: 每次弹跳高度衰减 40–50%，触底压扁一帧。
items.pe: Each bounce loses 40–50% height, with a squash at contact.

items.dz: 一格一格跳，像秒针
items.de: Jumps frame by frame, like a second hand
items.pz: steps(n) 用于精灵图、打字机、秒表。
items.pe: steps(n) is for sprite sheets, typewriters, tickers.

items.dz: 同一曲线，快慢完全两种性格
items.de: Same curve, two totally different personalities
items.pz: 微交互 120ms、常规 200–300ms、页面级 360–500ms。
items.pe: Micro 120ms, standard 200–300ms, page-level 360–500ms.

items.dz: 一个接一个地启动
items.de: Each one starts after the last
items.pz: delay = index × 步长，步长 50–90ms 最舒服。
items.pe: delay = index × step, 50–90ms feels best.

items.dz: 后一个动作在前一个结束前就开始
items.de: The next move starts before the last one ends
items.pz: 相邻动画重叠 30–50%，整体更连贯不拖沓。
items.pe: Overlap neighbouring animations by 30–50% to keep it fluid.

items.dz: 主体停了，附属还在动
items.de: The body stops, the trailing part keeps going
items.pz: 子元素比父元素晚 60–120ms 停，动画立刻有质感。
items.pe: Let children settle 60–120ms after the parent.

items.dz: 主动作之外的一点点附加运动
items.de: A small extra motion riding on the main one
items.pz: 主体位移时给内部元素反向微移，制造惯性。
items.pe: Counter-move the contents slightly to fake inertia.

items.dz: 越快越斜，停下就正
items.de: Faster means more lean; it straightens on stop
items.pz: 把速度映射到 skewX，速度归零时角度归零。
items.pe: Map velocity onto skewX; zero velocity, zero angle.

items.dz: 来回摆动不间断
items.de: Swings back and forth forever
items.pz: animation-direction:alternate，别用两段动画拼。
items.pe: Use animation-direction:alternate rather than two chained animations.

items.dz: 动一下、停一会儿、再动
items.de: Move, hold, move again
items.pz: 在关键帧里留 30–40% 的静止段，比加 delay 更可控。
items.pe: Hold for 30–40% of the keyframes instead of adding a delay.

items.dz: 沿一条曲线走，而不是直线
items.de: Follows a curve rather than a straight line
items.pz: CSS offset-path:path(...) + offset-distance 动画。
items.pe: CSS offset-path:path(...) animated via offset-distance.

items.dz: 系统开了“减弱动效”就只留淡入
items.de: With reduced-motion on, keep only a fade
items.pz: @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){动画时长设为 .01ms 或只留 opacity}。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop to opacity-only or 0.01ms.

items.dz: 从一角扩散到整个网格
items.de: Ripples across a grid from one corner
items.pz: delay 由行列距离决定（曼哈顿距离或欧氏距离）。
items.pe: Delay from grid distance — Manhattan or Euclidean.

items.dz: 多个元素按剧本先后出场
items.de: Several elements enter on a script
items.pz: 用时间线工具（GSAP timeline / Web Animations）统一编排，别各写各的 delay。
items.pe: Use a timeline (GSAP / WAAPI) instead of scattering delays.

dz: 有质量、有阻尼、有摩擦，动效才可信
de: Mass, damping and friction are what make motion believable

items.dz: 过冲一点再回来
items.de: It overshoots, then settles
items.pz: 刚度 / 阻尼 / 质量三参数，别用固定时长曲线硬凑。
items.pe: Stiffness, damping, mass — not a fixed-duration curve.

items.dz: 摆动越来越小
items.de: The swing keeps shrinking
items.pz: 每次振幅乘 0.5–0.6，三次以内必须停。
items.pe: Multiply amplitude by 0.5–0.6; stop within three cycles.

items.dz: 落地压扁、起跳拉长
items.de: Squash on impact, stretch on launch
items.pz: 体积守恒：scaleX 与 scaleY 互为倒数。
items.pe: Conserve volume — scaleX and scaleY are reciprocals.

items.dz: 弹几次高度递减
items.de: Each bounce is lower
items.pz: 每次弹起约为上次的 45%，间隔也随之变短。
items.pe: Each bounce ≈45% of the last, with shorter gaps.

items.dz: 越掉越快
items.de: It falls faster and faster
items.pz: 位移 ∝ t²，用 ease-in（cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,1)）近似。
items.pe: Displacement ∝ t² — approximate with a strong ease-in.

items.dz: 两端慢、中间快
items.de: Slow at the ends, fast in the middle
items.pz: 钟摆用 sine 缓动（in-out），不能用匀速。
items.pe: A pendulum is sine-eased in and out, never linear.

items.dz: 停下时还往前滑一点
items.de: It slides on after you let go
items.pz: 松手速度 × 摩擦系数逐帧衰减，低于阈值归零。
items.pe: Decay release velocity by friction each frame.

items.dz: 后面的元素慢一拍
items.de: The trailing element lags
items.pz: lerp 系数 0.1–0.2，越小越黏。
items.pe: A lerp factor of 0.1–0.2 — smaller feels heavier.

items.dz: 一串跟着头部摆
items.de: A chain follows its head
items.pz: 每节延迟 60ms、幅度递增，形成鞭状。
items.pe: Delay each link 60ms with growing amplitude.

items.dz: 像果冻一样晃
items.de: It wobbles like jelly
items.pz: skewX 与 skewY 交替衰减，别用 scale。
items.pe: Alternate decaying skewX and skewY — not scale.

items.dz: 被拉长再弹回
items.de: Stretched, then snapped back
items.pz: 拉伸方向与运动方向一致，回弹要快。
items.pe: Stretch along the motion vector; snap back fast.

items.dz: 靠近就被吸住
items.de: It gets caught
items.pz: 进入阈值后用 spring 快速吸附，别线性。
items.pe: Inside the threshold, spring in — never linear.

items.dz: 撞上去把力传下去
items.de: The impact travels through
items.pz: 前一个停住的瞬间下一个启动，节奏差 40ms。
items.pe: The next starts as the previous stops — 40ms apart.

items.dz: 两头交替摆动
items.de: The ends take turns
items.pz: 中间几颗完全不动，这才是牛顿摆的关键。
items.pe: The middle balls must not move at all.

items.dz: 慢慢磨到停
items.de: It grinds to a halt
items.pz: 摩擦是线性衰减，与惯性的指数衰减不同。
items.pe: Friction decays linearly — inertia decays exponentially.

items.dz: 走多远就转多少
items.de: Distance equals rotation
items.pz: 旋转角 = 位移 / 半径，不同步就像在滑。
items.pe: Angle = distance / radius, or it looks like sliding.

items.dz: 重的慢、轻的快
items.de: Heavy is slow, light is quick
items.pz: 质量差异用时长 + 过冲量表达，别只改速度。
items.pe: Express mass with duration and overshoot, not speed alone.

items.dz: 先反向一点再出发
items.de: A tiny wind-up first
items.pz: 反向 8–12% 幅度，时长占总时长 15%。
items.pe: Wind back 8–12% for about 15% of the duration.

items.dz: 主体停了附件还在动
items.de: The body stops, the parts keep going
items.pz: 附属元素延后 60–120ms 停止，动画才不僵。
items.pe: Let secondary parts settle 60–120ms later.

items.dz: 不走直线走弧线
items.de: It curves instead of going straight
items.pz: 真实物体几乎不走直线，X 与 Y 用不同缓动。
items.pe: Real things arc — give X and Y different easings.

items.dz: 一个还没停下一个已开始
items.de: The next starts before the last ends
items.pz: 错峰 60–80ms 是重叠，超过 200ms 就成排队。
items.pe: 60–80ms overlaps; past 200ms it reads as a queue.

items.dz: 最后 2px 的收敛
items.de: The last two pixels
items.pz: 收尾的小幅回弹是“质感”的来源，幅度 1–3px。
items.pe: That 1–3px settle is where quality lives.

items.dz: 横向摇两下
items.de: Two quick shakes
items.pz: 幅度 ≤6px、频率两个来回、300ms 结束。
items.pe: Under 6px, two cycles, done in 300ms.

items.dz: 两下一停的节奏
items.de: Two beats, then a rest
items.pz: 双峰节奏（快-快-停）比单次脉冲更像生命。
items.pe: A double beat reads alive; a single pulse reads mechanical.

items.dz: 缓慢均匀地胀缩
items.de: Slow, even swelling
items.pz: 4s 一次、幅度 3–5%，超过就成了脉冲。
items.pe: One 4s cycle at 3–5% — more becomes a pulse.

items.dz: 像硬币快停时的晃
items.de: Like a coin about to settle
items.pz: 频率递增、幅度递减，是“将停”的关键。
items.pe: Frequency up, amplitude down — that is “about to stop”.

items.dz: 一串依次弹进来
items.de: They spring in one after another
items.pz: 每项相同曲线、不同延迟，才有“一队”的感觉。
items.pe: Same curve, different delay — that is what makes a queue.

items.dz: 有人不想看动画
items.de: Some people want it still
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion 下只保留淡入，不做位移与缩放。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion keep the fade, drop the movement.

dz: 效果跟着滚动条走（请在画布里滚动）
de: Effects tied to the scrollbar — scroll inside the stage

items.dz: 滚到才淡入上浮，最常用的一种
items.de: Blocks fade up as they scroll into view
items.pz: 用 IntersectionObserver 加类，或 CSS animation-timeline:view() 做进入动画。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver toggling a class, or CSS animation-timeline:view().

items.dz: 出现过就不再重播，避免晕眩
items.de: Plays once and stays — no re-triggering
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 触发后 unobserve，状态写进 dataset。
items.pe: Unobserve after the first intersection and record it on the dataset.

items.dz: 背景比前景滚得慢
items.de: The background scrolls slower than the foreground
items.pz: 按滚动进度给不同层不同的 translateY 速率（0.2×~0.6×）。
items.pe: Give each layer a different translateY rate against scroll (0.2×–0.6×).

items.dz: 图片随滚动缓缓放大
items.de: The image slowly scales as you scroll
items.pz: 滚动进度映射到 scale(1→1.15)，容器 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: Map scroll progress to scale(1→1.15) inside an overflow-hidden frame.

items.dz: 顶部一条随滚动增长的线
items.de: A top bar that grows with the scroll
items.pz: scaleX 绑定 scroll() 时间线，transform-origin:left。
items.pe: scaleX bound to scroll() timeline with transform-origin left.

items.dz: 头部滚动时变矮变紧凑
items.de: The header compresses as you scroll
items.pz: position:sticky + 滚动进度驱动高度/字号，或滚过阈值加类。
items.pe: Sticky header plus scroll progress driving height/size, or a class past a threshold.

items.dz: 卡片一张叠一张停住
items.de: Cards stack up and pin one over another
items.pz: 每张卡 position:sticky;top 递增，配合轻微 scale 做纵深。
items.pe: Each card sticky with an increasing top offset plus a small scale for depth.

items.dz: 内容钉住不动，里面继续演变
items.de: The section pins while its contents keep changing
items.pz: GSAP ScrollTrigger 的 pin，或 sticky 容器 + 高度撑开。
items.pe: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, or a sticky child inside a tall spacer.

items.dz: 纵向滚动带动横向移动
items.de: Vertical scrolling drives horizontal travel
items.pz: 钉住外层，把滚动进度映射为内层 translateX。
items.pe: Pin the wrapper and map scroll progress onto the inner translateX.

items.dz: 一屏一屏地停住
items.de: Each block snaps into place
items.pz: 容器 scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，子项 scroll-snap-align:center。
items.pe: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory on the scroller, scroll-snap-align on the items.

items.dz: 文字随滚动由灰变黑
items.de: Copy brightens from grey to black as it passes
items.pz: 按滚动进度改变 color / opacity，可逐词做。
items.pe: Drive color/opacity from scroll progress, optionally per word.

items.dz: 物体随滚动持续旋转
items.de: An object rotates as long as you scroll
items.pz: rotate 绑定 scroll() 进度，适合装饰元素。
items.pe: Bind rotate to scroll() progress — good for decorative objects.

items.dz: 数字滚到视口才开始跳动
items.de: The number starts counting when it enters view
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 触发 requestAnimationFrame 计数，缓出。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver kicks off a rAF counter with an ease-out curve.

items.dz: 往下滚导航收起，往上滚回来
items.de: Nav hides scrolling down, returns scrolling up
items.pz: 比较上一次 scrollY 判断方向，切换 translateY(-100%)。
items.pe: Compare the previous scrollY for direction and toggle translateY(-100%).

items.dz: 滚到不同区块背景色渐变
items.de: The page tint changes section by section
items.pz: 每个 section 记录目标色，进入视口时过渡 body 背景。
items.pe: Each section carries a target color; transition the page background on enter.

items.dz: 一条竖线随滚动画下来
items.de: A vertical line draws itself as you scroll
items.pz: scaleY 或 SVG stroke-dashoffset 绑定滚动进度。
items.pe: Bind scaleY or SVG stroke-dashoffset to scroll progress.

items.dz: 离视口中心越远越模糊
items.de: The further from centre, the blurrier
items.pz: 把与视口中心的距离映射为 blur 值。
items.pe: Map distance from viewport centre onto the blur radius.

items.dz: 钉住时画面推近
items.de: The frame pushes in while pinned
items.pz: 钉住区间内把进度映射到 scale，退出时解钉。
items.pe: Within the pinned range map progress to scale, then unpin.

items.dz: 滚得越快横条跑得越快
items.de: The ticker speeds up with your scrolling
items.pz: 记录滚动速度，映射到 marquee 的播放速率或 skew。
items.pe: Track scroll velocity and map it to the ticker rate or a skew.

items.dz: 右侧圆点标出当前区块
items.de: Dots mark which section you are in
items.pz: IntersectionObserver 判断当前 section，高亮对应圆点。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver picks the active section and highlights its dot.

items.dz: 侧栏跟随，主内容继续滚
items.de: The sidebar follows while content scrolls on
items.pz: position:sticky;top:24px，父级不要 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: position:sticky with a top offset; the parent must not clip overflow.

items.dz: 数据条随滚动长出来
items.de: Data bars grow as they enter view
items.pz: 进入视口后 scaleX/height 由 0 到目标值，带 stagger。
items.pe: On enter, animate scaleX/height from 0 with a stagger.

items.dz: 色块划过后露出图片
items.de: A color panel slides off to expose the image
items.pz: 覆盖层随滚动 translateX 移出，露出下面内容。
items.pe: The overlay translates away as scroll progresses.

items.dz: 不同卡片以不同速度掠过
items.de: Cards drift past at different speeds
items.pz: 给每个元素不同的视差系数，形成层次。
items.pe: Give each element its own parallax factor.

items.dz: 滚到底部按钮升起来
items.de: The button rises once you reach the bottom
items.pz: 监听滚动到底（或最后一个哨兵元素进入视口）再显示。
items.pe: Watch for a sentinel at the bottom entering view, then reveal.

dz: 鼠标碰到时的反馈（请把鼠标移上去）
de: Feedback on hover — move your cursor over the demo

items.dz: 卡片微微升起、影子变深
items.de: The card lifts and its shadow deepens
items.pz: translateY(-4px) + 阴影加深，200–280ms。
items.pe: translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow over 200–280ms.

items.dz: 卡片跟着鼠标方向倾斜
items.de: The card tips toward your cursor
items.pz: 按鼠标在卡内的相对位置计算 rotateX/rotateY，父级 perspective。
items.pe: Map cursor position inside the card to rotateX/rotateY under a perspective parent.

items.dz: 边缘泛起一圈柔光
items.de: A soft halo blooms at the edge
items.pz: box-shadow 用品牌色低透明度大扩散，别用 filter:blur。
items.pe: A wide, low-opacity brand-color box-shadow — not filter:blur.

items.dz: 边框沿四周画出来
items.de: The border draws itself around the box
items.pz: 两个伪元素各画两条边，用 scaleX/scaleY 顺序展开。
items.pe: Two pseudo-elements draw two edges each, scaling in sequence.

items.dz: 边框上的光一直在转
items.de: Light keeps travelling around the border
items.pz: conic-gradient 背景 + 内层遮罩留出 1–2px 边，旋转角度。
items.pe: A conic-gradient background masked by an inner panel, with the angle animating.

items.dz: 颜色从左扫满按钮
items.de: Color sweeps across the button
items.pz: 伪元素 scaleX(0)→1，transform-origin 悬停时左、离开时右。
items.pe: Pseudo-element scaleX(0)→1; origin left on enter, right on leave.

items.dz: 悬停时箭头往前挪一格
items.de: The arrow nudges forward on hover
items.pz: 只位移箭头（4–6px），文字不动，短促 180ms。
items.pe: Move only the arrow 4–6px in 180ms; the label stays put.

items.dz: 框不动，里面的图放大
items.de: The frame holds still while the image grows
items.pz: 外框 overflow:hidden，内图 scale(1.06)，400ms。
items.pe: Overflow-hidden frame, inner image scale(1.06) over 400ms.

items.dz: 悬停时底部滑出说明
items.de: A caption slides up from the bottom
items.pz: 覆盖层 translateY(100%)→0，带渐变遮罩保证文字可读。
items.pe: Overlay translateY(100%)→0 with a gradient scrim for legibility.

items.dz: 鼠标位置亮起一团光
items.de: A soft light follows the cursor
items.pz: 把鼠标坐标写进 CSS 变量，radial-gradient 跟着变位置。
items.pe: Write cursor coords into CSS vars and position a radial-gradient with them.

items.dz: 按下去有真实的下沉感
items.de: Real depression on press
items.pz: active 时 translateY(1px) + 内阴影，松开回弹要快。
items.pe: On :active translateY(1px) with an inset shadow; release fast.

items.dz: 点击处扩散一圈波纹
items.de: A ripple spreads from the click point
items.pz: 在点击坐标插入一个圆并 scale+fade，动画结束移除。
items.pe: Insert a circle at the click point, scale + fade it, then remove.

items.dz: 黑白对调
items.de: Black and white swap
items.pz: 同时过渡 background 与 color，保持 4.5:1 对比。
items.pe: Transition background and color together, keeping 4.5:1 contrast.

items.dz: 被按住时轻微缩小
items.de: Shrinks slightly while held
items.pz: :active 时 scale(.96)，别超过 .94 否则廉价。
items.pe: scale(.96) on :active; below .94 starts to look cheap.

items.dz: 影子变大变虚，元素不动
items.de: The shadow grows softer without moving the element
items.pz: 只过渡 box-shadow 的模糊与扩散半径。
items.pe: Transition only the shadow blur and spread.

items.dz: 悬停一张，其他张变淡
items.de: Hovering one card dims the others
items.pz: 父级 :hover 时给所有子项降透明度，被 hover 的恢复。
items.pe: On parent hover dim all children; restore the hovered one.

items.dz: 悬停时照片恢复颜色
items.de: The photo regains its color on hover
items.pz: filter:grayscale(1)→0，400ms，配合轻微亮度提升。
items.pe: filter grayscale(1)→0 over 400ms with a small brightness bump.

items.dz: 悬停时标签整行换掉
items.de: The label rolls over to a second one
items.pz: 两行文字上下排列，容器高度固定，hover 时 translateY(-100%)。
items.pe: Two stacked labels in a fixed-height slot, translateY(-100%) on hover.

items.dz: 打钩时线条被画出来
items.de: The tick draws itself
items.pz: SVG path 的 stroke-dashoffset 从满到 0。
items.pe: Animate an SVG path stroke-dashoffset from full to zero.

items.dz: 滑块滑到另一端并变色
items.de: The knob slides across and the track recolors
items.pz: 轨道背景色 + 滑块 translateX 同步过渡，200ms。
items.pe: Track color and knob translateX transition together in 200ms.

items.dz: 收藏时星星填色并弹一下
items.de: The star fills and pops
items.pz: 颜色过渡 + 一次 scale 过冲，可加细碎粒子。
items.pe: Color transition plus one scale overshoot; optional sparkle particles.

items.dz: 点完变成“已复制”
items.de: The button turns into “Copied”
items.pz: 文案与图标切换 + 1.5s 后自动回退，别用弹窗。
items.pe: Swap label and icon, revert after 1.5s — no modal needed.

items.dz: 折叠箭头转 180 度
items.de: The chevron flips 180°
items.pz: rotate(180deg) 过渡，与内容展开同时长同缓动。
items.pe: rotate(180deg) matching the panel’s duration and easing.

items.dz: 悬停 400ms 后浮出提示
items.de: A tip floats up after a 400ms delay
items.pz: 给显示加 transition-delay，隐藏不加，避免闪烁。
items.pe: Delay on show, none on hide, so it does not flicker.

items.dz: 鼠标靠近时按钮被吸过去
items.de: The button leans toward the cursor
items.pz: 监听 mousemove，按距离把按钮位移 6–12px，离开回弹。
items.pe: On mousemove translate the button 6–12px toward the pointer; spring back on leave.

items.dz: 灰条被真实内容替换
items.de: Grey bars give way to real content
items.pz: 内容淡入时骨架淡出，两者高度一致避免跳动。
items.pe: Cross-fade with matching heights so nothing jumps.

items.dz: 数字角标弹一下提醒
items.de: The count badge pops
items.pz: scale(0)→1 用 out-back，数值变化时再弹一次。
items.pe: scale(0)→1 with out-back; re-pop whenever the value changes.

items.dz: 键盘选中时的清晰外圈
items.de: A crisp ring for keyboard focus
items.pz: 用 :focus-visible + outline-offset，别删掉默认焦点样式。
items.pe: Use :focus-visible with outline-offset — never remove focus styles.

items.dz: 下划线从左进、从右出
items.de: The underline enters left and exits right
items.pz: 进入与离开切换 transform-origin，是细节感的关键。
items.pe: Swap transform-origin between enter and leave — that is the detail.

items.pz: 自绘光标元素跟随 mousemove，hover 目标时 scale 放大。
items.pe: A custom cursor element follows mousemove and scales up over targets.

items.dz: 外圈慢一拍跟上来
items.de: The ring lags a beat behind
items.pz: 外圈用 lerp 0.15 跟随，内点即时，差速就是质感。
items.pe: Lerp the ring at 0.15 while the dot is instant.

items.dz: 悬停可点元素时变大
items.de: It swells over anything clickable
items.pz: 进入可点区域放大到 2.5×并降透明度。
items.pe: Scale to 2.5× and lower the alpha over targets.

items.dz: 光标里写着“查看”
items.de: “View” written in the cursor
items.pz: 文字随光标移动，进入时 scale + fade 一起。
items.pe: The label rides the cursor, scaling and fading in together.

items.dz: 靠近按钮就被吸住
items.de: It gets caught by the button
items.pz: 进入吸附半径后光标贴合元素形状。
items.pe: Inside the radius, the cursor morphs to the target shape.

items.dz: 经过深色就自动反白
items.de: It inverts over dark areas
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:difference，一层解决所有底色。
items.pe: mix-blend-mode:difference handles every background.

items.dz: 两条线跟着指针延伸
items.de: Two lines track the pointer
items.pz: 图表取值、地图定位常用，线要 1px 且半透明。
items.pe: For charts and maps — 1px and semi-transparent.

items.dz: 指针周围亮一圈
items.de: A pool of light round the pointer
items.pz: 径向渐变随指针，半径 160–240px，强度别超 16%。
items.pe: A 160–240px radial that stays under 16% alpha.

items.dz: 整块跟着指针歪
items.de: The block leans with the pointer
items.pz: 把指针相对中心归一化到 -1..1 再乘最大角度。
items.pe: Normalise the pointer offset to −1..1, then scale by max angle.

items.dz: 几层按不同幅度反向移动
items.de: Layers counter-move at different rates
items.pz: 越靠前系数越大，背景层可以只动 2–4px。
items.pe: Bigger factor for nearer layers; the background only needs 2–4px.

items.dz: 悬停露出下一层内容
items.de: Hover reveals what is behind
items.pz: 露出区域跟随指针，用遮罩而不是移动内容。
items.pe: Move the mask, not the content.

items.dz: 按得越重反应越强
items.de: Harder press, stronger response
items.pz: PointerEvent.pressure 映射到缩放或颜色深度。
items.pe: Map PointerEvent.pressure onto scale or ink density.

items.dz: 笔尖角度改变笔画
items.de: Tilt changes the stroke
items.pz: tiltX/tiltY 控制笔刷宽高比，是绘图应用的基础。
items.pe: tiltX/tiltY set the nib aspect — the drawing-app basic.

items.dz: 路过不算，停下才算
items.de: Passing through does not count
items.pz: 停留 120–200ms 才触发，避免菜单乱闪。
items.pe: Require 120–200ms of dwell before opening.

items.dz: 从点击点扩散
items.de: It spreads from where you clicked
items.pz: 涟漪要落在点击坐标，动画结束后立刻移除节点。
items.pe: Origin at the click point; remove the node when it ends.

items.dz: 第一次点提示要双击
items.de: The first click says “again”
items.pz: 双击不可发现，必须有一次性提示或右键菜单兜底。
items.pe: Double-click is undiscoverable — give a hint or a menu.

items.dz: 选中文字的底色
items.de: The colour of selected text
items.pz: ::selection 用品牌色的浅色版本，注意对比度。
items.pe: Use a pale brand tint in ::selection and check contrast.

items.dz: 输入光标也能是品牌色
items.de: Even the caret can be brand
items.pz: caret-color 一行搞定，但别用低对比色。
items.pe: caret-color is one line — just keep it visible.

items.dz: grab 变 grabbing
items.de: grab becomes grabbing
items.pz: 按下瞬间换成 grabbing，松手才回 grab。
items.pe: Swap to grabbing on pointerdown, back on release.

items.dz: 角上的小三角
items.de: The little corner grip
items.pz: 手柄点击区要 ≥16px，光标用 nwse-resize。
items.pe: A ≥16px hit area with the nwse-resize cursor.

items.dz: 光标消失只留位移
items.de: The cursor vanishes; only motion remains
items.pz: 游戏与 3D 视角用，必须提供退出提示（Esc）。
items.pe: For games and 3D — always show how to exit (Esc).

items.dz: 局部放大跟随指针
items.de: A magnifier follows the pointer
items.pz: 镜片内用更大的 background-size，位置反向偏移。
items.pe: Inside the lens use a bigger background-size, offset inversely.

items.dz: 还没碰到就有反应
items.de: It responds before you arrive
items.pz: 按距离插值，比 hover 更早给出反馈。
items.pe: Interpolate by distance — feedback before hover.

items.dz: 换成一个图形
items.de: Replace it with a graphic
items.pz: cursor:url() 必须给 fallback，尺寸不超过 32px。
items.pe: cursor:url() needs a fallback and should stay under 32px.

items.dz: 看起来小、点起来大
items.de: Looks small, taps big
items.pz: 视觉 24px、热区 44px，用伪元素扩大。
items.pe: 24px visual, 44px hit area via a pseudo-element.

items.dz: 按住一会儿弹出操作
items.de: Hold to open actions
items.pz: 长按 500ms + 触觉反馈，期间显示进度环。
items.pe: 500ms hold with haptics and a progress ring.

dz: 跟手才叫直接操作
de: Direct manipulation means it tracks your finger

items.dz: 拿起来的一瞬间浮起
items.de: It lifts the moment you grab it
items.pz: 按下 80ms 内 scale 1.02 + 阴影升两级。
items.pe: Within 80ms: scale 1.02 and two shadow steps.

items.dz: 原位留一个虚框
items.de: A ghost stays where it was
items.pz: 虚位用虚线框 + 浅底，高度与被拖项一致。
items.pe: A dashed well matching the dragged item’s height.

items.dz: 其他项让位
items.de: The others make room
items.pz: 让位用 FLIP（transform）而不是重排，200ms。
items.pe: Move neighbours with FLIP transforms, 200ms.

items.dz: 只有手柄能拖
items.de: Only the grip drags
items.pz: 手柄用六点纹理，光标 grab，其余区域仍可点击。
items.pe: A six-dot grip with a grab cursor; the rest stays clickable.

items.dz: 能放的地方亮起来
items.de: Valid targets light up
items.pz: 只高亮合法目标，非法目标给 not-allowed。
items.pe: Highlight valid targets only; mark invalid ones not-allowed.

items.dz: 松手对齐到格
items.de: It clicks onto the grid
items.pz: 吸附阈值 8–12px，松手时用短 spring 落位。
items.pe: An 8–12px threshold with a short spring on release.

items.dz: 拖到尽头还能拉一点
items.de: Past the end it still gives a little
items.pz: 超界位移乘 0.3–0.5 衰减，松手弹回。
items.pe: Damp overscroll to 0.3–0.5 and spring back.

items.dz: 推出屏幕就删掉
items.de: Push it off and it is gone
items.pz: 位移带旋转与透明度衰减，过阈值继续飞出。
items.pe: Add rotation and fade; past the threshold let it fly.

items.dz: 左右决定去留
items.de: Left or right decides
items.pz: 方向标签随位移淡入，超过 40% 宽度即判定。
items.pe: Fade in the verdict label; commit past 40% width.

items.dz: 两指撑开放大
items.de: Two fingers spread to zoom
items.pz: 缩放中心是两指中点，边界用橡皮筋。
items.pe: Scale about the midpoint; rubber-band at the limits.

items.dz: 双击放大到该点
items.de: Double-tap zooms to that point
items.pz: 以点击点为原点缩放 2×，再次双击复原。
items.pe: Zoom 2× about the tap point; tap again to reset.

items.dz: 按住拖动整个画布
items.de: Grab and move the whole canvas
items.pz: 平移要跟手 1:1，惯性滑行 300–600ms。
items.pe: 1:1 tracking with 300–600ms of inertia.

items.dz: 松手后继续滑一段
items.de: It keeps going after release
items.pz: 按松手速度衰减（0.95/帧），低于阈值停止。
items.pe: Decay the release velocity ~0.95 per frame.

items.dz: 一格一格停住
items.de: It stops one card at a time
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory + snap-align:center。
items.pe: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory with snap-align:center.

items.dz: 拉到阈值松手刷新
items.de: Pull past the line and release
items.pz: 阈值前跟手、越界阻尼，触发后转成 spinner。
items.pe: Track, then damp past the threshold, then spin.

items.dz: 从屏幕边缘拉回上一页
items.de: Drag from the edge to go back
items.pz: 上一页跟随位移露出，过 50% 判定完成。
items.pe: Reveal the previous page as you drag; commit past 50%.

items.dz: 卡片在列之间搬
items.de: Cards move between columns
items.pz: 跨列时目标列整体高亮，插入位留出空隙。
items.pe: Highlight the target column and open a gap.

items.dz: 一把抓起好几个
items.de: Grab several at once
items.pz: 被拖的堆叠在指针下，角标显示数量。
items.pe: Stack them under the pointer with a count badge.

items.dz: 手柄不能落后于手指
items.de: The thumb must not lag
items.pz: 滑块位置直接用指针坐标，不要加过渡。
items.pe: Bind position to the pointer directly — no transition.

items.dz: 绕中心转动取值
items.de: Turn about the centre
items.pz: 用角度差而不是绝对角度，避免跳变。
items.pe: Use angle deltas, not absolute angle, to avoid jumps.

items.dz: 第一次用给个示范
items.de: Show it once, the first time
items.pz: 用一次性动画演示手势，之后不再出现。
items.pe: Demonstrate once, then never again.

items.dz: 两指移动画布
items.de: Two fingers move the canvas
items.pz: 单指用于选择、双指用于平移，避免冲突。
items.pe: One finger selects, two pan — no conflict.

items.dz: 先动哪个方向就锁哪个
items.de: The first direction wins
items.pz: 起始 10px 内判定主轴，之后忽略另一轴。
items.pe: Decide the axis in the first 10px, then ignore the other.

items.dz: 差一点就不算
items.de: Almost does not count
items.pz: 过阈值给视觉确认（变色/震动），未过就弹回。
items.pe: Confirm past the line; spring back before it.

items.dz: 关键节点震一下
items.de: A tap at the key moment
items.pz: 只在状态真正改变时震动，别连续震。
items.pe: Buzz only when state actually changes.

items.dz: 拖到边界容器自己滚
items.de: Near the edge, the list scrolls itself
items.pz: 越靠边滚得越快，速度上限要设。
items.pe: Speed rises with proximity — cap it.

items.dz: 中间那条线可以拖
items.de: The divider is draggable
items.pz: 拖动时给整页 cursor:col-resize，并禁用文本选中。
items.pe: Set col-resize on the body and disable selection while dragging.

dz: 状态切换的手感全在这几毫秒里
de: The feel of a state change lives in a few milliseconds

items.dz: 旋钮滑到另一头
items.de: The knob slides across
items.pz: 轨道变色与旋钮位移同时，160–200ms。
items.pe: Track colour and knob travel together, 160–200ms.

items.dz: 旋钮滑动时被压扁一点
items.de: The knob squashes as it travels
items.pz: 位移中间帧 scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9)，落位复原。
items.pe: Mid-travel scaleX(1.15) scaleY(.9), then settle.

items.dz: 开时对勾、关时叉
items.de: Tick when on, cross when off
items.pz: 图标随旋钮一起移动，切换时旋转 90°。
items.pe: The icon rides the knob and rotates 90° on change.

items.dz: 轨道上写着开/关
items.de: ON / OFF written on the track
items.pz: 文字随旋钮位置交换，宽度必须固定。
items.pe: Swap the labels with the knob; fix the width.

items.dz: 方框里画一个勾
items.de: A tick drawn in the box
items.pz: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出，180ms 完成。
items.pe: Draw the tick with dashoffset over 180ms.

items.dz: 子项只选了一部分
items.de: Only some children are picked
items.pz: 半选用短横线，不是灰勾，语义完全不同。
items.pe: A dash, not a grey tick — different meaning.

items.dz: 整张卡都是点击区
items.de: The whole card is the target
items.pz: 选中给 2px 主色边 + 浅底，别只靠一个小勾。
items.pe: A 2px accent border and tint — a tiny tick is not enough.

items.dz: 圆心亮起
items.de: The centre lights up
items.pz: 内点用 scale 从 0 到 1，别用 opacity。
items.pe: Scale the inner dot from 0 — not opacity.

items.dz: 滑块滑到选中项
items.de: The pill slides to the choice
items.pz: 背景滑块用 transform 平移，宽度差异要一起过渡。
items.pe: Translate one pill; transition width too when segments differ.

items.dz: 下划线跟着标签走
items.de: The rule follows the tab
items.pz: 一条线的 translateX + width 过渡，不要每个标签自带线。
items.pe: One rule transitioning translateX and width.

items.dz: 点一下就选上
items.de: Tap to include
items.pz: 选中翻转为深底白字，未选保持描边。
items.pe: Selected inverts to dark; unselected stays outlined.

items.dz: 带叉号可删除
items.de: A small cross removes it
items.pz: 删除后其余项用 FLIP 平滑补位。
items.pe: Reflow the rest with a FLIP transition.

items.dz: 一组里只能选一个
items.de: One of the set
items.pz: 相邻按钮共用 1px 边，选中项 z-index 提前。
items.pe: Share the 1px border; raise the active item.

items.dz: 悬停到第几颗就亮到第几颗
items.de: Hover lights up to that star
items.pz: 用 ~ 兄弟选择器实现悬停填充，键盘也要能改。
items.pe: Sibling selectors for hover fill; keep it keyboard-operable.

items.dz: 按下时迸出小粒子
items.de: Particles burst on press
items.pz: 心形 scale 过冲 1.3 回到 1，粒子 400ms 后清除。
items.pe: Overshoot the heart to 1.3, and clean up particles after 400ms.

items.dz: 过中点才“咔”地弹过去
items.de: Past the midpoint it snaps
items.pz: 拖到 50% 以上松手才切换，否则弹回。
items.pe: Commit past 50%, otherwise spring back.

items.dz: 选中几项后浮出操作条
items.de: A bar rises once you pick items
items.pz: 操作条固定底部，写清“已选 3 项”。
items.pe: Pin the bar and state “3 selected”.

items.dz: 打开一个自动关上别的
items.de: Opening one closes the rest
items.pz: 同时做“收起”和“展开”，总时长控制在 300ms。
items.pe: Collapse and expand together, 300ms total.

items.dz: 看得见但点不动
items.de: Visible, not operable
items.pz: 禁用降对比但保持可读，并说明为什么禁用。
items.pe: Lower contrast but stay legible — and say why it is off.

items.dz: 等服务器确认
items.de: Waiting on the server
items.pz: 乐观更新 + 失败回滚，旋钮内显示小 spinner。
items.pe: Optimistic update with rollback; spin inside the knob.

items.dz: 点击在三种状态间轮转
items.de: Tapping cycles three states
items.pz: 三态必须有清晰的图形差别，不能只靠颜色。
items.pe: Each state needs a distinct shape, not just colour.

items.dz: 按下去有物理反馈
items.de: It answers your finger
items.pz: 按下 translateY(1px) + 内阴影，抬起 120ms 回弹。
items.pe: translateY(1px) plus an inset shadow, 120ms release.

items.dz: 从按下点扩散一圈
items.de: A ring spreading from the touch point
items.pz: 涟漪起点是指针坐标，不要总从中心。
items.pe: Start the ripple at the pointer — not the centre.

items.dz: 按住一会儿才生效
items.de: Hold it to commit
items.pz: 进度环包住按钮，中途松手立刻归零。
items.pe: A ring wraps the button; releasing early resets it.

items.dz: 左滑露出删除
items.de: Swipe left for delete
items.pz: 滑出到阈值吸附，超过 60% 直接执行。
items.pe: Snap at the threshold; past 60% just do it.

items.dz: 菜单从触发点长出
items.de: The menu grows from its trigger
items.pz: transform-origin 对准触发元素，180ms scale + fade。
items.pe: Origin at the trigger; 180ms scale and fade.

items.dz: 高亮块在项之间滑动
items.de: The highlight glides between items
items.pz: 一个高亮块用 transform 移动，而不是每项自己变色。
items.pe: Move one highlight block instead of recolouring each row.

items.dz: 几个方案里挑一个
items.de: Pick one of the plans
items.pz: 推荐项用不同高度或角标，别只靠边框色。
items.pe: Mark the recommended one with height or a badge, not just a border.

items.dz: 表头勾选带动全表
items.de: The header box drives the table
items.pz: 子项部分选中时表头必须显示半选态。
items.pe: Partial selection must show as indeterminate in the header.

items.dz: 箭头翻转表示升降
items.de: The arrow flips
items.pz: 箭头旋转 180° 而不是换图标，语义更连贯。
items.pe: Rotate the arrow 180° rather than swapping icons.

items.dz: 收起时显示已选条件数
items.de: Collapsed, it shows how many filters are on
items.pz: 已选条件用可删除标签列出，一键清空。
items.pe: List active filters as removable chips with a clear-all.

items.dz: 日夜切换的小仪式
items.de: The little day/night ceremony
items.pz: 图标形变（太阳→月亮）比换图更连贯。
items.pe: Morph sun into moon instead of swapping icons.

items.dz: 加减一个数
items.de: Plus one, minus one
items.pz: 减到 1 时把减号换成删除，避免死角。
items.pe: At one, swap minus for delete — no dead end.

items.dz: 切换后给撤销机会
items.de: A window to undo
items.pz: 操作后出 toast 带撤销，5 秒后自动收起。
items.pe: A toast with undo, auto-dismissed after five seconds.

items.dz: 一排颜色点选
items.de: A row of colours
items.pz: 选中用外圈而不是打勾，颜色本身不能被遮。
items.pe: Ring the selection instead of covering it with a tick.

items.dz: 两个手柄框出区间
items.de: Two handles, one range
items.pz: 两手柄不能交叉，区间内轨道要变色。
items.pe: Handles must not cross; colour the span between.

items.dz: 一列开关整齐排开
items.de: A tidy column of switches
items.pz: 开关右对齐、标签左对齐，说明文字第二行。
items.pe: Labels left, switches right, help text on a second line.

items.dz: 选上后前面加个勾
items.de: A tick slides in when picked
items.pz: 勾出现时标签宽度变化要过渡，别瞬间跳。
items.pe: Transition the width change when the tick appears.

items.dz: 先当成功，失败再回滚
items.de: Assume success, roll back on failure
items.pz: 立即反馈 + 静默重试，失败时明确回滚并提示。
items.pe: Instant feedback, quiet retry, explicit rollback on failure.

items.dz: 二值开关表达即时状态，不用来替代需要确认的破坏操作。
items.de: Use binary toggles for immediate state, not destructive actions needing confirmation.
items.pz: 二值开关表达即时状态，不用来替代需要确认的破坏操作。 在键盘、触摸、失败保存和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Use binary toggles for immediate state, not destructive actions needing confirmation. Validate keyboard, touch, failed persistence, and locale switching.

items.dz: 复选框组允许独立选择并显示部分选中。
items.de: Checkbox groups allow independent selection and partial state.
items.pz: 复选框组允许独立选择并显示部分选中。 在键盘、触摸、失败保存和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Checkbox groups allow independent selection and partial state. Validate keyboard, touch, failed persistence, and locale switching.

items.dz: 单选组始终有当前值或明确允许为空。
items.de: Radio groups have a current value or explicitly allow none.
items.pz: 单选组始终有当前值或明确允许为空。 在键盘、触摸、失败保存和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Radio groups have a current value or explicitly allow none. Validate keyboard, touch, failed persistence, and locale switching.

items.dz: 开关标签描述开启后的结果，而不是开或关的抽象词。
items.de: Labels describe the resulting state rather than abstract on/off.
items.pz: 开关标签描述开启后的结果，而不是开或关的抽象词。 在键盘、触摸、失败保存和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Labels describe the resulting state rather than abstract on/off. Validate keyboard, touch, failed persistence, and locale switching.

items.dz: 禁用状态说明原因，不把不可操作误报为当前关闭。
items.de: Explain disabled state instead of implying off.

items.dz: 滑块只停在指定刻度值上，允许可选档位之间的数值间隔不均匀。
items.de: Restrict a slider to explicit marked values, including unevenly spaced value intervals.
items.pz: 原站用 step=null 与 marks 指定可选温度，展示不等间隔刻度。轨道上有刻度并不自动意味着只能选刻度；与普通连续滑块的关键区别在可接受值集合，而非小圆点的外观。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The source combines step=null and explicit marks to restrict selectable temperatures. Visible ticks alone do not imply restricted choices. The accepted value set, rather than the appearance of tick marks, defines this pattern. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

items.dz: 为双滑块的上下界设置最小间隔，阻止用户把区间压缩到无效宽度。
items.de: Maintain a minimum distance between two thumbs so the selected range cannot collapse below a valid width.
items.pz: 原站展示两种约束处理：到达间隔后停止，或推动另一端使区间平移。最小间隔在变更逻辑中执行，disableSwap 只控制拖过另一端时是否交换活动滑块，不能单独替代间隔校验。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The source contrasts stopping at the minimum gap with shifting the range. Change handling enforces the gap. disableSwap controls active-thumb swapping when crossing another thumb and does not by itself enforce a minimum distance. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

items.dz: 让滑块位置与业务数值按非线性函数映射，压缩跨度较大的数值范围。
items.de: Map slider position to the represented value with a nonlinear function for wide value ranges.
items.pz: 原站存储容量示例把内部值 x 映射为 2 的 x 次方，因此相同步长意味着按倍数增长。可见读数与可访问值说明都需使用映射后的容量；不能只改标签却仍按线性数值解释位置。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The storage example maps internal x to 2 to the power of x, so equal steps multiply the represented quantity. Visible and accessible value text should reflect the mapped capacity rather than implying a linear quantity scale. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

items.dz: 把滑轨中强调的填充部分翻转到普通选中范围之外。
items.de: Invert the emphasized track so it fills the complement of the usual selected span.
items.pz: 原站同时示范单值和双值轨道的反向填充。改变的是轨道的视觉强调区域，不会自动反转数值大小、键盘方向或读数含义；应另行说明填充部分代表包含范围还是排除范围。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The source demonstrates inverted tracks for single and range values. This changes the visual emphasis, not automatically the numeric order or keyboard direction. State whether the filled area represents inclusion or exclusion. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

dz: 填写是最容易被放弃的一步
de: Filling things in is where people give up

items.dz: 标签上移变小
items.de: The label rises and shrinks
items.pz: 标签上移 + 缩小 0.78，160ms；空值时回落。
items.pe: Rise and scale to 0.78 in 160ms; fall back when empty.

items.dz: 标签永远在上面
items.de: The label never moves
items.pz: 可访问性最好的方案：标签不动、不遮挡、不猜。
items.pe: The most accessible option: never moves, never hides.

items.dz: 边框变色变粗
items.de: The border sharpens
items.pz: 聚焦色和错误色必须不同，且都不是唯一提示。
items.pe: Focus and error colours must differ — and never be the only cue.

items.dz: 聚焦时底色变白
items.de: The field brightens on focus
items.pz: 未聚焦浅灰、聚焦纯白，比只改边框更明显。
items.pe: Grey at rest, white on focus — clearer than a border change.

items.dz: 光标滑过去而不是跳
items.de: The caret glides
items.pz: caret-animation 或自绘光标，注意输入延迟感。
items.pe: caret-animation, or a custom caret — mind the latency.

items.dz: 开始输入就淡掉
items.de: It fades as you type
items.pz: 占位符不能承担标签职责，只放示例格式。
items.pe: A placeholder is an example, never a label.

items.dz: 边输边分组
items.de: It groups as you type
items.pz: 格式化不要打断光标位置，删除时也要正确回退。
items.pe: Never lose the caret — and handle backspace properly.

items.dz: 快超了才提醒
items.de: It only speaks up near the limit
items.pz: 剩余 20% 才显示计数，超限变红并阻止提交。
items.pe: Show the count in the last 20%; block submit past the cap.

items.dz: 右侧一个绿勾
items.de: A green tick appears
items.pz: 成功提示要即时（失焦时），不要每敲一下就跳。
items.pe: Validate on blur, not on every keystroke.

items.dz: 红边加一行说明
items.de: A red edge and one line of help
items.pz: 错误文案说“怎么改”，不是“输入无效”。
items.pe: Tell them how to fix it, not that it is invalid.

items.dz: 轻轻摇一下
items.de: A small shake
items.pz: 幅度 ≤6px、两个来回、总时长 300ms，别做成抽风。
items.pe: Under 6px, two cycles, 300ms total.

items.dz: 规则提前告知
items.de: Rules stated up front
items.pz: 把要求写在输入前，而不是错了才说。
items.pe: State the requirement before they type, not after they fail.

items.dz: 一条分段的强度条
items.de: A segmented strength bar
items.pz: 给出具体缺什么，而不是只显示“弱”。
items.pe: Say what is missing — not just “weak”.

items.dz: 眼睛图标切换明文
items.de: The eye reveals it
items.pz: 默认隐藏，切换即时；不要因为切换清空输入。
items.pe: Toggle instantly and never clear the value.

items.dz: 下面浮出候选
items.de: Suggestions drop below
items.pz: 高亮匹配片段，键盘上下要能选。
items.pe: Highlight the matched span; arrow keys must work.

items.dz: 边打字边筛选选项
items.de: Type to filter the options
items.pz: 空结果要给“创建新的…”出口。
items.pe: Empty results need a “create new…” escape.

items.dz: 回车把词变成标签
items.de: Enter turns a word into a chip
items.pz: 退格删除最后一个标签，粘贴要能批量拆分。
items.pe: Backspace removes the last chip; paste should split.

items.dz: 有内容才出现叉号
items.de: The cross appears only when there is text
items.pz: 清除按钮点击区 ≥32px，清空后保持聚焦。
items.pe: A ≥32px hit area, and keep focus after clearing.

items.dz: 右侧转一个小圈
items.de: A small spinner on the right
items.pz: 搜索建议要有防抖（250–350ms），否则闪烁。
items.pe: Debounce 250–350ms or it flickers.

items.dz: 内容多了自动变高
items.de: It grows with the content
items.pz: 用隐藏镜像元素测高，别用 scrollHeight 循环。
items.pe: Measure with a hidden mirror element.

items.dz: 一步只问一件事
items.de: One question per step
items.pz: 顶部进度 + 可返回；每步都能保存草稿。
items.pe: Progress at the top, back allowed, drafts saved.

items.dz: 相关字段抱在一起
items.de: Related fields sit together
items.pz: 分组标题用小号大写，组间距是组内的 2 倍。
items.pe: Small caps for the group title; double the gap between groups.

items.dz: 标出必填而不是选填
items.de: Mark what is required
items.pz: 必填项少时标必填，多时反过来标“选填”。
items.pe: Mark the minority — required or optional, whichever is fewer.

items.dz: 按钮变成加载态
items.de: The button becomes a loader
items.pz: 按钮宽度锁死，文字换成 spinner，避免布局跳。
items.pe: Lock the width and swap the label for a spinner.

items.dz: 按钮变成对勾
items.de: The button becomes a tick
items.pz: 成功状态停留 1.2s 再跳转，让人看见结果。
items.pe: Hold the success state 1.2s before navigating.

items.dz: 没填完不能点
items.de: Not until it is complete
items.pz: 禁用时要说明还缺什么，别让人猜。
items.pe: Say what is missing — never let them guess.

items.dz: 悄悄保存并告知
items.de: Saved quietly, and said so
items.pz: 状态三态：保存中、已保存、保存失败可重试。
items.pe: Three states: saving, saved, failed with retry.

items.dz: 三段分开但连着走
items.de: Three segments, one flow
items.pz: 填满一段自动跳下一段，退格能回上一段。
items.pe: Auto-advance on fill; backspace returns.

items.dz: 弹出一个月历
items.de: A month pops out
items.pz: 今天、选中、区间三种状态要能区分。
items.pe: Today, selected and in-range must all read differently.

items.dz: 滚轮吸附到整刻
items.de: The wheel snaps to the slot
items.pz: scroll-snap + 中间高亮带，选中项放大。
items.pe: scroll-snap plus a highlight band; scale the centre item.

items.dz: 拖拽或点击选择
items.de: Drag in, or click to choose
items.pz: 写清支持格式与大小上限，上传中可取消。
items.pe: State formats and limits; allow cancel mid-upload.

items.dz: 每个文件一条进度
items.de: One bar per file
items.pz: 显示已传/总大小与速度，失败项可单独重试。
items.pe: Show bytes and rate; retry per file.

items.dz: 六个格子逐个填
items.de: Six boxes, one digit each
items.pz: 支持整段粘贴，填满自动提交。
items.pe: Accept a pasted code and auto-submit when full.

items.dz: 左侧一个国家选择
items.de: A country selector on the left
items.pz: 前缀与号码同一控件，别拆成两个字段。
items.pe: One control, not two fields.

items.dz: 符号固定、数字右对齐
items.de: Symbol fixed, digits right-aligned
items.pz: 金额右对齐并用等宽数字，符号不参与输入。
items.pe: Right-align with tabular digits; the symbol is not typed.

items.dz: 移动端最稳的选择器
items.de: The safest picker on mobile
items.pz: 选项多于 8 个就用原生 select，别自造。
items.pe: Past eight options, use the native control.

items.dz: 点一下文字就能改
items.de: Click the text to change it
items.pz: 编辑态与展示态位置完全一致，切换零跳动。
items.pe: The edit state must sit exactly where the text was.

items.dz: 顶部列出所有问题
items.de: All problems listed at the top
items.pz: 汇总项可点击定位到字段，并给 aria-live。
items.pe: Each entry links to its field, announced via aria-live.

items.dz: 长表单的提交永远在手边
items.de: On a long form, submit stays reachable
items.pz: 吸底条要有上边界阴影，并避开输入法。
items.pe: Give it a top shadow and keep clear of the keyboard.

items.dz: 角落里的键位提示
items.de: A key hint in the corner

items.pe: Handle Escape, Tab loop, and initial focus while restoring context. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 菜单支持方向键、Enter、Escape 和父级返回路径。
items.de: Menus support arrows, Enter, Escape, and return to the parent path.
items.pz: 菜单支持方向键、Enter、Escape 和父级返回路径。 在键盘、读屏、RTL 和输入法下复核。
items.pe: Menus support arrows, Enter, Escape, and return to the parent path. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 组合框区分输入光标、候选高亮和已选值的键盘状态。
items.de: Separate text caret, highlighted option, and selected value states.
items.pz: 组合框区分输入光标、候选高亮和已选值的键盘状态。 在键盘、读屏、RTL 和输入法下复核。
items.pe: Separate text caret, highlighted option, and selected value states. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 树形组件用左右键展开收起，上下键移动并保留层级。
items.de: Trees use left/right to expand and up/down to move while preserving hierarchy.
items.pz: 树形组件用左右键展开收起，上下键移动并保留层级。 在键盘、读屏、RTL 和输入法下复核。
items.pe: Trees use left/right to expand and up/down to move while preserving hierarchy. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 网格单元格按行列移动，编辑态与导航态有明确切换。
items.de: Grid cells move by row and column with a clear edit/navigation switch.
items.pz: 网格单元格按行列移动，编辑态与导航态有明确切换。 在键盘、读屏、RTL 和输入法下复核。
items.pe: Grid cells move by row and column with a clear edit/navigation switch. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 检测组件快捷键与浏览器、输入法和操作系统快捷键的冲突。
items.de: Detect conflicts with browser, IME, and operating-system shortcuts.
items.pz: 检测组件快捷键与浏览器、输入法和操作系统快捷键的冲突。 在键盘、读屏、RTL 和输入法下复核。
items.pe: Detect conflicts with browser, IME, and operating-system shortcuts. Validate keyboard, screen readers, RTL, and IME input.

items.dz: 让标签焦点与当前面板分开，用户确认后才切换内容。
items.de: Keep tab focus separate from the active panel and change content only after explicit activation.
items.pz: 已实测 ArrowRight 只移动到下一标签，当前面板不变；Enter 后才激活它。原文推荐在面板不能即时显示时使用此模式。这里只验证键盘路径，未测试辅助技术。 预览为原站静态截图；交互示例见来源链接。
items.pe: ArrowRight was verified to move focus without changing the panel; Enter then activated the focused tab. The source recommends manual activation when panels cannot appear instantly. Only this keyboard path was tested, not assistive technology. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; use the source link for interaction.

dz: 内容在页面上怎么摆
de: How content is arranged on the page

items.dz: 大小格子拼成一整块
items.de: Tiles of mixed size locked into one block
items.pz: grid-template-areas 或 span，给 1–2 个大格作视觉锚点。
items.pe: grid-template-areas or spans, with one or two large anchor tiles.

items.dz: 不等高卡片错落排列
items.de: Unequal-height cards interlock
items.pz: CSS columns 或 grid-template-rows:masonry；注意顺序会变列优先。
items.pe: CSS columns or grid masonry — note that column flow reorders items.

items.dz: 一半图一半字
items.de: Half image, half words
items.pz: grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr，小屏堆叠为一列。
items.pe: 1fr 1fr grid that stacks to one column on small screens.

items.dz: 固定侧栏 + 自适应主区
items.de: Fixed sidebar with a fluid main area
items.pz: grid-template-columns:260px minmax(0,1fr)，主区必须 minmax(0,1fr)。
items.pe: 260px minmax(0,1fr) — the minmax(0,…) is what stops overflow.

items.dz: 头 + 三栏 + 脚
items.de: Header, three columns, footer
items.pz: grid-template-areas 明确命名区域，最稳。
items.pe: Named grid-template-areas is the sturdiest version.

items.dz: 大小不一、白缝分割的拼贴
items.de: Mismatched tiles split by crisp white gutters
items.pz: 刻意打破对称，缝隙保持一致的纯白，是最有性格的一种拼图。
items.pe: Break symmetry on purpose and keep the white gutters even.

items.dz: 整屏一句话
items.de: One sentence owning the screen
items.pz: 给主视觉留大量留白，一句话 + 一个 CTA 就够。
items.pe: Leave a lot of air: one sentence and one CTA is enough.

items.dz: 图文互相压住一角
items.de: Blocks deliberately overlap at a corner
items.pz: 让两个 grid item 落在同一格并用 z-index/margin 错开。
items.pe: Place two items in the same cell and offset with margin/z-index.

items.dz: 长文两栏排版
items.de: Long-form set in two columns
items.pz: 正文列宽 60–75 字符，column-gap 至少 2rem。
items.pe: Measure of 60–75 characters, column-gap at least 2rem.

items.dz: 按容器宽度自动换行
items.de: Cards rewrap to the container width
items.pz: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))，无需媒体查询。
items.pe: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr)) — no media queries needed.

items.dz: 所有格子保持同一比例
items.de: Every tile keeps the same ratio
items.pz: aspect-ratio 而不是写死高度，图片用 object-fit:cover。
items.pe: aspect-ratio instead of fixed heights; images object-fit:cover.

items.dz: 斜线把版面分成两块
items.de: A diagonal cuts the layout in two
items.pz: clip-path polygon 做斜切，注意内容避让斜边。
items.pe: clip-path polygon for the cut; keep content clear of the angle.

items.dz: 统计卡按栅格排布
items.de: Stat cards on a 12-column grid
items.pz: 12 栅格 + span 组合，卡片高度用行数控制而非固定值。
items.pe: 12 columns with spans; control height by row count, not pixels.

items.dz: 一条线串起事件
items.de: Events threaded on one line
items.pz: 左侧一条线 + 节点，内容右侧对齐，节点用伪元素。
items.pe: A rule with pseudo-element nodes on the left, content right.

items.dz: 流程分步指示
items.de: Step-by-step progress
items.pz: 等分 flex + 连接线用伪元素，当前步高亮。
items.pe: Equal flex items joined by pseudo-element rules; highlight the active step.

items.dz: 目录固定、正文滚动
items.de: Pinned table of contents, scrolling body
items.pz: sticky 元素的父级不能有 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: A sticky child needs a parent without overflow clipping.

items.dz: 并排比较几个方案
items.de: Options compared side by side
items.pz: 列宽等分、突出推荐列，行高统一避免锯齿。
items.pe: Equal columns, one highlighted; keep row heights uniform.

items.dz: 左字右图的经典首屏
items.de: Copy left, image right
items.pz: 文字列 45–55% 宽，图片列出血到边。
items.pe: Copy column 45–55%, image bleeding to the edge.

items.dz: 一大多小的图片墙
items.de: One large image with small ones around it
items.pz: 第一张 span 2×2，其余自动填充。
items.pe: First tile spans 2×2, the rest auto-fill.

items.dz: 正文只占中间一条
items.de: Body copy in one centred column
items.pz: max-width:68ch + margin:auto，两侧留白比内容更重要。
items.pe: max-width:68ch with auto margins — the air matters more than the text.

items.dz: 一行可横滑的卡片
items.de: A horizontally scrollable row of cards
items.pz: overflow-x:auto + scroll-snap，首尾留 padding 做透出。
items.pe: overflow-x auto with scroll-snap and edge padding for peeking.

items.dz: 按钮一直贴在底部
items.de: The action bar stays at the bottom
items.pz: position:sticky;bottom:0 + 安全区 padding-bottom。
items.pe: position:sticky;bottom:0 plus safe-area padding.

items.dz: 图文左右交替往下走
items.de: Text and image alternate sides down the page
items.pz: 奇偶行用 direction 或 order 交换左右，节奏一致。
items.pe: Swap sides on odd/even rows with order; keep the rhythm even.

items.dz: 小屏一切都变一列
items.de: Everything becomes one column on mobile
items.pz: 先写单列，再在断点上升级为多列（mobile first）。
items.pe: Write the single column first, then upgrade at breakpoints.

items.dz: 不对称但舒服的比例
items.de: Asymmetric but comfortable proportions
items.pz: 用 1.618:1 或 2:3 这样的比例，比 50/50 更有张力。
items.pe: Use 1.618:1 or 2:3 — more tension than a flat 50/50.

dz: 把内容摆到圆上：环形画廊、弧形轮播、扇形展开
de: Content laid on a circle — ring galleries, arc carousels, fans

items.dz: 图片卡沿着圆周排一圈
items.de: Image cards laid around a circle
items.pz: 第 i 张：rotate(i×360/n) translateY(-半径)，再反向 rotate 让卡片竖直。
items.pe: Card i: rotate(i·360/n) translateY(−r), then counter-rotate so it stays upright.

items.dz: 整圈慢慢转，卡片始终朝上
items.de: The ring turns while cards stay upright
items.pz: 容器无限 rotate，子卡反向同速 rotate 抵消。
items.pe: Spin the container; counter-spin each card at the same rate.

items.dz: 圆环躺下来，成了椭圆
items.de: The ring lies back into an ellipse
items.pz: 容器 rotateX(64deg)，卡片再 rotateX(-64deg) 立起来。
items.pe: rotateX(64deg) on the ring, −64deg on each card to stand it up.

items.dz: 像手里的一把牌
items.de: Like a hand of cards
items.pz: transform-origin 放在底部很远处，每张只差 6–10°。
items.pe: Put the origin far below and step 6–10° per card.

items.dz: 一排卡沿弧线起伏
items.de: A row curving along an arc
items.pz: 按索引给 translateY = 弧高×(1−cos)，并同步 rotate。
items.pe: translateY by arc height×(1−cos) with a matching rotate.

items.dz: 中间那张正对你
items.de: The middle one faces you
items.pz: 按与中心的距离插值 scale / translateY / rotate 三者。
items.pe: Interpolate scale, translateY and rotate by distance from centre.

items.dz: 小图绕着主图转
items.de: Thumbs orbit the hero
items.pz: 主图静止，缩略图共享一个旋转容器。
items.pe: Hero stays; the thumbs share one spinning container.

items.dz: 一张张飞到圆上
items.de: They fly onto the circle one by one
items.pz: 从圆心 scale(0) 飞到目标角度，错峰 70ms。
items.pe: From scale(0) at the centre to the target angle, 70ms apart.

items.dz: 长按从中心弹出一圈
items.de: Hold and options bloom outward
items.pz: 按下时半径 0 → 目标，透明度同步，总时长 240ms。
items.pe: Radius 0 → target with opacity, 240ms total.

items.dz: 像花一样张开
items.de: It opens like a flower
items.pz: 每片 transform-origin 在圆心，rotate + scaleY 同时。
items.pe: Origin at the centre, rotate and scaleY together.

items.dz: 字沿着圆周排
items.de: Letters set around a circle
items.pz: 每个字 rotate(i×角) translateY(-半径)，字距靠角度调。
items.pe: Per glyph: rotate(i·step) translateY(−r); tracking is the angle.

items.dz: 徽章上的字在转
items.de: The badge type turns
items.pz: 整体 rotate 无限，速度 12–20s 才不晕。
items.pe: One endless rotate at 12–20s so it does not nauseate.

items.dz: 一圈被切成几段
items.de: The ring is cut into segments
items.pz: conic-gradient 硬色标 + 环形遮罩，段间留 2° 缝。
items.pe: Hard conic stops with a ring mask and a 2° gap.

items.dz: 一圈刻度线
items.de: A ring of tick marks
items.pz: 刻度用 repeating-conic-gradient，长刻度另叠一层。
items.pe: repeating-conic-gradient for ticks, a second layer for majors.

items.dz: 像 iOS 的滚轮
items.de: The iOS wheel
items.pz: 按距中心行数给 rotateX 与透明度，中间那行最清晰。
items.pe: rotateX and alpha by row distance; the centre row is crispest.

items.dz: 一串封面绕成圆柱
items.de: Covers wrapped into a cylinder
items.pz: rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径)，父层 perspective 1200。
items.pe: rotateY(i·step) translateZ(r) under a 1200px perspective.

items.dz: 一圈头像围着中心
items.de: Avatars circling a centre
items.pz: 头像加白描边，圆周留一个缺口放“+N”。
items.pe: White rings on the avatars, one slot left for “+N”.

items.dz: 一圈圈向外推
items.de: Rings pushing outward
items.pz: 多圈错峰 scale + 透明度衰减，delay 平均分布。
items.pe: Staggered scale with fading alpha, evenly delayed.

items.dz: 半径与角度同时增长
items.de: Radius and angle grow together
items.pz: 第 i 张：角度 i×35°、半径 40+i×12px。
items.pe: Card i: angle i·35°, radius 40+i·12px.

items.dz: 十二个位置各就各位
items.de: Twelve positions, each in place
items.pz: 12 等分最常用：每格 30°，注意 12 点在 -90°。
items.pe: Twelve slots of 30°; remember 12 o’clock is −90°.

items.dz: 留一个口子放数值
items.de: A gap left for the value
items.pz: conic 起止角避开底部 60°，缺口处放标签。
items.pe: Skip the bottom 60° in the conic and put the label there.

items.dz: 一圈卡片还带厚度
items.de: The ring has thickness
items.pz: 同一角度放两张，后一张 translateZ 更远并变暗。
items.pe: Two cards per angle; the back one sits deeper and darker.

items.dz: 悬停那张向外弹出
items.de: The hovered card pops outward
items.pz: 沿半径方向再推 16px，其余降饱和。
items.pe: Push it 16px further out and desaturate the rest.

items.dz: 半径不一样才不呆
items.de: Uneven radii keep it alive
items.pz: 给半径加 ±12px 的伪随机扰动，比完美圆更有机。
items.pe: Jitter the radius ±12px — more organic than a perfect circle.

items.dz: 中间留孔放总数
items.de: The hole holds the total
items.pz: 甜甜圈比饼图好读：中心可以放最重要的数。
items.pe: A donut beats a pie — the hole carries the headline number.

items.dz: 两层环表示层级
items.de: Two rings, two levels
items.pz: 内环是父级、外环是子级，颜色继承父级色相。
items.pe: Inner ring parents, outer ring children inheriting the hue.

items.dz: 多个维度一起看
items.de: Several axes at once
items.pz: 轴数 5–7 最好读，超过 8 就成一团。
items.pe: Five to seven axes read best; past eight it is mush.

items.dz: 留 90° 缺口的仪表
items.de: A gauge with a 90° gap
items.pz: 从 135° 起画 270°，缺口朝下最符合直觉。
items.pe: Start at 135° for 270°, gap facing down.

items.dz: 文字沿弧线滚动
items.de: Type scrolls along a curve
items.pz: 文字先摆到圆上，再整体旋转，就是弧形滚动。
items.pe: Place the type on the circle, then rotate the whole thing.

items.dz: 两个半环相对
items.de: Two half rings facing each other
items.pz: 两层 conic 各占一半，中间留白做数值。
items.pe: Two conics, half each, with a value between.

items.dz: 节点在圆上，连线在圆内
items.de: Nodes on the rim, links across the middle
items.pz: 节点在圆周、连线走弦，弦用二次贝塞尔更好看。
items.pe: Nodes on the rim, chords across — quadratic curves read better.

items.dz: 铜银金三级徽章
items.de: Bronze, silver, gold
items.pz: 同一形状换材质渐变，倾斜 8° 更有雕塑感。
items.pe: One shape, three material gradients, tilted 8°.

items.dz: 小球顺着轨迹走
items.de: A dot follows the track
items.pz: offset-path + offset-distance 是原生方案，比手算坐标准。
items.pe: offset-path with offset-distance beats hand-computed coordinates.

items.dz: 一圈依次起伏
items.de: The ring breathes in sequence
items.pz: delay 按角度递增，一圈刚好一个周期。
items.pe: Delay by angle so one lap equals one cycle.

items.dz: 圆盘斜着放，像唱片
items.de: A disc set at an angle
items.pz: rotateX(66deg) + 厚度用第二层 translateZ 假造。
items.pe: rotateX(66deg) plus a second layer for thickness.

items.dz: 大圆里塞小圆
items.de: Circles nested in circles
items.pz: 面积映射数值，不要用直径（会夸大 4 倍）。
items.pe: Map value to area — diameter exaggerates by four.

items.dz: 主体外一圈柔光
items.de: A soft ring of light
items.pz: 光环用同色高透明 + 大 blur，别用实心边。
items.pe: A blurred same-hue ring, never a solid border.

dz: 一堆条目怎么进场、排序、操作
de: How many items arrive, sort and respond

items.dz: 行一条条淡入
items.de: Rows fade in one by one
items.pz: delay = index × 60ms，超过 10 行后 delay 封顶。
items.pe: delay = index × 60ms, capped after ten rows.

items.dz: 行从左侧依次推入
items.de: Rows push in from the left in sequence
items.pz: translateX(-24px)→0，配合极短的 blur 更顺。
items.pe: translateX(-24px)→0, optionally with a tiny blur.

items.dz: 整行轻微变色并右移
items.de: The row tints and nudges right
items.pz: 背景色 + 2px 右移，别加边框免得跳动。
items.pe: Background tint plus a 2px nudge — no border, it causes jitter.

items.dz: 隔行浅色，方便横向读
items.de: Alternating tint helps you track across
items.pz: nth-child(even) 用最浅一档灰，别用边框分隔。
items.pe: nth-child(even) with the lightest grey; skip the borders.

items.dz: 点开行在原地展开详情
items.de: The row opens in place
items.pz: grid-template-rows:0fr→1fr，箭头同步旋转。
items.pe: grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr with the chevron rotating in sync.

items.dz: 左滑露出删除按钮
items.de: Swipe left to expose delete
items.pz: 行 translateX，底层操作按钮固定；超过阈值直接执行。
items.pe: Translate the row over fixed action buttons; past a threshold, commit.

items.dz: 拖起来的行浮起，其他行让位
items.de: The dragged row lifts, the rest make room
items.pz: 拖起项加阴影与 scale(1.02)，其他行用 transform 让位（FLIP）。
items.pe: Lift with shadow and scale(1.02); shift siblings with FLIP transforms.

items.dz: 删掉的行收起，下面补位
items.de: The removed row collapses and the rest close up
items.pz: 先淡出 + 横移，再收 height，两段共 320ms。
items.pe: Fade and slide first, then collapse height — 320ms total.

items.dz: 新行从零高度长出并高亮一下
items.de: A new row grows in and flashes once
items.pz: 高度展开 + 一次淡黄底闪现（500ms）标示“这是新的”。
items.pe: Grow the height, then flash a soft highlight for 500ms.

items.dz: 过滤后剩下的项平滑归位
items.de: Survivors glide into their new places
items.pz: 离场项 fade+scale，留下项用 FLIP 平移，别整体重绘。
items.pe: Fade out the removed, FLIP the survivors — never re-render blind.

items.dz: 排序时行互相交换位置
items.de: Rows swap places when sorted
items.pz: FLIP：记录旧位置，重排后反向补偿再播放。
items.pe: FLIP: record old rects, invert after the re-order, play.

items.dz: 分组标题贴住顶部直到下一组
items.de: Group headers pin until the next group
items.pz: position:sticky;top:0 给分组标题，注意层级与背景不透明。
items.pe: Sticky headers with an opaque background and a z-index.

items.dz: 勾选后整行变淡加删除线
items.de: Checked rows dim and strike through
items.pz: 勾 + 文字划线 + 透明度 60%，200ms 内完成。
items.pe: Tick, strike-through and 60% opacity, all inside 200ms.

items.dz: 头像互相压边，悬停展开
items.de: Overlapping avatars fan out on hover
items.pz: 负 margin 叠放 + hover 时恢复间距，最多显示 4 个 + N。
items.pe: Negative margins, restored on hover; show four plus a count.

items.dz: 紧凑与宽松两档行高
items.de: Compact and comfortable row heights
items.pz: 只改 padding 与 font-size，别改结构，切换加 200ms 过渡。
items.pe: Change padding and font-size only, with a 200ms transition.

items.dz: 卡片从左上角波浪式出现
items.de: Cards ripple in from the top-left
items.pz: delay 按行列距离计算，比单纯 index 更自然。
items.pe: Delay by grid distance rather than flat index.

items.dz: 悬停单张卡翻到背面
items.de: Hovering flips a single card

dz: 让人知道自己在哪、能去哪
de: Telling people where they are and where they can go

items.dz: 悬浮毛玻璃胶囊与汉堡形态切换
items.de: Floating glass pill detached from top with morphing controls
items.pz: 拒绝贴顶死板通栏：离顶悬浮（margin-top: 16px）、居中胶囊（w-max, rounded-full）、重度毛玻璃（backdrop-blur-3xl + 半透明浅底），配以汉堡图标平滑 45° 旋转变形为关闭叉（X），是现代高质量 Web 的标配。
items.pe: Detached floating glass pill (mt-4, mx-auto, w-max, rounded-full, backdrop-blur-3xl) paired with a fluid 45deg hamburger-to-cross transformation.

items.dz: 一块底色在项间滑动
items.de: One pill glides between items
items.pz: 共享指示器用 transform + width 过渡，250ms。
items.pe: One shared indicator transitioning transform and width, 250ms.

items.dz: 当前项下面一个点
items.de: A dot under the active item
items.pz: 圆点比下划线更轻，适合密集导航。
items.pe: A dot is lighter than a rule — better in dense navs.

items.dz: 底色从下往上升起
items.de: The fill rises from the bottom
items.pz: 伪元素 scaleY 从底部长起，180ms。
items.pe: A pseudo-element scaling up from the bottom, 180ms.

items.dz: 鼠标靠近就被吸过去
items.de: Items lean toward the pointer
items.pz: 按距离给邻近项位移，衰减半径 120px。
items.pe: Offset neighbours by distance with a 120px falloff.

items.dz: 悬停项变大、邻居次之
items.de: The hovered item swells, neighbours follow
items.pe: Centre 1.4×, neighbour 1.2×, next 1.08× — a wave.

items.dz: 路径一层层展开
items.de: The path, level by level
items.pz: 分隔符用 / 或 ›，最后一项不可点。
items.pe: Separate with / or ›; the last item is not a link.

items.dz: 只留图标
items.de: Icons only
items.pz: 收起时保留图标与 tooltip，宽度过渡 220ms。
items.pe: Keep icons and tooltips; 220ms width transition.

items.dz: 子项从父项下面滑出
items.de: Children slide out beneath the parent
items.pz: 子项缩进 + 逐个错峰出现，父项箭头旋转。
items.pe: Indent, stagger, and rotate the parent chevron.

items.dz: 悬停向右展开一层
items.de: Hover opens a panel to the right
items.pz: 给一个 safe triangle 容错区，别一移开就关。
items.pe: Add a safe triangle so a diagonal move does not close it.

items.dz: 整条面板落下来
items.de: A full panel drops down
items.pz: 面板高度过渡 + 内容淡入延后 80ms，别一起动。
items.pe: Transition height, then fade the content 80ms later.

items.dz: 三条线变成叉号
items.de: Three bars become a cross
items.pz: 上下线旋转 45°、中线淡出，260ms 内完成。
items.pe: Rotate the outer bars 45° and fade the middle, 260ms.

items.dz: 面板从侧边推进来
items.de: A panel pushes in from the side
items.pz: 进入 300ms ease-out、退出 220ms ease-in，遮罩同步。
items.pe: 300ms out-curve in, 220ms in-curve out, scrim in sync.

items.dz: 从底部推上来
items.de: It rises from the bottom
items.pz: 顶部留 handle，可拖到多档高度（peek/half/full）。
items.pe: Add a handle and support peek / half / full stops.

items.dz: 手机底部四个入口
items.de: Four entries at the bottom
items.pz: 图标 + 文字都要，选中项加色不加大。
items.pe: Icon and label both; colour the active one, do not enlarge it.

items.dz: 滚到哪节高亮哪节
items.de: The nav follows the section
items.pz: 用 IntersectionObserver 而不是 scroll 事件算位置。
items.pe: Use IntersectionObserver, not scroll math.

items.dz: 滚动后变紧凑
items.de: It compacts as you scroll
items.pz: 高度从 72 到 52，logo 同步缩小，加背景模糊。
items.pe: Shrink 72→52 with the logo, and add a blurred ground.

items.dz: 往下滚就收起，往上滚就回来
items.de: Down hides it, up brings it back
items.pz: 要加阈值（>8px）与方向去抖，否则会抽搐。
items.pe: Add a threshold and direction debounce or it twitches.

items.dz: 页码与省略号
items.de: Page numbers and an ellipsis
items.pz: 首末页常显、当前页两侧各留一页、其余省略。
items.pe: Always show first and last, one neighbour each side.

items.dz: 滚到底自动加载
items.de: It loads as you reach the end
items.pz: 底部哨兵 + 骨架项，必须保留“加载更多”兜底。
items.pe: A sentinel plus skeletons — keep a manual fallback.

items.dz: 滚远了才出现
items.de: It appears once you are deep
items.pz: 滚过一屏才显示，点击用 smooth scroll。
items.pe: Show after one viewport; scroll smoothly on click.

items.dz: ⌘K 打开的搜索台
items.de: The ⌘K surface
items.pz: 打开时 scale .96→1 + 遮罩淡入，聚焦立刻在输入框。
items.pe: Scale .96→1 with a scrim; focus lands in the input.

items.dz: 结果按类型分组
items.de: Results grouped by kind
items.pz: 分组标题 sticky，键盘上下跨组连续移动。
items.pe: Sticky group headers; arrow keys cross groups.

items.dz: 标签太多就横滑
items.de: Too many tabs? scroll them
items.pz: 两端渐隐提示还有内容，选中项自动滚进视野。
items.pe: Fade both ends and scroll the active tab into view.

items.dz: 像浏览器标签
items.de: Browser-style tabs
items.pz: 关闭后相邻标签用 FLIP 补位，激活项要接管。
items.pe: FLIP the neighbours closed and hand over activation.

items.dz: 跳过去要有偏移补偿
items.de: The jump needs an offset
items.pz: scroll-margin-top 抵消吸顶导航高度。
items.pe: scroll-margin-top compensates for the sticky header.

items.dz: 顶部一条细线
items.de: A thin line at the top
items.pz: 用 scroll-timeline 驱动 scaleX，不要监听 scroll。
items.pe: Drive scaleX with scroll-timeline, not a scroll listener.

items.dz: 第几步、还有几步
items.de: Which step, how many left
items.pz: 已完成可回退、未开始不可跳，当前步高亮。
items.pe: Completed steps are clickable; future ones are not.

items.dz: 列表 / 网格 / 地图
items.de: List / grid / map
items.pz: 切换时保持滚动位置与筛选条件。
items.pe: Preserve scroll position and filters across views.

items.dz: 在指针处打开
items.de: It opens at the pointer
items.pz: 边缘要翻转方向，避免超出视口。
items.pe: Flip near the edges so it stays in view.

items.dz: 键盘用户的第一站
items.de: The first stop for keyboard users
items.pz: 默认藏在视口外，聚焦时滑入左上角。
items.pe: Off-screen by default; slides in on focus.

items.dz: 中 / EN 两态
items.de: Two states, two languages
items.pz: 语言名用目标语言书写（English 而不是“英语”）。
items.pe: Write each language in its own language.

items.dz: 一条线从中间张开
items.de: A rule opens from the centre
items.pz: 线宽等于文字宽度，用 scaleX 而不是 width。
items.pe: Match the label width and animate scaleX.

items.dz: 内容从导航下穿过
items.de: Content passes under the bar
items.pz: backdrop-filter + 半透明底 + 1px 下边线。
items.pe: backdrop-filter, a translucent fill, and a 1px rule.

dz: 打断得体，退出干净
de: Interrupt politely, leave cleanly

items.de: Grows from 96% to 100%
items.pz: 遮罩淡入 + 面板 scale(.96)→1，200ms ease-out。
items.pe: Scrim fades while the panel scales .96→1 in 200ms.

items.dz: 从下方浮上来
items.de: It floats up from below
items.pz: 移动端优先用上移，桌面用缩放。
items.pe: Rise on mobile, scale on desktop.

items.dz: 退出要比进入快
items.de: Leaving is faster than arriving
items.pz: 退出 150ms、无位移、只淡出，避免拖沓。
items.pe: Exit in 150ms with opacity only.

items.dz: 背景被虚化
items.de: The background goes soft
items.pz: backdrop-filter 的遮罩比纯黑更贵气，但更耗性能。
items.pe: A blurred scrim looks richer but costs more.

items.dz: 跟着手指走，松手吸附
items.de: Follows your finger, snaps on release
items.pz: 超过 40% 高度或速度阈值就关闭，否则弹回。
items.pe: Dismiss past 40% or a velocity threshold; otherwise spring back.

items.dz: 贴着触发元素出现
items.de: It sticks to its trigger
items.pz: CSS anchor positioning 或 floating-ui，边缘要自动翻转。
items.pe: Anchor positioning or floating-ui, with edge flipping.

items.dz: 悬停 500ms 后出现
items.de: Appears after a 500ms hold
items.pz: 进入延迟 500ms、离开 100ms、同组之间无延迟。
items.pe: 500ms in, 100ms out, no delay between siblings.

items.dz: 提示里有标题和说明
items.de: A tooltip with a title and body
items.pz: 超过一行就该用 popover，并允许鼠标进入。
items.pe: Past one line it is a popover — and must be hoverable.

items.dz: 从边角滑入
items.de: Slides in from the corner
items.pz: 从最近的边缘进入，位移 16px，240ms。
items.pe: Enter from the nearest edge, 16px, 240ms.

items.dz: 多条叠成一叠
items.de: They pile into a stack
items.pz: 最多显示 3 条，其余折叠成“+2 条”。
items.pe: Show three; collapse the rest into “+2 more”.

items.dz: 一条线走完就消失
items.de: A line runs out and it goes
items.pz: 悬停暂停计时，是最基本的礼貌。
items.pe: Pause the timer on hover — basic courtesy.

items.dz: 往边上一推就走
items.de: Push it aside
items.pz: 带速度判定，快速轻扫也能触发。
items.pe: Honour velocity — a quick flick should count.

items.dz: 整条压在顶部
items.de: A full-width bar at the top
items.pz: 横幅要推开内容而不是覆盖，否则会遮住东西。
items.pe: A banner should push content, not cover it.

items.dz: 就在相关内容旁边
items.de: Right next to what it is about
items.pz: 行内警示最有效：靠近问题、不打断流程。
items.pe: The most effective kind: close to the problem, no interruption.

items.dz: 删除前的最后一问
items.de: The last question before deleting
items.pz: 主按钮是危险色，且不要默认聚焦；写清后果。
items.pe: Danger colour on the action, no autofocus, state the consequence.

items.dz: 要求打出名字才能删
items.de: Type the name to delete
items.pz: 高风险操作用输入确认，比二次点击更可靠。
items.pe: For high-risk actions, typed confirmation beats a second click.

items.dz: 整块被锁住
items.de: The area locks up
items.pz: 超过 400ms 才显示遮罩，避免闪一下。
items.pe: Only show it past 400ms so it does not flash.

items.dz: 用骨架而不是转圈
items.de: Skeletons, not spinners
items.pz: 知道布局就用骨架，未知才用 spinner。
items.pe: Skeletons when you know the layout; spinners when you do not.

items.dz: 什么都没有的时候
items.de: When there is nothing yet
items.pz: 空状态必须给下一步动作，而不只是一句“暂无数据”。
items.pe: An empty state needs a next action, not just “no data”.

items.dz: 出错页也要有出路
items.de: An error page needs an exit
items.pz: 写清发生了什么、能做什么、去哪儿反馈。
items.pe: What happened, what to do, where to report.

items.dz: 断网时顶部变色
items.de: The bar changes when the network drops
items.pz: 恢复时也要提示一次，并自动重试队列。
items.pe: Announce recovery too, and flush the retry queue.

items.dz: 任务在角落继续跑
items.de: The job keeps running in the corner
items.pz: 可折叠成小胶囊，完成后变成结果链接。
items.pe: Collapse to a pill; become a result link when done.

items.dz: 指着某个按钮说明
items.de: A bubble pointing at one control
items.pz: 一次只指一处，最多 3 步，可跳过。
items.pe: One target at a time, three steps max, always skippable.

items.dz: 只照亮要点的那块
items.de: Only the target stays lit
items.pz: 遮罩挖洞对齐目标 bounding box，加 4px 呼吸环。
items.pe: Punch the scrim at the target box and add a 4px ring.

items.dz: 弹层上再开弹层
items.de: A dialog on a dialog
items.pz: 下层要缩小并变暗，表示层级而不是并列。
items.pe: Shrink and dim the layer below to show hierarchy.

items.dz: 移动端直接铺满
items.de: On mobile it takes over
items.pz: 全屏弹层要有明确的返回，而不是右上小叉。
items.pe: A fullscreen sheet needs a real back affordance.

items.dz: Tab 只在弹层里循环
items.de: Tab stays inside the dialog
items.pz: 打开时焦点进入、关闭时归还触发元素。
items.pe: Move focus in on open, return it on close.

items.dz: 要走了才拦一下
items.de: It only asks as you leave
items.pz: 只在真的有未保存内容时拦，别做营销弹窗。
items.pe: Only when there is unsaved work — never for marketing.

items.dz: 一层压一层往右开
items.de: Panels stack to the right
items.pz: 每层露出 40px 表示可回退，最多三层。
items.pe: Leave 40px of each layer visible; three deep max.

items.dz: 浮层栈记录打开顺序和关闭层级，Escape 只关闭最上层。
items.de: Track open order and dismiss only the top layer on Escape.
items.pz: 浮层栈记录打开顺序和关闭层级，Escape 只关闭最上层。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Track open order and dismiss only the top layer on Escape. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 点击外部关闭轻量浮层，但不误伤拖动和选择文本。
items.de: Dismiss on outside click without breaking drag or text selection.
items.pz: 点击外部关闭轻量浮层，但不误伤拖动和选择文本。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Dismiss on outside click without breaking drag or text selection. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.de: Handle Escape by nested menu, dialog, and tip hierarchy.
items.pz: 嵌套菜单、弹窗和提示按层级处理 Escape。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Handle Escape by nested menu, dialog, and tip hierarchy. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.de: Lock background scroll and restore its position after modal close.
items.pz: 模态打开时锁定背景滚动并保留原滚动位置。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Lock background scroll and restore its position after modal close. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 焦点作用域隔离浮层内部移动，关闭后回到触发源。
items.de: Scope focus inside overlays and return it to the trigger.
items.pz: 焦点作用域隔离浮层内部移动，关闭后回到触发源。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Scope focus inside overlays and return it to the trigger. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 焦点护栏防止 Tab 穿透浮层边界。
items.de: Prevent Tab from escaping an overlay boundary.
items.pz: 焦点护栏防止 Tab 穿透浮层边界。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Prevent Tab from escaping an overlay boundary. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.de: Portals change rendering layer without breaking semantics or theme.
items.pz: Portal 只改变渲染层，不改变语义、事件和主题继承。 在嵌套、移动端、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Portals change rendering layer without breaking semantics or theme. Validate nesting, mobile, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: Portal 内容继承主题和语言，不出现独立的暗色或英文。

dz: 等待、成功、失败、空空如也
de: Waiting, success, failure, empty

items.dz: 最常见的等待指示
items.de: The default wait indicator
items.pz: 一段圆弧无限 rotate，linear，1s 内一圈。
items.pe: An arc rotating linearly, about one turn per second.

items.dz: 三个点依次弹起
items.de: Three dots bounce in turn
items.pz: 每个点 delay 差 160ms，幅度不超过自身直径。
items.pe: Stagger by 160ms; travel no further than one dot diameter.

items.dz: 点在原地放大缩小
items.de: Dots swell in place
items.pz: scale + opacity 同步呼吸，比跳动更安静。
items.pe: scale with opacity — quieter than bouncing.

items.dz: 几根柱子上下起伏
items.de: Bars rise and fall like a meter
items.pz: 每根柱不同 delay 与不同 duration，才不显得机械。
items.pe: Vary both delay and duration per bar so it is not robotic.

items.dz: 一段光在轨道里来回跑
items.de: A segment sweeps along the track
items.pz: 不知道进度时用它；知道进度就一定要用确定型。
items.pe: Only when progress is unknown — otherwise show real progress.

items.dz: 按真实百分比推进
items.de: Advances by real percentage
items.pz: 过渡 width，别回退；到 100% 后停留一下再消失。
items.pe: Transition width, never backwards; hold at 100% before dismissing.

items.dz: 内容形状的灰块占位
items.de: Grey blocks in the shape of the content
items.pz: 骨架要和真实内容同尺寸同位置，否则加载完会跳。
items.pe: Match the real content’s size and position or the page will jump.

items.dz: 灰块上有一道光扫过
items.de: A highlight sweeps across the grey
items.pz: 斜向高光带循环平移，速度别太快（1.4–1.8s）。
items.pe: A diagonal highlight looping at 1.4–1.8s.

items.dz: 骨架行依次亮起
items.de: Skeleton rows pulse in sequence
items.pz: 每行 delay 递增，暗示内容正在陆续到达。
items.pe: Stagger the rows to suggest content streaming in.

items.dz: 先小糊图，再换清晰图
items.de: A tiny blurred image resolves into the real one
items.pz: 先加载 20px 缩略图放大模糊，真实图加载完淡入替换。
items.pe: Load a 20px thumbnail blurred up, then cross-fade the full image.

items.dz: 按钮自己转起来，宽度不变
items.de: The button spins in place, width unchanged
items.pz: 锁定按钮宽度再换内容，避免布局跳动；同时 disabled。
items.pe: Lock the width before swapping content, and disable it.

items.dz: 圆圈画完再打钩
items.de: The circle draws, then the tick
items.pz: 两段动画串联：环 800ms、钩 300ms，共 1.1s 内结束。
items.pe: Sequence: ring 800ms then tick 300ms, done inside 1.1s.

items.dz: 输入框左右抖一下
items.de: The field shakes side to side
items.pz: 抖动 ≤ 3 个来回，同时把边框换成错误色并给出文字说明。
items.pe: Three passes max, plus an error border and a written reason.

items.dz: 角落滑出一条提示
items.de: A message slides in from the corner
items.pz: 从边缘 translate + fade 进入，4s 后自动消失，可堆叠。
items.pe: Slide and fade from the edge, auto-dismiss after 4s, stackable.

items.dz: 页面顶部一条细进度
items.de: A thin bar across the top of the page
items.pz: 路由切换时出现，先冲到 80% 再等真实完成。
items.pe: Show on navigation, rush to 80%, then wait for the real finish.

items.dz: 聊天气泡里的三个点
items.de: Three dots inside a chat bubble
items.pz: 气泡 + 三点跳动，收到消息后气泡原地变成内容。
items.pe: Bubble with bouncing dots; it morphs into the message on arrival.

items.dz: 环形显示上传百分比
items.de: A ring shows upload percentage
items.pz: conic-gradient 绑定真实进度，中间放取消按钮。
items.pe: Bind a conic-gradient to real progress, cancel button inside.

items.dz: 下拉露出转圈图标
items.de: Pulling down reveals the spinner
items.pz: 下拉距离映射到图标旋转角度，松手后再进入无限旋转。
items.pe: Map pull distance to rotation, then switch to an endless spin on release.

items.dz: 环随时间缩短
items.de: The ring drains with time
items.pz: conic 角度从 100% 到 0，最后 3 秒变为警示色。
items.pe: Conic angle 100% → 0, switching to the alert color in the last 3s.

items.dz: 什么都没有的时候说点什么
items.de: Say something when there is nothing
items.pz: 一句解释 + 一个明确的下一步动作，别只放个灰图。
items.pe: One line of explanation plus one clear next action.

items.dz: 断网时顶部压下来一条
items.de: A bar drops in when the network goes
items.pz: 从顶部 translateY 推入，恢复时自动收起并提示已重连。
items.pe: Push in from the top; retract automatically on reconnect.

items.dz: 失败后按钮轻轻呼吸提示可重试
items.de: The retry button breathes after a failure
items.pz: 低频 scale 脉冲（2s 一次），别做成闪烁。
items.pe: A slow 2s scale pulse — never a flash.

items.dz: 一步步告诉你在干什么
items.de: Tells you which step it is on
items.pz: 长任务把进度拆成有名字的步骤，比一个转圈更耐等。
items.pe: Name the steps for long jobs — far more tolerable than a spinner.

items.dz: 先当成功显示，失败再回退
items.de: Show success first, roll back on failure
items.pz: 立刻更新 UI 并轻微降透明度表示未确认，失败时回滚 + 提示。
items.pe: Update immediately at slight opacity; roll back with a message on failure.

items.dz: 多个任务各自的进度
items.de: Per-item progress in a batch
items.pz: 每行一条小进度 + 总进度在顶部，失败行单独标红。
items.pe: A bar per row with an overall bar on top; failures flagged inline.

items.dz: 短请求不显示闪烁骨架，超过阈值再提示等待。
items.de: Delay loading UI to avoid flicker on short requests.
items.pz: 短请求不显示闪烁骨架，超过阈值再提示等待。 在慢网络、离线、失败和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Delay loading UI to avoid flicker on short requests. Validate slow networks, offline, failure, and locale switching.

items.de: Show critical content first and load secondary resources progressively.

items.pe: The source places province and city on rows, product category and subcategory on columns, and quantity in the cells. The default cross-tab layout was checked; alternative aggregation and large-data performance were not tested.
