items.pz: 原站弹层把 province、city 放在行头，type 放在列头，price、cost 放在值区，并提供取消、确定和恢复默认。本次只核实弹层与字段分组，没有应用新配置。 预览为原站静态截图；交互示例见来源链接。
items.pe: The popup assigns province and city to rows, type to columns, and price and cost to values, with Cancel, Confirm and Restore defaults controls. Only the popup and role groups were inspected; no changed configuration was applied. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; use the source link for interaction.

dz: 每个零件都有名字：scrim、rail、thumb、twisty——叫对了才改得准
de: Every part has a name — scrim, rail, thumb, twisty. Naming is half the craft

items.dz: 浮层背后那层压暗的膜
items.de: The dimming veil behind an overlay
items.pz: 30–50% 黑，120ms 淡入，点它即关闭。
items.pe: 30–50% black, 120ms in, click-to-dismiss.

items.dz: 内容之外的那一圈壳
items.de: Everything around the content
items.pz: 头/尾/侧栏统称 chrome，密度要一致。
items.pe: Header, footer and rails are the chrome — keep one density.

items.dz: 只有图标的窄侧栏
items.de: The narrow icon-only sidebar
items.pz: 宽 56–72px，悬停外扩成完整侧栏。
items.pe: 56–72px wide, expanding on hover.

items.dz: 两栏之间那道空
items.de: The space between columns
items.pz: gutter 是栏间距，margin 是版心外边距，别混。
items.pe: Gutter is between columns; margin is outside the grid.

items.dz: 贴底的一条操作区
items.de: The action strip at the bottom
items.pz: 常驻不遮内容，安全区内边距别忘。
items.pe: Persistent, non-occluding, safe-area padded.

items.dz: 从底部拉起来的半屏
items.de: The half-height panel from below
items.pz: 两档高度（peek / full），拖拽可切换。
items.pe: Two stops — peek and full — draggable between.

items.dz: 从边缘推进来的面板
items.de: The panel that slides in from an edge
items.pz: 宽度不超过 80%，带 scrim 和边缘阴影。
items.pe: Under 80% width, with a scrim and an edge shadow.

items.dz: 锚定在触发器上的小面板
items.de: A small panel anchored to its trigger
items.pz: 带箭头指向锚点，贴边自动翻转。
items.pe: An arrow points at the anchor; it flips at edges.

items.dz: 只解释、不承载操作
items.de: It explains; it never acts
items.pz: 延迟 400ms 出现、80ms 消失，绝不放按钮。
items.pe: In after 400ms, out after 80ms, never interactive.

items.dz: 一个三角控制一段内容
items.de: One caret controls one region
items.pz: 三角旋转 90° 表示展开，aria-expanded 必须写。
items.pe: Rotate the caret 90°, and set aria-expanded.

items.dz: 树形里那个小三角
items.de: The little triangle in a tree
items.pz: 点击区要覆盖整行，不只是三角本身。
items.pe: The hit target is the whole row, not the glyph.

items.dz: 一组互斥的展开器
items.de: A set of mutually exclusive disclosures
items.pz: 同时只开一个时要说明，否则用户会找丢内容。
items.pe: If only one opens, say so.

items.dz: 加减号夹着一个数
items.de: Plus and minus around a value
items.pz: 长按连续增减，到边界按钮要禁用。
items.pe: Press-and-hold repeats; disable at the bounds.

items.dz: 输入框右侧的上下小箭头
items.de: The tiny up/down pair in a field
items.pz: 键盘上下键必须同效，滚轮默认别绑。
items.pe: Arrow keys must work; do not bind the wheel by default.

items.dz: 轨道叫 track，圆点叫 thumb
items.de: The bar is the track, the dot is the thumb
items.pz: thumb 命中区至少 44px，视觉可以只有 16px。
items.pe: A 44px hit target even if the dot is 16px.

items.dz: 滑轨上的档位点
items.de: Detents along the track
items.pz: 有刻度就必须吸附，否则刻度是骗人的。
items.pe: If there are ticks, it must snap.

items.dz: 那几道小杠是可拖的暗示
items.de: Those little bars mean draggable
items.pz: 两三道 2px 短线，光标 grab / grabbing。
items.pe: Two or three 2px bars, with grab cursors.

items.dz: 两栏之间可拖的分隔条
items.de: The draggable divider between panes
items.pz: 命中区 8px、视觉 1px，悬停整条变色。
items.pe: An 8px hit zone over a 1px line.

items.dz: 右下角那个小三角
items.de: The corner nub that resizes
items.pz: 八个方向都可拖时，要给对应的 cursor。
items.pe: Give each of the eight directions its cursor.

items.dz: 你在层级里的哪一层
items.de: Where you are in the hierarchy
items.pz: 末项不可点，中间过长要折成省略。
items.pe: The last crumb is not a link; collapse the middle.

items.dz: 2–4 个互斥选项挤在一起
items.de: Two to four exclusive options in one row
items.pz: 超过四项就该用下拉，别硬挤。
items.pe: Past four options, use a select.

items.dz: 能输入也能选的下拉
items.de: Type or pick
items.pz: 输入即过滤，键盘上下选，Enter 确认。
items.pe: Filter as you type; arrows navigate; Enter commits.

items.dz: 一组可选项，不带输入框
items.de: A pickable list with no input
items.pz: 当前项用 aria-selected，视觉不能只靠背景色。
items.pe: Mark aria-selected; do not rely on fill alone.

items.dz: 打两个字就出候选
items.de: Suggestions after two characters
items.pz: 防抖 150ms，候选里高亮匹配片段。
items.pe: Debounce 150ms and highlight the matched span.

items.dz: 输入变成一颗颗可删的标签
items.de: Input turns into removable tokens
items.pz: 回车成 token，退格删最后一个。
items.pe: Enter tokenises; Backspace deletes the last.

items.dz: 可开关的一组条件
items.de: Toggleable conditions
items.pz: 选中要有形状变化（勾），不只是深色。
items.pe: Add a check, not just a darker fill.

items.dz: 按维度分组的筛选区
items.de: Filters grouped by dimension
items.pz: 每组显示计数，已选项置顶。
items.pe: Show counts and pin the selected ones.

items.dz: 三个点里藏次要操作
items.de: Secondary actions behind three dots
items.pz: 主操作永远别进 kebab，里面不超过 7 项。
items.pe: Never hide the primary action there; keep it under seven items.

items.dz: 在指针处长出来的菜单
items.de: It grows at the pointer
items.pz: transform-origin 设在指针位置，贴边翻转。
items.pe: Origin at the pointer, flipped at the edges.

items.dz: 搜索一切、执行一切
items.de: Search everything, run anything
items.pz: 模糊匹配 + 分组 + 快捷键提示，一屏内。
items.pe: Fuzzy match, grouped, with shortcut hints.

items.dz: 最底下那条持续信息
items.de: The persistent strip at the bottom
items.pz: 只放状态与轻量操作，不放主导航。
items.pe: State and light actions only — never primary nav.

items.dz: 右侧那一列参数
items.de: The property column on the right
items.pz: 按语义分组、每组可折叠、数值可拖动。
items.pe: Grouped, collapsible, scrubbable numbers.

items.dz: 按住数值左右拖就能改
items.de: Drag the number to change it
items.pz: 光标变 ew-resize，按住 shift 精细调。
items.pe: ew-resize cursor, Shift for fine control.

items.dz: 一格颜色就是一个 swatch
items.de: One cell of colour
items.pz: 选中态用外框而不是勾，透明色要显示棋盘底。
items.pe: Ring for selection; checkerboard for transparency.

items.dz: 从画面上吸一个颜色
items.de: Pick a colour off the screen
items.pz: 放大镜跟随指针，显示 hex 与对比度。
items.pe: A loupe follows the pointer with hex and contrast.

items.dz: 可展开的层级列表
items.de: A hierarchy you can unfold
items.pz: 缩进 16px 一级，连接线可选但要一致。
items.pe: 16px per level; guide lines optional but consistent.

items.dz: 左边选，右边看
items.de: Pick left, read right
items.pz: 窄屏退化成两级页面，返回要保留选中。
items.pe: On narrow screens it becomes two pages; keep the selection.

items.dz: 横滚时第一列不动
items.de: The first column stays
items.pz: position:sticky left:0 + 一道右侧阴影表示可滚。
items.pe: sticky left with a right-edge shadow.

items.dz: 表头那个小箭头
items.de: The arrow in the header
items.pz: 三态：未排序 / 升 / 降，未排序也要占位。
items.pe: Three states, and reserve the space when unsorted.

items.dz: 页码 + 上下页
items.de: Page numbers with prev and next
items.pz: 当前页不可点，两端与当前页附近才列出。
items.pe: Current page is not a link; elide the middle.

items.dz: 没有内容时不能空白一片
items.de: Nothing yet is still a design
items.pz: 一句说明 + 一个主动作，别只画插图。
items.pe: One sentence and one action.

items.dz: 内容形状的占位
items.de: A placeholder shaped like the content
items.pz: 形状要对得上真实内容，宽度别全部一样。
items.pe: Match the real shapes; vary the widths.

items.dz: 数字或圆点贴在图标角上
items.de: A count or dot on the corner
items.pz: 超过 99 显示 99+，纯提醒用点不用数。
items.pe: 99+ past two digits; a dot when the count adds nothing.

items.dz: 底部一条短暂提示
items.de: A brief strip at the bottom
items.pz: 4 秒自动收，带一个撤销，不叠加超过一条。
items.pe: Four seconds, one undo, never stacked.

items.dz: 常驻在内容顶部的通告
items.de: A persistent notice above content
items.pz: 可关闭且状态要记住，别每次刷新都出现。
items.pe: Dismissible, and remember the dismissal.

items.dz: 正文里一段被框起来的提醒
items.de: A boxed aside inside prose
items.pz: 用背景与图标区分类型，别只靠左侧色条。
items.pe: Type by fill and icon — not a left colour bar.

items.dz: 分步表单，一次只问一屏
items.de: A stepped form, one screen at a time
items.pz: 顶部步骤条要能看出总共几步、现在第几。
items.pe: The rail shows total and current step.

items.dz: 第一次用的时候指一下
items.de: A first-run pointer
items.pz: 一次只讲一个，最多三步，可跳过。
items.pe: One point at a time, three max, skippable.

items.dz: 一个呼吸的点提示可交互
items.de: A breathing dot invites a tap
items.pz: 只在教学场景用，用户点过就永久消失。
items.pe: Onboarding only, and gone once tapped.

items.dz: 键盘用户的定位框
items.de: The keyboard user's locator
items.pz: 2px 外框 + 2px 间隙，颜色对比 ≥3:1。
items.pe: A 2px ring with 2px offset, contrast ≥ 3:1.

items.dz: 看得见的和点得到的不是一回事
items.de: What you see is not what you tap
items.pz: 移动端 ≥44px，靠 padding 或伪元素撑开。
items.pe: 44px minimum on touch, via padding or a pseudo-element.

items.dz: 能往里拖东西的区域
items.de: A region that accepts a drop
items.pz: 拖入时整块高亮并说明会发生什么。
items.pe: Highlight the whole region and say what will happen.

items.dz: 拖动时跟着手的那个半透明副本
items.de: The translucent copy under your hand
items.pz: 幽灵 70% 不透明 + 轻微旋转，原位留虚框。
items.pe: 70% opacity, a slight tilt, and a dashed gap left behind.

items.dz: 选区那圈会走的虚线
items.de: The crawling dashes around a selection
items.pz: dashoffset 匀速走，1px 虚线黑白交替。
items.pe: Animate dashoffset linearly with alternating dashes.

items.dz: 拖一个框把东西选进来
items.de: Drag a rectangle to select
items.pz: 按住 shift 追加选择，选中数实时显示。
items.pe: Shift adds to the selection; show the live count.

items.dz: 靠近就吸附并画一条线
items.de: It snaps and draws a line
items.pz: 吸附阈值 4–6px，参考线用 1px 强调色。
items.pe: Snap within 4–6px; a 1px accent line.

items.dz: 选中对象周围的八个手柄
items.de: Eight handles around the selection
items.pz: 角点等比、边点单向，旋转手柄在上方。
items.pe: Corners scale proportionally, edges one axis, rotate on top.

items.dz: 角落里的全局缩略图
items.de: The whole document, in a corner
items.pz: 视口框可拖，点击直接跳。
items.pe: The viewport rect is draggable and clickable.

items.dz: 一个小胶囊控制缩放
items.de: A pill that owns the zoom
items.pz: 显示百分比、点击回到 100%、可下拉预设。
items.pe: Show the percentage, click to reset, presets in a menu.

items.dz: 画布边上的刻度尺
items.de: The scale along the canvas edge
items.pz: 随缩放换单位与刻度密度，指针位置有游标。
items.pe: Units follow zoom; a cursor tracks the pointer.

items.dz: 三个轴向的拖拽手柄
items.de: One handle per axis
items.pz: 轴色固定（X 红 Y 绿 Z 蓝），悬停整轴变亮。
items.pe: Fixed axis colours; the whole axis lights on hover.

items.dz: 全选 / 部分 / 未选
items.de: All, some, none
items.pz: 部分选中用横线不是勾，父子要联动。
items.pe: A dash for partial, and keep parent and children in sync.

items.dz: 开关立即生效，复选要提交
items.de: A switch acts now, a checkbox waits
items.pz: 表单里用复选，设置里用开关，别混。
items.pe: Checkboxes in forms, switches in settings.

items.dz: 按下去别让它变空
items.de: Do not blank the label
items.pz: 宽度锁定、标签保留、加一个小转圈。
items.pe: Lock the width, keep the label, add a small spinner.

items.dz: 删除类操作要更难点到
items.de: Deletion should be harder to hit
items.pz: 不做默认焦点、按钮文案写清对象、支持撤销。
items.pe: No autofocus, name the object, offer undo.

items.dz: 删了还能救回来的那几秒
items.de: The few seconds to take it back
items.pz: 5 秒内可撤销，比"确定要删除吗"体验好。
items.pe: Five seconds of undo beats a confirm dialog.

items.dz: 看一眼就知道能干什么
items.de: It looks like what it does
items.pz: 可点的要有边界或阴影，纯文字链接要下划线。
items.pe: Boundaries or shadows for controls; underline text links.

items.dz: 视觉图标和实际命中区域分离，触控目标保持足够尺寸。
items.de: Separate glyph from hit area and keep touch targets large enough.
items.pz: 视觉图标和实际命中区域分离，触控目标保持足够尺寸。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Separate glyph from hit area and keep touch targets large enough. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 展开控件同步 aria-expanded、内容可见性和焦点。
items.de: Sync aria-expanded, visibility, and focus in disclosures.
items.pz: 展开控件同步 aria-expanded、内容可见性和焦点。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Sync aria-expanded, visibility, and focus in disclosures. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 互斥和多选切换组分别表达选择模型与当前值。
items.de: Distinguish exclusive and multi-select groups.
items.pz: 互斥和多选切换组分别表达选择模型与当前值。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Distinguish exclusive and multi-select groups. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 命令按钮区分执行、导航和打开菜单三种动作。
items.de: Distinguish execute, navigate, and menu-opening actions.
items.pz: 命令按钮区分执行、导航和打开菜单三种动作。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Distinguish execute, navigate, and menu-opening actions. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 提交后按钮显示忙碌并防止重复提交，同时允许取消。
items.de: Show busy state, prevent duplicates, and allow cancellation.
items.pz: 提交后按钮显示忙碌并防止重复提交，同时允许取消。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Show busy state, prevent duplicates, and allow cancellation. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 异步状态更新不会让按钮文字突然跳动或丢失上下文。
items.de: Async updates do not make labels jump or lose context.
items.pz: 异步状态更新不会让按钮文字突然跳动或丢失上下文。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Async updates do not make labels jump or lose context. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 行内错误靠近字段并说明修复方法，焦点可跳到错误。
items.de: Place errors near fields with repair guidance and focus access.
items.pz: 行内错误靠近字段并说明修复方法，焦点可跳到错误。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Place errors near fields with repair guidance and focus access. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 提交失败提供汇总和逐字段错误，两者共享同一来源。
items.de: Provide summary and field errors from one source.
items.pz: 提交失败提供汇总和逐字段错误，两者共享同一来源。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Provide summary and field errors from one source. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 辅助说明解释格式和限制，不把错误预埋在 placeholder。
items.de: Explain format and limits without using placeholder as error copy.
items.pz: 辅助说明解释格式和限制，不把错误预埋在 placeholder。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Explain format and limits without using placeholder as error copy. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 占位文字在输入后消失，不能替代持久标签。
items.de: Placeholders disappear on input and never replace labels.
items.pz: 占位文字在输入后消失，不能替代持久标签。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Placeholders disappear on input and never replace labels. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 标签位置在密度和响应式变化中保持字段关系。
items.de: Preserve label relationship across density and responsive changes.
items.pz: 标签位置在密度和响应式变化中保持字段关系。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Preserve label relationship across density and responsive changes. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 图标和文字的语义一致，装饰图标不重复读屏文本。
items.de: Keep icon and label semantics aligned without duplicate screen-reader text.
items.pz: 图标和文字的语义一致，装饰图标不重复读屏文本。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Keep icon and label semantics aligned without duplicate screen-reader text. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 空状态只提供与当前任务相关的第一步操作。
items.de: Offer the first action relevant to the current task.
items.pz: 空状态只提供与当前任务相关的第一步操作。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Offer the first action relevant to the current task. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 骨架保留真实控件尺寸，加载完成不改变操作位置。
items.de: Match control dimensions so loading does not move actions.
items.pz: 骨架保留真实控件尺寸，加载完成不改变操作位置。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Match control dimensions so loading does not move actions. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 弹出层跟随触发点定位，空间不足时翻转或改为底部面板。
items.de: Anchor popovers and flip or become a bottom sheet when space is tight.
items.pz: 弹出层跟随触发点定位，空间不足时翻转或改为底部面板。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Anchor popovers and flip or become a bottom sheet when space is tight. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 提示延迟防止扫过时闪烁，键盘聚焦时即时显示。
items.de: Delay pointer tips but show them immediately on keyboard focus.
items.pz: 提示延迟防止扫过时闪烁，键盘聚焦时即时显示。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Delay pointer tips but show them immediately on keyboard focus. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 可操作提示保留足够时间并提供显式操作入口。
items.de: Keep actionable toasts long enough and expose the action.
items.pz: 可操作提示保留足够时间并提供显式操作入口。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Keep actionable toasts long enough and expose the action. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 横幅关闭后记住状态，但重要安全通知不能永久隐藏。
items.de: Remember dismissal without hiding critical safety notices forever.
items.pz: 横幅关闭后记住状态，但重要安全通知不能永久隐藏。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Remember dismissal without hiding critical safety notices forever. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 对话框按内容和视口设上限，长内容内部滚动。
items.de: Bound dialogs by content and viewport with internal scrolling.
items.pz: 对话框按内容和视口设上限，长内容内部滚动。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Bound dialogs by content and viewport with internal scrolling. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 抽屉打开后焦点进入，关闭时回到触发按钮。
items.de: Move focus into a drawer and back to its trigger.
items.pz: 抽屉打开后焦点进入，关闭时回到触发按钮。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Move focus into a drawer and back to its trigger. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 嵌套浮层按层级关闭，Escape 不误关底层页面。
items.de: Dismiss nested overlays by layer without closing the page.
items.pz: 嵌套浮层按层级关闭，Escape 不误关底层页面。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Dismiss nested overlays by layer without closing the page. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 菜单避开视口边缘并保持触发项与菜单的关系。
items.de: Avoid viewport edges while preserving trigger relationship.
items.pz: 菜单避开视口边缘并保持触发项与菜单的关系。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Avoid viewport edges while preserving trigger relationship. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 控件在窄屏改变排列但不改变任务语义。
items.de: Reflow controls on narrow screens without changing task semantics.
items.pz: 控件在窄屏改变排列但不改变任务语义。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Reflow controls on narrow screens without changing task semantics. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 组件公开输入、状态、事件和无障碍契约，组合时可预测。
items.de: Expose predictable inputs, state, events, and accessibility contracts.
items.pz: 组件公开输入、状态、事件和无障碍契约，组合时可预测。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Expose predictable inputs, state, events, and accessibility contracts. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 发布前检查焦点、命中区、错误、浮层、语言和主题切换。
items.de: Audit focus, hit areas, errors, overlays, locale, and theme.
items.pz: 发布前检查焦点、命中区、错误、浮层、语言和主题切换。 在键盘、触摸、暗色和失败状态下复核。
items.pe: Audit focus, hit areas, errors, overlays, locale, and theme. Validate keyboard, touch, dark mode, and failure states.

items.dz: 把一个主操作和展开相关操作的箭头分成相邻的两个点击区域。
items.de: Place a primary action beside a separate arrow that exposes related actions.
items.pz: 原站示例的文字区域执行当前合并方式，箭头区域展开方式菜单；选择菜单项会改变主操作。另一些实现可直接执行菜单动作，因此应明确菜单是改选还是立即执行。本次仅打开示例菜单，没有执行主操作。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The example's text region runs the current merge mode, while its arrow opens a menu that changes that mode. Other implementations may execute menu actions immediately. Only the demo menu was opened here; the primary action was not invoked. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

dz: 一整块面的质感
de: The texture of a whole surface

items.dz: 规律的小点，像方格纸
items.de: Regular dots, like graph paper
items.pz: radial-gradient 的圆点 + background-size 控制间距。
items.pe: A radial-gradient dot repeated via background-size.

items.dz: 横竖细线组成的格子
items.de: A grid of hairlines
items.pz: 两层 linear-gradient 交叉，线宽 1px。
items.pe: Two crossed linear-gradients at 1px.

items.dz: 深蓝底白格，工程图感
items.de: White rules on deep blue — drafting paper
items.pz: 深色底 + 两级网格（细格 + 粗格）。
items.pe: Dark ground with a fine grid and a heavier one on top.

items.dz: 一层极细的噪点，去塑料感
items.de: Fine grain that kills the plastic look
items.pz: SVG feTurbulence 生成噪声图，低透明度叠在底色上。
items.pe: An SVG feTurbulence noise layer at low opacity over the base color.

items.dz: 几团颜色柔和地融在一起
items.de: Soft color blobs melting together
items.pz: 多个 radial-gradient 叠加，颜色数量控制在 3–4 个。
items.pe: Several stacked radial-gradients; keep to three or four hues.

items.dz: 色团缓慢漂移
items.de: Color clouds drifting slowly
items.pz: 两三个模糊色块做低速位移循环，父级 overflow:hidden。
items.pe: Two or three blurred blobs looping slowly inside a clipped parent.

items.dz: 中间亮、四周暗
items.de: Bright centre, dark edges
items.pz: 一层 radial-gradient 从透明到暗色，做视线聚焦。
items.pe: A radial-gradient from transparent to dark focuses the eye.

items.dz: 像色轮一样绕一圈
items.de: Sweeps around like a color wheel
items.pz: conic-gradient(from angle, …)，可加 blur 柔化接缝。
items.pe: conic-gradient(from angle, …); blur the seam if needed.

items.dz: 45 度重复条纹
items.de: Repeating 45° stripes
items.pz: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, …) 控制条宽与间隔。
items.pe: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, …) sets width and gap.

items.dz: 条纹持续平移，像进度条
items.de: Stripes travel — the barber-pole loader
items.pz: 动画 background-position，配 linear 缓动无限循环。
items.pe: Animate background-position linearly, forever.

items.dz: 经典透明底格子
items.de: The classic transparency checker
items.pz: 两个 45/135 度 conic 或两层 linear-gradient 拼成。
items.pe: A conic-gradient repeated, or two offset linear-gradients.

items.dz: 像地形图的一圈圈线
items.de: Contour rings like a topo map
items.pz: 重复 radial-gradient 圆环 + 轻微偏移错位。
items.pe: Repeating radial-gradient rings, slightly offset.

items.dz: 印刷网点，从密到疏
items.de: Print dots, dense to sparse
items.pz: radial-gradient 圆点 + mask 渐变控制疏密。
items.pe: A dot pattern masked by a gradient controls the density.

items.dz: 微微不均的纸面
items.de: Slightly uneven paper
items.pz: 暖白底 + 极低透明度噪点 + 一点点纤维纹理。
items.pe: Warm white with very low-opacity grain and faint fibres.

items.dz: 四角压暗，把注意力收进来
items.de: Darkened corners pull the eye inward
items.pz: 一层 inset box-shadow 或 radial-gradient 覆盖。
items.pe: An inset box-shadow or radial overlay.

items.dz: 半透明模糊的浮层
items.de: A translucent blurred panel
items.pz: backdrop-filter:blur(16px) + 半透明底色 + 1px 亮边。
items.pe: backdrop-filter blur(16px), translucent fill, 1px light border.

items.dz: 照片只保留两种色调
items.de: A photo reduced to two tones
items.pz: grayscale 后叠一层混合模式为 screen/multiply 的双色。
items.pe: Grayscale, then two color layers in screen/multiply blend.

items.dz: CRT 屏幕的横纹
items.de: CRT screen lines
items.pz: 2px 一循环的横向渐变 + 缓慢下移动画。
items.pe: A 2px repeating horizontal gradient drifting slowly.

items.dz: 深色底上零散亮点
items.de: Scattered points on a dark ground
items.pz: 多层不同尺寸的 radial-gradient 圆点 + 不同 background-size。
items.pe: Several dot layers at different sizes and densities.

items.dz: 两块颜色之间是一条波浪
items.de: A wave separates two color fields
items.pz: 用 SVG path 或 radial-gradient 重复做波形边界。
items.pe: An SVG path, or repeated radial-gradients, forms the wavy edge.

items.dz: 六边形密铺
items.de: Tiled hexagons
items.pz: 两层 60/120 度重复渐变叠出六边形错觉。
items.pe: Two 60/120° repeating gradients fake the hex tiling.

items.dz: 小加号排成阵列
items.de: A field of little plus signs
items.pz: 两条短线交叉 + background-size 重复。
items.pe: Two short crossing lines, repeated by background-size.

items.dz: 边框是渐变而不是纯色
items.de: The border itself is a gradient
items.pz: border:1px solid transparent + background-origin/clip 双层背景。
items.pe: Transparent border with two backgrounds using background-origin/clip.

items.dz: 一侧被柔光照亮
items.de: One side is washed with soft light
items.pz: 大范围 linear-gradient 从品牌色淡到白，透明度别超 15%。
items.pe: A wide gradient from a brand tint to white, under 15% opacity.

items.dz: 网格向边缘淡出
items.de: The grid fades toward the edges
items.pz: 网格图案 + radial mask，避免网格顶到边框显脏。
items.pe: Grid pattern under a radial mask so it never hits the frame.

items.dz: 两块纯色硬碰硬
items.de: Two flat color fields meeting hard
items.pz: 不用渐变，直接切两块饱和色，是最“部落”的一种底。
items.pe: No gradient — two saturated fields meeting at a hard edge.

dz: 颜色怎么过渡，决定画面高级还是廉价
de: How colour transitions is the line between rich and cheap

items.dz: 最基本的一道过渡
items.de: The basic ramp
items.pz: 两色之间尽量走同色相，避免中间发灰。
items.pe: Keep hues close so the midpoint does not go muddy.

items.dz: 中间不再发灰
items.de: No more grey midpoint
items.pz: linear-gradient(in oklch,…) 让感知亮度均匀。
items.pe: linear-gradient(in oklch,…) keeps perceived lightness even.

items.dz: 三色以上的过渡
items.de: Three or more stops
items.pz: 色阶位置不要均分，35/65 更有层次。
items.pe: Do not space stops evenly — 35/65 reads richer.

items.dz: 从一点向外扩散
items.de: Spreading from a point
items.pz: at 关键字挪动圆心，比换角度更自然。
items.pe: Move the centre with `at` rather than changing angle.

items.dz: 绕着中心转一圈
items.de: Sweeping around the centre
items.pz: conic-gradient 是做饼图、色环的原生方案。
items.pe: conic-gradient is the native way to do pies and colour wheels.

items.dz: 色块之间没有过渡
items.de: No blending between wedges
items.pz: 同一位置写两个色标即成硬边。
items.pe: Two stops at one position gives a hard edge.

items.dz: 几团颜色柔和交融
items.de: Several colour blooms melting together
items.pz: 多个大半径径向渐变叠加，透明度收在 60–80%。
items.pe: Stack wide radial gradients at 60–80% opacity.

items.dz: 色团缓慢漂移
items.de: The blooms drift slowly
items.pz: 各层用不同周期平移 background-position，周期 8–20s。
items.pe: Pan each layer on its own 8–20s cycle.

items.dz: 几道光带缓慢摆动
items.de: Slow ribbons of light
items.pz: 模糊的斜向色带 + 缓慢旋转，底色要暗。
items.pe: Blurred diagonal bands rotating slowly over a dark base.

items.dz: 边框颜色在跑
items.de: The border colour travels
items.pz: @property 注册角度变量，才能过渡 conic 角度。
items.pe: Register the angle with @property to transition a conic gradient.

items.dz: 字被渐变填满
items.de: Letters filled with a ramp
items.pz: background-clip:text，注意 fallback 颜色。
items.pe: background-clip:text — always ship a fallback colour.

items.dz: 消除色带
items.de: Kills the banding
items.pz: 大面积渐变加 3–5% 噪点，色带就看不见了。
items.pe: A 3–5% noise layer hides banding on large ramps.

items.dz: 一格一格的色阶
items.de: Colour in discrete steps
items.pz: 每个色标写两次形成台阶，常用于数据分级。
items.pe: Double each stop to make a plateau — good for data classes.

items.dz: 一道白光划过表面
items.de: A white blade crosses the surface
items.pz: 窄白渐变斜向平移，只在 hover 或加载时出现。
items.pe: A narrow white band sweeping diagonally — hover or loading only.

items.dz: 占位块上的一道光
items.de: A light passing over placeholders
items.pz: 90deg 三段渐变 200% 宽，1.4s 平移。
items.pe: A three-stop 200%-wide ramp panning over 1.4s.

items.dz: 上半部亮一点
items.de: The top half catches light
items.pz: 上 50% 白色低透明渐变，是拟物按钮的核心。
items.pe: A white ramp over the top half — the core of a skeuomorphic button.

items.dz: 两色重绘整幅画面
items.de: Two colours redraw the picture
items.pz: 灰度层 + 双色渐变 blend，品牌感极强。
items.pe: A grayscale layer plus a two-colour ramp in blend mode.

items.dz: 影子染上主体的颜色
items.de: The shadow takes the object colour
items.pz: 取主色降亮度做阴影，比黑色更真实。
items.pe: Darken the object colour for the shadow instead of using black.

items.dz: 物体背后透出彩光
items.de: Coloured light leaking from behind
items.pz: 副本放大 + blur + 降透明度，放在下层。
items.pe: A scaled, blurred copy behind the object.

items.dz: 用比例调出中间色
items.de: Blend two colours by ratio
items.pz: color-mix(in oklab,A 60%,B) 生成整套 tint/shade。
items.pe: color-mix(in oklab,A 60%,B) generates whole tint scales.

items.dz: 从一个颜色推导整套
items.de: One colour derives the set
items.pz: rgb(from var(--c) …) 或 oklch(from …) 改单个通道。
items.pe: rgb(from var(--c) …) tweaks one channel of a base colour.

items.dz: 光斑跟着鼠标走
items.de: The highlight follows the pointer
items.pz: 把指针位置写入 --x/--y，驱动径向渐变圆心。
items.pe: Write pointer position into --x/--y and drive the radial centre.

items.dz: 字里的颜色在跑
items.de: Colour running through the letters
items.pz: background-size 300% + position 无限平移。
items.pe: 300% background-size with an endless position pan.

items.dz: 经典的斜纹底
items.de: The classic barber pattern
items.pz: repeating-linear-gradient，条宽不要小于 6px。
items.pe: repeating-linear-gradient; keep bands 6px or wider.

items.dz: 条纹在往一个方向跑
items.de: The stripes march
items.pz: 平移一个完整周期，动画 timing 用 linear。
items.pe: Translate exactly one period, always linear.

items.dz: 透明背景的通用符号
items.de: The universal transparency symbol
items.pz: conic-gradient 一行搞定，比四层渐变简洁。
items.pe: One conic-gradient beats four linear ones.

items.dz: 设计工具的标准画布
items.de: The design-tool canvas
items.pz: 径向渐变点 + background-size 控制间距。
items.pe: A radial dot with background-size as the pitch.

items.dz: 细线加粗线的双层网格
items.de: Fine lines with a heavier every fifth
items.pz: 两层线性渐变，粗线间距是细线的 5 倍。
items.pe: Two gradient layers; the major pitch is 5× the minor.

items.dz: 暗底上几团微光
items.de: Faint blooms on a dark field
items.pz: 暗底 + 低饱和径向光，透明度别超 30%。
items.pe: Dark base plus desaturated radials under 30% opacity.

items.dz: 天空那种连续过渡
items.de: The continuous wash of a sky
items.pz: 自然渐变的色标是不等距的，越靠地平线越密。
items.pe: Sky stops crowd toward the horizon — never even.

items.dz: 下划线两端淡掉
items.de: The rule fades at both ends
items.pz: 用渐变做 border-image，避免硬边。
items.pe: Use a gradient as border-image so the ends dissolve.

items.dz: 颜色慢慢绕一圈
items.de: Colour walks the wheel
items.pz: 用 hue-rotate 或 oklch 的 h 通道动画。
items.pe: Animate hue-rotate, or the h channel in oklch.

items.dz: 一个主色推出九级
items.de: One accent, nine steps
items.pz: 用 oklch 固定色相，只走明度，比手调更均匀。
items.pe: Hold hue in oklch and walk lightness only.

items.dz: 成功、警告、危险
items.de: Success, warning, danger
items.pz: 语义色要在浅底和深底上都够对比。
items.pe: Semantic colours must clear contrast on light and dark.

items.dz: 底色一变，文字色也得变
items.de: Change the ground, change the ink
items.pz: 用 color-contrast() 或按亮度阈值切换黑白字。
items.pe: Use color-contrast(), or switch ink at a luminance threshold.

items.dz: 同色不同透明度堆出层次
items.de: One colour, many alphas
items.pz: 界面里用 8/12/20% 的同色叠层，比多种灰更统一。
items.pe: Layer one colour at 8/12/20% instead of many greys.

items.dz: 内容底部化开
items.de: The bottom dissolves
items.pz: mask 渐变比覆盖白色渐变块更适应任意底色。
items.pe: A gradient mask adapts to any background; a white overlay does not.

items.dz: 渐变上有一层细砂
items.de: Fine grain over the ramp
items.pz: 噪点 + 渐变是当代海报的默认组合。
items.pe: Noise over a ramp — the contemporary poster default.

items.dz: 主按钮的一点纵深
items.de: A little depth on the primary button
items.pz: 上浅下深 6–10% 的纵向渐变就够，别做彩虹。
items.pe: A 6–10% vertical ramp is enough — never a rainbow.

items.dz: 进度条本身有颜色变化
items.de: The bar shifts colour as it fills
items.pz: 把渐变固定在轨道上（background-attachment 思路），进度只做遮罩。
items.pe: Pin the ramp to the track and let progress mask it.

items.dz: 数值映射到颜色
items.de: Values mapped to colour
items.pz: 连续型数据用单色明度阶，别用彩虹色。
items.pe: Use a single-hue lightness ramp for continuous data — not rainbow.

items.dz: 中间是中性，两端反向
items.de: Neutral centre, two directions
items.pz: 正负数据用双向色阶，中点必须是浅色。
items.pe: Signed data wants a divergent scale with a pale midpoint.

items.dz: 文字底部淡出
items.de: The type dissolves downward
items.pz: 给文字加 mask 渐变，比裁切更柔和。
items.pe: A gradient mask on type is softer than clipping.

items.dz: 主色渗进整个界面
items.de: The accent seeps through the UI
items.pz: 主色只出现在一处 CTA，其余用它的 8% 淡色。
items.pe: One CTA in the accent; everything else at 8% of it.

items.dz: 半透明加高光边
items.de: Translucent with a lit edge
items.pz: 一层高光内阴影 + 一层暗部内阴影，形成厚度。
items.pe: One light inner shadow, one dark — that is the thickness.

items.dz: 滚到哪里就换色
items.de: The palette follows the scroll
items.pz: 用 scroll-timeline 驱动背景色插值，注意可读性。
items.pe: Drive background interpolation with scroll-timeline; watch contrast.

items.dz: 一块深色打断浅色页面
items.de: A dark block interrupts a light page
items.pz: 反色区块是最省力的节奏工具，一页最多两块。
items.pe: An inverted band is the cheapest rhythm device — two per page max.

items.dz: 分隔线中间实、两端虚
items.de: Solid in the middle, gone at the ends
items.pz: 1px 高的渐变块，比 border 更精致。
items.pe: A 1px gradient block beats a border here.

items.dz: 每个用户一套渐变
items.de: A gradient per user
items.pz: 用 ID 哈希取色相，保证同一用户永远同色。
items.pe: Hash the id into a hue so a user always gets the same colours.

items.dz: 字背后透出彩色光
items.de: Coloured light behind the letters
items.pz: 复制一层做 blur，颜色比前景更饱和。
items.pe: A blurred clone behind, more saturated than the front.

dz: 同一素材，靠滤镜和混合模式换气质
de: Same pixels — filters and blend modes change the mood

items.dz: 失焦
items.de: Out of focus
items.pz: filter:blur() 会吃性能，大面积慎用。
items.pe: filter:blur() is expensive over large areas.

items.dz: 从虚到实
items.de: From soft to sharp
items.pz: blur 与 opacity 同步收敛，最像相机对焦。
items.pe: Converge blur and opacity together — it reads as focusing.

items.dz: 越往下越虚
items.de: Softer toward the bottom
items.pz: 多层 backdrop-filter + 渐变遮罩叠出梯度。
items.pe: Stack masked backdrop-filter layers to build the gradient.

items.dz: 玻璃片压在内容上
items.de: A glass sheet over the content
items.pz: backdrop-filter 作用于层后内容，需要半透明底色。
items.pe: backdrop-filter blurs what is behind it; keep the surface semi-transparent.

items.dz: 抽掉所有颜色
items.de: All colour drained
items.pz: grayscale(1) 常用于未选中或禁用态。
items.pe: grayscale(1) reads as inactive or disabled.

items.dz: 悬停才有颜色
items.de: Colour arrives on hover
items.pz: grayscale 过渡 300ms，比 opacity 更有档次。
items.pe: Transition grayscale over 300ms — classier than fading opacity.

items.dz: 旧照片的暖调
items.de: Old-photograph warmth
items.pz: sepia + 轻微 contrast 更像胶片。
items.pe: sepia with a little contrast reads more like film.

items.dz: 颜色全部翻过来
items.de: Every colour flipped
items.pz: invert(1) 可做暗色模式的暴力方案，但会毁图片。
items.pe: invert(1) is the brute-force dark mode — it ruins photos.

items.dz: 颜色变浓或变淡
items.de: Colour turned up or down
items.pz: saturate(1.4) 让照片更有食欲；超过 2 就假了。
items.pe: saturate(1.4) makes photos appetising; past 2 it looks fake.

items.dz: 明暗拉开
items.de: Lights and darks pulled apart
items.pz: contrast 提高时高光容易溢出，配合 brightness 微调。
items.pe: Raising contrast blows out highlights — trim brightness to compensate.

items.dz: 用真实照片和图注一起测试亮度，观察提亮后云层细节是否丢失，文字是否也被过度提亮。
items.de: Test brightness on a real photograph and its caption, watching for lost cloud detail or overbright text.
items.pz: filter:brightness() 作用于整张卡及其子元素。若只想处理照片，应把 filter 放到照片层；提亮不能恢复原图已经丢失的高光。
items.pe: brightness() affects the whole card and its descendants. Apply it only to the photo layer when captions should stay unchanged. It cannot recover clipped highlights.

items.dz: 整套配色一起转
items.de: The whole palette rotates
items.pz: hue-rotate 循环可做“彩虹”而不必换素材。
items.pe: Loop hue-rotate for a rainbow without new assets.

items.dz: 只用两种颜色重绘
items.de: Redrawn in two colours
items.pz: grayscale 后叠两层 blend（multiply + screen）。
items.pe: Grayscale first, then two blended layers (multiply + screen).

items.dz: 暗、中、亮各给一色
items.de: A colour each for shadow, mid, highlight
items.pz: 三层不同 blend 模式叠加，控制各自 opacity。
items.pe: Three layers, three blend modes, tuned opacities.

items.dz: 越叠越深
items.de: Overlaps get darker
items.pz: multiply 适合把文字压进照片，白色会消失。
items.pe: multiply presses ink into a photo; white disappears.

items.dz: 越叠越亮
items.de: Overlaps get brighter
items.pz: screen 用于光效、烟雾，黑色会消失。
items.pe: screen suits light and smoke; black disappears.

items.dz: 暗处更暗、亮处更亮
items.de: Darks darker, lights lighter
items.pz: overlay 是给照片“加质感”的默认选择。
items.pe: overlay is the default way to add texture to a photo.

items.dz: 重叠处颜色反转
items.de: Overlaps invert
items.pz: difference 让文字在任意底色上都可读。
items.pe: difference keeps type legible over anything.

items.dz: 比差值更柔和的反转
items.de: A softer inversion than difference
items.pz: exclusion 中灰重叠会变灰，适合柔和艺术效果。
items.pe: Mid greys cancel to grey — good for softer art direction.

items.dz: 亮部被推爆
items.de: Highlights blown out
items.pz: color-dodge 做霓虹辉光比 box-shadow 更真。
items.pe: color-dodge glows read truer than box-shadow.

items.dz: 强烈的高反差叠加
items.de: A hard, high-contrast overlay
items.pz: hard-light 常用于做“印刷错版”质感。
items.pe: hard-light gives that misprinted look.

items.dz: 像打了一层柔光罩
items.de: Like a diffusion filter
items.pz: soft-light + 低不透明度是最安全的照片调色。
items.pe: soft-light at low opacity is the safest photo grade.

items.dz: 只借上层的颜色
items.de: Borrows only the upper hue
items.pz: hue / saturation / color / luminosity 是四个分量混合。
items.pe: hue / saturation / color / luminosity blend one channel each.

items.dz: 一个元素内部的多层混合
items.de: Layers blending inside one element
items.pz: background-blend-mode 不影响下方元素，比 mix-blend 更安全。
items.pe: background-blend-mode stays inside the element — safer than mix-blend.

items.dz: 把混合限制在一个组里
items.de: Blending kept inside one group
items.pz: isolation:isolate 建立新的堆叠上下文，防止混合穿透。
items.pe: isolation:isolate creates a new stacking context so blends do not leak.

items.dz: 沿着形状轮廓的影子
items.de: A shadow that follows the real silhouette
items.pz: filter:drop-shadow 认得透明像素，box-shadow 不认。
items.pe: filter:drop-shadow respects alpha; box-shadow does not.

items.dz: 边缘发光
items.de: Edges emitting light
items.pz: 多层 drop-shadow 同色叠加，半径递增。
items.pe: Stack same-colour drop-shadows with growing radii.

items.dz: 像玻璃灯管一样通电
items.de: Glass tubing under current
items.pz: 内白外彩的多层 text-shadow，配合轻微闪烁。
items.pe: White core, coloured halo, with a faint flicker.

items.dz: 边缘泛红蓝
items.de: Red/blue fringing at the edges
items.pz: 文字用红青两层偏移，幅度 1–3px。
items.pe: Two tinted copies offset 1–3px.

items.dz: 被撕成几条错位
items.de: Torn into misaligned bands
items.pz: clip-path 分段 + 随机水平偏移，只在几帧出现。
items.pe: Clip into bands and jump them horizontally for a few frames only.

items.dz: CRT 显示器的横纹
items.de: CRT banding
items.pz: repeating-linear-gradient 加 overlay，线宽 2–3px。
items.pe: A repeating gradient in overlay, 2–3px pitch.

items.dz: 屏幕四角向内弯
items.de: The screen bulges
items.pz: 径向渐变压暗四角 + 轻微 border-radius 与内阴影。
items.pe: Darken corners with a radial gradient, add radius and inner shadow.

items.dz: 像报纸印刷的网点
items.de: Newsprint dots
items.pz: 径向渐变点阵 + multiply，点距决定“印刷精度”。
items.pe: A radial dot lattice in multiply; pitch sets the print resolution.

items.dz: 用有序噪点模拟灰阶
items.de: Ordered noise standing in for grey
items.pz: 棋盘格 conic-gradient 平铺 2px，配合 contrast。
items.pe: A 2px conic checker tile plus contrast.

items.dz: 颜色被压成几个台阶
items.de: Colour crushed into steps
items.pz: CSS 只能近似：高 contrast + 低饱和分层渐变。
items.pe: CSS approximates it: high contrast plus stepped gradients.

items.dz: 亮处糊出光晕
items.de: Highlights bleeding light
items.pz: 复制一层做 blur + screen，只保留亮部。
items.pe: Duplicate, blur, screen — keep only the highlights.

items.dz: 四周压暗，视线集中
items.de: Darkened edges pull the eye in
items.pz: inset box-shadow 或径向渐变，别超过 40% 透明度。
items.pe: An inset shadow or radial gradient — stay under 40% opacity.

items.dz: 细密噪点在跳
items.de: Fine noise dancing
items.pz: SVG feTurbulence 或平铺噪点图 + 轻微位移动画。
items.pe: feTurbulence or a tiled noise image, jittered slightly.

items.dz: 干净底色上一层细砂
items.de: Fine grit over a clean field
items.pz: 静态噪点提升“材质感”，透明度 4–8% 足够。
items.pe: Static noise adds material; 4–8% opacity is plenty.

items.dz: 半透明磨砂片
items.de: A translucent frosted pane
items.pz: blur + 微弱噪点 + 1px 高光边，才不像塑料。
items.pe: Blur plus faint noise plus a 1px highlight edge — otherwise it looks plastic.

items.dz: 边缘把背景挤歪
items.de: The rim bends what is behind it
items.pz: 边缘用更强的 blur 与轻微放大，制造厚度。
items.pe: Stronger blur and slight scale at the rim fakes thickness.

items.dz: 高光在玻璃上滑动
items.de: A highlight sliding across glass
items.pz: 斜向高光条无限平移，叠在 backdrop-filter 之上。
items.pe: A diagonal highlight sweeping over the blurred surface.

items.dz: 细纹反光面
items.de: Fine-brushed reflective surface
items.pz: 细密线性渐变 + 一道高光扫过。
items.pe: Tight linear striping with one sweeping highlight.

items.dz: 在真实照片上叠加移动的彩色反光，模拟纪念卡片的彩虹箔效果，照片细节仍然能够辨认。
items.de: A moving color reflection over a real photograph suggests a foil collector card while preserving recognizable image detail.
items.pz: 同一背景包含彩色渐变与照片，使用 background-blend-mode:color-dodge 混合；移动渐变位置。它是二维反光样本，不包含真实视角或物理材质计算。
items.pe: Blend a gradient and photograph with background-blend-mode:color-dodge and move the gradient. This is a 2D reflection specimen, not a view-dependent physical material.

items.dz: 只有边缘泛彩虹
items.de: Only the rim goes rainbow
items.pz: 用 conic 渐变描边 + mask 只留 1px 环。
items.pe: A conic-gradient border masked down to 1px.

items.dz: 按亮度映射成热力色
items.de: Brightness mapped to heat colours
items.pz: 灰度化后叠彩色渐变，用 hue 或 color 混合。
items.pe: Grayscale, then blend a heat ramp with hue or color.

items.dz: 反相加冷调
items.de: Inverted and cooled
items.pz: invert + hue-rotate + 高对比，常用于科技演示。
items.pe: invert plus hue-rotate plus contrast — the sci-demo look.

items.dz: 只留轮廓线
items.de: Only outlines remain
items.pz: SVG feConvolveMatrix 做卷积；CSS 只能近似。
items.pe: SVG feConvolveMatrix does it properly; CSS only approximates.

items.dz: 只剩黑与白
items.de: Pure black and white
items.pz: grayscale + 极高 contrast，常用于印章、剪影。
items.pe: Grayscale plus extreme contrast — stamps and silhouettes.

items.dz: 字后面拖一道虚影
items.de: A soft ghost trailing the letters
items.pz: 同色低透明度 blur 副本，偏移 4–10px。
items.pe: A blurred low-opacity clone offset 4–10px.

items.dz: 卡片从黑白变成彩色，山体、天空和图注的位置都保持不变，便于比较选中前后的视觉强调。
items.de: The same card moves from grayscale to color without changing its composition, making the emphasis easy to compare.
items.pz: 两端都列出 grayscale、brightness、saturate，并保持函数顺序。滤镜覆盖整卡，包括文字；真正交互控件还需要键盘焦点反馈。
items.pe: List grayscale, brightness, and saturate in the same order at both ends. Filters also affect the caption; actual controls need keyboard feedback.

items.dz: 只有一处清晰
items.de: One spot stays sharp
items.pz: blur 层加径向 mask，中心镂空。
items.pe: A blurred layer with a radial hole in the mask.

items.dz: 像被按进去一块
items.de: Pressed into the surface
items.pz: inset 阴影上深下浅，才符合顶光。
items.pe: Darker at the top edge — that matches overhead light.

items.dz: 把红绿蓝拆开
items.de: RGB channels pulled apart
items.pz: SVG feColorMatrix 拆通道，再各自偏移。
items.pe: Split channels with feColorMatrix and offset each.

items.dz: 文字像印在照片上
items.de: Type printed onto the photo
items.pz: mix-blend-mode:overlay 或 soft-light，白字最稳。
items.pe: overlay or soft-light; white type is safest.

items.dz: 小图先糊着，大图到了才清
items.de: A tiny blurred proxy sharpens into the real image
items.pz: 20px 缩略图放大 + blur，加载完成后交叉淡出。
items.pe: Upscale a 20px thumbnail with blur, then cross-fade.
