items.pz: 空值位置明确并可配置在前或后。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Define null placement explicitly. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 点击字段循环升序、降序和未排序状态。
items.de: Cycle ascending, descending, and unsorted states.
items.pz: 点击字段循环升序、降序和未排序状态。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Cycle ascending, descending, and unsorted states. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 大数据量排序在 worker 或服务端执行，不阻塞输入。
items.de: Sort large data off the main thread or server-side.
items.pz: 大数据量排序在 worker 或服务端执行，不阻塞输入。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Sort large data off the main thread or server-side. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 筛选标签、运算符、错误和 prompt 完全跟随语言。
items.de: Filter labels, operators, errors, and prompts follow locale.
items.pz: 筛选标签、运算符、错误和 prompt 完全跟随语言。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Filter labels, operators, errors, and prompts follow locale. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 筛选和排序状态在暗色、高对比主题下仍可辨。
items.de: Keep filter and sort states visible in dark and high contrast.
items.pz: 筛选和排序状态在暗色、高对比主题下仍可辨。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Keep filter and sort states visible in dark and high contrast. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

items.dz: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。
items.de: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery.
items.pz: 发布前检查复杂条件、URL、权限、性能、语言和错误恢复。 在大数据量、移动端和中英文切换下复核。
items.pe: Audit conditions, URL, permissions, performance, locale, and recovery. Validate scale, mobile, and locale switching.

dz: 把照片放进形状、文字和镂空窗口；比较硬裁切、半透明遮罩与真实擦除，调节范围和构图。
de: Put photographs inside shapes, type, and cut-out windows. Compare clipping, alpha masks, and actual erasing while adjusting coverage and composition.

items.dz: 比较旅游封面从四个方向显现的读图顺序。照片尺寸不动，边界移动，山峰不会随着揭示被压扁。
items.de: Compare four reveal directions on a travel cover. The photograph keeps its size while the clipping edge moves.
items.pz: 用 inset() 裁切照片层；从左显现应先裁掉右侧。保持标题在裁切层外。布局尺寸不变不代表一定由 GPU 合成，仍需测量大图的绘制开销。
items.pe: Clip only the photo with inset(); a left-to-right reveal starts with the right side hidden. Keep the caption outside. Stable layout does not guarantee compositor-only rendering.

items.dz: 从画面中央的山脊开始，向两边展现完整山谷，适合横幅开场和作品展示。
items.de: Reveal the ridge first, then the surrounding valley, useful for a wide opening image or a portfolio cover.
items.pz: 一层 inset(0 50%) 即可同时隐藏左右两半，过渡到 inset(0)。缩窄窗口不会缩放照片；重要主体应先出现在中线附近。
items.pe: Animate one layer from inset(0 50%) to inset(0). This changes the window without scaling the photo; place the subject near its center.

items.dz: 让显现从指定山峰或按钮附近开始。移动圆心，观察相同半径在画面边角会留下多少未覆盖区域。
items.de: Start a reveal near a chosen peak or trigger. Move its origin to see how much of the far corner remains uncovered.
items.pz: circle() 的百分比半径相对参考框的归一化对角线。结束半径必须覆盖最远角；示例取 150%，不能把 50% 当作完整展开。
items.pe: A percentage circle radius uses the normalized diagonal. The final radius must reach the farthest corner; this example uses 150%, not 50%.

items.dz: 以草坡为最后保留的焦点，模拟章节结束时画面收拢；其余画面先消失。
items.de: Keep the green slopes visible last as a chapter closes, giving the ending a deliberate focal point.
items.pz: 反向缩小 circle()；光圈中心和照片焦点是两套坐标。正文或关闭按钮不要放进消失的区域，低动态偏好应直接显示结束态。
items.pe: Shrink circle() in reverse. Its center is independent of the photo focal point. Keep text and dismissal controls outside the disappearing region.

items.dz: 运动或旅行海报可让斜边带出整幅照片，同时保留照片的水平地平线。
items.de: A diagonal edge can introduce an outdoor poster while the photograph itself keeps a level horizon.
items.pz: 两端都使用四个 polygon 顶点，按同一顺序插值。终点超出画框，避免右上角残留三角空白；不要用 skew 把照片本身拉斜。
items.pe: Keep four polygon vertices in the same order at both ends. Extend beyond the frame to cover the final corner; do not skew the image itself.

items.dz: 同一张山谷照片通过平行窗口逐条露出。拖动开合比例，可以检查细条是否把主体切碎。
items.de: Parallel windows reveal one continuous valley image. Adjust their opening to judge whether narrow bands fragment the subject.
items.pz: 重复线性渐变决定每条窗口的透明段；条数决定周期，开合比例决定不透明段长度。照片始终只有一层，不会被重复平铺。
items.pe: A repeating linear gradient defines each opaque band and transparent gap. Band count sets the period; opening sets the opaque fraction. The photo is not tiled.

items.dz: 章节标题先被色条覆盖，再露出完整文字。先后顺序可以避免文字与色条同时抢占注意力。
items.de: A slab covers a chapter title before revealing it, separating the two visual events.
items.pz: 色条用独立伪元素，文字在覆盖最满时由透明变为可见。不要把 opacity 加在整个父层上，否则遮盖用的色条也会消失。
items.pe: Animate an independent pseudo-element and reveal the glyphs only when the slab fully covers them. Parent opacity would also hide the slab.

items.dz: 照片的一侧慢慢融入纸色背景，为封面标题留出柔和空间，而照片主体仍保持完整对比度。
items.de: Fade one side of a photograph into the paper background, leaving a calm area for a cover title without fading the entire subject.
items.pz: alpha 遮罩里不透明黑色保留图像，transparent 隐藏图像；黑色并不代表挖空。调节渐隐起点，不要把文字一并放入遮罩层。
items.pe: In an alpha mask, opaque black preserves the image and transparent hides it. Adjust the fade start and keep the text outside the mask.

items.dz: 把景观照片融入米色画布。四边都逐渐透明，换成有纹理的底色也不会出现白色假边。
items.de: Blend a landscape into the surrounding canvas. Transparent edges work over a textured or colored background without a white fringe.
items.pz: 横向和纵向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交。这里使用两层完整 mask-image；只写一层 WebKit 前缀会丢失另一个方向的渐隐。
items.pe: Intersect horizontal and vertical alpha gradients. Both prefixed and standard declarations contain both layers so neither axis is lost.

items.dz: 景点清单用渐隐暗示下方还有内容。到达列表顶端或底端时，相应的渐隐消失，第一项和最后一项仍能读全。
items.de: A destination list fades only where more content remains. At either end, the fade clears so the first and last entries stay readable.
items.pz: 根据 scrollTop 与最大滚动距离分别开关上下渐隐。容器可用键盘滚动；此演示由用户控制，不自动争抢滚动位置。
items.pe: Set the top and bottom fades independently from scrollTop and the maximum scroll position. The focusable list scrolls by keyboard and does not auto-scroll.

items.dz: 把真实山谷装进 ALPS 四个粗体字，适合短标题和目的地封面。移动照片焦点，比较山脊与山体在笔画中的占比。
items.de: Fill the short title ALPS with a real valley photograph. Shift the photo to balance sky and mountain detail inside the strokes.
items.pz: background-clip:text 只裁背景；用足够粗、足够大的字，确保照片仍可辨认。文字颜色透明前用 @supports 检测，正文和链接保留普通可读颜色。
items.pe: background-clip:text clips the background. Use large, heavy type so the image is recognizable. Gate transparent text with @supports and keep body copy readable.

items.dz: 让全景照片在 ALPS 字形后面缓慢移动，适合片头或目的地标题；字形保持静止，动态只发生在文字内部。
items.de: Pan a panorama behind the stationary word ALPS for a destination title or opening sequence.
items.pz: 本例移动的是照片背景，不冒充视频。背景尺寸大于字形后才有平移空间；真正的视频填字需独立 video 与 SVG/CSS 遮罩，并提供静态海报回退。
items.pe: This example pans a photograph, not a video. An oversized background creates room to pan. Actual video type needs a video layer, a mask, and a static poster fallback.

items.dz: 把矩形照片装进圆、六边形、三角形或星形。形状不需要变成图片：它是窗口，后面的照片仍可独立更换、缩放和移动。
items.de: Place a photograph inside a circle, hexagon, triangle, or star. The shape is a window; the photo remains a separate, replaceable layer.
items.pz: 先给照片层设置 cover，再用 clip-path 裁外轮廓，最后移动照片焦点保护主体。clip-path 会裁掉元素自己的阴影；需要沿轮廓的阴影时给外层加 drop-shadow。不同点数的 polygon 不保证平滑过渡。
items.pe: Size the photo with cover, clip its outline, then adjust the focal point. clip-path also clips the element’s shadow; apply drop-shadow to an outer wrapper. Polygons with different point counts do not interpolate smoothly.

items.dz: 非对称轮廓让同一张自然风景从矩形版面中跳出来，可用于人物介绍或生态主题封面。
items.de: An asymmetric silhouette gives a landscape an organic outline for a profile or nature-themed cover.
items.pz: border-radius 的斜杠前后分别控制水平、垂直半径。只改变外框，不拉伸照片；轮廓过度波动会裁掉主体，也会影响文字旁的稳定留白。
items.pe: Values before and after the border-radius slash control horizontal and vertical radii. Change the frame without stretching the image; excessive movement can crop the subject.

items.dz: 照片保持原位，六边形轮廓在两种构图之间过渡；可用来强调内容切换而不移动整张图片。
items.de: The photo stays still while a six-vertex outline changes shape, signaling a transition without moving the image itself.
items.pz: 两端使用相同数量、相同顺序的 polygon 顶点。此限制针对 polygon 插值，不能推广成所有 clip-path 都必须有点数；边缘平滑度也不同于 SVG 曲线路径。
items.pe: Use the same number and order of polygon vertices. This is a polygon interpolation rule, not a rule for every clip-path shape; straight edges also differ from SVG curves.

items.dz: 用平滑的 SVG 曲线把照片做成相册封面或图标，避免用多边形近似时出现明显折角。
items.de: A smooth SVG silhouette turns a photo into an album cover or icon without polygon corners.
items.pz: 示例是连续贝塞尔曲线近似，不宣称是 iOS 图标的精确超椭圆。SVG viewBox 统一坐标，mask-size:100% 100% 随容器缩放。
items.pe: This is a continuous Bézier approximation, not an exact iOS superellipse. A normalized SVG viewBox and mask-size:100% 100% let the frame scale.

items.dz: 把地点档案做成带切角的照片卡。切角只占装饰区，标题和坐标仍在完整矩形安全区内。
items.de: A cut corner gives a location card a document-like edge while its title and coordinates remain inside the safe area.
items.pz: 用 polygon 切掉右上角，给内容留出大于切角深度的内边距。边框会一起被裁掉，不能把原本的矩形 border 当作沿轮廓描边。
items.pe: Cut the top-right corner with polygon and keep content farther in than the cut depth. A rectangular border is clipped too; it does not trace the new outline.

items.dz: 让展示票券两侧的半圆缺口真正透出背景，可直接放在彩色海报或照片上。
items.de: Real transparent notches let a sample ticket sit over a colored poster or photograph without painted-on circles.
items.pz: 两层径向 alpha 渐变用 intersect 相交；每层只挖一侧。二维码、票号和正文要离缺口至少一个半径，不能依赖背景色补两个圆。
items.pe: Intersect two radial alpha masks, one notch per side. Keep ticket numbers and content at least a notch radius away; no background-colored circles are used.

items.dz: 把风景裁成一张四边穿孔的纪念邮票。透明齿孔能透出下面的画布，中央照片和邮资字样仍完整。
items.de: Frame a landscape as a sample stamp with transparent perforations on all four sides.
items.pz: 四层径向渐变分别在上、下、左、右边重复并相交。齿孔只切边缘，不能把圆心放在卡片中线，否则得到的是穿孔横条。
items.pe: Four repeated radial masks cut the top, bottom, left, and right edges. Their centers lie on the edges, not on the middle of the card.

items.dz: 把同一张照片透过圆孔阵列展示，适合展示窗、印刷网点或装饰性封面。调节孔距即可改变图像的可识别度。
items.de: View one photograph through a repeated aperture pattern, useful for a display screen or decorative cover. Pitch controls recognizability.
items.pz: mask-size 定义重复单元，mask-repeat 平铺遮罩而不是照片。alpha 模式看透明度，黑色和白色只要不透明都会保留画面，并非必须黑白图。
items.pe: mask-size sets the tile; mask-repeat repeats the mask, not the photograph. Alpha mode uses opacity, so both opaque black and opaque white reveal the image.

items.en: Type cut through a paper layer
items.dz: 在纸色封面上挖出 ALPS 字样，只有字内显示真实山谷；这与给文字涂渐变不同，背景照片贯穿整个版面。
items.de: Cut ALPS out of a paper-colored cover so the panorama shows through the letters as one continuous image.
items.pz: 纸层使用 SVG 黑字白底蒙版并明确设置 luminance：白底保留纸，黑字挖洞。换成 alpha 模式时，不透明黑字也会保留纸，洞就消失；可切换比较。正常文字标题保留在演示之外。
items.pe: A black-type-on-white SVG masks the paper in luminance mode: white keeps paper, black cuts a hole. In alpha mode, opaque black also keeps paper, closing the hole. Switch modes to compare.

items.dz: 用柔边窗口聚焦照片中的草坡，周边保留暗色轮廓帮助定位。适合比较局部细节，而不是隐藏全部上下文。
items.de: A soft window emphasizes the foreground slopes while a dark surrounding image preserves context.
items.pz: 底层照片保持可见但变暗，上层同图使用径向 alpha 渐变。两层必须使用相同尺寸和焦点；只移动遮罩中心，不移动照片。
items.pe: Keep a dim full image underneath and mask a matching image above. Both layers share size and position; move only the mask center.

items.dz: 移动指针或手指，在暗化风景上查看原图细节；键盘方向键也可移动窗口。
items.de: Move a pointer or finger to inspect the original photo through a spotlight; arrow keys move it too.
items.pz: 把指针坐标换算成容器内百分比，再更新 mask 中心。触屏拖动要设置 pointer capture；键盘聚焦后提供相同功能，离开画面时保留最后位置。
items.pe: Convert pointer coordinates into container percentages and update the mask center. Capture touch drags and provide equivalent arrow-key movement while focused.

items.dz: 两片不透明幕布从中间退开，先看到山脊，再看到全景；完整照片一直在下方，没有左右两幅不对齐的问题。
items.de: Two opaque curtains open over one continuous image, revealing the central ridge before the full panorama.
items.pz: 用两个伪元素覆盖左右半幅，以 translateX 移出。保留底图尺寸，避免把每半张图单独 cover；幕布只用于过场，不遮挡必须立即操作的内容。
items.pe: Cover each half with a pseudo-element and translate them out. Keep one background photo rather than separately cropping two halves.

items.dz: 一张带真实风景的折页从封面侧展开。透视与固定折痕让用户看清它是在翻页，不是在压缩照片。
items.de: A landscape page unfolds around a fixed hinge. Perspective makes it read as a fold rather than a squashed image.
items.pz: 外层设置 perspective，照片层以左边为 transform-origin 做 rotateY。backface-visibility 避免背面倒字；本例是单页折叠，不模拟纸张弯曲。
items.pe: Set perspective on the wrapper and rotate the photo around its left edge. Hide the backface. This is a single-plane fold, not a paper-bending simulation.

items.dz: 同一张照片分成五个连续竖片，按次序展开。山脊线必须能在相邻片之间接上，才能保持全景的整体感。
items.de: Five aligned slices open in sequence. The ridge should connect across neighboring slices so the panorama remains one image.
items.pz: 每片的背景尺寸是整幅宽度的五倍，背景位置依次为 0/25/50/75/100%。只缩放片的遮罩窗口，不能把五份完整照片拼在一起。
items.pe: Each slice uses a background five times its width, positioned at 0/25/50/75/100%. Reveal slices of one image rather than repeating five full images.

items.dz: 从低分辨率山谷逐步恢复到清晰照片，可用于揭晓答案或模拟图像逐步解析。细节真的被采样成像素块。
items.de: Resolve a low-resolution valley into a clear photograph. The detail is actually sampled into blocks, not covered by a dotted mask.
items.pz: 先把照片画到较小的离屏 canvas，再关闭 imageSmoothingEnabled 放大。右侧参数控制采样宽度；这只是显示处理，不代表真实下载进度。
items.pe: Draw into a smaller offscreen canvas, then enlarge with imageSmoothingEnabled=false. The sample-width control changes resolution; it does not represent download progress.

items.dz: 将圆形风景放入一段真实的旅行手记中，正文沿圆弧绕排；改变圆形大小可以检查窄栏是否还剩足够字数。
items.de: Place a round landscape inside an actual paragraph and let the copy wrap along its curve. Resize it to test the remaining line length.
items.pz: shape-outside 只影响 float 周围的行内内容，不负责裁切照片。用同样的 circle() 做 clip-path，另设 shape-margin 留出阅读距离；flex 子项不会自动绕形。
items.pe: shape-outside changes inline flow around a float; it does not clip the photo. Use matching clip-path and shape-margin. Flex children do not wrap this way.

items.dz: 卡片默认只露出中央取景，悬停或键盘聚焦后展开全景；触屏点按也可以切换。
items.de: A card opens from a central crop to the full panorama on hover or focus; tapping toggles it on touch screens.
items.pz: 始终使用 inset()，同时过渡裁切量与圆角。给触屏和键盘提供等价状态，不把关键信息只藏在 hover 中。
items.pe: Use inset() in both states and transition its crop and radius. Provide equivalent touch and keyboard states rather than making essential information hover-only.

items.dz: 把两个错开的圆当作取景窗口：相加显示并集，相交只保留重叠，排除则挖掉重叠；减去还能观察图层顺序。
items.de: Combine two offset circular windows: add reveals their union, intersect keeps overlap, exclude removes overlap, and subtract exposes layer order.
items.pz: 列表第一层是当前源层，其下方是目标层；subtract 不是两边对称相减。先用两层图检查运算，再扩展到复杂遮罩。
items.pe: The first listed mask is the source over the layers below. Subtract is directional, unlike exclude. Verify a two-layer case before stacking more masks.

items.dz: 一条环形读数表示资料准备进度，中间保留数值。拖动到 0% 和 100%，确认起点与闭合状态都正确。
items.de: A ring indicates preparation progress while keeping the numeric value in its center. Test both empty and complete states.
items.pz: conic-gradient 画进度，径向遮罩只挖掉中间，数字放在未遮罩的兄弟层。CSS 环和 SVG stroke 各有适用场景，不能直接断言某个性能更好。
items.pe: A conic gradient draws the progress and a radial mask removes its center. Keep the number on an unmasked sibling. Neither CSS nor SVG is inherently faster in every case.

items.dz: 用水箱液面表达高度比例，数字与实际填充高度同步。这里的百分比是高度，不是圆形截面的面积或液体体积。
items.de: A tank level communicates height with a synchronized number. The percentage measures height, not circular area or liquid volume.
items.pz: 圆形容器裁切液体层，液面位置由参数决定，顶部弧面轻微旋转。百分比文本不进入裁切层；若要表示真实体积，需要先将体积换算成对应液位，低动态偏好仅停止表面运动。
items.pe: Clip a level-controlled fill inside a circle and gently rotate its rounded surface. Keep the number outside the clipped fill. For actual volume, first convert volume to level; reduced motion stops the surface movement.

items.dz: 拖动鼠标或手指，银色表层会沿笔迹真正被擦掉，露出下方山谷照片。键盘可用“全部揭开”，也能重新覆盖再试。
items.de: Drag a mouse or finger to erase the silver coating along your actual path and reveal the valley. Keyboard users can reveal all or reset.
items.pz: 在透明 canvas 上绘制覆盖层，再用 destination-out 擦除笔迹；照片留在 canvas 下方。按设备像素比绘制、捕获指针并处理取消事件，避免触屏拖动中断。遮住的内容已在客户端，不能作为秘密信息保护。
items.pe: Paint a coating on a transparent canvas and erase strokes with destination-out; keep the photo underneath. Handle device pixel ratio, pointer capture, and cancellation. The hidden content is already on the client, so this is not a security boundary.

items.dz: 照片在固定取景框内横向移动，外侧边缘被截住；框下的标题始终保持原位。
items.de: A photo pans inside a fixed viewport while its caption remains still outside the crop.
items.pz: overflow:clip 不创建滚动容器，也不能像 hidden 那样通过 scrollLeft 滚动。这里移动内部图片层；若需要独立格式化上下文可加 display:flow-root。
items.pe: overflow:clip creates no scroll container and cannot be programmatically scrolled like hidden. Move the inner photo layer; add flow-root when an independent formatting context is needed.

items.dz: 把圆形照片像钟面一样沿顺时针方向揭开，适合短过场或圆形媒体浏览。拖动角度可看清扇形范围。
items.de: Reveal a round photograph clockwise like a clock face. Adjust the angle to inspect the actual sector.
items.pz: 圆形裁切决定外轮廓，conic-gradient alpha 遮罩决定扇形。普通 background 渐变本身不会可靠地平滑插值；本例直接控制角度，不伪装为自动动画。
items.pe: A circle defines the silhouette and a conic alpha mask defines the sector. Ordinary background gradients do not smoothly interpolate by default, so this study controls the angle directly.

items.dz: 照片下沿变成连续波浪，适合从景观横幅过渡到下一段正文；背景仍从波谷自然透出。
items.de: A scalloped lower edge transitions a landscape banner into the next section while preserving transparency in the valleys.
items.pz: 主矩形与底部一排圆相加形成波浪。遮罩与照片使用独立的尺寸，确保只影响下沿，不把整张照片裁成多个竖条。
items.pe: Add a solid upper rectangle to a row of circles at the bottom. Size the mask independently from the photo so only the lower edge is shaped.

items.dz: 用不规则下沿给旅行档案增加剪贴感，照片上方仍留出完整矩形区域以保留主体。
items.de: An irregular lower edge gives a travel archive a clipped-paper feel without interrupting the main subject.
items.pz: 用不等距 polygon 顶点切出纸边；这是平面轮廓，不包含纸纤维或厚度。不要重复同一组等距锯齿，否则更像票据撕线。
items.pe: Use uneven polygon vertices for a torn silhouette. It is a flat edge without paper fibers or thickness. Equal repeated teeth read more like a receipt perforation.

items.dz: 把横向风景重新构图为拱形竖幅，可用于目的地封面或展览海报。移动照片焦点，避免山峰被拱顶切掉。
items.de: Reframe a landscape as an arched portrait for a destination cover or exhibition poster. Adjust the focal point to protect the peak.
items.pz: 上角使用椭圆半径、下角保持小圆角；overflow:hidden 裁切实际照片。框是竖幅，cover 必然裁去横图两侧，不能把裁切误认作图片变形。
items.pe: Use elliptical top radii and small bottom radii with overflow:hidden. Cover crops a landscape to a portrait frame; it should not stretch the image.

items.dz: 在原尺寸照片上缩小取景窗口，同时改变圆角。比较硬边矩形与胶片式圆角窗口的构图差异。
items.de: Inset a window within the original photograph and change its radius to compare hard and rounded crops.
items.pz: inset() 的 round 在裁切边界上生效；它不同于给整张图片设 border-radius。照片和窗口各自独立，内缩量过大时要重新调整主体位置。
items.pe: The round keyword rounds the inset clipping boundary, unlike border-radius on the entire image. The photo and window remain independent.

items.dz: 把照片放进叶片或地图标记轮廓。SVG 定义轮廓，真实照片独立保留，可替换素材而不重画形状。
items.de: Place a photograph inside a leaf or map-pin silhouette. The SVG defines the outline independently from the replaceable photo.
items.pz: 本例实际使用含 path 的 SVG 图像作为 mask-image，设置 viewBox 与 mask-size。它不是 polygon，也不是 clipPath 引用；需要软边时可在 SVG 里增加透明渐变。
items.pe: This uses an SVG image containing a path as mask-image, with viewBox and mask-size. It is not a polygon or a clipPath reference; SVG alpha gradients can add soft edges.

items.dz: 深色封面挖出一个圆形窗口，窗口里露出清晰照片。调整窗口位置，可以用同一张大图制作不同局部封面。
items.de: Cut a clear circular window through a dark cover. Reposition the window to create different close-up covers from one photo.
items.pz: 透明圆形加超大扩散 box-shadow 形成覆盖层，外容器限制阴影范围。覆盖层应 pointer-events:none；这只做视觉遮挡，不改变底层交互或可访问树。
items.pe: A transparent circle with a large spread shadow forms the cover, clipped by its wrapper. Keep the overlay pointer-events:none; visual coverage does not remove underlying interaction or accessibility.

items.dz: 在地点资料清单中突出当前整理步骤，其他步骤变暗但仍保留位置关系。切换目标，观察高亮是否完整包住这一行。
items.de: Highlight the current step in a location-data checklist while keeping the surrounding workflow visible.
items.pz: 示例用目标行的扩散阴影覆盖其他行。真实引导还需管理焦点、Esc 退出、定位更新和跳过入口；视觉挖洞不能替代这些行为。
items.pe: The selected row casts a spread shadow over its siblings. Production onboarding also needs focus handling, Escape, skip, and position updates; a visual hole does not implement them.

items.dz: 让“PREPARING”随完成比例被填色，文字本身始终可读。填色只承担辅助反馈，不能代替可访问的数值进度。
items.de: Fill PREPARING with color as completion increases while keeping the whole word readable. The color is secondary to an accessible numeric value.
items.pz: 两层同字同字体重合，上层用 inset() 按进度裁切；不用渐变过渡造成模糊中线。真实任务应把同一数值写入 progress 或 aria-valuenow。
items.pe: Align two identical text layers and clip the colored layer by progress. Use the same value in progress or aria-valuenow for actual task status.

items.dz: 斜向条纹把照片处理成可识别的图形纹理；条纹越密，整体越接近原图，越疏则更适合做背景装饰。
items.de: Diagonal slits turn a photograph into a recognizable graphic texture. Dense stripes preserve more detail; wider gaps make a stronger decorative pattern.
items.pz: 重复线性 alpha 渐变交替保留和隐藏照片。条宽与间隔分别控制，文字放在独立实色区域；不要把高频条纹持续快速移动。
items.pe: A repeating alpha gradient alternates visible and hidden bands. Control stripe and gap widths separately and keep text on a solid region. Avoid fast continuous motion.

items.dz: 九片照片从错位状态回到原位，最后拼成一张连续的全景；可检查山脊和草坡是否在接缝处对齐。
items.de: Nine displaced tiles settle into one continuous photograph. Check that the ridge and hillside align across the seams.
items.pz: 每片使用同一图片、三倍背景尺寸和对应的横纵定位；整体取景比例保持不变。位移动画结束时必须回到准确坐标，不随机改变终点。
items.pe: Use the same image on every tile with 300% background size and matching row/column positions. Preserve the full-frame ratio and return every tile to exact coordinates.

items.dz: 用同一张照片比较原始彩色与黑白处理。拖动分界线，内容的位置完全重合，避免读者把构图变化误认为处理效果。
items.de: Compare the same photograph in color and grayscale. The divider changes coverage while both images remain perfectly aligned.
items.pz: 两层同图同尺寸，顶层用 inset() 裁切；滤镜只是示例处理。保留原图在后面，不能让中间阶段露出空白，也不把裁切称为透明度交叉淡化。
items.pe: Align two same-sized images and clip the processed top layer with inset(). Keep the original behind it; this is a wipe comparison, not an opacity cross-fade.

items.dz: 短标题的每个字从自己的基线窗口依次上升，适合章节开场；完整标题结束后停留，便于阅读。
items.de: Each letter rises through its own baseline window, followed by a pause that keeps the complete title readable.
items.pz: 每个字必须有独立裁切窗口；这里只让 span 的 clip-path 和 translateY 同时变化，父层裁掉底部溢出。长正文不要逐字播放，低动态时直接显示全部。
items.pe: Each glyph needs its own clipping behavior. Here each span combines clip-path and translateY within an overflow-clipped parent. Do not animate long paragraphs letter by letter.

items.dz: 从一个小窗口扩大到整张照片，边缘始终柔和；可用于图片聚焦转全景的过场。
items.de: Grow from a small window to the full photograph while retaining a soft boundary.
items.pz: 保持照片尺寸固定，放大居中的径向遮罩；mask-repeat:no-repeat 避免重复窗口。最终遮罩要覆盖四角，不能只放大到照片宽度的一倍。
items.pe: Keep the image fixed and enlarge a centered radial mask with no-repeat. The final mask must cover all four corners, not just reach the frame width.

items.dz: 同一条底色被裁到当前栏目下面。切换栏目时，观察指示范围是否跟随完整按钮，而不是只追着文字中点。
items.de: One colored layer is clipped to the current navigation item. Change the selected section and inspect how the highlight covers the full target.
items.pz: 示例五项等宽，inset 左右值可由索引计算。真实的不同宽度导航需读取按钮位置；文字层放在遮罩上方，并以 aria-current 或选中状态表达当前项。
items.pe: These five items have equal widths, so insets follow the index. Unequal items need measured bounds. Keep labels above the layer and expose selection semantically.

items.dz: 给一张内容完整的地点卡添加细渐变边框。边框强调卡片边界，内部照片和文字仍保持平静。
items.de: Give a complete location card a thin gradient border while keeping its photo and text calm.
items.pz: 双层背景分别裁到 padding-box 与 border-box，并保留透明 border 宽度。此方法中间是实色填充；若中间必须真正透明，改用排除合成的遮罩边框。
items.pe: Clip two backgrounds to padding-box and border-box with a transparent border. The center is an opaque fill; use an exclude mask when it must be truly transparent.

items.dz: 让一段高亮沿地点卡边框缓慢经过，提示“当前选中”或处理中。照片与标题保持静止，避免整卡闪烁。
items.de: Move a restrained highlight around a location card to suggest selection or activity while its content remains still.
items.pz: 旋转的锥形渐变放在最底层，内层纸面遮住中心；内容单独抬到上层。不要给整张卡持续变色，低动态模式保留静态边框即可。
items.pe: Rotate a conic gradient behind an opaque inset surface and lift the content above both. Reduced motion keeps a static border.

items.dz: 照片清单底部的阴影表示仍有下一张，到底后阴影消失；向下滚动后，上方阴影才出现。
items.de: A bottom shadow indicates more photos below, disappears at the end, and gains a top counterpart after scrolling down.
items.pz: 四层背景中两层白色遮片用 background-attachment:local 随内容滚动，两层阴影用 scroll 留在视口边缘。它不依赖滚动驱动动画，也不需要固定假遮罩盖住正文。
items.pe: Two local-attached white covers move with the content while two scroll-attached shadows stay at the viewport edges. This uses background attachment, not scroll-driven animation.

dz: 阴影不是装饰，是在说“谁在上面”
de: Shadow is not decoration — it says what sits on top

items.dz: 一套可复用的高度
items.de: A reusable set of heights
items.pz: 定 4–5 级阴影，越高越大越淡，不要每处现调。
items.pe: Define 4–5 steps: higher means larger and fainter. Never improvise.

items.dz: 把同一张照片卡放在多层阴影上，观察近边缘的接触影与远处的柔影如何分工。
items.de: Compare the tight contact shadow and the wider soft shadow beneath the same photo card.
items.pz: 每层分别控制偏移、模糊与透明度；靠近物体的层更紧。照片、边框和卡片尺寸保持一致，比较才有意义。
items.pe: Tune offset, blur, and opacity per layer. Keep the photo, border, and dimensions fixed so the shadow comparison remains meaningful.

items.dz: 用一层短柔影把照片卡与白色背景分开，适合低层级内容卡，不会把它抬成浮窗。
items.de: A single short shadow separates the photo card from its background without suggesting a floating dialog.
items.pz: 示例偏移 1px、模糊 2px；这些数值只对应当前尺寸，不是所有界面的通用处方。浅底色下还要检查边界能否被看见。
items.pe: This specimen uses a 1px offset and 2px blur. Those values fit this size, not every interface; check whether the boundary remains visible.

items.dz: 让照片卡的投影带一点强调色，适合暖色背景或品牌色面；照片本身保持原色，便于比较。
items.de: Tint the card shadow with the accent color while keeping the photograph unchanged for comparison.
items.pz: 颜色参与阴影透明度混合；先控制饱和度和不透明度，再调整模糊半径。带色并不天然更高级，过饱和会像发光。
items.pe: Control saturation and opacity before blur radius. A tinted shadow is not inherently better; excessive saturation reads as a glow.

items.dz: 低角度光的长影
items.de: A low sun, a long shadow
items.pz: 偏移远大于模糊，方向要全站统一。
items.pe: Offset far exceeds blur; keep one direction site-wide.

items.dz: 给完整照片卡加零模糊的偏移投影，边缘像印刷错版一样清楚。它适合强图形边界和海报式卡片。
items.de: A zero-blur offset shadow gives the complete photo card a crisp, print-like edge for graphic layouts.
items.pz: box-shadow 的第三个长度是模糊半径，这里为 0。8px 偏移不会占据布局空间；相邻卡片仍需预留可见投影的位置。
items.pe: The third box-shadow length is blur radius, set to zero here. The 8px offset occupies no layout space, so neighboring cards need clearance.

items.dz: 按下去像沉进面板
items.de: Sinks into the panel
items.pz: 按下用 inset 阴影加 1px 位移，弹起用外阴影。
items.pe: Press: inset shadow plus 1px shift. Release: back to outer.

items.dz: 同色浮雕，一亮一暗
items.de: Same-colour relief: one light, one dark
items.pz: 两个反向阴影 + 与底色完全同色，对比度是硬伤。
items.pe: Two opposite shadows on an identical background — contrast is its flaw.

items.dz: 阴影变成光源
items.de: The shadow becomes a light
items.pz: 同色高饱和 + 无偏移大模糊。
items.pe: Same hue, saturated, no offset, wide blur.

items.dz: 键盘焦点必须看得见
items.de: Keyboard focus has to be visible
items.pz: 用 outline + outline-offset，别用 box-shadow（会被裁）。
items.pe: Use outline with outline-offset — box-shadow gets clipped.

items.dz: 深浅两圈，任何底色都看得见
items.de: Two rings so it shows on any ground
items.pz: 内圈浅色、外圈深色，是无障碍推荐做法。
items.pe: Light inner ring, dark outer ring — the accessible pattern.

items.dz: 悬停后照片卡抬高并出现更宽的阴影，表示这张卡可以进一步查看。标题随卡片一起移动。
items.de: Hover lifts the photo card and broadens its shadow, suggesting that the card can be explored further.
items.pz: 位移与阴影同时过渡，照片不单独缩放。当前演示是 CSS 悬停反馈；实际产品还需真实链接和键盘焦点反馈。
items.pe: Transition the offset and shadow together without zooming the photograph separately. Production use also needs a real link and keyboard focus feedback.

items.dz: 一圈实心环随状态变化
items.de: A solid ring that reacts to state
items.pz: box-shadow 的 spread 参数做环，比 border 不占布局。
items.pe: Use the spread value as a ring — it costs no layout.

items.dz: 底部一条很紧的暗影
items.de: A tight dark line where it touches
items.pz: 接触面处必须有一层几乎不模糊的暗影，否则物体在飘。
items.pe: Without a near-sharp contact shadow the object floats.

items.dz: 物体轻轻上下浮，影子跟着变
items.de: It bobs, and the shadow answers
items.pz: 物体上移时阴影变大变淡，两者必须同步。
items.pe: As it rises the shadow grows and fades — in sync.

items.dz: 影子贴合真实形状
items.de: The shadow hugs the real shape
items.pz: filter:drop-shadow 会识别透明像素与 clip-path。
items.pe: filter:drop-shadow respects alpha and clip-path.

items.dz: 文字轻轻浮起
items.de: Type lifted slightly
items.pz: 低透明度大模糊，别给正文加阴影。
items.pe: Low opacity, wide blur — and never on body copy.

items.dz: 照片上的字必须压得住
items.de: Type over a photo needs help
items.pz: 底部渐变遮片比 text-shadow 更可靠。
items.pe: A bottom gradient scrim beats a text-shadow.

items.dz: 夹角处自然变暗
items.de: Corners naturally darken
items.pz: 内阴影只给上边缘，模拟顶光下的接缝。
items.pe: An inset shadow on the top edge only.

items.dz: 滚动后头部才出现阴影
items.de: The header only gets a shadow once you scroll
items.pz: 用 IntersectionObserver 或 scroll-driven，别常驻阴影。
items.pe: Toggle it with IntersectionObserver — do not ship it always-on.

items.dz: 背景压暗把注意力交出去
items.de: The background dims and hands over attention
items.pz: 遮罩 40–60% 黑，进入 200ms、退出 150ms。
items.pe: 40–60% black; 200ms in, 150ms out.

items.dz: 较深的双层阴影把内容卡从背景中提起，可用于比较菜单或浮层的视觉层级。
items.de: A deeper two-layer shadow lifts content above the background for a popover or menu elevation study.
items.pz: 近层收紧接触边缘，远层表现悬浮距离。本例是一张视觉样本卡，不包含菜单的焦点、定位和关闭逻辑。
items.pe: A tight layer anchors the edge; a wide layer suggests distance. This is a visual specimen, not a menu with focus, positioning, or dismissal behavior.

items.dz: 暗底下阴影几乎没用
items.de: Shadows barely work on dark
items.pz: 暗色里用更亮的背景色分层，而不是加深阴影。
items.pe: Separate dark layers by lightening the surface, not darkening the shadow.

items.dz: 照片卡在取起、悬浮、放回三个状态间循环，阴影随距离变化，而照片内容持续保持可辨认。
items.de: The photo card cycles through rest, lift, and settle while its changing shadow communicates distance.
items.pz: 缩放、轻微旋转和阴影必须在同一关键帧序列对齐。减少动态时停在静态内容，不能留下透明空卡。
items.pe: Align scale, rotation, and shadow in one keyframe sequence. Reduced motion should keep a visible resting card.

items.dz: 全站阴影同一个方向
items.de: One direction, everywhere
items.pz: 光从上方偏左，所有阴影就该往右下。
items.pe: Light from upper-left means every shadow falls lower-right.

items.dz: 大元素要更大的影
items.de: Bigger things cast bigger shadows
items.pz: 阴影半径大致等于元素高度的 15–25%。
items.pe: Blur ≈ 15–25% of the element height.

items.dz: 有时候一条线就够了
items.de: Sometimes a hairline is enough
items.pz: 信息密集界面用 1px 线分层，比阴影干净得多。
items.pe: In dense UI, hairlines separate better than shadows.

items.dz: 几圈环表达强调
items.de: Rings to emphasise
items.pz: 多个 spread 递增的 box-shadow，透明度递减。
items.pe: Several shadows with growing spread and falling alpha.

items.dz: 一圈圈扩散出去
items.de: Rings pushing outward
items.pz: spread 从 0 到大、opacity 到 0，循环 1.6s。
items.pe: Spread grows while alpha falls, on a 1.6s loop.

items.dz: 像挖进页面的一块
items.de: A well carved into the page
items.pz: 浅灰底 + 上边缘内阴影，表示“输入区”。
items.pe: Grey fill plus a top inset shadow reads as an input well.

items.dz: 两道实心阴影模拟照片卡后面的纸张堆叠，不额外复制正文，也不会造成多份可读内容。
items.de: Two solid shadows suggest stacked paper behind a photo card without duplicating readable content.
items.pz: 用正 Y 偏移和负扩散半径产生逐层缩小的薄片。它只暗示数量，不能用于表示真实可翻阅的卡片堆。
items.pe: Positive Y offsets and negative spread make the thin layers progressively smaller. They imply a stack, not an actual set of browsable cards.

items.dz: 两侧影子不同颜色
items.de: Two shadows, two colours
items.pz: 两个反向偏移的彩色阴影，是海报语言。
items.pe: Opposed coloured shadows — poster language, not product UI.

items.dz: 光源在鼠标那边
items.de: The light sits where the pointer is
items.pz: 把指针方向取反，写进阴影偏移变量。
items.pe: Invert the pointer vector into the shadow offset.

items.dz: 一条 1px 的白线
items.de: A single 1px white line
items.pz: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) 是拟物的灵魂。
items.pe: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6) is the whole trick.

items.dz: 悬停时只让预先画好的柔影逐渐出现，照片与标题保持静止，便于观察阴影透明度的作用。
items.de: Fade in a prepainted shadow on hover while keeping the photograph and title still.
items.pz: 阴影放在独立伪元素上，动画改变 opacity。伪元素要 pointer-events:none，否则可能挡住卡片内的真实控件。
items.pe: Put the shadow on a pseudo-element and animate opacity. Use pointer-events:none so it cannot cover actual card controls.

items.dz: 每一层有固定用途
items.de: Every layer has one job
items.pz: 把 z-index 定成命名常量：内容 0、浮层 100、模态 1000。
items.pe: Name your z-index tiers: content 0, popover 100, modal 1000.

items.dz: 深色照片卡周围透出一圈扩散色光，强调选中或活动状态；卡内文字需要保持足够对比。
items.de: A colored halo around a dark photo card can mark an active state while its caption stays legible.
items.pz: 模糊伪元素位于卡片后方，外容器不能把光晕裁掉。光晕属于强调光，不应当作自然投影或唯一选中提示。
items.pe: Keep the blurred layer behind the card and allow its halo outside the container. It is an accent glow, not a natural shadow or a sole selection cue.

items.dz: 阴影主要落在卡片右下角，帮助比较有方向的光照与居中的柔影。
items.de: A shadow concentrated below the right corner makes directional lighting easier to compare with centered elevation.
items.pz: X/Y 偏移确定光源反方向，负扩散半径收窄投影。整组卡片应共享方向，避免每张卡有不同的“太阳”。
items.pe: Offsets define the direction and negative spread narrows the shadow. Use one direction across a group of cards.

items.dz: 父层裁切会吃掉阴影
items.de: A clipping parent eats the shadow
items.pz: overflow:hidden 的父层里，阴影只能画在内部。
items.pe: Inside overflow:hidden, shadows can only live within bounds.

items.dz: 一条极淡的影代替线
items.de: A faint shadow instead of a rule
items.pz: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) 比 border 更柔和，不占 1px 布局。
items.pe: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.06) is softer than a border and costs no layout.

items.dz: 鼠标周围一圈微光
items.de: A faint halo around the pointer
items.pz: 径向渐变跟随指针，透明度 8–14%，尺寸 200px 左右。
items.pe: A radial gradient at 8–14% alpha, roughly 200px.

items.dz: 当前项浮起来一点
items.de: The active row floats a touch
items.pz: 选中项给一级阴影 + 白底，其余保持平。
items.pe: One shadow step and a white fill on the active row only.

items.dz: 带照片的通知卡从下方进入，较宽阴影让它与背景内容分层；通知内容在停留时仍要读得清。
items.de: A photo notification enters from below with a broad shadow separating it from the background.
items.pz: 这里只展示通知的视觉入场，生产实现还需停留时长、关闭入口和读屏播报策略。动画不要替代状态文案。
items.pe: This shows visual entry only. Production notifications still need timing, dismissal, and an announcement strategy.

items.dz: 快速移动时影子被拉长
items.de: The shadow smears when it moves fast
items.pz: 按速度把阴影沿运动方向拉长，停下即恢复。
items.pe: Stretch the shadow along the velocity vector; reset at rest.

dz: 把平面推进空间：翻转、深度、视差
de: Pushing flat things into space — flips, depth, parallax

items.dz: 沿竖轴翻过去
items.de: Flips around the vertical axis
items.pz: 父层 perspective + 元素 rotateY，记得 backface-visibility。
items.pe: perspective on the parent, rotateY on the child, plus backface-visibility.

items.dz: 沿横轴翻过去
items.de: Flips around the horizontal axis
items.pz: rotateX，配合略短的时长避免晕。
items.pe: rotateX with a slightly shorter duration so it does not feel queasy.

items.dz: 正反两面来回翻
items.de: Front and back trade places
items.pz: 两层绝对定位，一层 rotateY(180deg)，父层翻转。
items.pe: Two stacked faces, the back pre-rotated 180°, the parent flips.

items.dz: 真正的六面体在转
items.de: A real six-sided box turning
items.pz: 六个面用 translateZ + rotate 摆位，父层 preserve-3d。
items.pe: Six faces placed with rotate + translateZ inside a preserve-3d parent.

items.dz: 卡片跟着鼠标歪一点
items.de: The card leans toward the pointer
items.pz: 把鼠标相对中心的偏移映射到 rotateX/rotateY，幅度别超过 12°。
items.pe: Map pointer offset from centre onto rotateX/rotateY, capped around 12°.

items.dz: 几层卡片在 Z 轴上排开
items.de: Cards spread out along the Z axis
items.pz: 每层 translateZ 递增，加轻微缩放模拟距离。
items.pe: Increase translateZ per layer and scale slightly for distance.

items.dz: 从远处推到眼前
items.de: Pushed from far away up to the glass
items.pz: 动画 translateZ 而不是 scale，透视会自然产生形变。
items.pe: Animate translateZ rather than scale — perspective does the rest.

items.dz: 以一条边为轴推开
items.de: Swings open on one edge
items.pz: transform-origin 设到左边，rotateY 负角度。
items.pe: Put transform-origin on the left edge and rotateY negatively.

items.dz: 像书页一样掀过去
items.de: A page turning in a book
items.pz: 页面右缘为轴，翻转过半时切换正反面内容。
items.pe: Hinge on the right edge; swap face content past the halfway point.

items.dz: 中间正对，两侧向内斜
items.de: Centre faces you, the sides angle inward
items.pz: 按与中心的距离给 rotateY 和 translateZ 插值。
items.pe: Interpolate rotateY and translateZ by distance from centre.

items.dz: 薄片高速自转
items.de: A thin disc spinning fast
items.pz: rotateY 无限旋转 + 用 scaleX 模拟厚度错觉。
items.pe: Endless rotateY, with scaleX cheating the thickness.

items.dz: 翻几次停在一面
items.de: Tumbles, then settles on one face
items.pz: 把 rotate 值取 90° 的整数倍，落点才是正面。
items.pe: Keep rotations to multiples of 90° so it lands square.

items.dz: 小球绕着主体转一圈
items.de: A satellite circles the body
items.pz: 父层 rotateY，子元素 translateZ 撑出半径。
items.pe: Rotate the parent on Y; push the child out with translateZ.

items.dz: 元素沿螺旋线排开
items.de: Items strung along a helix
items.pz: 第 i 个元素 rotateY(i×角) translateZ(半径) translateY(i×步长)。
items.pe: Item i gets rotateY(i·angle) translateZ(r) translateY(i·step).

items.dz: 一层层从深处冲过来
items.de: Rings rush at you from the depth
items.pz: 多层同心矩形，translateZ 从远到近循环。
items.pe: Concentric frames looping translateZ from far to near.

items.dz: 缓慢无规律地浮动
items.de: Drifts slowly, never quite repeating
items.pz: 两三个不同周期的 rotate/translate 叠加，周期互质。
items.pe: Layer two or three rotations with co-prime durations.

items.dz: 像折纸一样一片片打开
items.de: Panels unfold like paper
items.pz: 相邻面 transform-origin 交替、角度取反。
items.pe: Alternate transform-origin and flip the sign per panel.

items.dz: 中缝一折，收起来
items.de: Creases down the middle and closes
items.pz: 上下两半分别 rotateX，共用中线做轴。
items.pe: Two halves rotateX around the shared centre line.

items.dz: 吊在一角轻轻晃
items.de: Hangs from a corner and sways
items.pz: transform-origin 放角上，rotate 小角度阻尼摆。
items.pe: Origin at a corner, small damped rotation.

items.dz: 布面一波一波起伏
items.de: Cloth rippling in waves
items.pz: 把面切成竖条，每条 rotateY 错峰摆动。
items.pe: Slice into vertical strips and phase-shift each rotateY.

items.dz: 网格像水面起伏
items.de: The grid undulates like water
items.pz: translateZ 按 sin(行+列) 错峰，父层大 perspective。
items.pe: translateZ phased by sin(row+col) under a wide perspective.

items.dz: 像建筑模型那样斜看
items.de: Seen at an architectural angle
items.pz: rotateX(54deg) rotateZ(45deg)，不用透视保持平行。
items.pe: rotateX(54deg) rotateZ(45deg) with no perspective keeps lines parallel.

items.dz: 越重要的越高
items.de: The important thing sits higher
items.pz: translateZ 分级 + 投影同步变大，层级一眼可读。
items.pe: Step translateZ and grow the shadow together.

items.dz: 红蓝双影的错位感
items.de: Red/cyan ghosting
items.pz: 两层同形状分别染红青、反向偏移几像素。
items.pe: Two tinted copies offset a few pixels in opposite directions.

items.dz: 换个透视原点，空间就歪了
items.de: Move the vanishing point and the room tilts
items.pz: perspective-origin 决定观察者位置，别只调角度。
items.pe: perspective-origin sets where the viewer stands — not just the angle.

items.dz: 转过去就看不见了
items.de: Turn it around and it disappears
items.pz: backface-visibility:hidden 是翻牌不漏内容的关键。
items.pe: backface-visibility:hidden is what keeps a flip clean.

items.dz: 一次写完所有变换
items.de: Every transform in one matrix
items.pz: matrix3d 适合从设计工具导出的精确变换，可读性差。
items.pe: matrix3d suits exact transforms from design tools; it reads badly by hand.

items.dz: 远处的层是虚的
items.de: The far layers go soft
items.pz: 按 Z 距离给 filter:blur 分级，近处保持全清。
items.pe: Grade filter:blur by Z distance; keep the front layer sharp.

items.dz: 零件沿轴散开
items.de: Parts pull apart along an axis
items.pz: 每层沿同一方向 translateZ 拉开，常用于产品说明。
items.pe: Pull every layer along one axis — the product-diagram move.

items.dz: 整块斜过去，像被风推
items.de: The block leans as if pushed
items.pz: skewY 配合 rotate 很小的量，避免文字失真。
items.pe: A touch of skewY plus rotate — keep text legible.

items.dz: 右下角翘起一块
items.de: The bottom corner lifts
items.pz: 伪元素做三角形 + 渐变，配合 rotate 与阴影。
items.pe: A gradient triangle pseudo-element, rotated, with a shadow under it.

items.dz: 球面纹理转过去
items.de: A textured sphere turning
items.pz: 用重复渐变模拟经线，background-position 平移。
items.pe: Fake meridians with a repeating gradient and slide background-position.

items.dz: 文字挤出厚度
items.de: Letters with real thickness
items.pz: 多层 text-shadow 逐像素偏移堆出侧面。
items.pe: Stack text-shadows one pixel apart to build the side wall.

items.dz: 每个字母翻一次
items.de: Each letter flips in turn
items.pz: 逐字 rotateX + 错峰 delay，父层要 perspective。
items.pe: Per-letter rotateX with staggered delay under a perspective parent.

items.dz: 悬停的那张浮到最前
items.de: The hovered one comes to the front
items.pz: 3D 场景里用 translateZ 而不是 z-index 决定前后。
items.pe: In a 3D scene, translateZ decides depth — not z-index.

items.dz: 几层按不同幅度跟着倾斜
items.de: Layers tilt by different amounts
items.pz: 同一倾斜量，越靠前的层乘更大系数。
items.pe: One tilt input, larger multiplier for nearer layers.

items.dz: 只允许一个方向转
items.de: Only one axis is allowed to move
items.pz: 交互式 3D 里锁死次要轴，观感更可控。
items.pe: Lock the secondary axis in interactive 3D — it reads calmer.

items.dz: 一叠卡略微错开
items.de: A stack fanned just slightly
items.pz: 每张 rotate 1–2°、translateY 递增，最上层无变换。
items.pe: Rotate each card 1–2° and step translateY; the top card stays flat.

items.dz: 当前页退到后面去
items.de: The current page steps back
items.pz: 页面转场里旧页 translateZ 负值 + 变暗，新页盖上。
items.pe: On transition, push the old page back and dim it, then cover it.

items.dz: 一下顶到最前面
items.de: Jumps right up to the glass
items.pz: translateZ + 轻微 rotate，时长控制在 260ms 内。
items.pe: translateZ with a hint of rotate, under 260ms.

items.dz: 一圈卡片绕轴转
items.de: Cards on a rotating ring
items.pz: 第 i 张 rotateY(i×360/n) translateZ(半径)。
items.pe: Card i: rotateY(i·360/n) translateZ(radius).

items.dz: 长条沿轴扭一圈
items.de: A strip twisting along its length
items.pz: 把长条切段，每段 rotateX 递增 20–30°。
items.pe: Slice the strip and add 20–30° rotateX per segment.

items.dz: 一边转一边往上走
items.de: Rotating as it climbs
items.pz: rotate 与 translateY 同时动，注意 transform 顺序。
items.pe: Animate rotate and translateY together — order matters.

items.dz: 两面墙像转门一样换位
items.de: Two walls swap like a revolving door
items.pz: 容器 rotateY 90°，两个面分别 translateZ 到内外。
items.pe: Rotate the container 90°; place the faces with translateZ.

items.dz: 一列面板像风箱展开
items.de: Panels open like bellows
items.pz: 相邻面反向 rotateX，公用铰链边。
items.pe: Neighbouring panels rotateX in opposite directions on a shared hinge.

items.dz: 网格向地平线收敛
items.de: A grid converging on the horizon
items.pz: rotateX(70deg) 的重复渐变网格 + 上方渐隐遮罩。
items.pe: A repeating-gradient grid at rotateX(70deg), masked toward the horizon.

items.dz: 越高投影越远越虚
items.de: Higher means a longer, softer shadow
items.pz: 把高度同时映射到 translateZ、阴影偏移和模糊半径。
items.pe: Map height onto translateZ, shadow offset and blur at once.

items.dz: 整个区块斜着躺下
items.de: The whole block lies back
items.pz: rotateX 加 translateY，常用于展示界面截图。
items.pe: rotateX plus translateY — the screenshot-showcase angle.

items.dz: 有没有它，层次完全不同
items.de: With or without it, depth is a different story
items.pz: 任何祖先设了 overflow 或 filter 都会压平 3D 上下文。
items.pe: Any ancestor with overflow or filter flattens the 3D context.

items.dz: 整片卡片一起躺斜
items.de: A whole field of cards leaning back
items.pz: 在容器上做一次 3D 变换，子项保持 2D，性能最好。
items.pe: One 3D transform on the container, children stay 2D — cheapest.

items.dz: 切换标签时旧标签翻走
items.de: The old tab flips away
items.pz: 两层文字叠放，rotateX 50% 时交接。
items.pe: Two stacked labels handing over at the 50% mark of rotateX.

items.dz: 新消息浮在最上层
items.de: The newest message floats highest
items.pz: 按时间给 translateZ 与阴影分级，最新的最近。
items.pe: Grade translateZ and shadow by recency.

items.dz: 几张图错落浮在空间里
items.de: Prints floating at different depths
items.pz: 随机 rotate 与 translateZ，但要保持一个统一光源方向。
items.pe: Randomise rotate and translateZ, keep one light direction.

dz: 线本身就是内容：描边、下划线、连接线
de: The line as content — strokes, underlines, connectors

items.dz: 边框沿着四边画出来
items.de: The frame draws itself round
items.pz: 两个伪元素各画两边，配合 delay 顺序展开。
items.pe: Two pseudo-elements draw two edges each, delayed in sequence.

items.dz: 线条像被笔画出来
items.de: The stroke appears as if drawn
items.pz: SVG 里 stroke-dasharray = 路径长度，动画 stroke-dashoffset 到 0。
items.pe: Set stroke-dasharray to the path length and animate dashoffset to 0.

items.dz: 选区的虚线在爬
items.de: The selection dashes crawl
items.pz: 虚线渐变边框 + background-position 平移，一格一周期。
items.pe: A dashed gradient border with a one-period position pan.

items.dz: 悬停时线从左伸出
items.de: The rule grows from the left on hover
items.pz: 用 scaleX + transform-origin，不要动 width。
items.pe: scaleX with transform-origin — never animate width.

items.dz: 线从中间往两边长
items.de: The rule opens from the middle
items.pz: transform-origin:center 即可，视觉上更礼貌。
items.pe: transform-origin:center — a politer variant.

items.dz: 旧线退出、新线进入
items.de: One rule leaves as the next arrives
items.pz: 离开时 origin 换到右侧，形成“接力”而不是“回缩”。
items.pe: Flip the origin on leave so it hands off instead of retracting.

items.dz: 一条起伏的线
items.de: A rippling rule
items.pz: text-decoration:underline wavy 或重复径向渐变。
items.pe: text-decoration wavy, or a repeating radial gradient.

items.dz: 线遇到字母下伸部就断开
items.de: The rule breaks around descenders
items.pz: text-decoration-skip-ink:auto，是排版细节的分水岭。
items.pe: text-decoration-skip-ink:auto — a typographic tell.

items.dz: 像马克笔刷过一道
items.de: Swiped with a marker
items.pz: 背景层从 0 到 100% 宽，混合模式 multiply 更像墨。
items.pe: A background growing to full width in multiply.

items.dz: 一条线穿过文字
items.de: A line crosses the text
items.pz: 用伪元素 scaleX，语义上仍需 <del>。
items.pe: A scaleX pseudo-element — still mark it up with <del>.

items.dz: 四角的取景框
items.de: Four corner marks, like a viewfinder
items.pz: 四个伪元素或一层 conic 遮罩，常用于科技风。
items.pe: Four pseudo-corners, or one masked conic layer.

items.dz: 四角轻轻内外呼吸
items.de: The corner marks breathe
items.pz: 四角同步位移 2–3px，周期 1.6s。
items.pe: Move the corners 2–3px on a 1.6s cycle.

items.dz: 几乎看不见但有秩序
items.de: Barely there, but it organises
items.pz: 0.5px 在高分屏才准，用 transform:scaleY(.5) 实现。
items.pe: Real 0.5px needs transform:scaleY(.5) on a 1px line.

items.dz: 线中间嵌一个词
items.de: A word set into the rule
items.pz: flex + 两侧 flex:1 的线，比背景挖洞可靠。
items.pe: Flex with two flexible rules beats a masked background.

items.dz: 两个节点之间的线
items.de: A line between two nodes
items.pz: 正交连接线用两段直线 + 圆角拐点，别用曲线。
items.pe: Orthogonal connectors: two straight runs and a rounded elbow.

items.dz: 线上有光点在跑
items.de: A pulse travels the wire
items.pz: 虚线渐变平移，或一个小点沿 offset-path 走。
items.pe: Pan a dashed gradient, or send a dot along offset-path.

items.dz: 文件树的那种折线
items.de: The file-tree elbows
items.pz: 每层用 ::before 画竖线、::after 画横线，末项截断竖线。
items.pe: Vertical line in ::before, elbow in ::after, truncated on the last child.

items.dz: 一条主线串起节点
items.de: One spine, many stops
items.pz: 主线用容器伪元素，节点用列表项的圆点。
items.pe: The spine belongs to the container; the dots to the items.

items.dz: 已完成的线是实的
items.de: Completed segments go solid
items.pz: 未完成段用浅灰，已完成用主色，节点状态三态。
items.pe: Grey for pending, accent for done — three node states.

items.dz: 一条线加个头
items.de: A line with a head
items.pz: 箭头用旋转 45° 的两条边，别用字符。
items.pe: Two rotated edges — not a text glyph.

items.dz: 箭头往前挪一点
items.de: The arrow nudges forward
items.pz: 悬停时箭头 translateX 4px，文字不动。
items.pe: On hover, translateX the arrow 4px and leave the label.

items.dz: 不那么直的线
items.de: A line that is not quite straight
items.pz: 用 SVG path 的轻微抖动，或 border-image 平铺手绘纹理。
items.pe: A slightly jittered SVG path, or a tiled hand-drawn border-image.

items.dz: 像铅笔勾的框
items.de: Pencilled in
items.pz: border-image 用手绘 SVG 平铺，slice 要留白。
items.pe: A hand-drawn SVG border-image with generous slices.

items.dz: 表示“可放入”
items.de: Says “drop here”
items.pz: 虚线 + 浅底，拖拽悬停时变实线并高亮。
items.pe: Dashed with a tint; solid and highlighted on drag-over.

items.dz: 粗细表达重要性
items.de: Weight carries importance
items.pz: 一套线宽只用三档：1px 分隔、2px 强调、4px 图形。
items.pe: Three weights only: 1px rules, 2px emphasis, 4px graphics.

items.dz: 边框和元素之间留空
items.de: A gap between frame and object
items.pz: outline-offset 可以是负值，做“内描边”。
items.pe: outline-offset takes negative values for an inset frame.

items.dz: 两圈线，古典排版味
items.de: Two rules — a classical device
items.pz: border + outline 或 box-shadow 做第二圈。
items.pe: A border plus an outline, or a second ring via box-shadow.

items.dz: 悬停时线变粗
items.de: The stroke thickens on hover
items.pz: 用 box-shadow 的 spread 代替 border-width，避免布局跳动。
items.pe: Grow a box-shadow spread instead of border-width — no layout shift.

items.dz: 状态从“草稿”到“确定”
items.de: From draft to committed
items.pz: border-style 不能过渡，用两层伪元素交叉淡出。
items.pe: border-style cannot transition — cross-fade two layers.

items.dz: 折线从左往右画出
items.de: The line draws left to right
items.pz: stroke-dashoffset 从路径长度到 0，1.2s ease-out。
items.pe: dashoffset from path length to 0 over 1.2s ease-out.

items.dz: 嵌在文字里的小图
items.de: A chart small enough to sit in a line
items.pz: 不要坐标轴、不要图例，只要形状与末点。
items.pe: No axes, no legend — just the shape and the last point.

items.dz: 一圈线画完
items.de: A ring drawing itself
items.pz: conic-gradient + 环形遮罩，或 SVG circle 的 dashoffset。
items.pe: A conic gradient with a ring mask, or an SVG circle dashoffset.

items.dz: 一段弧在转
items.de: An arc going round
items.pz: 经典 spinner：一边 border 透明 + 无限旋转。
items.pe: The classic spinner: three transparent borders, one coloured.

items.dz: 勾一笔画出来
items.de: The tick draws in one stroke
items.pz: 两段线分别 delay，勾的转折要有停顿感。
items.pe: Two segments with a delay — the corner needs a beat.

items.dz: 两笔交叉画出
items.de: Two strokes crossing
items.pz: 两条线各自 scaleX，delay 60ms。
items.pe: Two scaleX lines, 60ms apart.

items.dz: 汉堡变叉号
items.de: Burger becomes a cross
items.pz: 三条线：上下旋转成叉，中间淡出，250ms。
items.pe: Three bars: outer two rotate, the middle fades, 250ms.

items.dz: 一排竖线高低起伏
items.de: Vertical bars rising and falling
items.pz: 每条 scaleY 错峰，delay 用负值让它一开始就满。
items.pe: Stagger scaleY with negative delays so it starts full.

items.dz: 像音频条一样跳
items.de: Bars jumping like audio
items.pz: 每条独立周期与相位，看起来才不像统一动画。
items.pe: Give each bar its own period and phase.

items.dz: 每一行都被划到
items.de: Every line gets its rule
items.pz: 用 text-decoration 而不是伪元素，才能跟随换行。
items.pe: Use text-decoration so it follows line breaks.

items.dz: 输入光标在跳
items.de: The caret blinks
items.pz: steps(1) 硬切换，别用淡入淡出（那不像光标）。
items.pe: steps(1) — a fade does not read as a caret.

items.dz: 一条弯箭头指过去
items.de: A curved arrow pointing off
items.pz: 弯箭头用 SVG path + marker-end，别拼贝塞尔。
items.pe: An SVG path with marker-end — do not fake the curve.

items.dz: 线本身有颜色变化
items.de: The rule itself shifts colour
items.pz: 渐变 background 做线，比 border 更灵活。
items.pe: A gradient background beats a border for this.

items.dz: 走过的路留下一条线
items.de: The path leaves a trace
items.pz: 记录点集画 polyline，旧点逐渐淡出。
items.pe: Record points into a polyline and fade the tail.

items.dz: 大引号做视觉锚点
items.de: Oversized quotes as an anchor
items.pz: 用 ::before 放大引号并降低透明度，别用图片。
items.pe: An oversized low-opacity ::before glyph, not an image.

items.dz: 章节之间的小记号
items.de: A small mark between sections
items.pz: 三个点或一个小菱形，比长线更有排版味。
items.pe: Three dots or a small lozenge reads more typographic than a long rule.

dz: 图片怎么进场、怎么被裁、怎么被看
de: How images arrive, crop, and get looked at

items.dz: 照片极慢地推近平移
items.de: A very slow push across a still
items.pz: scale 1→1.08 配合轻微位移，周期 12–20s。
items.pe: scale 1→1.08 with a slight pan over 12–20s.

items.dz: 图片轻轻升起
items.de: The image rises in
items.pz: translateY 12px + opacity，别加 scale。
items.pe: translateY 12px plus opacity — skip the scale.

items.dz: 框不动，图放大
items.de: The frame holds, the image grows
items.pz: 容器 overflow:hidden，图 scale(1.06)，400ms。
items.pe: Clip the frame and scale the image 1.06 over 400ms.

items.dz: 反其道：悬停时退开一点
items.de: The inverse — it pulls back
items.pz: 初始 scale(1.08)，悬停回到 1，观感更“克制”。
items.pe: Start at 1.08 and return to 1 — reads more restrained.

items.dz: 图比容器慢一点
items.de: The image lags the frame
items.pz: 图高出容器 20%，滚动时反向位移一半距离。
items.pe: Oversize the image 20% and move it at half the scroll rate.

items.dz: 两张图无缝交替
items.de: Two stills trade places
items.pz: 两层同位，opacity 反向过渡，中间避免同时半透明。
items.pe: Stack both and counter-fade; avoid both being semi-transparent.

items.dz: 一张推走一张
items.de: One pushes the next in
items.pz: 整条轨道 translateX 整格，用 steps 时长控制停留。
items.pe: Translate the whole track by whole frames; hold with steps.

items.dz: 填满还是完整显示
items.de: Cover it or contain it
items.pz: cover 会裁掉边缘，contain 会留白，二选一别拉伸。
items.pe: cover crops, contain letterboxes — never stretch.

items.dz: 裁的时候保住主体
items.de: Keep the subject when cropping
items.pz: 给每张图存一个焦点坐标，object-position 用它。
items.pe: Store a focal point per image and feed object-position.

items.dz: 图未加载也不跳版
items.de: No layout jump before it loads
items.pz: aspect-ratio 或 padding hack，必须写 width/height 属性。
items.pe: aspect-ratio (or the padding hack) plus real width/height attributes.

items.dz: 进入视口才加载并淡入
items.de: Loads and fades when it enters view
items.pz: loading="lazy" + decode 完成后加 class 淡入。
items.pe: loading="lazy", then add a class once decode resolves.

items.dz: 先糊后清
items.de: Blurry first, sharp after
items.pz: LQIP 20px 缩略图放大模糊，真图到位后交叉淡出。
items.pe: Upscale a 20px LQIP with blur, then cross-fade.

items.dz: 占位块先撑住版面
items.de: A placeholder holds the layout
items.pz: 骨架比例必须和真图一致，否则一定跳版。
items.pe: The skeleton must match the real ratio or the page jumps.

items.dz: 从上到下逐渐清晰
items.de: Resolves from the top down
items.pz: 渐进式 JPEG 或分块解码，感知速度更快。
items.pe: Progressive JPEG or chunked decode feels faster.

items.dz: 一片等大的缩略图
items.de: A field of equal thumbnails
items.pz: 统一比例 + 1px 白缝，不要给每张加圆角阴影。
items.pe: One ratio, 1px white gutters, no per-tile shadow.

items.dz: 高度不齐但列对齐
items.de: Ragged heights, aligned columns
items.pz: CSS columns 或 grid-template-rows:masonry；JS 方案要防抖。
items.pe: CSS columns or masonry rows; debounce any JS fallback.

items.dz: 大小不一、白缝分割
items.de: Unequal tiles split by white gutters
items.pz: 让一块占两格，白缝保持一致宽度。
items.pe: Let one tile span two cells; keep the gutter constant.

items.dz: 点开占满屏幕
items.de: Tap and it takes the screen
items.pz: 用共享元素过渡（View Transitions）从缩略图长到大图。
items.pe: Use a shared-element transition from thumb to full.

items.dz: 拖动滑块看差异
items.de: Drag the handle to compare
items.pz: 上层 clip-path inset 跟随滑块位置，配一条竖线手柄。
items.pe: Clip the top layer to the handle position; draw a vertical grip.

items.dz: 文字从底部滑出
items.de: The caption slides up
items.pz: 说明层 translateY(100%) → 0，加渐变遮片保可读。
items.pe: Slide the caption from translateY(100%) with a scrim behind it.

items.dz: 悬停才上色
items.de: Colour on hover only
items.pz: filter:grayscale 过渡 400ms，比 opacity 更克制。
items.pe: Transition grayscale over 400ms.

items.dz: 图跟着指针倾斜
items.de: The photo leans with the pointer
items.pz: 容器 perspective，图 rotateX/rotateY 幅度 ≤10°。
items.pe: Perspective on the frame, ≤10° of rotation on the photo.

items.dz: 白边加轻微投影
items.de: A white margin and a soft shadow
items.pz: 白边 8–14px + 底部略宽，像实体照片。
items.pe: An 8–14px white margin, slightly wider at the bottom.

items.dz: 带手写说明的方边照片
items.de: Square print with a handwritten note
items.pz: 轻微旋转（≤2°）比正放更真实。
items.pe: A ≤2° rotation reads truer than perfectly straight.

items.dz: 不动就隐藏控件
items.de: Controls hide when idle
items.pz: 3s 无操作淡出控件，任何输入立即淡入。
items.pe: Fade out after 3s idle; any input brings them back.

items.dz: 中间一个三角
items.de: A triangle in the middle
items.pz: 播放键要有 44px 以上的点击区，悬停轻微放大。
items.pe: At least a 44px hit area; a small scale on hover.

items.dz: 细线加一个圆点
items.de: A thin line with a knob
items.pz: 轨道 2px、悬停变 4px，缓冲段用更浅的颜色。
items.pe: A 2px track growing to 4px on hover; buffered range in a paler tone.

items.dz: 调音量时的短暂提示
items.de: A brief readout while adjusting
items.pz: 出现 200ms、停留 800ms、淡出 200ms。
items.pe: 200ms in, 800ms hold, 200ms out.

items.dz: 悬停进度条弹出小图
items.de: Hovering the bar pops a thumbnail
items.pz: 预生成雪碧图，按时间取偏移，别现场截帧。
items.pe: Pre-generate a sprite sheet and offset by time.

items.dz: 一排缩略图可横滑
items.de: A scrollable strip of thumbs
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory，每格 snap-align:start。
items.pe: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory with snap-align:start per item.

items.dz: 图从一条边露出
items.de: The photo emerges from one edge
items.pz: clip-path inset 从 100% 到 0，配 ease-out 700ms。
items.pe: clip-path inset from 100% to 0 over 700ms ease-out.

items.dz: 上面一张被抽走
items.de: The top print is pulled away
items.pz: 最上层 translate + rotate 出场，下层同时上移一层。
items.pe: The top layer translates and rotates out as the next steps up.

items.dz: 两张图各自平移
items.de: Two photos panning in opposition
items.pz: 两层反向 translateX，速度差 20% 才有层次。
items.pe: Counter-pan the layers with a 20% speed difference.

items.dz: 几个头像互相压边
items.de: Avatars overlapping
items.pz: 负 margin + 白描边，悬停时展开间距。
items.pe: Negative margin plus a white ring; spread out on hover.

items.dz: 右上角一个小标签
items.de: A small tag in the corner
items.pz: 角标必须有底色或阴影，不能只靠白字。
items.pe: A badge needs a fill or shadow — white text alone fails.

items.dz: 图挂了也要好看
items.de: Even a failure should look designed
items.pz: 用浅底 + 图标 + 说明，别让浏览器默认破图出现。
items.pe: A tinted block with an icon and label — never the browser default.

items.dz: 将真实地点标题放到照片下沿的纸色标签上，让图注与照片产生明确关联，而不直接压在复杂山纹上。
items.de: Place the destination title in a paper-colored label overlapping the photo edge instead of directly over busy mountain detail.
items.pz: 标签保留实色底与小阴影，再用负 margin 形成叠层；文字仍是独立内容。改成多行标题时必须检查高度，不能让下一段内容被覆盖。
items.pe: An opaque label, small shadow, and negative margin form the overlap while the caption remains separate text. Test multi-line captions for collisions.

items.dz: 用这张山地照片中实际采样出的蓝灰色设置卡片背景与色条，比较图像和界面色彩之间的连续性。
items.de: Use blue-gray colors sampled from this mountain photograph for the card and its swatches.
items.pz: 此调色板由原图缩至 160×72 后进行五色中位切分量化得到，使用 #8babbf 与 #2b5876。演示预存结果，换图不会自动重新采样；动态实现需读取同源或允许 CORS 的像素。
items.pe: The photo was resized to 160×72 and median-cut into five colors; this uses #8babbf and #2b5876. The palette is precomputed. Dynamic extraction needs same-origin or CORS-enabled pixels.

items.dz: 底部压暗放文字
items.de: Darkened at the bottom for type
items.pz: 遮片高度 40–55%，用两段 ease 的渐变更自然。
items.pe: 40–55% tall, with an eased two-stop ramp.

items.dz: 悬停时形状变了
items.de: The shape changes on hover
items.pz: border-radius 过渡 400ms，四角可以不对称。
items.pe: Transition border-radius over 400ms; corners need not match.

items.dz: 滚到才出现
items.de: Appears as you reach it
items.pz: IntersectionObserver + 一次性 class，别反复播放。
items.pe: IntersectionObserver plus a one-shot class — do not replay.

items.dz: 只照亮一块
items.de: Only one patch is lit
items.pz: 暗层挖圆洞，跟随指针移动。
items.pe: A dark layer with a radial hole tracking the pointer.

items.dz: 图被裁成非矩形
items.de: Cropped to something other than a rectangle
items.pz: clip-path 或 mask，注意焦点不能被切掉。
items.pe: clip-path or mask — keep the focal point inside.

items.dz: 文字滚动，图不动
items.de: The text scrolls, the image holds
items.pz: position:sticky 的图 + 长文，是产品叙事的标配。
items.pe: A sticky image beside long copy — the product-story staple.

items.dz: 悬停那张变大，别人退让
items.de: One grows, the rest give way
items.pz: grid 的悬停项 scale 1.06，兄弟项降透明度。
items.pe: Scale the hovered tile 1.06 and dim its siblings.

dz: 很多小东西一起动，就有了氛围
de: Many small things moving together become atmosphere

items.dz: 一片点轻轻起伏
items.de: A field of dots swelling
items.pz: 相位由索引决定，周期统一才不乱。
items.pe: Phase by index, one shared period.

items.dz: 碎片炸开再落下
items.de: Shards burst, then fall
items.pz: 初速度随机、重力一致、旋转独立，1.4s 内清场。
items.pe: Random velocity, shared gravity, independent spin, gone in 1.4s.

items.dz: 零星几点亮一下
items.de: A few points twinkle
items.pz: 稀疏且随机，密了立刻显廉价。
items.pe: Sparse and random — dense reads cheap.

items.dz: 慢慢往下飘
items.de: Drifting down
items.pz: 速度、粒径、横向摆动都要分档，否则像雨。
items.pe: Vary speed, size and sway or it reads as rain.

items.dz: 往上飘并变大
items.de: They rise and swell
items.pz: 上升中半径增大、透明度降低，到顶消失。
items.pe: Grow and fade as they rise.

items.dz: 暖色小点缓缓上升
items.de: Warm motes drifting up
items.pz: 颜色由橙衰减到暗红，配轻微横向抖动。
items.pe: Fade orange to dark red with a slight sway.

items.dz: 几个点绕中心转
items.de: Dots circling a centre
items.pz: 统一旋转容器，粒子只做半径偏移，最省。
items.pe: One spinning container; particles only offset radially.

items.dz: 走过留下一串点
items.de: A string of dots left behind
items.pz: 尾部按时间衰减尺寸与透明度，头部最实。
items.pe: Decay size and alpha along the tail.

items.dz: 从一点向外爆开
items.de: It bursts outward
items.pz: 方向沿圆周均分，统一 easing 收尾。
items.pe: Spread evenly round the circle, one shared easing.

items.dz: 散点收拢成阵
items.de: Scattered dots gather
items.pz: 每点有目标坐标，错峰 30ms 抵达。
items.pe: A target per dot, arriving 30ms apart.

items.dz: 粒子沿看不见的风走
items.de: Particles ride an invisible wind
items.pz: Perlin 噪声给方向场，粒子只跟随不碰撞。
items.pe: A Perlin field gives direction; no collisions.

items.dz: 星点向外加速拉长
items.de: Stars streak outward
items.pz: 径向位移 + scaleX 拉长，越快越长。
items.pe: Radial motion with streaks that grow with speed.

items.dz: 一列列字符往下掉
items.de: Columns of glyphs falling
items.pz: 每列独立速度，头部最亮、尾部渐隐。
items.pe: Per-column speed, bright head, faded tail.

items.dz: 大块几何缓慢漂移
items.de: Large shapes drifting
items.pz: 3–5 个形状、20s 以上周期，周期互质永不重复。
items.pe: Three to five shapes, 20s+, co-prime cycles.

items.dz: 两团靠近就融在一起
items.de: Two blobs fuse as they meet
items.pz: 父层 blur + contrast 制造粘连，是纯 CSS 的取巧法。
items.pe: Blur then crank contrast on the parent — the CSS cheat.

items.dz: 一圈圈向外扩散
items.de: Rings spreading outward
items.pz: 半径线性、透明度指数衰减，才像水。
items.pe: Linear radius, exponential fade.

items.dz: 粒子被吸过去
items.de: Particles pull toward the pointer
items.pz: 距离越近力越大，但要设最小距离防抖。
items.pe: Force rises with proximity — clamp the minimum.

items.dz: 粒子被推开
items.de: Particles scatter away
items.pz: 排斥半径 100–160px，恢复用弹簧。
items.pe: A 100–160px radius with a spring return.

items.dz: 一圈波纹扫过网格
items.de: A ripple crosses the grid
items.pz: delay 由到波源的距离决定，不是索引。
items.pe: Delay by distance to the source, not index.

items.dz: 点阵拼出图形
items.de: Dots spell something out
items.pz: canvas 采样文字像素，再把点放到亮处。
items.pe: Sample the type on canvas, place dots on lit pixels.

items.dz: 格子按规则生灭
items.de: Cells live and die by rule
items.pz: 状态更新要双缓冲，别边算边写。
items.pe: Double-buffer the state.

items.dz: 色团缓慢翻滚
items.de: Colour churning slowly
items.pz: 多层大半径径向渐变各自平移，周期互质。
items.pe: Several wide radials panning on co-prime cycles.

items.dz: 不规则分区镶嵌
items.de: Irregular tessellation
items.pz: 真 Voronoi 要算最近点，CSS 只能用 conic 拼近似。
items.pe: True Voronoi needs nearest-point maths; CSS only fakes it.

items.dz: 慢慢游走并明暗
items.de: They wander and pulse
items.pz: 位置随机游走 + 独立明暗周期，不同步才自然。
items.pe: Random walk plus independent pulse — never in sync.

items.dz: 光里的细小微粒
items.de: Motes in a shaft of light
items.pz: 极慢、极淡、极小，观感上只是“空气有质感”。
items.pe: Very slow, faint and small — it should only read as air.

items.dz: 细长线条快速落下
items.de: Thin lines falling fast
items.pz: 雨是线不是点，用 scaleY 拉长并统一角度。
items.pe: Rain is lines, not dots — stretch scaleY at one angle.

items.dz: 边落边翻转
items.de: They tumble as they fall
items.pz: 下落时 rotate3d 让正反面交替，才有轻盈感。
items.pe: rotate3d so both faces show — that is the lightness.

items.dz: 一团团散开变淡
items.de: Puffs spreading and thinning
items.pz: 上升 + 放大 + 模糊 + 淡出四者同时，缺一不像烟。
items.pe: Rise, scale, blur and fade together — all four.

items.dz: 靠近的点之间连线
items.de: Nearby points get linked
items.pz: 只连距离小于阈值的点，线的透明度按距离衰减。
items.pe: Only link under a threshold; fade the line by distance.

items.dz: 一圈迅速扩散消失
items.de: One ring, fast and gone
items.pz: 半径快、透明度更快归零，只出现一次。
items.pe: Radius fast, alpha faster — and only once.

dz: 无缝循环的横向内容：logo 墙、公告带、评价流
de: Seamless horizontal loops — logo walls, ticker bars, testimonial rows

items.dz: 一直往左走，看不出接缝
items.de: It never stops and never seams
items.pz: 内容复制两份、整体 translateX(-50%)，linear 匀速。
items.pe: Duplicate the content and translate −50%, always linear.

items.dz: 两排反方向走
items.de: Two rows travelling opposite ways
items.pz: 上下两排反向，速度略有差异才不像镜像。
items.pe: Counter-run the rows at slightly different speeds.

items.dz: 想看清就停下
items.de: Stops so you can read it
items.pz: animation-play-state:paused，比重设动画平滑。
items.pe: animation-play-state:paused — smoother than restarting.

items.dz: 进出都柔和
items.de: Soft at both ends
items.pz: mask 渐变而不是覆盖白块，任何底色都适用。
items.pe: A gradient mask adapts to any ground; white overlays do not.

items.dz: 一排客户标识滚过
items.de: A row of client marks
items.pz: logo 统一高度而不是宽度，去色后再统一透明度。
items.pe: Normalise height, then desaturate to one alpha.

items.dz: 像股票行情条
items.de: A stock-ticker bar
items.pz: 涨跌用符号 + 颜色双编码，数字等宽。
items.pe: Sign plus colour, tabular figures.

items.dz: 一列内容往上走
items.de: A column travelling up
items.pz: 纵向循环同理：复制两份、translateY(-50%)。
items.pe: Same trick vertically: duplicate and translateY −50%.

items.dz: 三排不同速度
items.de: Three rows, three speeds
items.pz: 速度比 1 : 1.3 : 0.8，视觉最丰富。
items.pe: A 1 : 1.3 : 0.8 speed ratio reads richest.

items.dz: 整条带子斜着穿过
items.de: The band crosses on a slant
items.pz: 容器 rotate(-4deg) 并超出边界，避免露出端头。
items.pe: Rotate the band −4° and overflow the bounds.

items.dz: 两条斜带交叉
items.de: Two slanted bands cross
items.pz: 两条角度相反，交点处用混合模式更有层次。
items.pe: Opposite angles; blend where they cross.

items.dz: 一排图片无缝滚过
items.de: A seamless row of images
items.pz: 每张统一比例，间距 8–12px，别加圆角阴影。
items.pe: One ratio, 8–12px gutters, no per-tile shadow.

items.dz: 一排评价卡缓慢走过
items.de: A slow row of quote cards
items.pz: 速度要慢到能读完一句（40s 以上）。
items.pe: Slow enough to read a sentence — 40s or more.

items.dz: 滑动后停在整格
items.de: It settles on whole cards
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:x mandatory，滚动条隐藏但保留键盘。
items.pe: x mandatory snapping; hide the bar, keep keyboard access.

items.dz: 边缘故意露一点
items.de: A sliver of the next card shows
items.pz: 露出 16–28px 提示可滑，比小圆点更有效。
items.pe: A 16–28px peek beats dot indicators.

items.dz: 当前那颗变长
items.de: The active dot stretches
items.pz: 当前项用宽度变化而不是换色，识别更快。
items.pe: Widen the active dot rather than recolouring it.

items.dz: 每 5 秒换一张
items.de: A new card every five seconds
items.pz: 必须可暂停，且悬停/聚焦时自动停。
items.pe: Must be pausable, and pause on hover or focus.

items.dz: 一条线走完就换
items.de: The line runs out and it advances
items.pz: 计时条要和真实切换同步，悬停一起暂停。
items.pe: Keep the bar and the advance in sync — pause together.

items.dz: 一条大字循环带
items.de: A big-type loop
items.pz: 字号越大速度要越慢，感知速度与字号成正比。
items.pe: Bigger type needs slower speed — perception scales with size.

items.dz: 句子里一个词在换
items.de: One word keeps changing
items.pz: 换词时容器宽度过渡，否则整句会跳。
items.pe: Transition the container width or the sentence jumps.

items.dz: 整片网格缓慢平移
items.de: The whole grid drifts
items.pz: 平移一个完整格距后瞬移回零，视觉无缝。
items.pe: Translate exactly one cell, then snap back.

items.dz: 物件被送过去
items.de: Objects ride along
items.pz: 带纹与物件同速，否则会有“滑动”错觉。
items.pe: Match the belt texture speed to the objects.

items.dz: 两端的翻页按钮
items.de: Page buttons at both ends
items.pz: 到头就禁用箭头，别让它无反应地存在。
items.pe: Disable the arrow at the end — do not leave it dead.

items.dz: 按住直接拖
items.de: Grab and drag it
items.pz: 鼠标拖动 + 惯性，光标要用 grab / grabbing。
items.pe: Pointer drag with inertia and grab cursors.

items.dz: 滚一段后停住
items.de: It rolls, then stops
items.pz: 停下时保留一点减速，别硬切。
items.pe: Ease into the stop — never cut it.

items.dz: 顶部一条持续滚动
items.de: A running line at the top
items.pz: 公告条必须可关闭，且关闭状态要记住。
items.pe: Dismissible — and remember the dismissal.

items.dz: 页面滚得快，带子也快
items.de: Scroll faster, the band runs faster
items.pz: 把滚动速度映射到 playbackRate，上限要 clamp。
items.pe: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate — clamp the top end.

items.dz: 远近三层各自速度
items.de: Three depths, three speeds
items.pz: 越远越慢越淡，才有空间感。
items.pe: Farther means slower and paler.

dz: 数字要看得清、跳得稳、涨得有说服力
de: Numbers should read clean, tick steady, and land convincingly

items.dz: 数字跳动时位置不抖
items.de: Digits stop jittering as they change
items.pz: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums，所有会变的数字都该开。
items.pe: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums on anything that changes.

items.dz: 从 0 涨到目标值
items.de: Climbs from zero to the target
items.pz: 用 ease-out 收尾，最后 20% 放慢，别线性。
items.pe: Ease out the last 20% — never linear.

items.dz: 每一位像滚筒一样翻
items.de: Each digit rolls like a drum
items.pz: 每位一个竖列 0–9，translateY 到目标位。
items.pe: One 0–9 column per digit, translateY to the target.

items.dz: 像机械翻牌钟
items.de: A split-flap clock
items.pz: 上下两半分别翻转，中缝要有一条暗线。
items.pe: Two halves flipping with a dark seam between.

items.dz: 旧数字上移、新数字进来
items.de: The old digit leaves upward
items.pz: 容器 overflow:hidden，两个数字上下排，整体 translateY。
items.pe: Clip the cell and translate a two-digit column.

items.dz: 旁边一个小箭头和百分比
items.de: A small arrow and a percentage
items.pz: 涨跌用形状 + 颜色双编码，别只靠红绿。
items.pe: Encode direction with shape and colour, never colour alone.

items.dz: 变了就闪一下
items.de: It flashes when it changes
items.pz: 背景色闪 300ms 后淡出，不要移动数字。
items.pe: Flash the background for 300ms — never move the number.

items.dz: 数字大、说明小
items.de: A huge figure, a small label
items.pz: 数字用 tabular + 负字距，说明用小号大写。
items.pe: Tabular figures with tight tracking; the label small and uppercase.

items.dz: 单位小一号并对齐基线
items.de: The unit sits smaller, on the baseline
items.pz: 单位用 0.4em 并 baseline 对齐，不要上标。
items.pe: Set the unit at 0.4em on the baseline — not superscript.

items.de: 3,425 becomes 3.4k
items.pz: 仪表盘用缩写，明细页用完整数字。
items.pe: Abbreviate in dashboards, spell out in detail views.

items.dz: 符号、千分位、小数位
items.de: Symbol, separators, decimals
items.pz: 用 Intl.NumberFormat，别手写正则。
items.pe: Use Intl.NumberFormat — never hand-rolled regex.

items.dz: 一条填充的轨道
items.de: A track filling up
items.pz: 进度只用 transform:scaleX，别动 width。
items.pe: Fill with transform:scaleX, not width.

items.dz: 不知道多久，先动着
items.de: No idea how long — keep moving
items.pz: 一小段在轨道上往复，不要伪造百分比。
items.pe: A short segment sweeping the track — never fake a percentage.

items.dz: 几段格子逐个亮起
items.de: Segments lighting one by one
items.pz: 分段进度更适合“共 5 步”这类有限流程。
items.pe: Segments suit finite flows: step 3 of 5.

items.dz: 一圈表示百分比
items.de: A ring reading a percentage
items.pz: conic-gradient + 遮罩；起点固定 12 点方向。
items.pe: A conic gradient with a ring mask, starting at 12 o’clock.

items.dz: 环从 0 转到目标
items.de: The ring sweeps to its value
items.pz: @property 注册百分比变量，conic 角度才能过渡。
items.pe: Register the percentage with @property so the conic can animate.

items.dz: 半圈量表加指针
items.de: A semi-ring with a needle
items.pz: 半圆用 conic 0–180° + 下半遮住，指针单独旋转。
items.pe: A 180° conic with the lower half hidden; rotate the needle separately.

items.dz: 一排小柱表示趋势
items.de: Tiny bars carrying a trend
items.pz: 不加坐标轴，只标最后一根。
items.pe: No axes; label only the last bar.

items.dz: 柱子从底部长出
items.de: Bars grow from the baseline
items.pz: transform-origin:bottom + scaleY，错峰 60ms。
items.pe: scaleY from the bottom, 60ms stagger.

items.dz: 悬停那根变深
items.de: The hovered bar darkens
items.pz: 悬停项加深、其余降饱和，比 tooltip 更快读。
items.pe: Darken one, desaturate the rest — faster than a tooltip.

items.dz: 一条虚线标出目标
items.de: A dashed line marks the target
items.pz: 阈值线要有标签，超过部分换色。
items.pe: Label the threshold and recolour anything above it.

items.dz: 一根柱里分几段
items.de: One bar, several parts
items.pz: 段数不要超过 4，超过就换成分组柱。
items.pe: Four segments max — beyond that, group instead.

items.dz: 用点代替柱
items.de: Dots instead of bars
items.pz: 比较少量类别时点图比柱图更轻。
items.pe: For a handful of categories a dot plot reads lighter.

items.dz: 一段范围而不是一个值
items.de: A span, not a point
items.pz: 区间两端加短刻度，中位数用一条线。
items.pe: Cap the ends with ticks and mark the median.

items.dz: 时间在减少
items.de: Time draining away
items.pz: 最后 10 秒变色并加脉冲，别整段都在跳。
items.pe: Recolour and pulse the last 10 seconds only.

items.dz: 毫秒位一直在跑
items.de: The milliseconds never rest
items.pz: 毫秒位用固定宽度并降低对比，避免视觉噪音。
items.pe: Fix the width of the ms digits and lower their contrast.

items.dz: 秒针一格一格走
items.de: The second hand ticks
items.pz: 秒针用 steps(60)，分针连续，才像真表。
items.pe: steps(60) for seconds, continuous for minutes.

items.dz: 拖动时数值跟着手
items.de: The value follows your thumb
items.pz: 数值气泡跟着滑块，松手后 600ms 淡出。
items.pe: A bubble tracks the thumb and fades 600ms after release.

items.dz: 加减按钮改数字
items.de: Plus and minus, nothing else
items.pz: 长按要加速，数字用等宽避免宽度跳动。
items.pe: Accelerate on hold; tabular digits keep the width stable.

items.dz: 小红点里的数字
items.de: The number in the dot
items.pz: 超过 99 显示 99+，圆点最小 16px。
items.pe: Cap at 99+; never smaller than 16px.

items.dz: 一组横条比较占比
items.de: Rows comparing shares
items.pz: 横条按数值排序，标签左对齐、数值右对齐。
items.pe: Sort by value; labels left, numbers right.

items.dz: 格子深浅表示数量
items.de: Cell darkness carries the count
items.pz: 色阶最多 5 级，最浅一级要能看出与空的区别。
items.pe: Five steps max; the palest must differ from empty.

items.dz: 一年的小方块
items.de: A year of small squares
items.pz: 格子 10–12px、间距 3px，一年 53 列。
items.pe: 10–12px cells, 3px gaps, 53 columns for a year.

items.dz: 标签、数字、趋势三层
items.de: Label, number, trend
items.pz: 数字最大、趋势第二、标签最小，别都一样大。
items.pe: Number biggest, trend next, label smallest.

items.dz: 两个数字并列比较
items.de: Two figures side by side
items.pz: 并列数字必须同位数、同单位、同字号。
items.pe: Same digits, same unit, same size — or it lies.

items.dz: 单位晚一点出现
items.de: The unit arrives a beat later
items.pz: 数字停下后 120ms 再让单位淡入。
items.pe: Fade the unit 120ms after the number settles.

items.dz: 数字没到先占位
items.de: A placeholder holds the digits
items.pz: 骨架宽度按最长可能值，避免数值到位后跳动。
items.pe: Size the skeleton to the longest plausible value.

items.dz: 负数换颜色和符号
items.de: Negatives change sign and colour
items.pz: 负数用括号或减号 + 颜色，双编码更稳。
items.pe: Parentheses or a minus plus colour — double-encode it.

items.dz: 小数位不要太多
items.de: Fewer decimals, please
items.pz: 仪表盘一位小数，财务两位，计数零位。
items.pe: One decimal in dashboards, two in finance, none for counts.

items.dz: 真实值加一条平滑线
items.de: The raw series plus a smoothed line
items.pz: 原始数据浅色，平滑线深色 2px，图例必写窗口大小。
items.pe: Raw pale, smoothed dark at 2px, and state the window.

items.dz: 数字持续小幅跳动
items.de: The figure keeps twitching
items.pz: 跳动幅度要小、频率不超过 2Hz，否则不可读。
items.pe: Small deltas, under 2Hz, or nobody can read it.

items.dz: 离目标还差多少
items.de: How far from the goal
items.pz: 同时给出当前值、目标值和剩余量，别只给百分比。
items.pe: Show current, target and remainder — not just a percentage.

items.dz: 表示已知上下界内的当前数量，读数对应容量或测量值，而非任务完成进度。
items.de: Display a quantity within known bounds, such as capacity or a measurement, rather than task completion.
items.pz: 原站 Storage 示例把标签、百分比和填充轨道放在一起，也允许设置上下界与单位格式。它描述当前数值所处的位置；若要表达下载或后台任务的完成程度，应使用进度条语义。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The Storage example combines a label, percentage and filled track, with configurable bounds and unit formatting. It communicates the current quantity; task completion such as a download belongs to progress semantics. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

dz: 数字怎么变成看得懂的图形
de: Turning numbers into shapes people read

items.dz: 柱状图从底部长出来
items.de: Bars rise from the baseline
items.pz: transform-origin:bottom 的 scaleY(0→1)，别动 height 免得重排。
items.pe: scaleY(0→1) with transform-origin bottom, not height.

items.dz: 一根一根依次长出
items.de: Bars grow one after another
items.pz: delay = index × 70ms，读者的视线会跟着走。
items.pe: delay = index × 70ms — the eye follows the sequence.

items.dz: 类别名长时用横条
items.de: Use horizontal bars when labels are long
items.pz: 横条从左生长，标签左对齐、数值右对齐。
items.pe: Grow from the left; labels left, values right.

items.dz: 折线像被笔画出来
items.de: The line draws itself
items.pz: SVG path 的 stroke-dasharray/-dashoffset 从满到 0。
items.pe: Animate SVG stroke-dasharray/offset from full to zero.

items.dz: 折线下方渐变填色
items.de: A gradient fills under the line
items.pz: 线画完后面积层再淡入，两段动画错开 200ms。
items.pe: Fade the area in 200ms after the line finishes.

items.dz: 圆环按比例扫一圈
items.de: The ring sweeps to its value
items.pz: conic-gradient 的角度动画，或 SVG circle 的 dashoffset。
items.pe: Animate the conic-gradient angle, or an SVG circle dashoffset.

items.dz: 细环显示完成度
items.de: A thin ring shows completion
items.pz: SVG circle + stroke-dashoffset，round 线帽更友好。
items.pe: SVG circle with stroke-dashoffset and round caps.

items.dz: 半圆表盘配指针
items.de: A half-dial with a needle
items.pz: 半圆 conic-gradient + 指针 rotate，指针用 out-back 落定。
items.pe: Half conic-gradient plus a needle rotating with out-back.

items.dz: 一根柱里分几段
items.de: One bar split into segments
items.pz: 每段单独动画，从下往上依次叠加。
items.pe: Animate segments bottom-up, one after another.

items.dz: 两组数据并排比较
items.de: Two series side by side
items.pz: 组内间距小于组间间距，视觉才分得清。
items.pe: Inner gap must be smaller than the gap between groups.

items.dz: 用点代替柱，更轻
items.de: Dots instead of bars — lighter
items.pz: 柱子替换为端点圆 + 细连接线，适合数据点少时。
items.pe: A dot at the value with a thin stem; best for few points.

items.dz: 嵌在文字旁的小趋势
items.de: A tiny trend that sits beside text
items.pz: 无坐标轴、无标签，只表达方向，高度 20–32px。
items.pe: No axes or labels — direction only, 20–32px tall.

items.dz: 颜色深浅表示大小
items.de: Color depth encodes magnitude
items.pz: 单色系明度阶梯，别用彩虹色，色阶控制在 5–7 级。
items.pe: A single-hue lightness ramp, 5–7 steps — never rainbow.

items.dz: 一格格方块表示百分比
items.de: Squares stand in for a percentage
items.pz: 10×10 网格，填充数量 = 百分比，比饼图更好读。
items.pe: A 10×10 grid filled to the percentage — easier than a pie.

items.dz: 实际值对着目标线
items.de: Actual value against a target line
items.pz: 背景带表示区间，粗条是实际值，竖线是目标。
items.pe: Range band behind, thick bar for actual, tick for target.

items.dz: 两维关系的点云
items.de: A cloud showing two dimensions
items.pz: 点半透明避免重叠糊成一片，可加抖动。
items.pe: Semi-transparent dots (plus jitter) survive overplotting.

items.dz: 一条虚线标出警戒值
items.de: A dashed line marks the limit
items.pz: 虚线 + 右侧标签，超过阈值的柱换成警示色。
items.pe: Dashed rule with a label; bars above it switch to the alert color.

items.dz: 指到哪根哪根变深，其余变淡
items.de: The hovered bar darkens, the rest recede
items.pz: 父级 hover 降低所有条透明度，当前条恢复并显示数值。
items.pe: Dim all on parent hover; restore the hovered one and show its value.

items.dz: 悬停时冒出精确数值
items.de: Exact numbers appear on hover
items.pz: 气泡吸附到最近的数据点，不要跟着鼠标乱飘。
items.pe: Snap the tooltip to the nearest datum, do not float with the cursor.

items.dz: 重新排序时柱子平移到新位置
items.de: Bars slide to their new rank
items.pz: 用 FLIP 保证每根柱从旧位置平滑移动到新位置。
items.pe: FLIP each bar from its old rect to the new one.

items.dz: 网格线安静地先出现
items.de: Grid lines arrive quietly first
items.pz: 轴线先于数据出现，透明度不超过 12%。
items.pe: Axes appear before the data, at 12% opacity or less.

items.dz: 正负分列基线两侧
items.de: Positive and negative split by the baseline
items.pz: 基线居中，涨用品牌绿、跌用 Folly 粉，别用红绿撞色。
items.pe: Centre the baseline; brand green up, Folly down.

items.dz: 关键指标跳到目标值
items.de: The headline metric counts to its value
items.pz: 用 ease-out 的计数曲线（先快后慢），保留千分位。
items.pe: Ease-out counting with thousand separators.

items.dz: 柱子绕成一圈
items.de: Bars wrapped into a circle

items.dz: 加载状态说明等待原因，动画节奏稳定且可暂停。
items.de: Loading motion explains waiting and has a stable pausable rhythm.
items.pz: 加载状态说明等待原因，动画节奏稳定且可暂停。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Loading motion explains waiting and has a stable pausable rhythm. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 骨架闪光不模拟真实内容，降低频率并提供静态回退。
items.de: Skeleton shimmer does not pretend to be content and has a static fallback.
items.pz: 骨架闪光不模拟真实内容，降低频率并提供静态回退。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Skeleton shimmer does not pretend to be content and has a static fallback. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 错误反馈短促且不摇晃整页，避免给用户造成额外焦虑。
items.de: Error feedback is brief and does not shake the whole page.
items.pz: 错误反馈短促且不摇晃整页，避免给用户造成额外焦虑。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Error feedback is brief and does not shake the whole page. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 成功反馈强调完成结果并可被跳过，不延迟继续操作。
items.de: Success feedback highlights completion without delaying the next action.
items.pz: 成功反馈强调完成结果并可被跳过，不延迟继续操作。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Success feedback highlights completion without delaying the next action. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 开发模式显示持续时间、缓动和触发源，便于复核复杂过渡。
items.de: Debug mode exposes duration, easing, and trigger for complex transitions.
items.pz: 开发模式显示持续时间、缓动和触发源，便于复核复杂过渡。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Debug mode exposes duration, easing, and trigger for complex transitions. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 测试覆盖 reduced-motion、低性能设备、快速重复操作和中断。
