items.de: Test reduced motion, low-end devices, rapid repetition, and interruption.
items.pz: 测试覆盖 reduced-motion、低性能设备、快速重复操作和中断。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Test reduced motion, low-end devices, rapid repetition, and interruption. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 每个动效记录触发、目的、时长、回退和可访问性要求。
items.de: Document trigger, purpose, duration, fallback, and accessibility.
items.pz: 每个动效记录触发、目的、时长、回退和可访问性要求。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Document trigger, purpose, duration, fallback, and accessibility. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

items.dz: 发布前检查动效是否可理解、可取消、可访问并且性能可接受。
items.de: Audit motion for comprehension, cancellation, accessibility, and performance.
items.pz: 发布前检查动效是否可理解、可取消、可访问并且性能可接受。 在暗色主题、键盘操作和 reduced-motion 下复核。
items.pe: Audit motion for comprehension, cancellation, accessibility, and performance. Validate dark theme, keyboard interaction, and reduced-motion.

dz: 焦点、播报、对比、命中区、减弱动效——每条都能被验收，不是"加个 aria" 就完事
de: Focus, announcements, contrast, target size, reduced motion — each one testable, not just "add an aria attribute"

items.dz: 键盘走到哪，哪里有一圈
items.de: Wherever the keyboard lands, a ring appears
items.pz: 2px 实心外环 + 2px 偏移，颜色要在深浅底上都够；绝不 outline:none 而不给替代。
items.pe: A 2px solid ring with a 2px offset, legible on light and dark. Never outline:none without a replacement.

items.dz: 鼠标点不显环，键盘走才显
items.de: Mouse clicks show no ring; keyboard does
items.pz: 交互样式挂 :focus-visible，:focus 只留作兜底；不要为了"好看"全局关掉。
items.pe: Style :focus-visible and keep :focus as a fallback. Never disable it globally for looks.

items.dz: 模态打开后 Tab 走不出去
items.de: Tab cannot escape an open modal
items.pz: 循环首尾可聚焦元素，Esc 关闭；背景内容加 inert，不只是 aria-hidden。
items.pe: Cycle the first and last focusable nodes, Esc closes, and mark the background inert — not just aria-hidden.

items.dz: 关掉浮层后焦点回到原来那个按钮
items.de: Closing an overlay returns focus to its trigger
items.pz: 打开前存住 document.activeElement，关闭后 focus() 回去；否则键盘用户直接被扔回页首。
items.pe: Store document.activeElement before opening and focus() it back on close, or keyboard users are dumped at the top.

items.dz: 第一个 Tab 出现"跳到正文"
items.de: The first Tab reveals "skip to content"
items.pz: 视觉隐藏但可聚焦，聚焦时滑出；目标容器要有 tabindex="-1"。
items.pe: Visually hidden but focusable; it slides in on focus. Give the target container tabindex="-1".

items.dz: 一组控件只占一个 Tab 位
items.de: A whole group takes one Tab stop
items.pz: 组内只有一个 tabindex="0"，其余 -1，方向键在组内移动；工具栏、单选组、日历必用。
items.pe: One tabindex="0" inside the group, the rest -1, arrows move within. Mandatory for toolbars, radio groups, calendars.

items.zh: 阅读顺序 = DOM 顺序
items.dz: 看起来在左边，Tab 却最后到
items.de: It looks first but Tab reaches it last
items.pz: flex order / grid 定位 / 绝对定位都会把视觉顺序和 DOM 顺序拆开；用 DOM 顺序对齐视觉，别用正 tabindex 打补丁。
items.pe: order, grid placement and absolute positioning split visual from DOM order. Fix the DOM — never patch with positive tabindex.

items.dz: 屏幕上看不见，读屏能读到
items.de: Invisible on screen, present to a reader
items.pz: 1px 裁切 + clip-path，不用 display:none 也不用 visibility:hidden（那两个读屏也读不到）。
items.pe: A 1px clipped box — never display:none or visibility:hidden, which hide it from readers too.

items.dz: 内容变了要说一声
items.de: Say it out loud when content changes
items.pz: aria-live 容器必须在变更前就存在于 DOM；文本要完整成句，不要只播报数字。
items.pe: The aria-live container must exist in the DOM before the change. Announce a whole sentence, not a bare number.

items.dz: 插话还是排队
items.de: Interrupt, or wait your turn
items.pz: 状态更新用 polite（排队），只有错误与危险用 assertive（打断）；滥用 assertive 等于一直喊。
items.pe: Status updates are polite (queued); only errors and danger are assertive (interrupting). Overusing assertive means shouting.

items.dz: 点标签能聚焦到输入框
items.de: Clicking the label focuses the field
items.pz: label[for] 对应 input[id]，或把 input 包进 label；placeholder 永远不能当标签用。
items.pe: label[for] matched to input[id], or wrap the input in the label. A placeholder is never a label.

items.dz: 每个控件都要能被这三样描述
items.de: Every control needs all three
items.pz: 可访问名称来自 label / aria-label / 内容；角色来自语义标签优先；值用 aria-valuenow 之类。缺一个就等于不可用。
items.pe: The name comes from a label or content, the role from a semantic element first, the value from aria-value*. Missing one makes it unusable.

items.dz: 读屏用户靠它跳章节
items.de: Readers jump between them
items.pz: header / nav / main / aside / footer 各一个，main 只能有一个；多个同类要加 aria-label 区分。
items.pe: One each of header, nav, main, aside, footer — exactly one main. Label duplicates to tell them apart.

items.dz: h1 到 h6 不能跳级
items.de: No skipped heading levels
items.pz: 一页一个 h1，往下不跳级；标题大小是视觉决定，层级是结构决定，两件事分开。
items.pe: One h1 per page and no level skipping. Size is a visual decision, level is a structural one — keep them separate.

items.dz: 有信息就写，纯装饰就留空
items.de: Informative gets text, decorative gets empty
items.pz: 装饰图 alt=""，信息图写清"说了什么"而不是"画了什么"，图表要在正文给出数据。
items.pe: Decorative images get alt="", informative ones say what it means (not what it depicts), and charts need the data in prose.

items.dz: 有声音就要有字
items.de: If it makes sound, it needs text
items.pz: 字幕含说话人与关键音效，位置避开画面下方 UI；长视频再另配可搜索文字稿。
items.pe: Captions carry speaker labels and key sound effects, placed clear of bottom UI. Long video also needs a searchable transcript.

items.dz: 把画面里的信息念出来
items.de: Narrate what only the picture says
items.pz: 给纯视觉信息（表情、图表、文字卡）配一条描述音轨或扩展描述版本。
items.pe: Add a description track — or an extended-description cut — for information carried only by the image.

items.de: 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large
items.pz: 算的是文字与其"真实背景"的比；半透明文字、图上文字、渐变上文字都要按最差点算。
items.pe: Measure against the real backdrop. Alpha text, text on photos and text on gradients are all judged at the worst point.

items.dz: 边框和图标也要够
items.de: Borders and icons need it too
items.pz: 输入框边框、开关轨道、图标、焦点环对相邻色至少 3:1；"极淡的灰线"是最常见的失败点。
items.pe: Field borders, switch tracks, icons and focus rings need 3:1 against neighbours. Hairline greys are the usual failure.

items.dz: 红绿色盲看不出你的"红涨绿跌"
items.de: Red-green cannot read your up-down colours
items.pz: 成对色改用蓝橙轴，或在色相之外再加明度差、形状、标签；用模拟器验收三种类型。
items.pe: Swap red-green pairs for a blue-orange axis, and add a lightness, shape or label difference. Verify with a simulator.

items.dz: 把颜色遮掉还看得懂吗
items.de: Would it still read in greyscale?
items.pz: 状态、必填、错误、图例都要有第二编码：图标、下划线、文案、纹理。
items.pe: States, required marks, errors and legends need a second encoding: an icon, an underline, a word, a texture.

items.dz: 视觉可以小，命中区不能小
items.de: It can look small; it cannot be small
items.pz: 移动端 44×44px、桌面 24×24px 起；用 padding 或伪元素撑开命中区，不要放大图标本身。
items.pe: From 44×44px on touch, 24×24px on desktop. Grow the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element, not the icon.

items.dz: 两个小按钮之间要留手指的余量
items.de: Leave room for a fingertip between them
items.pz: 命中区不足时，相邻目标中心距至少 44px；密集图标行是最容易误触的地方。
items.pe: When targets are undersized, keep 44px between centres. Dense icon rows are where mis-taps happen.

items.dz: 有人一看视差就晕
items.de: Parallax makes some people ill
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion:reduce 时去掉视差、缩放、旋转、自动轮播，保留淡入与瞬时状态变化。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop parallax, scale, rotation and autoplay — keep fades and instant state changes.

items.dz: 毛玻璃对某些人就是一团糊
items.de: Frosted glass reads as mud to some
items.pz: prefers-reduced-transparency 时把半透明面板换成实色，去掉 backdrop-filter。
items.pe: Under prefers-reduced-transparency, swap translucent panels for solid fills and drop backdrop-filter.

items.dz: Windows 高对比下你的界面还在吗
items.de: Does your UI survive Windows high contrast?
items.pz: forced-colors:active 时系统接管颜色；用 CanvasText / ButtonFace 等系统色，给纯色块加 border 才不会消失。
items.pe: When forced-colors is active the system owns colour. Use system keywords and give solid blocks a border or they vanish.

items.dz: 放大四倍不能出现横向滚动
items.de: No horizontal scroll at 400%
items.pz: 等价于 320px 宽视口：用相对单位、允许换行、避免固定宽容器与两轴滚动。
items.pe: It equals a 320px viewport — relative units, allowed wrapping, no fixed-width containers or two-axis scrolling.

items.dz: 用户拉大行距不能把字压掉
items.de: User line-height must not clip text
items.pz: 行高 1.5×、段距 2×、字距 0.12em、词距 0.16em 时仍不能截断；给文本容器留可增长的高度。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Survive line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2×, letter-spacing .12em, word-spacing .16em without clipping. Let text boxes grow. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 轮椅上装的平板转不过来
items.de: A mounted tablet cannot be rotated
items.pz: 除游戏等本质需求外不要锁 orientation；横竖两种布局都要能用。
items.pe: Do not lock orientation unless it is essential. Both portrait and landscape must work.

items.dz: 会话要过期得先问一句
items.de: Warn before the session dies
items.pz: 至少提前 20 秒提示，并提供"延长"；表单内容要能恢复，不能一刷新全没。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Warn at least 20 seconds ahead with an extend action, and preserve form content across the refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 超过 5 秒的自动动作必须能停
items.de: Anything auto over 5s needs a stop
items.pz: 轮播、跑马灯、动图都要有暂停控件，且默认不自动播放声音。
items.pe: Carousels, marquees and animated media need a pause control, and never autoplay audio.

items.dz: 闪太快会诱发癫痫
items.de: Fast flashing can trigger seizures
items.pz: 任何区域每秒闪烁不超过 3 次，且不要大面积红色闪动；故障风、霓虹风尤其要收着。
items.pe: No more than three flashes per second in any region, and never large-area red flashing. Glitch and neon styles need restraint.

items.dz: 错在哪、是哪条
items.de: Which field, and which rule
items.pz: 错误要文字化并与字段关联（aria-describedby），聚焦到第一个错误；不要只把边框变红。
items.pe: Errors are text, linked to the field with aria-describedby, and focus moves to the first one. A red border alone is not an error message.

items.dz: 别只说错了，说怎么改
items.de: Say how to fix it, not just that it broke
items.pz: 给出示例、允许值域或一键修正；金融与法律场景还要给撤销窗口。
items.pe: Offer an example, the allowed range, or a one-tap fix. Financial and legal flows also need an undo window.

items.dz: 把说明放在需要它的地方
items.de: Put the hint where the doubt is
items.pz: 帮助文本放在标签下、输入前，常驻而不是悬停才出；tooltip 里的关键信息等于没有。
items.pe: Help sits under the label, before the field, and stays visible. Critical information inside a tooltip is invisible.

items.dz: 让浏览器和密码管理器帮上忙
items.de: Let the browser and password manager help
items.pz: 按规范写 autocomplete（name / email / one-time-code / new-password），对认知障碍与运动障碍用户帮助最大。
items.pe: Use the standard tokens (name, email, one-time-code, new-password). It helps cognitive and motor users the most.

items.dz: 星号之外还要有话
items.de: An asterisk is not a sentence
items.pz: 用 required 属性 + 文字"必填"，并在表单顶部说明标记含义；反过来标"选填"往往更清楚。
items.pe: Use the required attribute plus the word, and explain the mark at the top. Marking the optional fields is often clearer.

items.dz: 一组单选要有一个组名
items.de: A radio group needs a group name
items.pz: 用 fieldset + legend 或 role="group" + aria-labelledby，否则读屏只念得到"选项一"。
items.pe: Use fieldset with legend, or role="group" with aria-labelledby, or a reader only hears "option one".

items.dz: 用原生 dialog，别自己搭
items.de: Use the native dialog, do not rebuild it
items.pz: <dialog> + showModal() 自带焦点管理、Esc、inert 背景与顶层渲染；自造的 div 十有八九漏一样。
items.pe: dialog with showModal() gives focus handling, Esc, an inert background and top-layer rendering. A hand-rolled div misses at least one.

items.dz: aria-expanded 必须跟着变
items.de: aria-expanded has to actually change
items.pz: 触发器是 button，带 aria-expanded 与 aria-controls；箭头旋转只是视觉，状态在属性里。
items.pe: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The rotating caret is decoration; the state lives in the attribute.

items.dz: tablist / tab / tabpanel 三件套
items.de: The tablist, tab and tabpanel triad
items.pz: aria-selected 标当前项，方向键切换（roving tabindex），面板用 aria-labelledby 指回标签。
items.pe: aria-selected marks the current tab, arrows switch with roving tabindex, and the panel points back with aria-labelledby.

items.dz: 能打字也能选，语义最容易写错
items.de: Type or pick — the easiest pattern to get wrong
items.pz: input[role=combobox] + aria-expanded + aria-activedescendant，列表是 listbox；候选变化要通过 live region 报数量。
items.pe: input with role=combobox, aria-expanded and aria-activedescendant over a listbox; announce the result count in a live region.

items.dz: 表头必须是 th
items.de: Headers must be th
items.pz: th + scope="col|row"，caption 说明表在讲什么；用 div 拼的表格要补 role=table/row/cell。
items.pe: th with a scope, plus a caption saying what the table is. A div-built grid needs role=table/row/cell added back.

items.dz: 点了表头要说"已按日期升序"
items.de: Say "sorted by date, ascending"
items.pz: th 上写 aria-sort，切换后用 live region 播报完整句子；箭头图标不构成播报。
items.pe: Put aria-sort on the th and announce a whole sentence in a live region. An arrow glyph is not an announcement.

items.dz: 转圈对读屏是一片安静
items.de: A spinner is silence to a reader
items.pz: 给忙碌区域 aria-busy="true"，完成后在 live region 播报"已加载 12 条"；骨架屏同理。
items.pe: Mark the busy region aria-busy and announce "12 items loaded" when done. Skeletons need the same.

items.dz: 拖不动的人也要能排序
items.de: Sorting must work without dragging
items.pz: 每个可拖项提供"上移/下移"或"剪切—粘贴到此"；单指拖动也要有非拖动路径。
items.pe: Give every draggable an up/down action or a cut-and-place path. Single-pointer drag needs a non-drag route too.

items.dz: 捏合、长按、划动都要有按钮版
items.de: Pinch, long-press and swipe all need a button
items.pz: 多点与路径手势必须有单点等价操作，且可撤销；边缘划动更要给可见入口。
items.pe: Multipoint and path gestures need a single-pointer equivalent that is undoable. Edge swipes especially need a visible entry.

items.dz: "确定要删除吗"是懒惰的设计
items.de: "Are you sure?" is the lazy option
items.pz: 低风险操作直接执行 + 提供撤销条；只有不可逆且高代价的操作才用二次确认，并要求输入名称。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Execute low-risk actions and offer undo. Reserve confirmation for irreversible, costly actions — and make them type the name. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 功能控件有稳定名称，装饰图形不重复播报。
items.de: Functional controls have stable names without duplicate decorative speech.
items.pz: 功能控件有稳定名称，装饰图形不重复播报。
items.pe: Functional controls have stable names without duplicate decorative speech.

items.dz: 角色、状态和属性同步实际交互，不把文字当作唯一语义。
items.de: Roles, states, and properties match actual interaction.
items.pz: 角色、状态和属性同步实际交互，不把文字当作唯一语义。
items.pe: Roles, states, and properties match actual interaction.

items.dz: 页面地标帮助读屏用户跳到导航、主内容和补充区域。
items.de: Landmarks let screen-reader users jump to navigation and content.
items.pz: 页面地标帮助读屏用户跳到导航、主内容和补充区域。
items.pe: Landmarks let screen-reader users jump to navigation and content.

items.dz: 标题层级按内容结构组织，不用字号模拟层级。
items.de: Headings follow content structure rather than visual size.
items.pz: 标题层级按内容结构组织，不用字号模拟层级。
items.pe: Headings follow content structure rather than visual size.

items.dz: 混合语言片段标记正确语言，读屏使用合适发音。
items.de: Mark mixed-language spans for correct pronunciation.
items.pz: 混合语言片段标记正确语言，读屏使用合适发音。
items.pe: Mark mixed-language spans for correct pronunciation.

items.dz: 低优先级更新不抢占用户正在阅读的内容。
items.de: Low-priority updates do not interrupt reading.
items.pz: 低优先级更新不抢占用户正在阅读的内容。
items.pe: Low-priority updates do not interrupt reading.

items.dz: 紧急更新仅用于真正需要立即注意的安全状态。
items.de: Reserve assertive updates for urgent safety states.
items.pz: 紧急更新仅用于真正需要立即注意的安全状态。
items.pe: Reserve assertive updates for urgent safety states.

items.dz: 区域更新期间标记忙碌，完成后恢复可读状态。
items.de: Mark regions busy during updates and readable after completion.
items.pz: 区域更新期间标记忙碌，完成后恢复可读状态。
items.pe: Mark regions busy during updates and readable after completion.

items.dz: 字段无效状态与视觉错误、描述和焦点保持同步。
items.de: Sync invalid state with visual error, description, and focus.
items.pz: 字段无效状态与视觉错误、描述和焦点保持同步。
items.pe: Sync invalid state with visual error, description, and focus.

items.dz: 帮助文本和错误文本通过关联属性接到对应控件。
items.de: Associate help and errors with their controls.
items.pz: 帮助文本和错误文本通过关联属性接到对应控件。
items.pe: Associate help and errors with their controls.

items.dz: 错误摘要可导航到字段，并说明错误数量。
items.de: Summaries navigate to fields and state count.
items.pz: 错误摘要可导航到字段，并说明错误数量。
items.pe: Summaries navigate to fields and state count.

items.dz: 焦点顺序遵循视觉和任务顺序，动态插入不打乱。
items.de: Focus follows visual and task order despite dynamic insertion.
items.pz: 焦点顺序遵循视觉和任务顺序，动态插入不打乱。
items.pe: Focus follows visual and task order despite dynamic insertion.

items.dz: 焦点环在暗色、高对比和缩放下仍然可见。
items.de: Focus rings remain visible across themes and zoom.
items.pz: 焦点环在暗色、高对比和缩放下仍然可见。
items.pe: Focus rings remain visible across themes and zoom.

items.dz: 触控目标满足尺寸和间距，邻近操作不易误触。
items.de: Meet target size and spacing to reduce mis-taps.
items.pz: 触控目标满足尺寸和间距，邻近操作不易误触。
items.pe: Meet target size and spacing to reduce mis-taps.

items.dz: 核心任务不依赖鼠标、拖动或 hover。
items.de: Core tasks do not require mouse, drag, or hover.
items.pz: 核心任务不依赖鼠标、拖动或 hover。
items.pe: Core tasks do not require mouse, drag, or hover.

items.dz: 表头、行列、排序和选择状态能被读屏理解。
items.de: Expose headers, axes, sorting, and selection in tables.
items.pz: 表头、行列、排序和选择状态能被读屏理解。
items.pe: Expose headers, axes, sorting, and selection in tables.

items.dz: 对话框打开后标题、描述和关闭入口立即可知。
items.de: Expose title, description, and close path on dialog open.
items.pz: 对话框打开后标题、描述和关闭入口立即可知。
items.pe: Expose title, description, and close path on dialog open.

items.dz: 菜单项角色、层级、选中和禁用状态清楚。
items.de: Expose menu role, level, selected, and disabled state.
items.pz: 菜单项角色、层级、选中和禁用状态清楚。
items.pe: Expose menu role, level, selected, and disabled state.

items.dz: 进度值和完成状态通过文本或 aria 提供。
items.de: Expose progress and completion through text or aria.
items.pz: 进度值和完成状态通过文本或 aria 提供。
items.pe: Expose progress and completion through text or aria.

items.dz: 尊重 reduced-motion，同时保留内容和状态变化。
items.de: Respect reduced motion while retaining content and state changes.
items.pz: 尊重 reduced-motion，同时保留内容和状态变化。
items.pe: Respect reduced motion while retaining content and state changes.

items.dz: 放大后内容重排，不强迫用户双向滚动才能操作。
items.de: Reflow at zoom without requiring two-axis scrolling.
items.pz: 放大后内容重排，不强迫用户双向滚动才能操作。
items.pe: Reflow at zoom without requiring two-axis scrolling.

items.dz: 增加文字间距后内容、按钮和错误仍不被裁切。
items.de: Survive increased text spacing without clipping.
items.pz: 增加文字间距后内容、按钮和错误仍不被裁切。
items.pe: Survive increased text spacing without clipping.

items.dz: 输入错误指出位置、原因和修复，不清空已输入值。
items.de: State location, cause, and fix without clearing input.
items.pz: 输入错误指出位置、原因和修复，不清空已输入值。
items.pe: State location, cause, and fix without clearing input.

items.dz: 提示有触摸、键盘和读屏等价路径。
items.de: Provide touch, keyboard, and screen-reader equivalents.
items.pz: 提示有触摸、键盘和读屏等价路径。
items.pe: Provide touch, keyboard, and screen-reader equivalents.

items.dz: 导出数据和截图提供标题、来源和文本等价物。
items.de: Provide title, source, and text equivalents in exports.
items.pz: 导出数据和截图提供标题、来源和文本等价物。
items.pe: Provide title, source, and text equivalents in exports.

items.dz: 无障碍名称、错误、状态和 prompt 完全跟随语言。
items.de: Accessible names, errors, states, and prompts follow locale.
items.pz: 无障碍名称、错误、状态和 prompt 完全跟随语言。
items.pe: Accessible names, errors, states, and prompts follow locale.

items.dz: 发布前检查键盘、读屏、对比、缩放、动效和动态更新。
items.de: Audit keyboard, screen reader, contrast, zoom, motion, and updates.
items.pz: 发布前检查键盘、读屏、对比、缩放、动效和动态更新。
items.pe: Audit keyboard, screen reader, contrast, zoom, motion, and updates.

items.dz: 把持续延伸的信息流组织为可独立聚焦的文章，并保留文章位置与内容描述。
items.de: Organize an extending feed into independently focusable articles with positions and content descriptions.
items.pz: 原站用重复加载的餐厅样例模拟信息流。本次验证 PageDown 从第一篇移到第二篇、PageUp 返回；未测试读屏器或加载延迟。APG 原文把该实现称为提案。 预览为原站静态截图；交互示例见来源链接。
items.pe: The source simulates a feed with repeatedly loaded restaurant examples. PageDown from article one to two and PageUp back were checked. Screen readers and loading latency were not tested; the APG describes this implementation as a proposal. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; use the source link for interaction.

dz: LCP、CLS、INP 这些能测的，和"感觉上快"这件不能测的，得一起做
de: The measurable side — LCP, CLS, INP — and the unmeasurable side of feeling fast, done together

items.dz: 首屏那块最大的东西多久出来
items.de: How long the biggest thing takes
items.pz: 2.5s 以内。首屏主图不要懒加载、不要等 JS，给 fetchpriority="high" 与预载。
items.pe: Under 2.5s. Never lazy-load or JS-gate the hero image; give it fetchpriority="high" and a preload.

items.dz: 正要点，内容跳走了
items.de: It jumps just as you reach for it
items.pz: 0.1 以内。图片、广告、嵌入、字体、异步插入的横幅都要预留尺寸；不要在已有内容上方插东西。
items.pe: Under 0.1. Reserve space for images, ads, embeds, fonts and late banners — and never insert above existing content.

items.dz: 点下去到画面变，多久
items.de: From tap to the next frame
items.pz: 200ms 以内。长任务切片（scheduler.yield / setTimeout），先画反馈再算数据。
items.pe: Under 200ms. Slice long tasks with scheduler.yield, and paint the feedback before computing the data.

items.dz: 服务器开口说话的时间
items.de: How long before the server speaks
items.pz: 0.8s 以内。CDN 边缘缓存、避免串行数据库调用、HTML 先流出来再补数据。
items.pe: Under 0.8s. Cache at the edge, avoid serial database calls, and stream the HTML before the data.

items.dz: 骨架和真内容不一样大就白做了
items.de: A mismatched skeleton causes the very jump it prevents
items.pz: 骨架块的宽高、行数、间距要和真实内容一致；宁可少画几块，也不要尺寸对不上。
items.pe: Match the skeleton to the real width, height, line count and gaps. Fewer blocks beat wrong sizes.

items.dz: 图还没来，位置先占住
items.de: Hold the space before the image arrives
items.pz: width/height 属性 + CSS aspect-ratio，容器高度不依赖图片本身；这是消除 CLS 最省事的一招。
items.pe: Set width/height attributes plus CSS aspect-ratio so the box does not depend on the image. The cheapest CLS fix there is.

items.dz: swap 会闪，optional 会不换
items.de: swap flashes, optional may never swap
items.pz: 正文用 swap 保可读，品牌大标题可用 optional 避免跳字；配 size-adjust 让回退字体度量接近。
items.pe: swap keeps body text readable; optional avoids a headline reflow. Use size-adjust so the fallback metrics match.

items.dz: 先看到回退字，还是先看到空白
items.de: Fallback text first, or blank first
items.pz: FOIT（空白）比 FOUT（换字）更伤感知速度；默认选 FOUT，并把回退字体调到相近字宽。
items.pe: A blank flash hurts perceived speed more than a swap. Default to FOUT and tune the fallback width.

items.dz: 中文字体全量是几 MB
items.de: A full CJK font is megabytes
items.pz: 按 unicode-range 分片，中文用动态子集或按首屏字符裁；一个字重能省下三个字重的体积。
items.pe: Split by unicode-range, and subset CJK dynamically or to the above-the-fold glyphs. One weight saves the cost of three.

items.dz: 别等浏览器自己发现
items.de: Do not wait for discovery
items.pz: 首屏字体与 LCP 图用 <link rel=preload>；预载超过 2–3 个就会互相抢带宽，反而更慢。
items.pe: Preload the above-the-fold font and the LCP image. More than two or three and they fight for bandwidth.

items.dz: 握手也要时间
items.de: The handshake costs too
items.pz: 对确定会用到的第三方域名 preconnect（DNS + TCP + TLS 一次做完）；不确定的用 dns-prefetch。
items.pe: Preconnect to third-party origins you will certainly use; dns-prefetch the ones you might.

items.dz: 首屏之外的图晚点再说
items.de: Off-screen images can wait
items.pz: loading="lazy" 只给首屏以下的图；首屏图加了反而拖慢 LCP。配合固定比例占位。
items.pe: loading="lazy" belongs below the fold only — on the hero it slows LCP. Pair it with a reserved ratio.

items.dz: 告诉浏览器谁更重要
items.de: Tell the browser what matters
items.pz: LCP 图 fetchpriority="high"，轮播第二张往后 low；脚本用 defer/async 分层。
items.pe: fetchpriority="high" on the LCP image, low on later carousel frames, and layer scripts with defer/async.

items.dz: 手机不该下载 2000px 的图
items.de: A phone should not fetch a 2000px image
items.pz: srcset 列宽度候选，sizes 描述真实渲染宽度；sizes 写错等于没做。
items.pe: srcset lists the widths, sizes describes the real rendered width — a wrong sizes value undoes the whole thing.

items.dz: 同样画质，体积少一半
items.de: Same quality, half the bytes
items.pz: <picture> 里 AVIF → WebP → JPEG 依次回退；照片走 AVIF，带透明与图形走 WebP/PNG。
items.pe: Inside picture, fall back AVIF → WebP → JPEG. Photos favour AVIF; transparency and flat art favour WebP or PNG.

items.dz: 先给一张糊的，再换清的
items.de: A blurry one first, then the sharp one
items.pz: 20–40px 宽的缩略图内联为 data URI，放大模糊后作背景，真图加载完淡入替换。
items.pe: Inline a 20–40px thumbnail as a data URI, scale it up blurred, then cross-fade the real image in.

items.dz: 一块颜色就够了
items.de: One colour is enough
items.pz: 提取图片平均色作背景，比灰块更不刺眼、也不像坏图；成本几乎为零。
items.pe: Use the image average colour as the ground — gentler than grey and it never looks broken. Nearly free.

items.dz: 看不见的区块干脆不排版
items.de: Skip layout for what is off-screen
items.pz: content-visibility:auto + contain-intrinsic-size 给长页面省下大量排版成本；尺寸估错会导致滚动条抖。
items.pe: content-visibility:auto with contain-intrinsic-size saves layout on long pages. A wrong estimate makes the scrollbar jitter.

items.dz: 一万行只渲染看得见的二十行
items.de: Ten thousand rows, twenty rendered
items.pz: 按滚动位置只渲染窗口内的项 + 上下缓冲；行高不定时要测量缓存，否则滚动条会跳。
items.pe: Render only the window plus a buffer. With variable row heights, measure and cache or the scrollbar will jump.

items.dz: 能不能回到"第 7 页"
items.de: Can you get back to page 7?
items.pz: 需要定位、分享、对比的内容用分页；消费型信息流用无限滚动，但要保留位置与"加载更多"兜底。
items.pe: Paginate anything you must cite, share or compare. Infinite scroll suits feeds — keep scroll restoration and a load-more fallback.

items.dz: 提前提层，但别一直提着
items.de: Promote early, but do not hold it
items.pz: 只在交互即将开始时加，结束后移除；常驻 will-change 会一直占显存并让文字变糊。
items.pe: Add it just before the interaction and remove it after. A permanent will-change eats VRAM and softens text.

items.dz: transform / opacity / filter 之外都会掉帧
items.de: Anything else drops frames
items.pz: width / height / top / margin / box-shadow 会触发排版或重绘；改用 transform 与 scale 等价实现。
items.pe: width, height, top, margin and box-shadow trigger layout or paint. Express the same motion with transform.

items.dz: 每个元素都提层就等于没提
items.de: Promote everything and you promote nothing
items.pz: 合成层有内存与合成成本；用 DevTools 图层面板数一遍，几十层以上就要合并。
items.pe: Composited layers cost memory and compositing time. Count them in the layers panel and merge past a few dozen.

items.dz: 交替读写会逼浏览器反复排版
items.de: Interleaving forces layout again and again
items.pz: 先把所有 offsetWidth 之类读完，再统一写样式；或用 requestAnimationFrame 分成读帧与写帧。
items.pe: Read every offsetWidth first, then write. Or split reads and writes across animation frames.

items.dz: 60fps 只有 16.7ms
items.de: 16.7ms per frame at 60fps
items.pz: 实际留给自己的约 8–10ms；超了就切片、降频（每 2–3 帧算一次）或挪到 Worker。
items.pe: You get about 8–10ms of it. Past that, slice the work, run every second or third frame, or move it to a Worker.

items.dz: 一个等你停下，一个按拍子来
items.de: One waits for a pause, one keeps a beat
items.pz: 搜索输入用防抖（150–300ms），滚动与 resize 用节流或 rAF；两者混用是常见错误。
items.pe: Debounce search input at 150–300ms; throttle scroll and resize, or drive them with rAF. Mixing them up is the usual bug.

items.dz: 滚动监听别挡住滚动
items.de: Do not block the scroll you listen to
items.pz: touchstart / wheel / scroll 加 {passive:true}，浏览器就不必等你决定是否 preventDefault。
items.pe: Add passive:true to touchstart, wheel and scroll so the browser need not wait on preventDefault.

items.dz: 别用 scroll 事件算可见性
items.de: Never compute visibility in a scroll handler
items.pz: 可见性、懒加载、曝光埋点、动画触发全部交给 IO；rootMargin 用来提前触发。
items.pe: Visibility, lazy loading, impression tracking and animation triggers all belong to IO. rootMargin fires them early.

items.zh: CSS 动画还是 JS 动画
items.dz: 能写成 CSS 的就别写 JS
items.de: If CSS can express it, CSS should
items.pz: 声明式过渡与循环用 CSS（可跑在合成线程）；需要打断、跟手、物理反馈的用 WAAPI 或动画库。
items.pe: Declarative transitions and loops go to CSS, which can run off-thread. Interruptible, gesture-following, physical motion needs WAAPI or a library.

items.dz: 主线程卡了动画还在动
items.de: The animation survives a busy main thread
items.pz: 只用 transform / opacity / filter 的 CSS 动画可交给合成线程；一旦读取布局或改颜色就掉回主线程。
items.pe: A CSS animation limited to transform, opacity and filter can run on the compositor. Touch layout or colour and it falls back.

items.zh: 用 transform 代替布局动画
items.dz: 展开高度是最贵的动画
items.de: Animating height is the expensive one
items.pz: height:auto 无法过渡；用 grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr、scaleY + 反向补偿，或 max-height 上限法。
items.pe: height:auto cannot transition. Use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr, a compensated scaleY, or a max-height cap.

items.dz: 解码也会卡主线程
items.de: Decoding blocks the main thread too
items.pz: 大图加 decoding="async"，或用 img.decode() 在换图前解好；轮播切换前预解码下一张。
items.pe: Add decoding="async", or await img.decode() before swapping. Pre-decode the next carousel frame.

items.dz: 几十个请求变一个
items.de: Dozens of requests become one
items.pz: SVG symbol sprite 或子集化图标字体；单色图标优先内联 SVG，避免额外往返。
items.pe: An SVG symbol sprite or a subset icon font. Inline single-colour SVG to avoid a round trip entirely.

items.dz: 别让样式表挡住第一帧
items.de: Do not let a stylesheet block frame one
items.pz: 首屏用到的规则内联进 <head>，其余异步加载；超过 14KB 就得重新审视首屏范围。
items.pe: Inline the above-the-fold rules and load the rest asynchronously. Past 14KB, rethink what "above the fold" means.

items.dz: 首页不该下载后台的代码
items.de: The homepage should not ship the admin bundle
items.pz: 按路由与交互边界动态 import；把重型依赖（图表、编辑器、3D）推到用它的那一屏。
items.pe: Dynamic-import per route and per interaction boundary, and push heavy dependencies onto the screen that uses them.

items.dz: 导入一个函数拖进整个库
items.de: One import, the whole library
items.pz: 用具名导入与 ESM 版本，package.json 标 sideEffects:false；moment、lodash 全量导入是经典陷阱。
items.pe: Named imports, ESM builds, sideEffects:false. Whole-library imports of moment or lodash are the classic trap.

items.dz: 静态内容不需要被"激活"
items.de: Static content needs no activation
items.pz: 只让交互组件水合（岛屿架构），其余保持纯 HTML；全页水合是 INP 变差的头号原因。
items.pe: Hydrate only the interactive islands and leave the rest as HTML. Whole-page hydration is the top cause of bad INP.

items.dz: 有多少先发多少
items.de: Send what you have
items.pz: 外壳先流出来，慢数据用 Suspense 占位后补；用户看到骨架的时间点大幅提前。
items.pe: Stream the shell first and fill slow data behind a Suspense boundary. The skeleton appears far sooner.

items.dz: 在他点之前就开始下载
items.de: Start fetching before the click
items.pz: 悬停 / 触摸开始 / 进入视口时预取下一页数据；用 speculationrules 或框架的 prefetch，注意别把流量打爆。
items.pe: Prefetch on hover, touchstart or viewport entry via speculation rules or your framework — but watch the bandwidth.

items.dz: 先当成功了再说
items.de: Assume it worked
items.pz: 本地立刻应用变更并给可撤销入口，失败再回滚并说明；点赞、勾选、重命名最适合。
items.pe: Apply the change locally with an undo path, and roll back with an explanation on failure. Ideal for likes, checkboxes, renames.

items.dz: 按等待时长选
items.de: Choose by how long the wait is
items.pz: <300ms 什么都不显示；300ms–1s 用转圈；>1s 且结构已知用骨架；>3s 要给进度或分步反馈。
items.pe: Under 300ms show nothing; to 1s a spinner; past 1s with known structure a skeleton; past 3s show progress or steps.

items.dz: 同样 2 秒，可以像 1 秒也可以像 5 秒
items.de: The same 2s can feel like 1 or 5
items.pz: 立刻给反馈、先渲染框架、把等待填上有用信息、结束时别再多一次跳动；等待中的空白最长。
items.pe: Acknowledge instantly, render the frame first, fill the wait with something useful, and do not add a final jump. Blank waits feel longest.

items.dz: 前快后慢比匀速更"快"
items.de: Fast then slow feels faster than linear
items.pz: 进度条前段走快、后段放缓；条纹向前流动会让同样时长感觉更短。绝不倒退。
items.pe: Race the early progress and ease the tail. Forward-moving stripes make the same duration feel shorter. Never go backwards.

items.dz: 别靠"感觉有点卡"
items.de: Never ship on "feels laggy"
items.pz: 用 Long Animation Frames、performance.measure 与真实设备节流 4× CPU 复现；低端安卓才是基准线。
items.pe: Use Long Animation Frames, performance.measure and a 4× CPU throttle on a real device. A low-end Android is the baseline.

dz: 断点从内容来不从设备来：容器查询、流体字阶、安全区，一路到打印样式与邮件表格
de: Breakpoints come from content, not devices — container queries, fluid scales, safe areas, through to print styles and email tables

items.dz: 先写窄的，再往宽加
items.de: Write narrow first, then add
items.pz: 基础样式面向最小屏，用 min-width 逐级增强；反过来写会留下一堆覆盖不掉的桌面假设。
items.pe: Base styles target the smallest screen and min-width queries add on. The reverse leaves desktop assumptions you cannot override.

items.dz: 不是 768，是"这行开始难读了"
items.de: Not 768px — the width where the line breaks badly
items.pz: 把窗口慢慢拉，在版式真正坏掉的位置设断点；设备尺寸每年都变，内容的临界宽度不变。
items.pe: Drag the window and put a breakpoint where the layout actually breaks. Device sizes change yearly; content thresholds do not.

items.dz: 组件问的是"我多宽"，不是"窗口多宽"
items.de: The component asks its own width, not the window's
items.pz: container-type:inline-size + @container；同一个卡片放侧栏和放主栏能各自变形，这是媒体查询做不到的。
items.pe: container-type:inline-size with @container lets one card adapt differently in a sidebar and in the main column. Media queries cannot.

items.dz: clamp 一次搞定所有中间尺寸
items.de: clamp covers every size in between
items.pz: clamp(最小, 计算式, 最大)，中间项混 rem 与 vw 保证可缩放；只用 vw 会让用户缩放失效。
items.pe: clamp(min, a rem+vw expression, max). Pure vw breaks user zoom, so always keep a rem term.

items.dz: 小屏不该按同一个比例往下缩
items.de: Small screens need a tighter ratio
items.pz: 窄屏用 1.2 左右的比例，宽屏放到 1.333–1.5；标题与正文的差距在小屏要收窄。
items.pe: Use about 1.2 on narrow screens and 1.333–1.5 on wide ones. Compress the heading-to-body jump when narrow.

items.dz: 1fr 会被长内容顶破
items.de: A long child bursts a plain 1fr
items.pz: grid 轨道写 minmax(0,1fr)，flex 子项加 min-width:0；这两句能解决八成"莫名横向滚动条"。
items.pe: Write minmax(0,1fr) for grid tracks and min-width:0 on flex children. That fixes most mystery horizontal scrollbars.

items.dz: 一个会撑开，一个会留空轨
items.de: One stretches, one keeps empty tracks
items.pz: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr)) 是无媒体查询的响应式网格；auto-fill 会保留空列，适合要对齐的场合。
items.pe: repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr)) is a query-free responsive grid. auto-fill keeps the empty tracks, which suits fixed alignment.

items.dz: 让元素自己说"我最少要多宽"
items.de: Let elements state their own minimum
items.pz: min-content / max-content / fit-content + flex-wrap，用元素的内在尺寸驱动换行，断点数量能砍一半。
items.pe: min-content, max-content, fit-content plus wrapping lets intrinsic sizes drive the reflow. It halves your breakpoint count.

items.dz: 够宽并排，不够就上下
items.de: Side by side when it fits, stacked when it does not
items.pz: flex-wrap + 侧栏 flex-basis 固定、主栏 flex:999 1 60%，主栏低于阈值时自动换行——不用媒体查询。
items.pe: Wrap plus a fixed sidebar basis and flex:999 1 60% on the main column. It folds on its own with no query.

items.dz: 过了阈值一次性从一列变多列
items.de: It flips all at once at a threshold
items.pz: 用 flex-basis:calc((阈值 - 100%) * 999) 做零查询切换；比逐级断点更干净，也不会出现"半宽尴尬列"。
items.pe: flex-basis:calc((threshold - 100%) * 999) flips it with no query — cleaner than stepped breakpoints and no awkward half-columns.

items.dz: 一堆标签自己找地方排
items.de: A pile of chips finds its own arrangement
items.pz: flex-wrap + gap，不给固定列数；标签、面包屑、操作按钮组都属于这一类。
items.pe: Wrapping flex with a gap and no fixed column count. Tags, breadcrumbs and action groups all belong here.

items.dz: 小屏放不下就让它横着滑
items.de: If it will not fit, let it slide
items.pz: overflow-x:auto + scroll-snap-type:x mandatory + 首尾 scroll-padding；一定要露出下一张的边，暗示可滑。
items.pe: overflow-x:auto with x-mandatory snapping and scroll padding. Always reveal the next card's edge as an affordance.

items.dz: 小屏的表格要变成一叠卡
items.de: On narrow screens a table becomes a stack
items.pz: 每行变一张卡，表头下沉成每格的行内标签（data-label + ::before）；横滑表格是次优解。
items.pe: Each row becomes a card and the header sinks into per-cell labels via data-label. A horizontally scrolled table is second best.

items.dz: 拇指能到的地方才是主导航
items.de: Primary nav lives where the thumb reaches
items.pz: 桌面顶部横排，移动端 3–5 项落到底部 tab bar；超过 5 项的第五格放"更多"，不要挤。
items.pe: A top row on desktop, a three-to-five item bottom bar on mobile. Past five, the last slot becomes More.

items.dz: 刘海、圆角、手势条都会吃掉边缘
items.de: Notches, corners and the home bar eat your edges
items.pz: viewport-fit=cover + env(safe-area-inset-*)；底部固定条要加 padding-bottom，否则被手势条压住。
items.pe: viewport-fit=cover with env(safe-area-inset-*). Fixed bottom bars need the padding or the home indicator covers them.

items.dz: 100vh 在手机上永远不对
items.de: 100vh is always wrong on a phone
items.pz: 地址栏会伸缩：全屏用 100dvh，最小可见用 svh，最大用 lvh；固定高度容器一律换掉 vh。
items.pe: The address bar moves. Use dvh for full height, svh for the smallest visible, lvh for the largest — and retire plain vh.

items.dz: 键盘一弹，输入框就没了
items.de: The keyboard swallows the field
items.pz: 用 VirtualKeyboard API 或 visualViewport 事件把内容上移；不要靠 scrollIntoView 硬顶。
items.pe: Shift content with the VirtualKeyboard API or visualViewport events. Do not fight it with scrollIntoView.

items.dz: 横屏不是"变宽的竖屏"
items.de: Landscape is not just a wider portrait
items.pz: 横屏可用高度骤减：把纵向堆叠改成左右分栏，弹层改成侧滑，别让主按钮掉到屏幕外。
items.pe: Landscape loses vertical room. Turn stacks into columns, sheets into side panels, and keep the primary action on screen.

items.dz: 中间那道缝不能放按钮
items.de: Nothing important sits on the seam
items.pz: viewport-segments 与 env(viewport-segment-*) 拆成两块；把内容对齐到某一半，跨缝的表格要分段。
items.pe: Split with viewport-segments and env(viewport-segment-*). Align content to one half and break tables at the seam.

items.dz: 触屏没有 hover，别把功能藏在里面
items.de: Touch has no hover — do not hide function there
items.pz: @media (hover:hover) 才挂悬停效果；触屏用长按或常驻按钮替代，绝不用 hover 承载唯一入口。
items.pe: Attach hover effects inside @media (hover:hover). On touch use long-press or a visible button — never hover as the only path.

items.dz: 手指要 44px，鼠标 24px 就够
items.de: 44px for a finger, 24px for a mouse
items.pz: @media (pointer:coarse) 放大命中区与间距，缩小密度；同一份 UI 两套密度比两套 UI 好维护。
items.pe: Grow targets and gaps under @media (pointer:coarse). Two densities of one UI beat two UIs.

items.dz: 让用户自己选紧凑还是舒适
items.de: Let people pick compact or comfortable
items.pz: 把行高、内边距、字号收进一组 token，用一个 data-density 切换；表格与列表最需要。
items.pe: Put row height, padding and size into one token set toggled by a data-density attribute. Tables and lists need it most.

items.dz: 窄屏该换构图，不是压扁
items.de: Narrow screens need a new crop, not a squash
items.pz: 宽屏 16:9、窄屏 4:5，配 object-position 保住主体；用 aspect-ratio 切换而不是缩放同一张。
items.pe: 16:9 wide, 4:5 narrow, with object-position protecting the subject. Switch aspect-ratio rather than scaling one crop.

items.dz: 不只是换尺寸，是换照片
items.de: A different image, not a smaller one
items.pz: <picture> + media 换不同构图的源文件：宽屏给全景，窄屏给特写。srcset 只解决体积，解决不了构图。
items.pe: Use picture with media to swap crops: a panorama wide, a close-up narrow. srcset solves bytes, not composition.

items.dz: 2x 屏上 1x 图会糊
items.de: A 1x asset is mush on a 2x screen
items.pz: srcset 用 2x 描述符或宽度描述符；但别无脑上 3x——体积翻倍而肉眼几乎无差。
items.pe: Use 2x or width descriptors in srcset — but not 3x by reflex; it doubles bytes for almost no visible gain.

items.dz: 有人真的会按 Ctrl+P
items.de: People really do hit Ctrl+P
items.pz: @media print：去掉导航与固定条、展开折叠内容、链接后追加 URL、深底反白、图表改线稿。
items.pe: In @media print: drop nav and fixed bars, expand collapsed content, append link URLs, invert dark grounds, line-art the charts.

items.dz: 标题不能孤零零留在页底
items.de: A heading must not be orphaned at the page foot
items.pz: break-inside:avoid 保住卡片与表格行，break-after:avoid 让标题跟住正文，orphans/widows 至少 2 行。
items.pe: break-inside:avoid keeps cards and rows whole, break-after:avoid keeps headings with their text, and orphans/widows at least 2.

items.dz: 邮件客户端还活在 2005 年
items.de: Email clients still live in 2005
items.pz: 外层 table 居中 + 内层 table 分栏，宽度写死 600px；Outlook 不认 flex/grid，也不认大部分现代 CSS。
items.pe: A centred outer table with nested column tables at a hard 600px. Outlook understands neither flex nor grid nor most modern CSS.

items.dz: <style> 会被吃掉
items.de: The style block gets stripped
items.pz: 关键样式全部内联到 style 属性，只把媒体查询留在 <style>；不能用外链 CSS、不能用 class 兜底。
items.pe: Inline every critical declaration and keep only media queries in a style block. No external CSS, no class-only fallbacks.

items.dz: 客户端会自己反色，反得很难看
items.de: Clients invert it for you, badly
items.pz: 用 prefers-color-scheme + meta color-scheme，把 PNG 换成两版；白底 logo 要加浅色描边防止消失。
items.pe: Declare prefers-color-scheme and meta color-scheme, ship two PNGs, and outline a white logo so it does not vanish.

items.dz: 2560px 上不该有 200 字一行
items.de: No 200-character lines at 2560px
items.pz: 内容容器给 max-width，多出的宽度用来放侧栏、留白或加大图；不要让正文无限拉长。
items.pe: Cap the content container and spend the extra width on a rail, whitespace or bigger imagery — never on longer lines.

items.dz: 一行 45–75 个字符最好读
items.de: 45–75 characters reads best
items.pz: 用 ch 单位设 max-width（中文约 30–40 字）；行长与行高要一起调，长行需要更大行高。
items.pe: Cap max-width in ch — about 30–40 Han characters. Line length and line height move together; longer lines need more leading.

items.dz: 放大到 400% 不能出现两轴滚动
items.de: No two-axis scrolling at 400%
items.pz: 一切用相对单位，允许所有容器换行；固定宽度的表格与代码块要能横滑，但页面本身不行。
items.pe: Relative units throughout and wrapping everywhere. Fixed-width tables and code may scroll horizontally; the page may not.

items.dz: 吸顶条吃掉的是可读高度
items.de: Every sticky bar costs reading height
items.pz: 移动端吸顶总高不超过视口 12%；多条吸顶要合并，或滚动时收起只留一行。
items.pe: Keep total sticky height under about 12% of the viewport. Merge multiple bars, or collapse to one line on scroll.

items.dz: 小屏的对话框应该从下面上来
items.de: On small screens dialogs come from below
items.pz: 桌面居中模态，移动端全宽底部抽屉 + 拖拽把手 + 多段吸附高度；顶部关闭按钮要在拇指区之外。
items.pe: A centred modal on desktop, a full-width bottom sheet with a grab handle and snap heights on mobile. Keep close out of the thumb zone.

items.dz: 窄屏先给主线，细节收起来
items.de: Narrow screens get the spine, details fold
items.pz: 把次要字段、筛选、元信息折进手风琴或"更多"；不要在小屏里靠横滑藏功能。
items.pe: Fold secondary fields, filters and metadata into an accordion or a More affordance. Do not hide function behind a horizontal swipe.

items.dz: 小屏的第一屏该放什么
items.de: What earns the first screen when narrow
items.pz: 按任务优先级重排而不是等比缩小：价格与主按钮上移，导航与推荐下沉；用 order 但保住 DOM 阅读顺序。
items.pe: Reorder by task priority rather than scaling down — price and primary action rise, nav and recommendations sink. Keep DOM order sane.

items.dz: 看不出来能滑，就等于不能滑
items.de: If it does not look scrollable, it is not
items.pz: 两端渐隐遮罩 + 露出下一项的边 + 到边时收掉遮罩；纯靠"用户会试试"是不成立的。
items.pe: Edge fade masks, a peeking next item, and masks that retract at the ends. Hoping people will try is not a design.

items.zh: 能力查询而非设备查询
items.dz: 问它能做什么，别猜它是什么
items.de: Ask what it can do, not what it is
items.pz: hover / pointer / prefers-* / dynamic-range / scripting 都是能力查询；设备判断（UA sniffing）年年失效。
items.pe: hover, pointer, prefers-*, dynamic-range and scripting are capability queries. UA sniffing breaks every year.

items.dz: 组件按容器而不是窗口断点改变布局。
items.de: Components reflow by container rather than window breakpoints.
items.pz: 组件按容器而不是窗口断点改变布局。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Components reflow by container rather than window breakpoints. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 列数和栏距连续变化，极端宽度有上下限。
items.de: Columns and gutters vary continuously with bounded extremes.
items.pz: 列数和栏距连续变化，极端宽度有上下限。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Columns and gutters vary continuously with bounded extremes. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 最小内容宽避免按钮标签被不必要截断。
items.de: Min-content sizing prevents needless label truncation.
items.pz: 最小内容宽避免按钮标签被不必要截断。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Min-content sizing prevents needless label truncation. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 最大内容宽只用于不会挤压相邻内容的短字段。
items.de: Max-content sizing suits short fields without squeezing neighbors.
items.pz: 最大内容宽只用于不会挤压相邻内容的短字段。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Max-content sizing suits short fields without squeezing neighbors. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 适配内容宽在可用空间和内容之间取平衡。
items.de: Fit-content balances content and available space.
items.pz: 适配内容宽在可用空间和内容之间取平衡。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Fit-content balances content and available space. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 卡片根据内容和最小宽度自然排列，不依赖固定列数。
items.de: Cards arrange from content and minimum width rather than fixed columns.
items.pz: 卡片根据内容和最小宽度自然排列，不依赖固定列数。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Cards arrange from content and minimum width rather than fixed columns. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 接近断点时避免布局反复跳变，保持交互稳定。
items.de: Avoid layout thrash near a breakpoint.
items.pz: 接近断点时避免布局反复跳变，保持交互稳定。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Avoid layout thrash near a breakpoint. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 折叠铰链区域不放置关键内容或跨屏按钮。
items.de: Keep critical content and controls clear of fold hinges.
items.pz: 折叠铰链区域不放置关键内容或跨屏按钮。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Keep critical content and controls clear of fold hinges. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 设备姿态变化调整面板分栏而不重置导航上下文。
items.de: Adjust panes without resetting navigation on posture changes.
items.pz: 设备姿态变化调整面板分栏而不重置导航上下文。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Adjust panes without resetting navigation on posture changes. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 粗指针设备增大目标和间距，不把 hover 当作必需。
items.de: Enlarge targets for coarse pointers and avoid hover dependence.
items.pz: 粗指针设备增大目标和间距，不把 hover 当作必需。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Enlarge targets for coarse pointers and avoid hover dependence. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 精细指针可提供悬停预览，但核心信息仍可通过点击获取。
items.de: Offer hover preview while keeping core information click-accessible.
items.pz: 精细指针可提供悬停预览，但核心信息仍可通过点击获取。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Offer hover preview while keeping core information click-accessible. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 触摸设备不显示只在 hover 出现的操作。
items.de: Do not hide essential actions behind hover on touch.
items.pz: 触摸设备不显示只在 hover 出现的操作。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Do not hide essential actions behind hover on touch. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 手势区域明确 touch-action，避免页面滚动和组件拖动互相抢夺。
items.de: Define touch-action to separate scroll from component gestures.
items.pz: 手势区域明确 touch-action，避免页面滚动和组件拖动互相抢夺。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Define touch-action to separate scroll from component gestures. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 触摸点击反馈及时，不用双击缩放假设桌面交互。
items.de: Give timely touch feedback without desktop double-click assumptions.
items.pz: 触摸点击反馈及时，不用双击缩放假设桌面交互。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Give timely touch feedback without desktop double-click assumptions. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 动态浏览器工具栏变化时底部操作仍然可见。
items.de: Keep bottom actions visible as browser chrome changes.
items.pz: 动态浏览器工具栏变化时底部操作仍然可见。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Keep bottom actions visible as browser chrome changes. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 软键盘出现时输入和提交按钮不被遮挡。
items.de: Keep input and submit visible above the soft keyboard.
items.pz: 软键盘出现时输入和提交按钮不被遮挡。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Keep input and submit visible above the soft keyboard. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 200% 放大保持内容可读，不把功能藏到不可达横向滚动。
items.de: Keep content usable at 200% zoom.
items.pz: 200% 放大保持内容可读，不把功能藏到不可达横向滚动。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Keep content usable at 200% zoom. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 用户增大文字和间距后布局不裁切关键内容。
items.de: Survive increased text and spacing without clipping.
items.pz: 用户增大文字和间距后布局不裁切关键内容。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Survive increased text and spacing without clipping. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 高对比模式仍保留边界、分组和焦点。
items.de: Preserve boundaries, grouping, and focus in high contrast.
items.pz: 高对比模式仍保留边界、分组和焦点。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Preserve boundaries, grouping, and focus in high contrast. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 减少动效只改变过渡，不改变内容出现顺序。
items.de: Reduce transitions without changing content order.
items.pz: 减少动效只改变过渡，不改变内容出现顺序。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Reduce transitions without changing content order. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 打印样式隐藏导航和交互控件，保留内容和来源。
items.de: Hide navigation and controls in print while retaining content.
items.pz: 打印样式隐藏导航和交互控件，保留内容和来源。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Hide navigation and controls in print while retaining content. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 邮件布局使用安全宽度、回退字体和可访问链接。
items.de: Use safe widths, fallback fonts, and accessible links in email.
items.pz: 邮件布局使用安全宽度、回退字体和可访问链接。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Use safe widths, fallback fonts, and accessible links in email. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 嵌入 iframe 时不假设窗口尺寸和滚动归属。
items.de: Do not assume viewport or scroll ownership in iframes.
items.pz: 嵌入 iframe 时不假设窗口尺寸和滚动归属。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Do not assume viewport or scroll ownership in iframes. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 组件尺寸变化触发测量而非读取 window 宽度猜测。
items.de: Measure component size changes rather than guessing from window width.
items.pz: 组件尺寸变化触发测量而非读取 window 宽度猜测。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Measure component size changes rather than guessing from window width. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 媒体按容器和像素密度提供合适资源。
items.de: Serve media by container and pixel density.
items.pz: 媒体按容器和像素密度提供合适资源。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Serve media by container and pixel density. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 表格窄屏转为详情行或横向滚动，关键字段不消失。
items.de: Use detail rows or horizontal scroll while preserving key fields.
items.pz: 表格窄屏转为详情行或横向滚动，关键字段不消失。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Use detail rows or horizontal scroll while preserving key fields. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 导航在窄屏折叠但保持当前路径和搜索入口。
items.de: Collapse navigation while preserving current path and search.
items.pz: 导航在窄屏折叠但保持当前路径和搜索入口。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Collapse navigation while preserving current path and search. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

items.dz: 发布前检查断点、缩放、触控、键盘、方向和安全区。
items.de: Audit breakpoints, zoom, touch, keyboard, orientation, and safe areas.
items.pz: 发布前检查断点、缩放、触控、键盘、方向和安全区。 在窄屏、放大、触摸和方向变化下复核。
items.pe: Audit breakpoints, zoom, touch, keyboard, orientation, and safe areas. Validate narrow screens, zoom, touch, and orientation changes.

dz: RTL 镜像、CJK 断行标点、文本膨胀、历法与排序——这类问题上线前几乎没人测
de: RTL mirroring, CJK line breaking, text expansion, calendars and collation — the class of bugs nobody tests before launch

items.dz: 整个界面照镜子
items.de: The whole interface reflects
items.pz: dir="rtl" 翻转布局、对齐、缩进、进度方向；返回箭头要翻，播放键和时钟不翻。
items.pe: dir="rtl" flips layout, alignment, indent and progress direction. Back arrows flip; play buttons and clocks do not.

items.dz: margin-left 换成 margin-inline-start
items.de: Swap left/right for inline-start/end
items.pz: padding-inline / margin-block / inset-inline / text-align:start；一次改写就同时支持 LTR 与 RTL。
items.pe: padding-inline, margin-block, inset-inline, text-align:start — one rewrite covers both directions.

items.dz: 阿拉伯语里插英文会乱序
items.de: Latin inside Arabic scrambles
items.pz: 用 <bdi> 或 unicode-bidi:isolate 包住用户名、文件名等不可控片段；纯靠 dir 不够。
items.pe: Wrap usernames, filenames and any untrusted run in bdi or unicode-bidi:isolate. dir alone will not save you.

items.dz: 有方向语义的翻，有物理形态的不翻
items.de: Directional icons flip; physical objects do not
items.pz: 前进/后退/缩进/引号/进度要翻；播放、时钟、放大镜、勾选、logo 不翻；括号与斜杠按语义判断。
items.pe: Flip next/back, indent, quotes and progress. Never flip play, clocks, magnifiers, checkmarks or logos.

items.dz: 中文可以任意断，但不能断在标点前
items.de: Han breaks anywhere — except before punctuation
items.pz: line-break:strict + word-break:normal；中英混排时给 overflow-wrap:anywhere 防长网址顶破。
items.pe: line-break:strict with word-break:normal. Add overflow-wrap:anywhere for long URLs in mixed text.

items.dz: 两个句号之间的空要收掉
items.de: Squeeze the gap between stacked marks
items.pz: text-spacing-trim:space-first 收行首标点，font-feature-settings 用全角/半角变体；专业中文排版的分水岭。
items.pe: text-spacing-trim:space-first trims leading marks, and font features pick full- or half-width variants. This is where Chinese typesetting gets serious.

items.dz: 汉字倾斜就是变形
items.de: Slanted Han is just distortion
items.pz: 强调改用字重、字号、颜色、着重号（text-emphasis）或方头括号；浏览器的假斜体会毁掉字形。
items.pe: Emphasise with weight, size, colour, text-emphasis dots or bracket marks. Synthetic obliquing wrecks the glyphs.

items.dz: 没有粗体字重就会被"描一圈"
items.de: Without a bold cut the browser strokes it
items.pz: 中文字体家族常只有 Regular/Medium；缺字重时浏览器合成加粗会糊。要么装真字重，要么只用 400/500。
items.pe: CJK families often ship only Regular and Medium. Synthetic bold blurs — install the real weight or stay at 400/500.

items.dz: 日文书籍与中文题词会竖着走
items.de: Japanese books and Chinese inscriptions run vertically
items.pz: writing-mode:vertical-rl + text-orientation:upright；数字与拉丁要用 text-combine-upright 做"纵中横"。
items.pe: writing-mode:vertical-rl with text-orientation:upright, and text-combine-upright for numerals and Latin runs.

items.dz: 汉字上面那一行小字
items.de: The small line above the characters
items.pz: <ruby> + <rt>，ruby-position 控制上下；行高要预留注音空间，否则会压到上一行。
items.pe: ruby with rt, positioned by ruby-position. Reserve line height or the annotation collides with the line above.

items.dz: 德语能把按钮撑破
items.de: German bursts your button
items.pz: 德/俄/芬兰比英文长 30–40%，日韩更短；按钮与标签要能换行或截断，绝不写死宽度。
items.pe: German, Russian and Finnish run 30–40% longer than English; CJK runs shorter. Let buttons wrap or truncate — never fix their width.

items.dz: "你有" + n + "条消息"在别的语言里语序不同
items.de: Word order differs elsewhere
items.pz: 整句作为一个可翻译单元，变量用占位符；语序、量词、介词位置都由译文自己决定。
items.pe: Make the whole sentence one translatable unit with placeholders. Word order, measure words and prepositions belong to the translation.

items.dz: 不是"1 个"和"n 个"两种
items.de: It is not just one and many
items.pz: 阿拉伯语 6 类、俄语 4 类、中文 1 类；用 Intl.PluralRules 与 ICU MessageFormat，别写 n>1 的三目。
items.pe: Arabic has six categories, Russian four, Chinese one. Use Intl.PluralRules and ICU MessageFormat, never n>1 ternaries.

items.dz: 同一个词在句中要变形
items.de: The same word inflects in place
items.pz: 斯拉夫语系有格变化，罗曼语系有性；UI 里避免把人名塞进有格变化的句式，或让译者提供多个变体。
items.pe: Slavic languages inflect for case, Romance for gender. Avoid slotting names into inflected sentences, or let translators supply variants.

items.dz: 03/04 到底是三月四日还是四月三日
items.de: Is 03/04 March or April?
items.pz: 一律用 Intl.DateTimeFormat 与 locale；日志与 API 用 ISO 8601，界面上写月份名避免歧义。
items.pe: Always Intl.DateTimeFormat with a locale. Use ISO 8601 in logs and APIs, and spell the month in UI.

items.de: Germany writes 1.234,56
items.pz: 千分位与小数点因地而异，印度用 lakh/crore 分组；Intl.NumberFormat 处理，永远不要手写正则。
items.pe: Separators differ, and India groups by lakh and crore. Use Intl.NumberFormat and never hand-roll a regex.

items.dz: 符号在前在后、有没有空格都不同
items.de: Symbol before, after, spaced or not
items.pz: Intl.NumberFormat 的 currency 样式；金额存整数最小单位（分），显示时才格式化，避免浮点误差。
items.pe: Use the currency style, store amounts as integer minor units, and format only at display time to dodge float errors.

items.dz: 公顷、英亩、平方公里
items.de: Hectares, acres, square kilometres
items.pz: Intl.NumberFormat 的 unit 样式；同时给主单位与括号换算，别只给一个体系的人看得懂的数。
items.pe: Use the unit style, and show a converted value in parentheses. Do not publish a number only one measurement system understands.

items.dz: 按 Unicode 码点排序等于乱排
items.de: Code-point order is not alphabetical order
items.pz: Intl.Collator 按 locale 排；瑞典语 Å 在 Z 后，德语 ä 视作 a，中文可按拼音或笔画。
items.pe: Intl.Collator sorts per locale — Swedish Å follows Z, German ä sorts as a, Chinese by pinyin or stroke count.

items.dz: 不是所有人都有"名"和"姓"
items.de: Not everyone has a first and last name
items.pz: 优先一个"全名"字段 + 可选"显示名"；需要拆分时标清顺序，并支持单名、多姓、非拉丁字符。
items.pe: Prefer one full-name field plus an optional display name. If you must split, label the order and allow mononyms and non-Latin scripts.

items.dz: 省市区不是全球通用结构
items.de: State and ZIP are not universal
items.pz: 先选国家，再按国家渲染字段集与顺序；邮编不一定存在、不一定是数字、不一定必填。
items.pe: Pick the country first, then render that country's field set and order. Postcodes may not exist, may not be numeric, may be optional.

items.dz: 别做长度和格式校验
items.de: Do not validate length or shape
items.pz: 存 E.164（+ 国家码），显示时按 locale 分组；输入框给国家选择器而不是正则拦人。
items.pe: Store E.164 with the country code and group for display. Offer a country picker instead of a regex that rejects real numbers.

items.dz: 不是所有人都用公历
items.de: Not everyone uses the Gregorian calendar
items.pz: 伊斯兰历、佛历、和历、希伯来历都在用；Intl 支持 calendar 选项，日期选择器要能切换。
items.pe: Islamic, Buddhist, Japanese-era and Hebrew calendars are all in daily use. Intl supports a calendar option; your date picker should too.

items.dz: UTC 存储，本地显示，还要说清是哪个时区
items.de: Store UTC, show local, name the zone
items.pz: 存 UTC 时间戳 + 事件的 IANA 时区名；跨时区会议要显示两个时区，并标 DST 变更。
items.pe: Store a UTC instant plus the event's IANA zone. Cross-zone meetings show both, and flag DST transitions.

items.dz: 周一开始还是周日开始
items.de: Monday or Sunday
items.pz: 中国与欧洲多为周一、美国与日本多为周日、部分中东为周六；用 locale 的 weekInfo，不要写死。
items.pe: Monday in Europe and China, Sunday in the US and Japan, Saturday in parts of the Middle East. Read locale weekInfo.

items.dz: 缺字会跳到一个完全不同的字体
items.de: A missing glyph jumps to another face
items.pz: 按语言给不同栈（CJK 要显式列思源/苹方/微软雅黑），用 unicode-range 分片，避免一句话里三种字形。
items.pe: Give each script its own stack, split with unicode-range, and avoid three different faces inside one sentence.

items.dz: 不写 lang，读屏会用错发音
items.de: Without lang, the reader mispronounces
items.pz: <html lang> 必写，段落内换语言要在元素上标 lang；它还影响断行规则、连字与引号形状。
items.pe: Set html lang, and mark inline language switches on the element. It also drives line breaking, ligatures and quote shapes.

items.dz: 同一个字号，中文看起来更小
items.de: The same size reads smaller in Han
items.pz: CJK 通常要比拉丁大 1–2px、行高再高 0.1–0.2；用 :lang() 选择器分别微调，而不是一套值全局用。
items.pe: CJK usually needs 1–2px more size and 0.1–0.2 more line height. Tune per :lang() rather than one global value.

items.dz: 汉字方块密，行高要更松
items.de: Dense square glyphs need looser leading
items.pz: 中文正文 1.7–1.9，拉丁 1.5–1.6；标题可以收到 1.3，但绝不能像拉丁标题那样压到 1.0。
items.pe: Chinese body text wants 1.7–1.9 against 1.5–1.6 for Latin. Headings can tighten to 1.3, never to 1.0.

items.dz: 汉字和拉丁之间要有一点气
items.de: A hair of space between Han and Latin
items.pz: text-autospace 或在构建期插入 1/4 空；数字与单位之间也要，"5GB" 不如 "5 GB"。
items.pe: Use text-autospace, or insert a quarter space at build time. Numerals and units want it too — 5 GB, not 5GB.

items.dz: 省略号在不同语言里不一样宽
items.de: The ellipsis is not the same width everywhere
items.pz: 优先多行截断（line-clamp）而不是单行；CJK 按字截断没问题，拉丁要按词，且要给 title 或展开。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Prefer line-clamp to single-line truncation. CJK may break mid-run; Latin must break on words — and always offer the full text. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 阿拉伯语区用的是另一套数字
items.de: Arabic locales use different digits
items.pz: 阿拉伯-印度数字（٠١٢）、天城体数字都在用；Intl 的 numberingSystem 控制，表格对齐要用等宽数字。
items.pe: Eastern Arabic and Devanagari digits are in real use. Control it with numberingSystem, and align tables with tabular figures.

items.dz: 打拼音也要能搜到汉字
items.de: Pinyin should find Han characters
items.pz: 索引时同时存原文、拼音全拼与首字母；日文要存假名读音，阿拉伯语要去变音符号。
items.pe: Index the original plus full and initial pinyin. Japanese needs kana readings, Arabic needs diacritics stripped.

items.dz: 拼音还没上屏就别去搜索
items.de: Do not search while the IME is composing
items.pz: 监听 compositionstart / compositionend，组合期间不触发查询与校验；否则每敲一个字母都发请求。
items.pe: Listen for compositionstart and compositionend and suppress queries in between, or every keystroke fires a request.

items.dz: % 前面有没有空格也是本地习惯
items.de: Even the space before % is local
items.pz: 法语 12 % 有空格、英语 12% 没有；负号位置、括号表负也因地区与会计习惯而异。
items.pe: French writes 12 %, English 12%. Minus placement and parenthesised negatives vary by locale and accounting convention.

items.dz: 键名要说明"在哪、干什么"
items.de: A key says where and what
items.pz: 用 area.component.action 这类层级键，不要用英文原文当键；带上下文注释与最大长度约束给译者。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Use hierarchical keys like area.component.action, never the English string. Ship translator notes and a max length. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 上线前先用假语言把界面撑一遍
items.de: Stress the UI with a fake language first
items.pz: 把文案自动加长 40%、加变音符号、两端加方括号：一眼看出硬编码字符串与撑破的容器。
items.pe: Auto-expand strings 40%, add accents and wrap in brackets. Hard-coded strings and burst containers reveal themselves instantly.

items.dz: 每次改文案都可能撑破别的语言
items.de: Every copy change can burst another locale
items.pz: 把最长语言（德/俄/芬）与 RTL 各截一版进视觉回归；CI 里跑一次比上线后修十次便宜。
items.pe: Snapshot the longest locales and one RTL build in visual regression. One CI pass beats ten post-launch patches.

dz: 暗色不是把颜色反过来，是另一套光照模型；再加上 token 分层、品牌切换与首屏防闪
de: Dark mode is a different lighting model, not an inversion — plus token tiers, brand switching and no first-paint flash

items.dz: 别叫 grey-400，叫 border-subtle
items.de: Not grey-400 — border-subtle
items.pz: 三层：原始色阶 → 语义角色（surface / border / text-muted）→ 组件专用；组件只许用语义层。
items.pe: Three tiers: raw ramp → semantic role (surface, border, text-muted) → component alias. Components may only touch the semantic tier.

items.dz: 改一个原始色不该改遍全站
items.de: Changing one raw colour should not ripple everywhere
items.pz: raw 只被 semantic 引用，semantic 只被 component 引用；跨层直引是维护地狱的起点。
items.pe: Raw feeds semantic, semantic feeds component. A cross-tier reference is where the maintenance debt begins.

items.dz: 让改版只改一层
items.de: A redesign should touch one layer
items.pz: 组件写 button-bg 而不是 accent-600；换品牌或换主题时只重新指向别名，组件代码一行不动。
items.pe: Components read button-bg, not accent-600. Rebranding repoints the aliases and leaves component code untouched.

items.dz: 一行就修好滚动条和表单控件
items.de: One line fixes scrollbars and form controls
items.pz: :root{color-scheme:light dark} 让原生控件、滚动条、系统对话框跟着主题；漏了它暗色下会露出白条。
items.pe: color-scheme:light dark makes native controls, scrollbars and system dialogs follow. Skip it and white bars show through.

items.dz: 纯白变纯黑会刺眼到发光
items.de: Pure white to pure black glares
items.pz: 暗色底用 #12151a 一类而非 #000，文字用 #e8ecf1 而非 #fff；对比拉满会产生光晕（halation）。
items.pe: Use about #12151a rather than pure black, and #e8ecf1 rather than pure white. Maxed contrast causes halation.

items.dz: 暗色里越高越亮，不是越暗
items.de: Higher means lighter, not darker
items.pz: 亮色靠阴影表示层级，暗色靠"表面变亮"；每升一级底色提亮 3–5%，阴影只做辅助。
items.pe: Light mode encodes depth with shadow; dark mode encodes it with a lighter surface — about 3–5% per step.

items.dz: 亮色的饱和色在暗底上会震动
items.de: Saturated hues vibrate on dark
items.pz: 暗色主题的强调色要降饱和、提明度；同一个品牌色在两个主题下应该是两个数值。
items.pe: Dark themes need less saturation and more lightness. One brand hue means two different values across themes.

items.dz: 暗色里一张亮照片像手电筒
items.de: A bright photo is a torch in dark mode
items.pz: 给图片加 filter:brightness(.86) 或半透明遮罩；纯白背景的产品图要换成透明或深底版本。
items.pe: Apply brightness(.86) or a scrim. Product shots on white need a transparent or dark-ground variant.

items.zh: 暗色用高光而不是阴影
items.dz: 黑底上的黑影看不见
items.de: A black shadow is invisible on black
items.pz: 用 inset 顶部 1px 高光 + 边框透明白（rgba(255,255,255,.08)）代替投影；投影只在极亮元素下保留。
items.pe: Use a 1px inset top highlight and a translucent white border instead. Keep drop shadows only under very light elements.

items.dz: 品牌色可能在暗底上根本不合格
items.de: Your brand hue may simply fail on dark
items.pz: 先测对比度，不合格就在暗色里换成品牌色的亮阶，或者只把它用在大字与图形上。
items.pe: Measure first. If it fails, use a lighter step of the brand ramp in dark, or restrict it to large type and graphics.

items.dz: 亮 / 暗 / 跟随系统
items.de: Light, dark, system
items.pz: 默认"跟随系统"，用户显式选择后才写入存储；二态切换会让用户失去跟随能力。
items.pe: Default to system and only persist an explicit choice. A two-state toggle takes away the ability to follow.

items.dz: 用户在系统里切了，你要跟着变
items.de: They switch at the OS; you follow
items.pz: 监听 prefers-color-scheme 查询的 change 事件，而不是只在加载时读一次。
items.pe: Listen to the change event on the prefers-color-scheme query — do not read it once at load.

items.dz: 刷新一下白光闪一下眼
items.de: A white flash on every refresh
items.pz: 在 <head> 里用一段阻塞小脚本读存储并给 html 打 class；等 React 挂载再改就一定会闪。
items.pe: Read storage in a tiny blocking script in head and set a class on html. Waiting for React guarantees a flash.

items.dz: 一个属性写两个值
items.de: One property, both values
items.pz: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) 省掉整套媒体查询；需要 color-scheme 已声明才生效。
items.pe: color:light-dark(#23232f,#e8ecf1) removes a whole media-query layer — it needs color-scheme declared.

items.dz: 除了亮暗，还有"看得清"这一档
items.de: Beyond light and dark: legible
items.pz: prefers-contrast:more 时加粗边框、去掉浅灰、提高文字对比；不是把所有东西变黑白。
items.pe: Under prefers-contrast:more, thicken borders, drop pale greys and raise text contrast — not a black-and-white dump.

items.dz: 选了就要记住，跨标签也一致
items.de: Remember it, and across tabs
items.pz: localStorage 存显式选择 + storage 事件同步其他标签；服务端渲染时用 cookie 才能首屏就对。
items.pe: Store the explicit choice and sync tabs with the storage event. Server rendering needs a cookie to get frame one right.

items.dz: 一个暗色区块嵌在亮色页里
items.de: One dark block inside a light page
items.pz: 把 token 定义挂在容器上而不是 :root，容器内自成主题；页脚、代码块、演示区最常用。
items.pe: Declare tokens on a container rather than :root so it themes itself. Footers, code blocks and demo areas want this.

items.dz: 同一套组件跑五个品牌
items.de: One component set, five brands
items.pz: 品牌差异只允许存在于 token 值（色、圆角、字体、密度）；一旦落到组件结构上就无法扩展。
items.pe: Brand differences live only in token values — colour, radius, type, density. Once they reach component structure it stops scaling.

items.dz: 突变刺眼，全局过渡会卡
items.de: A hard cut jars; a global transition janks
items.pz: 用 View Transitions 做一次圆形揭开，或只给 background/color 加 120ms 过渡；不要给所有属性加 transition:all。
items.pe: Do one circular reveal with View Transitions, or transition only background and color for 120ms. Never transition:all.

items.dz: 线性图标在暗底要更细一点
items.de: Line icons need to be thinner on dark
items.pz: 暗底上同样线宽看起来更粗（光渗）；把 stroke 从 1.75 调到 1.5，或用 currentColor 让它自然跟随。
items.pe: The same stroke looks heavier on dark because of bloom. Drop 1.75 to 1.5, and use currentColor so it follows the text.

items.dz: 插画不能靠 filter 反色
items.de: You cannot invert illustration with a filter
items.pz: 插画与图表要出亮暗两版资产，或用 currentColor + CSS 变量画；PNG 插画在暗色里一定露白边。
items.pe: Ship two asset sets, or draw with currentColor and variables. PNG illustration always leaks a white fringe on dark.

items.dz: 代码块要跟着换配色
items.de: Code blocks switch schemes too
items.pz: 亮暗各选一个成熟主题（如 GitHub Light/Dark、One Light/Dark），别自己配；注释色最容易不合格。
items.pe: Pick a mature pair — GitHub or One, light and dark — rather than inventing one. Comment colour is the usual contrast failure.

items.dz: 数据色不能两套主题共用一份
items.de: One data palette cannot serve both
items.pz: 暗色下数据色要提亮降饱和，网格线用透明白，标注要重新测对比度；序列顺序保持一致以免读错。
items.pe: Lighten and desaturate data hues for dark, switch gridlines to translucent white, and re-measure labels. Keep the series order stable.

items.dz: 地图不换底图就毁掉整页暗色
items.de: A light basemap ruins the whole dark page
items.pz: 底图、道路、水体、标注要整套换；标注描边在暗底上要改成深色 halo 而不是白色。
items.pe: Swap the whole basemap — roads, water, labels — and change label halos from white to dark.

items.dz: 暗底毛玻璃要靠边框才看得出边界
items.de: On dark, glass needs a border to have an edge
items.pz: 暗色玻璃用 rgba(255,255,255,.06) 填充 + .12 顶部高光 + .1 边框；亮色那套 alpha 直接搬过来会消失。
items.pe: Dark glass wants a .06 white fill, a .12 top highlight and a .1 border. Reusing the light-mode alphas makes it vanish.

items.dz: 边框用透明白，不用固定灰
items.de: Translucent white, not a fixed grey
items.pz: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) 会随底色自动适配层级；写死的 #2a2a2a 在不同海拔上会时隐时现。
items.pe: rgba(255,255,255,.08–.14) adapts to whatever surface it sits on. A hard-coded #2a2a2a appears and disappears by elevation.

items.dz: 深色焦点环在深底上等于没有
items.de: A dark ring on dark is no ring
items.pz: 用双层环：内圈底色、外圈亮色，两种主题都成立；或直接用 outline-color:currentColor。
items.pe: Use a two-layer ring — an inner ring in the surface colour, an outer bright one — so it works in both themes.

items.dz: ::selection 不换就会看不清被选的字
items.de: Unchanged ::selection hides the selected text
items.pz: 两个主题各给一组 ::selection 背景与前景；浅色高亮块（mark）在暗色里也要重配。
items.pe: Give each theme its own ::selection pair, and re-tune mark highlights for dark too.

items.dz: 亮色滚动条在暗色页面上像一道伤口
items.de: A light scrollbar scars a dark page
items.pz: color-scheme 解决大部分；要精细控制用 scrollbar-color: thumb track，别整个 ::-webkit-scrollbar 重画。
items.pe: color-scheme covers most of it. For fine control use scrollbar-color rather than repainting the whole webkit scrollbar.

items.dz: 客户端会替你反色
items.de: The client will invert it for you
items.pz: meta name=color-scheme + supported-color-schemes，关键色写死并用表格背景色兜底；Gmail 只会部分尊重。
items.pe: Declare color-scheme and supported-color-schemes, hard-code critical colours and back them with table bgcolor. Gmail only partly complies.

items.dz: OG 图不会跟随用户主题
items.de: Share cards never follow the user theme
items.pz: 分享图固定一套（通常深底），不要指望它响应主题；文字要足够大，1200×630 会被压缩到很小。
items.pe: Fix one treatment — usually dark — and do not expect it to adapt. Set type large; 1200×630 gets shown tiny.

items.dz: 让主题跟着封面走
items.de: Let the theme follow the artwork
items.pz: 提取封面主色生成一组和谐色（Material You 那一套）；必须钳制饱和与明度，否则某些图会毁掉可读性。
items.pe: Extract a seed colour and generate a harmonised set. Clamp saturation and lightness or some artwork destroys legibility.

items.dz: 让用户挑一个颜色，但要兜住对比度
items.de: Let them pick — then guarantee contrast
items.pz: 只暴露强调色一个变量，前景色用 oklch 亮度判断自动取黑或白；不要让用户能配出不可读的组合。
items.pe: Expose one accent variable and derive the foreground from its oklch lightness. Never let a user configure an unreadable pair.

items.dz: 每个 token 在每个主题下都要过一遍
items.de: Every token, every theme, checked
items.pz: 生成对比度矩阵：每个 text token × 每个 surface token；CI 里跑，新增颜色不合格就拦下来。
items.pe: Generate a contrast matrix of every text token against every surface token, and gate it in CI.

items.dz: 系统会把你的主题整个接管
items.de: The OS takes your theme away entirely
items.pz: forced-colors:active 时放弃自定义色，改用系统关键字并保证结构可辨；这时"主题"变成"结构"。
items.pe: Under forced-colors, drop custom colour for system keywords and let structure carry meaning. Theme becomes layout.

dz: 零一多、错误、离线、过期、配额、通知——只画"有数据"那一种，是交付里最常见的缺口
de: Zero-one-many, errors, offline, stale, quota, notifications — shipping only the happy path is the most common gap of all

items.dz: 还没有任何东西的时候
items.de: Before anything exists
items.pz: 一句说明它是什么 + 一个主动作 + 可选的示例数据；别只画一张插画。
items.pe: One sentence saying what this is, one primary action, and optionally sample data. Not just an illustration.

items.dz: 搜不到要给下一步
items.de: A dead end needs an exit
items.pz: 回显搜索词、给拼写建议与放宽条件的按钮、列出热门项；不要只写"无结果"。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Echo the query, offer spelling suggestions and a broaden-search action, and list popular items. Never a bare "no results". This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 是筛没了，不是真没有
items.de: Filtered out, not absent
items.pz: 明确说"当前筛选下无结果"，并给"清除筛选"一键回到全集；两种空状态文案必须不同。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Say it is the filter, and offer a one-tap clear. These two empty states must never share copy. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 收件箱清空是好事
items.de: An empty inbox is a win
items.pz: 任务型列表清空要庆祝而不是道歉；语气与首次为空完全相反。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Celebrate a cleared task list instead of apologising. The tone is the opposite of first-run empty. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一条数据也要看起来是设计过的
items.de: One row must still look designed
items.pz: 网格里只有一张卡时不要拉满整行；列表只有一条时隐藏排序与分页。
items.pe: Do not stretch a single card across the whole row, and hide sorting and pagination for a single row.

items.dz: 一千条和十条不是同一个界面
items.de: A thousand rows is a different screen
items.pz: 出现搜索、筛选、批量操作、虚拟滚动与"跳到"；密度也要跟着变紧。
items.pe: Search, filters, bulk actions, virtual scrolling and a jump-to appear — and the density tightens.

items.dz: 超过 10000 条就别再说"共 N 条"
items.de: Past ten thousand, stop counting
items.pz: 显示"10,000+"而不是精确总数（精确 count 很贵），并强制引导到筛选与搜索。
items.pe: Show "10,000+" rather than an exact count — counting is expensive — and push people into search.

items.dz: 结构已知就用骨架
items.de: Known structure means skeleton
items.pz: 骨架块与真实内容同尺寸；同时预留操作栏位置，否则加载完会整页下移。
items.pe: Match the real geometry, and reserve the toolbar row too or the page shifts down on arrival.

items.dz: 追加时不要动已有内容
items.de: Appending must not move what is there
items.pz: 新内容加在下方，滚动位置保持不动；底部占位高度要在请求前就撑住。
items.pe: Append below and keep the scroll anchored. Reserve the footer height before the request.

items.dz: 旧数据还在，只是在更新
items.de: The old data stays while it updates
items.pz: 保留现有内容 + 顶部细进度条或轻微降透明度；千万不要清空再重载。
items.pe: Keep the content and add a hairline progress bar or a slight dim. Never blank and reload.

items.dz: 这是 3 分钟前的数字
items.de: These numbers are three minutes old
items.pz: 标注数据时间戳与"刷新"入口；金融、库存、监控类界面缺了它就是误导。
items.pe: Stamp the data time and offer a refresh. In finance, inventory and monitoring, omitting it is misinformation.

items.dz: 批量操作里有几条挂了
items.de: A few of the batch failed
items.pz: 说清成功几条、失败几条、失败原因分组，并只对失败项提供重试；别整批回滚。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Report the counts, group the reasons and retry only the failures. Do not roll back the batch. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 整个页面拿不到数据
items.de: Nothing on the page loaded
items.pz: 给出发生了什么、能做什么、以及一个可上报的错误码；不要显示堆栈。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: What happened, what to do, and a reportable code. Never a stack trace. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一个卡片挂了不该拖垮整页
items.de: One broken card must not take the page
items.pz: 每个数据区块自己承担错误边界，就地显示重试；容器高度保持不变。
items.pe: Give each block its own error boundary with a local retry, and keep the container height.

items.dz: 断网要说，恢复也要说
items.de: Announce the drop and the recovery
items.pz: 常驻一条低干扰横幅说明当前离线与哪些功能不可用；恢复时短暂提示后自动消失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A persistent low-noise bar naming what is unavailable, and a brief self-dismissing note on recovery. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 别让指数退避看起来像卡死
items.de: Backoff must not look frozen
items.pz: 显示尝试次数与下次重试倒计时，并给"立即重试"；静默重连会让用户以为坏了。
items.pe: Show the attempt count, the next retry countdown, and a retry-now button. Silent backoff reads as broken.

items.dz: 说清缺什么权限、找谁要
items.de: Name the permission and who grants it
items.pz: "没有权限"要具体到角色与资源，并给出申请入口；不要伪装成 404。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Name the role and the resource, and provide the request path. Do not disguise it as a 404. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 404 也要能继续走
items.de: A 404 still needs a next step
items.pz: 给搜索框、上一级链接与最近访问；纯插画 404 是在给用户添堵。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Offer search, a parent link and recent items. A purely decorative 404 wastes their time. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 东西曾经在这里
items.de: It used to be here
items.pz: 410 与 404 语气不同：说明它被谁在何时删除，是否能恢复；链接分享场景尤其重要。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A 410 is not a 404: say who removed it, when, and whether it can be restored. Shared links depend on this. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 告诉他等多久
items.de: Tell them how long
items.pz: 给出剩余等待秒数（Retry-After）与配额窗口，倒计时可视；不要只说"请稍后再试"。
items.pe: Surface Retry-After as a visible countdown with the quota window. "Try again later" is not information.

items.dz: 计划内停机要提前通知
items.de: Planned downtime is announced in advance
items.pz: 提前 3 天站内横幅 + 停机页给出预计恢复时间与状态页链接；时间要带时区。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A banner three days ahead, and a downtime page with an ETA in a named time zone plus a status-page link. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一部分功能暂时不可用
items.de: Part of it is temporarily off
items.pz: 把不可用功能就地置灰并说明原因，其余照常；整站下线是最后手段。
items.pe: Grey out the affected features in place with a reason and keep the rest working. A full outage is the last resort.

items.dz: 成功要说，但不该挡路
items.de: Say it, but do not block
items.pz: 底部或角落 3–4 秒自动消失，带撤销；不要用需要点确定的弹窗宣布成功。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Bottom or corner, three to four seconds, with undo. Never a modal to announce success. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 按钮自己变成"已保存"
items.de: The button becomes "saved"
items.pz: 在触发点就地反馈比飘出提示更好定位；保持 1.5s 后恢复，宽度不能跳。
items.pe: Feedback at the point of action beats a floating toast. Revert after 1.5s and keep the width stable.

items.dz: 比"确定要删除吗"好得多
items.de: Far better than "are you sure?"
items.pz: 执行后停留 5–8 秒的撤销条，堆叠时合并成"已删除 3 项"；撤销必须真的能还原顺序与位置。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A five-to-eight second strip, merged when stacked, and the undo must restore order and position exactly. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 第几步、还有几步、能不能退
items.de: Which step, how many, can I go back
items.pz: 步骤条显示当前、已完成与未来；允许回退且保留已填数据，禁止把校验错误藏在上一步。
items.pe: Show current, done and upcoming. Allow going back with data intact, and never hide a validation error on a previous step.

items.dz: 还没开始跑，在等位置
items.de: Not started — waiting in line
items.pz: 区分"排队中 / 处理中 / 已完成"三态，排队要给位次或预计开始时间。
items.pe: Distinguish queued, running and done — and give a position or an ETA for queued.

items.dz: 这事要跑十分钟，别让他干等
items.de: It takes ten minutes — let them leave
items.pz: 允许离开页面，完成后用通知或邮件告知；进度可在通知中心查询，别用 modal 锁住。
items.pe: Let them navigate away and notify on completion. Progress lives in the notification centre, not a blocking modal.

items.dz: 在还能补救的时候提醒
items.de: Warn while it can still be fixed
items.pz: 按剩余时间分级（30 天低干扰 / 7 天显眼 / 24 小时强提示），每级给不同动作。
items.pe: Escalate by time remaining — quiet at thirty days, prominent at seven, urgent at one — with a different action at each level.

items.dz: 安静但可见
items.de: Quiet, but visible
items.pz: 低对比小字 + 时间戳，写入时短暂变化；不要每次按键都闪一下"保存中"。
items.pe: Small low-contrast text with a timestamp that changes briefly on write. Do not flash "saving" on every keystroke.

items.dz: 两个人改了同一处
items.de: Two people changed the same thing
items.pz: 并排显示两版并让用户选，或提供合并；绝不静默覆盖，也不要只说"保存失败"。
items.pe: Show both versions side by side and let them choose, or offer a merge. Never overwrite silently.

items.dz: 看得见但改不了，要一眼看出来
items.de: Visibly not editable
items.pz: 去掉输入框边框、光标变默认、隐藏操作按钮，并说明为什么只读；不要只 disabled 一片。
items.pe: Drop field borders, use the default cursor, hide the actions, and say why. Do not just disable everything.

items.dz: 谁在改、什么时候能改
items.de: Who has it, and when it frees
items.pz: 显示占用者头像与开始时间，给"请求接管"；锁要有超时，别永久卡住。
items.pe: Show the holder and since when, offer a takeover request, and always expire the lock.

items.dz: 标清楚这是会变的
items.de: Mark what is still moving
items.pz: 角标 + 一句"可能变化/可关闭"，并给反馈入口；不要把 beta 当免责声明用。
items.pe: A badge plus one line saying it may change, with a feedback path. Beta is not a disclaimer.

items.dz: 给迁移路径和最后期限
items.de: A migration path and a date
items.pz: 标注下线日期、替代方案链接与影响范围；下线前 30 天升级为阻断式提示。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: State the sunset date, the replacement, and the blast radius — escalating to a blocking notice thirty days out. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 快用完了要提前知道
items.de: See it coming, not after
items.pz: 进度条 + 剩余量 + 重置时间，80% 与 95% 两个阈值变色并提示升级；超限行为要写清楚。
items.pe: A bar, the remainder and the reset time, with colour shifts at 80% and 95% — and a stated over-limit behaviour.

items.dz: 数字要有上限，也要能清零
items.de: Cap the number and let it clear
items.pz: 99+ 封顶；只对需要行动的事计数，纯资讯用圆点。进入列表即视为已读要谨慎。
items.pe: Cap at 99+. Count only actionable items and use a plain dot for informational ones. Auto-read on open is a risky default.

items.dz: 未读、已读、按来源分组
items.de: Unread, read, grouped by source
items.pz: 分组 + 批量已读 + 逐条静音；不要只做一个倒序列表，那会在第二周变成垃圾堆。
items.pe: Grouping, mark-all-read and per-source mute. A plain reverse-chronological list becomes landfill by week two.

items.dz: 同一件事别推十条
items.de: Ten pushes for one event is spam
items.pz: 按实体与时间窗合并（"张娇等 3 人评论了"），并提供每日/每周摘要；夜间静默。
items.pe: Collapse by entity and time window, offer a daily or weekly digest, and stay quiet at night.

items.dz: 空闲状态是明确的可操作状态，不等同于加载或失败。
items.de: Idle is an actionable state, not loading or failure.
items.pz: 空闲状态是明确的可操作状态，不等同于加载或失败。 在刷新、慢网络、失败恢复和中英文切换下复核。
