items.pz: 同步只发送必要字段，不把浏览历史或隐私查询混入偏好。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Send only necessary fields and keep history or private queries out. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 敏感本地数据同步前说明加密边界和密钥归属。
items.de: Explain encryption boundaries and key ownership before syncing sensitive data.
items.pz: 敏感本地数据同步前说明加密边界和密钥归属。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Explain encryption boundaries and key ownership before syncing sensitive data. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 导入文件先作为待合并数据，确认后才写入当前集合。
items.de: Treat imported files as pending data until explicitly merged.
items.pz: 导入文件先作为待合并数据，确认后才写入当前集合。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Treat imported files as pending data until explicitly merged. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 导出包含版本和时间戳，便于定位同步前后的差异。
items.de: Include version and timestamp in exports to compare sync states.
items.pz: 导出包含版本和时间戳，便于定位同步前后的差异。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Include version and timestamp in exports to compare sync states. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 同步错误不阻塞本地浏览和收藏，重试入口保持可见。
items.de: Sync errors do not block local browsing or favorites.
items.pz: 同步错误不阻塞本地浏览和收藏，重试入口保持可见。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Sync errors do not block local browsing or favorites. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 调试信息记录队列长度、延迟和失败原因，但不记录内容隐私。
items.de: Record queue length, latency, and failure reason without private content.
items.pz: 调试信息记录队列长度、延迟和失败原因，但不记录内容隐私。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Record queue length, latency, and failure reason without private content. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

items.dz: 发布前检查离线、跨标签、冲突、迁移、隐私和失败恢复。
items.de: Audit offline, cross-tab, conflict, migration, privacy, and recovery.
items.pz: 发布前检查离线、跨标签、冲突、迁移、隐私和失败恢复。 在刷新、离线、跨标签和重复操作下复核。
items.pe: Audit offline, cross-tab, conflict, migration, privacy, and recovery. Validate refresh, offline, cross-tab, and repeated operations.

dz: 底部抽屉、下拉刷新、侧滑操作、拇指区、共享元素转场——原生 App 的那套词汇
de: Bottom sheets, pull-to-refresh, swipe actions, thumb zones, shared-element transitions — the native app vocabulary

items.dz: 从下面推上来的一层
items.de: A layer pushed up from below
items.pz: 拖拽把手 + 多段吸附高度（30/60/95%）+ 下拉关闭；内容可滚时要区分"滚内容"与"拖抽屉"。
items.pe: A grab handle, snap heights around 30/60/95%, and swipe-down to close. Distinguish scrolling content from dragging the sheet.

items.dz: 往下拽一下松手
items.de: Drag down and let go
items.pz: 有阻尼、有阈值、有越过阈值的形变反馈；overscroll-behavior:contain 防止连带滚动祖先。
items.pe: Damped drag, a threshold, and a shape change once crossed. overscroll-behavior:contain stops the ancestor from scrolling.

items.dz: 往左滑露出删除
items.de: Swipe left to reveal delete
items.pz: 滑动露出 1–3 个动作，破坏性动作放最外侧并需要二次确认或完全划过；一定要有非滑动入口。
items.pe: Reveal one to three actions with the destructive one outermost, needing a full swipe or confirm. Always keep a non-swipe path.

items.dz: 三到五个平级入口
items.de: Three to five peer destinations
items.pz: 图标 + 文字（纯图标记不住），当前项要有形状差异不只变色；标签栏不承载"更多操作"。
items.pe: Icon plus label — icon-only is unmemorable — and mark the current tab with shape, not only colour.

items.dz: 屏幕上半部分是"够不到"的
items.de: The top half is out of reach
items.pz: 主操作放底部 1/3，破坏性操作放顶部（防误触）；6.7 寸屏上顶部按钮需要换手。
items.pe: Primary actions in the bottom third, destructive ones up top where mis-taps are unlikely. A 6.7-inch screen needs a hand change to reach the top.

items.dz: 从左边缘划回去
items.de: Swipe from the left edge to go back
items.pz: 系统手势会和你的横滑组件冲突：给横滑轨留出边缘 24px，或用 touch-action 明确让路。
items.pe: The system gesture fights your horizontal carousel. Leave a 24px edge gutter or yield with touch-action.

items.dz: 列表里那张图长成详情页的头图
items.de: The thumbnail grows into the hero
items.pz: View Transitions API 的 view-transition-name 对上同一个元素；比例要一致，否则会看到形变。
items.pe: Match one view-transition-name across both views. Keep the aspect ratio or you will see it warp.

items.dz: 新页从右边推进来，旧页往左走一点
items.de: The new page pushes in, the old one eases left
items.pz: 前进右进左出、返回反向；旧页要有轻微视差（-30%）与压暗，才有层次。
items.pe: Forward comes from the right; back reverses it. The outgoing page parallaxes about 30% and dims slightly.

items.dz: 从底部整页升起来
items.de: A full page rising from the bottom
items.pz: 模态是"另一个任务"，转场从下往上、圆角变大、背后页缩小；退出必须能下滑。
items.pe: A modal is a separate task: it rises, gains corner radius, and shrinks the page behind. Swipe-down must dismiss it.

items.dz: 轻震一下比动画更快被感知
items.de: A tap of vibration lands faster than animation
items.pz: 选择用轻（selection）、成功用中、错误用双击式；不要给滚动与悬停加震动。
items.pe: Light for selection, medium for success, a double pattern for errors. Never on scroll or hover.

items.dz: 按住 500ms 弹出上下文
items.de: Hold 500ms for context
items.pz: 长按要有渐进反馈（缩放 + 触感），菜单从按压点长出；必须另有可见入口（"…"按钮）。
items.pe: Give progressive feedback while holding — scale plus haptics — and grow the menu from the press point. Also ship a visible "…".

items.dz: 一屏一条，划过去就定住
items.de: One item per screen, snapped
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory + 每项 100dvh；要保证内部可滚元素不被吞掉手势。
items.pe: y-mandatory snapping with 100dvh items — and make sure inner scrollables still get the gesture.

items.dz: 大标题滚上去变成小标题
items.de: The large title shrinks into the bar
items.pz: 大标题在内容里，滚动时淡出并把文字交给顶栏；两者要在同一水平位置对齐才不突兀。
items.pe: The large title lives in the content and hands its text to the bar on scroll. Align them horizontally or it jars.

items.dz: 两到四个互斥视图
items.de: Two to four exclusive views
items.pz: 滑块跟随选中项移动，宽度按最长文案统一；超过四项改用下拉或标签滚动。
items.pe: The thumb slides to the selection and every segment shares the widest label. Past four, use a select.

items.dz: 从底部弹出的一列动作
items.de: A column of actions from below
items.pz: 破坏性动作单独一组并用红色，取消永远单独一块在最下方；不要超过 6 项。
items.pe: Destructive actions get their own group in red, and Cancel always sits alone at the bottom. Six items maximum.

items.dz: 别挡住底部标签栏
items.de: Keep clear of the tab bar
items.pz: 出现在标签栏之上、安全区之内，宽度留边距；带撤销的提示要延长到 8 秒。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Sit above the tab bar and inside the safe area with side margins. Extend to eight seconds when it carries an undo. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一个屏幕只配一个
items.de: One per screen, at most
items.pz: 固定在右下（RTL 翻到左下），滚动时可缩成图标；不要用它承载多个动作除非能展开。
items.pe: Bottom-trailing corner, shrinking to the icon on scroll. Do not overload it unless it expands.

items.dz: 窄屏骨架要按卡片来
items.de: Skeletons follow the card, not the table
items.pz: 一屏放 3–4 个骨架卡就够，再多也看不见；高度要和真实卡一致。
items.pe: Three or four skeleton cards fill the screen; more is invisible. Match the real card height exactly.

items.dz: 输数字就别弹字母键盘
items.de: Numbers should not summon letters
items.pz: inputmode=numeric/decimal/tel/email/search，配 enterkeyhint 改回车键文案；type=number 会带上没用的步进器。
items.pe: inputmode plus enterkeyhint. type=number drags along a stepper nobody wants.

items.dz: 六个格子，能粘贴也能自动填
items.de: Six boxes that accept a paste and an autofill
items.pz: 用一个真实 input 加视觉分格（别用六个 input），autocomplete="one-time-code"，满位自动提交。
items.pe: One real input with visual boxes — never six inputs — plus autocomplete="one-time-code" and auto-submit when full.

items.dz: 日期与时间用系统的那一套
items.de: Dates and times belong to the OS
items.pz: 移动端优先 input[type=date/time]：自带无障碍、本地格式与惯性滚轮；自造滚轮几乎总是更差。
items.pe: Prefer input type date and time on mobile — accessibility, locale format and momentum come free. Hand-rolled wheels lose.

items.dz: 底部条要加 env() 才不被压
items.de: Bottom bars need env() or they get covered
items.pz: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))；横屏时左右也要加。
items.pe: padding-bottom:max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) — and the inline insets too in landscape.

items.dz: 在图上双击，心跳一下
items.de: Double-tap the photo; a heart beats
items.pz: 要和单击（打开）与缩放（双击放大）区分：内容型双击点赞，图片查看器双击缩放，二者别混在同一屏。
items.pe: Separate it from single-tap open and double-tap zoom. Content feeds like; viewers zoom. Never both on one screen.

items.dz: 头像外面那圈渐变
items.de: The gradient ring around the avatar
items.pz: 未读用渐变环、已读用灰环、正在上传用旋转虚线；环宽 2–3px，与头像留 2px 白隙。
items.pe: Unread gets the gradient, read gets grey, uploading gets a spinning dash. A 2–3px ring with a 2px white gap.

items.dz: 露出下一张的一角
items.de: Show a sliver of the next
items.pz: 首项左侧留 padding、末项右侧留 padding（scroll-padding），让"还有更多"变成视觉事实。
items.pe: Pad the first and last items with scroll-padding so "there is more" becomes visible fact.

items.dz: 几页、第几页
items.de: How many, and which
items.pz: 超过 8 页改用"3/12"数字或缩略进度条；当前点放大而不只是变色。
items.pe: Past eight pages switch to "3/12" or a bar. Enlarge the active dot rather than only recolouring it.

items.dz: 键盘一弹，工具条贴在它上面
items.de: A bar riding on top of the keyboard
items.pz: 放"完成/上一个/下一个"或格式按钮，用 visualViewport 跟随键盘高度；表单跨字段跳转靠它。
items.pe: Done, previous and next, or formatting buttons, tracking the keyboard with visualViewport. It is how people move between fields.

items.dz: 点顶部就回到最上面
items.de: Tap the top to return to the start
items.pz: 滚过一屏后出现"回到顶部"按钮，或让顶栏可点；长列表没有这个就是残废。
items.pe: Show a back-to-top affordance after one screen, or make the header tappable. Long lists without it are broken.

items.dz: 不是断网，是很慢
items.de: Not offline — just slow
items.pz: 超过 3 秒给"网络较慢"提示与"仅加载文字"选项；把图片降级成占位。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Past three seconds, offer a slow-network notice and a text-only option, downgrading images to placeholders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 不装 App 也能用一小段
items.de: A slice that runs without installing
items.pz: 把单个任务（扫码点单、看票）做成免安装片段，只在必要时引导安装；不要一进来就拦装。
items.pe: Ship a single task as an install-free slice and only prompt when necessary. An immediate install wall loses everyone.

items.dz: 先说为什么，再弹系统框
items.de: Explain before the system asks
items.pz: 自建一屏说明用途与收益，用户同意后才触发系统弹窗；系统弹窗被拒一次就很难再要回来。
items.pe: Show your own screen explaining the benefit first — a system prompt refused once is nearly unrecoverable.

items.dz: 指纹或面容代替密码
items.de: A fingerprint instead of a password
items.pz: 失败要有密码兜底路径，且不能暴露"账号存在"；不要在每次前台切换都要求验证。
items.pe: Always keep a password fallback, never leak account existence, and do not re-prompt on every foreground.

items.dz: 从链接进来要落到对的那一屏
items.de: A link must land on the right screen
items.pz: 未登录时先记住目标再走登录，登录后直达；App 未装时回落到网页版同一内容。
items.pe: Remember the destination through login, and fall back to the same web content when the app is absent.

items.dz: 你的滑动和系统的滑动打起来了
items.de: Your swipe fights the system swipe
items.pz: 用 touch-action 明确让出方向；地图与画布这类需要全权手势的区域要显式声明 none 并给退出手势。
items.pe: Declare touch-action to yield an axis. Maps and canvases that need full control declare none — and provide an exit.

items.dz: 到底了还能拽一点，然后弹回来
items.de: It gives a little at the end, then springs back
items.pz: iOS 原生行为要保留（它是"到底了"的反馈）；只在需要防止连带滚动时用 overscroll-behavior。
items.pe: Keep the native bounce — it is the end-of-list signal. Use overscroll-behavior only to stop chaining.

items.dz: 往下滚把顶栏收走
items.de: Scrolling down takes the bar away
items.pz: 下滚隐藏、上滚立刻回来（不必滚到顶）；隐藏要有阈值防抖，且吸顶筛选条不能一起藏。
items.pe: Hide on down, return immediately on up. Add a threshold against jitter, and never hide the sticky filter bar with it.

items.dz: 离开字段才报错，不是每敲一下
items.de: Validate on blur, not on every keystroke
items.pz: blur 时校验、输入时清除错误；提交前统一再校验一次并聚焦第一个错误。
items.pe: Validate on blur and clear on input. Re-validate on submit and focus the first failure.

items.dz: 加减号要够大，中间数字可直接输
items.de: Big plus and minus, editable middle
items.pz: 按钮 44px 起，中间数字可点开键盘；长按连续加减要有加速度。
items.pe: Buttons from 44px with a tappable numeric middle, and acceleration on hold.

items.dz: 价格与按钮一起钉在底部
items.de: Price and button pinned together
items.pz: 滚动到内容底部时解除吸附并入内容流，避免遮挡最后一段；安全区内边距必须加。
items.pe: Release it into the flow at the end of the content so it stops covering the last paragraph. Safe-area padding required.

items.dz: 同一块区域既要横滑又要纵滚
items.de: One area, both a horizontal swipe and a vertical scroll
items.pz: 先按首次位移角度锁定主轴（超过 30° 判纵向），锁定后不再切换；否则会出现"滑不动"。
items.pe: Lock the axis from the first movement angle — past about 30° it is vertical — and never switch mid-gesture.

items.dz: 双指缩放、单指拖动、下滑关闭
items.de: Pinch, pan, swipe down to close
items.pz: 缩放上限 3–4×、双击在 1× 与 2× 间切换、下滑时背景渐透并跟手缩小。
items.pe: Cap zoom at three or four, double-tap toggles 1× and 2×, and a downward drag shrinks the image as the backdrop fades.

items.dz: 桌面上那个红点
items.de: The red dot on the home screen
items.pz: 只对需要用户行动的事计数；进入应用后要按实际已读收敛，不能只在打开时清零。
items.pe: Count only what needs action, and reconcile it with real read state rather than zeroing on launch.

items.dz: 抽屉上面又开一个抽屉
items.de: A sheet on top of a sheet
items.pz: 最多两层，下层要缩小并压暗表示"在后面"；第三层就该换成整页导航。
items.pe: Two layers maximum, with the lower one scaled and dimmed. A third layer should become full-page navigation.

items.dz: 返回列表要回到原来那一行
items.de: Going back returns you to the same row
items.pz: 记录滚动位置与列表项 id，返回时按 id 定位（分页数据可能已变）；不要只存像素值。
items.pe: Store the position and the anchor item id, and restore by id — paged data may have shifted under you.

items.dz: 先写本地，再慢慢同步
items.de: Write locally, sync eventually
items.pz: 所有写操作先落本地库并立刻反映在 UI，后台队列上传；网络只是同步通道而不是前置条件。
items.pe: Every write hits local storage and the UI immediately, with a background upload queue. The network is a sync channel, not a gate.

dz: 商品图、规格选择、加购动效、购物车、结算步骤、定价套餐——从看见到付完钱的全套词汇
de: Galleries, variant pickers, add-to-cart motion, carts, checkout steps and pricing tiers — from browsing to paid

items.dz: 主图加一排缩略图
items.de: A hero image with a thumbnail rail
items.pz: 缩略图当前项要有边框而不只是变亮；切换时主图淡入而不是滑动，避免误以为可横滑。
items.pe: Mark the active thumbnail with a border, and cross-fade the hero rather than sliding it.

items.dz: 鼠标停在图上局部放大
items.de: A loupe follows the pointer
items.pz: 2–3× 局部放大在旁边显示，移动端改为点击进全屏缩放；不要在原位放大遮住选项。
items.pe: Show a 2–3× loupe beside the image, and switch to a full-screen zoom on touch.

items.dz: 颜色、尺码、容量
items.de: Colour, size, capacity
items.pz: 缺货组合要置灰而不是隐藏（让人知道存在），色板用真实色块加名称；只剩一种规格时不显示选择器。
items.pe: Grey out unavailable combinations rather than hiding them, label every swatch, and hide the picker when only one option exists.

items.dz: 色块要能对上实物
items.de: The swatch must match the object
items.pz: 用产品实拍取色而不是品牌色；深色色块要加浅描边，白色要加深描边，选中用外环。
items.pe: Sample the colour from the product photo. Outline dark swatches light, white swatches dark, and select with a ring.

items.dz: 在选之前就能查
items.de: Available before they choose
items.pz: 尺码表就地展开而不是跳走，支持按身高体重推荐；退货率主要由这一步决定。
items.pe: Expand the chart in place rather than navigating away, and recommend from height and weight. This step drives your return rate.

items.dz: "仅剩 3 件"要是真的
items.de: "Only 3 left" must be true
items.pz: 真实库存低于阈值才显示，且不要跳动；假造紧迫感一旦被发现就会毁掉信任。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Show it only below a real threshold and keep it stable. Fabricated urgency destroys trust once noticed. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 让商品飞进购物车
items.de: The item flies into the cart
items.pz: 克隆商品图沿曲线飞向购物车图标 + 图标弹一下 + 数字变化；总时长不超过 500ms。
items.pe: Clone the thumbnail along an arc into the cart icon, bump the icon and change the count — under 500ms total.

items.dz: 从右边滑出，不用离开页面
items.de: Slides in from the right without leaving
items.pz: 加购后自动打开 3 秒再收起，或只弹提示；抽屉里要能改数量与删除，并显示运费门槛。
items.pe: Auto-open briefly or just toast. The drawer must allow quantity edits and show the free-shipping threshold.

items.dz: 再买 28 元就免运费
items.de: ¥28 more for free shipping
items.pz: 进度条 + 差额 + 推荐凑单商品；达成后要有明确的达成反馈而不是静默消失。
items.pe: A bar, the gap, and suggested add-ons — with a clear celebration when it is met, not a silent disappearance.

items.dz: 价格和按钮永远在手边
items.de: Price and button always at hand
items.pz: 滚过主图后出现，含缩略图、价格、规格摘要与主按钮；不要重复整个规格选择器。
items.pe: Appears past the hero with a thumbnail, price, variant summary and the button — not a duplicate picker.

items.dz: 现价、原价、单价、税
items.de: Now, was, per-unit, tax
items.pz: 现价最大，原价删除线且较小，折扣率单独标；单价（每 100g）对比购是刚需，含税与否要写明。
items.pe: Now price largest, was price struck and smaller, discount as its own tag. Unit price aids comparison; tax inclusion must be stated.

items.dz: 别拿虚构原价划线
items.de: Do not strike a price that never existed
items.pz: 原价要是真实成交过的价格，并标注参考期；多地法规已强制要求"30 天内最低价"。
items.pe: The was-price must be a real prior price with a stated window. Many jurisdictions now require the 30-day low.

items.dz: 星级分布比平均分有用
items.de: The distribution beats the average
items.pz: 给 1–5 星各自的条形分布、带图评价优先、按关键词聚合（"偏小 32 人提到"）。
items.pe: Show the per-star distribution, surface reviews with photos, and cluster by keyword.

items.dz: 半星要真的表示半星
items.de: A half star means a half
items.pz: 用渐变裁切显示小数星级并同时给数字（4.3）；只有一条评价时显示数量而不是星级。
items.pe: Clip the fill for fractional stars and always show the number too. With one review, show the count rather than the stars.

items.dz: 每个条件后面带数量
items.de: Every option carries its count
items.pz: 显示每个选项的结果数，选中项置顶并可一键清除；筛选后为空要给"清除"而不是空白。
items.pe: Show counts, pin the selected options, and offer a clear-all. An empty result needs an exit, not a blank.

items.dz: 默认排序要说清是什么
items.de: Name the default order
items.pz: "推荐排序"要能解释依据；价格排序要标明含不含运费。默认永远不该是"随机"。
items.pe: Explain what "recommended" means, and say whether price sorting includes shipping. Never default to random.

items.dz: 不离开列表就能看细节
items.de: Details without leaving the list
items.pz: 弹层里放图、规格、价格与加购，但不放完整详情；一定要给"查看完整详情"出口。
items.pe: The overlay carries images, variants, price and add-to-cart — never the full page. Always link out to it.

items.dz: 心跳一下，然后记住
items.de: It beats once, then remembers
items.pz: 未登录也要能收藏（本地存），登录后合并；图标要有明确的已收藏态而不是仅变色。
items.pe: Allow it before login with local storage and merge later. The saved state needs a shape change, not only colour.

items.dz: 并排看差异，相同的收起来
items.de: Side by side, with the identical rows folded
items.pz: 默认只显示有差异的行，提供"显示全部"；列头吸顶，最多同时比 4 项。
items.pe: Show only differing rows by default with a reveal-all. Sticky column headers, four items maximum.

items.dz: 地址、配送、支付、确认
items.de: Address, shipping, payment, review
items.pz: 步骤条显示进度且可回退；每步只问必要信息，总价与运费在每一步都可见。
items.pe: A reversible progress indicator, only essential fields per step, and the total visible throughout.

items.dz: 别在付款前逼人注册
items.de: Do not force an account before payment
items.pz: 先结算、付完再提供"一键创建账号"；强制注册是转化率最大的单点损失。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Let them pay, then offer one-tap account creation. A forced signup is the single largest conversion loss. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 打两个字就能选到
items.de: Two characters and it is found
items.pz: 接地址联想 API + 完整的 autocomplete 语义；手填要能纠正，不要因格式校验挡住真实地址。
items.pe: Wire an address lookup and the full autocomplete tokens. Keep manual entry editable and never block a real address on format.

items.dz: 四位一组，自动识别卡种
items.de: Grouped in fours, brand detected
items.pz: 自动分组、自动跳到有效期、卡种图标就地出现；不要禁止粘贴，也不要在失焦前报错。
items.pe: Auto-group, auto-advance, and show the brand inline. Never block paste, never validate before blur.

items.dz: 一键付掉，跳过所有表单
items.de: One tap, no forms at all
items.pz: Apple/Google Pay 按钮放在表单最上方而不是最下方；样式必须用官方按钮规范。
items.pe: Put the wallet button above the form, not below it, and use the official button styling.

items.dz: 把总价拆成月付
items.de: Split the total into monthly
items.pz: 同时显示总额与分期额，标明利率与总利息；只显示月付额是误导性定价。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Show both the total and the instalment with the rate and total interest. Monthly-only is deceptive pricing. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 折叠起来，别提醒所有人去找券
items.de: Fold it away — do not send everyone hunting
items.pz: 优惠码入口默认折叠；失败要说清原因（过期/不适用/最低门槛），成功要显示抵扣行。
items.pe: Collapse it by default. Failures name the reason; successes add a visible discount line.

items.dz: 每一笔钱都要能对上
items.de: Every line must reconcile
items.pz: 商品小计、运费、税、优惠、总计逐行列出；总计要加粗且与上方有分隔线。
items.pe: Itemise subtotal, shipping, tax, discounts and total, with the total ruled off and bold.

items.dz: 按下之后绝不能能再按一次
items.de: It must never be pressable twice
items.pz: 点击立刻禁用并转为加载态，按钮文案带金额（"支付 ¥128"）；失败后才恢复可点。
items.pe: Disable and switch to loading on the first press, label it with the amount, and only re-enable on failure.

items.dz: 几秒钟不能让人以为失败了
items.de: A few seconds must not read as failure
items.pz: 全屏遮罩 + 明确"正在处理，请不要关闭页面" + 超时后给查询入口；绝不允许重复提交。
items.pe: A blocking overlay saying do not close the page, plus a lookup path on timeout. Never allow a resubmit.

items.dz: 订单号、时间、下一步
items.de: Number, time, what happens next
items.pz: 订单号可复制、预计到货区间、跟踪入口与联系方式；这一页是客服工单量的主要变量。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: A copyable order number, a delivery window, a tracking link and support contact. This page decides your ticket volume. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 一条时间线，当前节点高亮
items.de: A timeline with the current node lit
items.pz: 节点写清"发生了什么"而不是内部状态码；预计时间变化要主动通知。
items.pe: Nodes describe what happened, not internal codes — and proactively notify when the estimate changes.

items.dz: 选商品、选原因、拿标签
items.de: Pick items, pick a reason, get a label
items.pz: 原因选项要能反哺商品页（"偏小"多就调尺码指引）；自助退货比客服退货便宜十倍。
items.pe: Feed the reasons back into the product page. Self-service returns cost a tenth of a support ticket.

items.dz: 三档，中间那档被推荐
items.de: Three tiers, the middle one recommended
items.pz: 推荐档要在视觉上升起（描边 + 徽标 + 略高），功能列表用"包含上一档全部"减少重复。
items.pe: Lift the recommended tier with a border, a badge and extra height, and say "everything in the previous tier".

items.dz: 切到年付要立刻看到省多少
items.de: Switching shows the saving at once
items.pz: 价格数字要滚动过渡而不是瞬变，并显示"省两个月"徽标；默认选年付要诚实标注。
items.pe: Roll the numbers rather than swapping them, and show the saving. If annual is preselected, label it plainly.

items.dz: 让人算得出这个月要花多少
items.de: They must be able to predict the bill
items.pz: 实时用量 + 已产生费用 + 预计月末费用 + 上限设置；超额规则必须在超额前就展示过。
items.pe: Live usage, cost so far, projected month-end and a cap. The overage rule must be shown before any overage.

items.dz: 推荐要真的相关
items.de: The recommendation must be relevant
items.pz: "经常一起买"用真实共购数据；加价购要在加购后而不是详情页打断决策。
items.pe: Base "bought together" on real co-purchase data, and place add-ons after the add-to-cart, not before the decision.

items.dz: 帮人找回刚看过的那个
items.de: Help them find the one they just saw
items.pz: 横滑轨放最近 8 件，可删除单项；这是转化率性价比最高的模块之一。
items.pe: A rail of the last eight with per-item removal. One of the highest-yield modules there is.

items.dz: 给你 10 分钟，别用假倒计时
items.de: Ten real minutes — no fake clocks
items.pz: 只在真的锁库存时显示倒计时；到期要真的释放并明确告知，而不是刷新后重新开始。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: Only show it when stock is truly held, and really release it — do not restart on refresh. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 结算时才冒出来的税最伤转化
items.de: A tax that appears at checkout kills conversion
items.pz: 在商品页就写明含税或另计与大致税率；跨境要标关税责任方。 当前画面是示例文案，括号中的操作不执行真实业务。
items.pe: State tax inclusion and the approximate rate on the product page, and name who pays duty on cross-border orders. This is sample copy; named actions do not perform real business operations.

items.dz: 退货政策比安全徽标有用
items.de: A return policy beats a security badge
items.pz: 把退货天数、发货地、客服响应时间写成文字放在按钮附近；泛泛的"安全支付"图标没人信。
items.pe: Put the return window, origin and support response near the button as words. Generic padlock badges convince nobody.

items.dz: 回来的时候东西还在
items.de: The cart is still there when they return
items.pz: 购物车跨设备持久化，回访时提示"你有 2 件未结算"；邮件挽回要带商品图与直达链接。
items.pe: Persist the cart across devices and greet returners with it. Recovery email carries the images and a direct link.

items.dz: 取消要和订阅一样容易
items.de: Cancelling is as easy as subscribing
items.pz: 一个页面看到下次扣费日、金额、暂停与取消；把取消藏进客服流程在多地已属违法。
items.pe: One page with the next charge date, amount, pause and cancel. Hiding cancellation behind support is illegal in several jurisdictions.

items.dz: 不显示价格、带贺卡、分开发货
items.de: Hide the price, add a note, ship separately
items.pz: 礼品模式要贯穿到发票与包裹（收件人看不到金额）；贺卡字数限制要在输入时提示。
items.pe: Gift mode must reach the invoice and the parcel, and the note needs a live character limit.

items.dz: 不是所有交易都能一键下单
items.de: Not every deal ends in a tap
items.pz: B2B 要有阶梯价、询价单、采购单号字段与账期支付；把它硬塞进 C 端结算流程一定会漏。
items.pe: B2B needs tiered pricing, a quote request, a PO number field and terms. Forcing it through a consumer checkout always breaks.

items.pz: 原站空值示例显示月、日、年占位，日期的各部分可独立编辑。片段顺序和显示格式按语言环境确定，时间精度也可配置；不能把分隔斜杠的普通文本掩码或日历弹层当作同一机制。 预览为原站静态截图；交互范围见原站示例。
items.pe: The empty source example shows month, day and year placeholders as editable parts. Locale determines their order and format, and time granularity is configurable. This differs from a plain masked string or a calendar popup. Preview: a static screenshot of the original example; follow the source link for interaction.

dz: 相机、材质、后处理——用 three.js 做出体积感的那一套
de: Cameras, materials, post-processing — the three.js toolkit for volume

items.dz: 相机自己慢慢绕着看
items.de: The camera slowly circles the subject
items.pz: OrbitControls + autoRotate=true，autoRotateSpeed 0.4~0.8，damping 打开。
items.pe: OrbitControls with autoRotate, speed 0.4–0.8, enableDamping on.

items.dz: 主体不变，背景被吸进来
items.de: Subject holds, background rushes in
items.pz: 同时改 camera.position.z 与 camera.fov，保持主体屏幕尺寸不变。
items.pe: Move camera.position.z and camera.fov together so the subject keeps its screen size.

items.dz: 边缘泛起一圈冷光
items.de: A cool halo rides the silhouette
items.pz: 在自定义 shader 里用 pow(1-dot(N,V), 3) 做边缘项，叠加到 emissive。
items.pe: pow(1.0 - dot(N,V), 3.0) as a rim term added to emissive.

items.dz: 一张贴图换来整块金属感
items.de: One texture, instant metal
items.pz: MeshMatcapMaterial + 一张 matcap 贴图，几乎零光照开销。
items.pe: MeshMatcapMaterial with a matcap texture — lighting for free.

items.dz: 从镜面滑到磨砂
items.de: From mirror to matte
items.pz: material.roughness 0→1 插值，配合 envMapIntensity 一起收。
items.pe: Lerp material.roughness 0→1 and pull envMapIntensity with it.

items.dz: 反射跟着环境慢慢转
items.de: Reflections drift with the environment
items.pz: 旋转 scene.environmentRotation（或环境贴图的 matrix），别转模型。
items.pe: Rotate scene.environmentRotation, not the mesh.

items.dz: 一团点重排成另一个形
items.de: A cloud of points re-forms
items.pz: 两套 position 属性做 GPU 插值，Points + shaderMaterial 里 mix()。
items.pe: Two position attributes mixed on the GPU inside a Points shader.

items.dz: 成千个方块像麦浪起伏
items.de: Thousands of tiles ripple like a field
items.pz: InstancedMesh + 每实例 matrix，y = sin(x*f + t)，一次 draw call。
items.pe: InstancedMesh, per-instance matrix, y = sin(x*f + t), one draw call.

items.dz: 表面被一张灰度图顶起来
items.de: A greyscale map pushes the surface out
items.pz: displacementMap + displacementScale，注意几何要足够细分。
items.pe: displacementMap plus enough geometry subdivisions to show it.

items.dz: 先给骨架再上皮
items.de: Skeleton first, skin after
items.pz: 先 wireframe 材质，再 crossfade 到实体材质（两个 mesh 叠加改 opacity）。
items.pe: Cross-fade a wireframe mesh into the solid one.

items.dz: 光在表面荡开
items.de: Light ripples across the skin
items.pz: 滚动 normalMap 的 offset，或用 shader 里的 sin 扰动法线。
items.pe: Scroll the normalMap offset, or perturb normals with sin in the shader.

items.dz: 亮的地方溢出光
items.de: Bright areas bleed light
items.pz: UnrealBloomPass，threshold 0.85 / strength 0.6，只让高光溢出。
items.pe: UnrealBloomPass at threshold 0.85, strength 0.6.

items.dz: 焦点从前景移到后景
items.de: Focus travels front to back
items.pz: BokehPass 改 focus 距离，aperture 别超过 0.0002。
items.pe: Animate BokehPass focus; keep aperture under 0.0002.

items.dz: 整幅画面亮度平移
items.de: The whole frame lifts
items.pz: renderer.toneMappingExposure 插值，配 ACESFilmic 才不会糊。
items.pe: Lerp renderer.toneMappingExposure with ACESFilmic tone mapping.

items.dz: 远处溶进雾里
items.de: Distance dissolves into fog
items.pz: scene.fog = FogExp2，密度 0.02~0.06，雾色要等于背景色。
items.pe: scene.fog = FogExp2, density 0.02–0.06, fog colour equal to background.

items.dz: 影子近处硬、远处散
items.de: Sharp near contact, soft far away
items.pz: PCFSoftShadowMap + shadow.radius，光源加 shadow.bias 防条纹。
items.pe: PCFSoftShadowMap with shadow.radius; add shadow.bias to kill banding.

items.dz: 撞击时镜头晃一下
items.de: Impact rattles the lens
items.pz: 给 camera 叠一层噪声偏移，200ms 内衰减到 0。
items.pe: Add a decaying noise offset to the camera over ~200ms.

items.dz: 物体一直盯着某处
items.de: The object keeps watching
items.pz: object.lookAt(target)，每帧 slerp 一点，别硬切。
items.pe: object.lookAt(target) with a per-frame slerp, never a snap.

items.dz: 鼠标扫到哪块就亮哪块
items.de: Whatever the ray hits lights up
items.pz: Raycaster.intersectObjects 拿到首个命中，改它的 emissive。
items.pe: Raycaster.intersectObjects, then raise emissive on the first hit.

items.dz: 标签永远面对镜头
items.de: Labels always face you
items.pz: Sprite 或每帧 quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion)。
items.pe: Use Sprite, or copy the camera quaternion each frame.

items.dz: 命中时闪一帧 ID 色
items.de: A one-frame ID colour flash
items.pz: 离屏 render target 里按 ID 涂色，读一像素得到对象。
items.pe: Render IDs to an offscreen target and read one pixel.

items.dz: 走远了自动换低模
items.de: Detail drops as it recedes
items.pz: THREE.LOD.addLevel(mesh, distance)，切换点要藏在运动中。
items.pe: THREE.LOD.addLevel(mesh, distance); hide the swap inside motion.

items.dz: 两个姿势之间平滑过渡
items.de: Two poses melt together
items.pz: AnimationMixer 里 crossFadeTo(action, 0.3, true)。
items.pe: AnimationMixer crossFadeTo(action, 0.3, true).

items.dz: 同一网格换脸
items.de: One mesh, many shapes
items.pz: geometry.morphAttributes + mesh.morphTargetInfluences 插值。
items.pe: Lerp mesh.morphTargetInfluences over morphAttributes.

items.dz: 字有厚度
items.de: Letters gain thickness
items.pz: TextGeometry + ExtrudeGeometry 的 bevel，字体走 typeface.json。
items.pe: TextGeometry with bevelled extrude; load a typeface.json font.

items.dz: 光沿着管道跑
items.de: Light runs the pipe
items.pz: TubeGeometry 沿 CatmullRomCurve3，滚动贴图 offset 造流动。
items.pe: TubeGeometry along a CatmullRomCurve3; scroll the texture offset.

items.dz: 车削出的形体慢转
items.de: A turned solid revolves
items.pz: LatheGeometry 由一条轮廓线旋成，配 side=DoubleSide。
items.pe: LatheGeometry from a profile curve, DoubleSide material.

items.dz: 几何自己就很好看
items.de: The geometry is the ornament
items.pz: TorusKnotGeometry(p=2,q=3) + 缓慢双轴旋转。
items.pe: TorusKnotGeometry(p=2, q=3) with a slow two-axis spin.

items.dz: 棱角一步步磨圆
items.de: Corners round off step by step
items.pz: LoopSubdivision 迭代 1–2 次就够，再多顶点数爆炸。
items.pe: One or two LoopSubdivision iterations is plenty.

items.dz: 贴纸贴在曲面上
items.de: A sticker wraps the surface
items.pz: DecalGeometry 从命中点投一小片几何，polygonOffset 防 z-fighting。
items.pe: DecalGeometry at the hit point; polygonOffset to avoid z-fighting.

items.dz: 球面上映出整个房间
items.de: The room shows up on the sphere
items.pz: CubeCamera 渲到 WebGLCubeRenderTarget，赋给 material.envMap。
items.pe: CubeCamera into a WebGLCubeRenderTarget, fed to material.envMap.

items.dz: 背后的东西被掰弯
items.de: Whatever is behind bends
items.pz: MeshPhysicalMaterial: transmission=1, ior=1.5, thickness>0。
items.pe: MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 1, ior 1.5, thickness > 0.

items.dz: 光从内部透出来
items.de: Light seeps from inside
items.pz: thickness + attenuationColor 模拟蜡/皮肤的透光。
items.pe: thickness plus attenuationColor for wax- or skin-like translucency.

items.dz: 角度一变颜色就变
items.de: Colour shifts with angle
items.pz: MeshPhysicalMaterial 的 iridescence + iridescenceThicknessRange。
items.pe: iridescence with iridescenceThicknessRange on MeshPhysicalMaterial.

items.dz: 拉丝金属那种长高光
items.de: The long highlight of brushed metal
items.pz: anisotropy + anisotropyRotation，高光沿切线方向拉长。
items.pe: anisotropy with anisotropyRotation stretches the highlight along the tangent.

items.dz: 车漆上那层亮膜
items.de: The lacquer layer on car paint
items.pz: clearcoat=1 + clearcoatRoughness 0.1，是独立于底层的第二层高光。
items.pe: clearcoat 1 with clearcoatRoughness 0.1 — a second specular layer.

items.dz: 像磨砂玻璃后的世界
items.de: Frosted-glass world behind
items.pz: transmission 配 roughness>0，需要 renderer 的 transmissionResolutionScale。
items.pe: transmission with roughness > 0; tune transmissionResolutionScale.

items.dz: 一群点绕着核心转
items.de: Points swarm a core
items.pz: Points + 每点自己的角速度，位置在 shader 里算，不要回 CPU。
items.pe: Points with per-point angular velocity computed in the shader.

items.dz: 运动留下一条带子
items.de: Motion leaves a ribbon
items.pz: 把历史位置写进 BufferGeometry 环形缓冲，做 MeshLine。
items.pe: Push history positions into a ring buffer and draw a MeshLine.

items.dz: 几十万点跟着看不见的风走
items.de: Hundreds of thousands of points ride invisible wind
items.pz: 位置存进 FloatTexture，用 ping-pong FBO 每帧积分速度。
items.pe: Store positions in a float texture; integrate velocity with ping-pong FBOs.

items.dz: 烟一样打卷上升
items.de: Smoke curls upward
items.pz: curl(noise) 保证无散度，粒子才不会挤成一团。
items.pe: Curl of a noise field is divergence-free — particles stop clumping.

items.dz: 分离、对齐、聚集
items.de: Separate, align, cohere
items.pz: 三条规则加权求和，邻域用空间哈希，不然 O(n²)。
items.pe: Weighted sum of three rules; use a spatial hash for neighbours.

items.dz: 网格被拉扯后回弹
items.de: A pulled mesh springs back
items.pz: 相邻顶点连弹簧（Verlet 积分），刚度别超 0.3 会炸。
items.pe: Verlet springs between neighbours; keep stiffness under 0.3.

items.dz: 落地后整块肉都在颤
items.de: The whole body quivers on landing
items.pz: 质点-弹簧网格 + 体积约束，或直接用 Rapier 的 softbody。
items.pe: Mass-spring mesh with a volume constraint, or Rapier softbodies.

items.dz: 一层层推过来的浪
items.de: Wave trains rolling in
items.pz: 叠 3–5 个 Gerstner 波（不同频率与方向），别用单一 sin。
items.pe: Sum 3–5 Gerstner waves at different frequencies and headings.

items.dz: 山脊从平面里长出来
items.de: Ridges rise out of the plane
items.pz: PlaneGeometry 顶点按 fBm 噪声抬高，颜色按高度分层。
items.pe: Raise PlaneGeometry vertices by fBm noise; colour by altitude.

items.dz: 厚厚一团有内部的云
items.de: Cloud with an inside
items.pz: 光线步进 3D 噪声，步数 48 起、抖动采样点去带状。
items.pe: Ray-march 3D noise, 48+ steps, jitter samples to hide banding.

items.dz: 光从缝隙里射出来
items.de: Shafts push through the gap
items.pz: 径向模糊亮度掩膜（GodraysPass），或直接画锥形半透几何。
items.pe: Radial-blur a luminance mask, or draw translucent cones.

items.dz: 缝隙处自然变暗
items.de: Crevices darken on their own
items.pz: SSAOPass 半径 0.1–0.3 场景尺度，强度别拉满。
items.pe: SSAOPass with a radius of 0.1–0.3 scene units, modest intensity.

items.dz: 选中物体镶一道边
items.de: The selection gets an edge
items.pz: OutlinePass 或 inverted-hull：放大一份背面材质当轮廓。
items.pe: OutlinePass, or an inverted-hull backface shell.

items.dz: 整幅画降成大像素
items.de: The frame drops to fat pixels
items.pz: RenderPixelatedPass，pixelSize 4–8，配合 normalEdge 更像素风。
items.pe: RenderPixelatedPass, pixelSize 4–8, with normalEdge strength.

items.dz: 印刷网点质感
items.de: Print-screen dots
items.pz: HalftonePass，或 shader 里按亮度决定圆点半径。
items.pe: HalftonePass, or size dots by luminance in a shader.

items.dz: 一层活的噪点
items.de: A living layer of grain
items.pz: FilmPass 或每帧偏移一张噪声图，强度 3–6%。
items.pe: FilmPass, or offset a noise texture each frame at 3–6% strength.

items.dz: 动作留下一串残影
items.de: Motion smears behind
items.pz: AfterimagePass damp 0.9，或每帧对上一帧 render target 做衰减混合。
items.pe: AfterimagePass with damp 0.9, blending the previous frame.

items.dz: 偶发的数字撕裂
items.de: Occasional digital tearing
items.pz: GlitchPass goWild=false，让它 2–4 秒才发作一次。
items.pe: GlitchPass with goWild off — fire every 2–4 seconds.

items.dz: 边缘泛红蓝
items.de: Red and blue creep at the edges
items.pz: 按到中心距离偏移 RGB 采样点，强度随半径平方增长。
items.pe: Offset RGB samples by radial distance squared.

items.dz: 四角自然压暗
items.de: The corners fall away
items.pz: 径向 mask 乘到最终颜色，别用一张 PNG 盖上去。
items.pe: Multiply a radial mask into the final colour, not an overlay PNG.

items.dz: 快的东西被拉长
items.de: Fast things stretch
items.pz: 按速度矢量做方向性模糊（速度缓冲），别全屏乱糊。
items.pe: Directional blur driven by a velocity buffer.

items.dz: 静止两帧后画面变干净
items.de: Hold still and it sharpens
items.pz: 相机不动时累积抖动采样，动起来立刻丢弃历史。
items.pe: Accumulate jittered samples while static; discard history on motion.

items.dz: 门里是另一个空间
items.de: Another space inside the frame
items.pz: stencil buffer 限制第二个场景只在门的区域渲染。
items.pe: Use the stencil buffer so scene B only draws inside the portal.

items.dz: 一屏两个相机
items.de: Two cameras, one canvas
items.pz: renderer.setScissorTest(true) + setViewport 分两次渲染。
items.pe: setScissorTest(true) and render twice with different viewports.

items.dz: 画面吃自己，越套越深
items.de: The frame eats itself
items.pz: 把上一帧的 render target 当贴图再画进场景，缩放 0.98。
items.pe: Feed the previous render target back in at 0.98 scale.

items.dz: 一张大图里换格子
items.de: Cells cycle inside one sheet
items.pz: texture.offset / repeat 定位到 atlas 的某一格。
items.pe: Point texture.offset and repeat at one atlas cell.

items.dz: 模型表面在播片
items.de: The mesh is playing footage
items.pz: VideoTexture 需要 muted+playsinline，别忘 needsUpdate。
items.pe: VideoTexture needs muted and playsinline; keep needsUpdate on.

items.dz: 三维表面上有字在打
items.de: Type appears on a 3D surface
items.pz: 用 2D canvas 画字再当 CanvasTexture，改字后置 needsUpdate。
items.pe: Draw text into a 2D canvas as a CanvasTexture; flag needsUpdate.

items.dz: 不用贴图也有花纹
items.de: Pattern without a texture
items.pz: shader 里 mod(floor(uv*n),2) 生成，永不失真。
items.pe: mod(floor(uv * n), 2.0) in the shader — resolution-independent.

items.dz: 任意形体都不拉伸贴图
items.de: No stretching on any shape
items.pz: 按法线权重混合 XY / YZ / XZ 三次采样。
items.pe: Blend XY / YZ / XZ samples weighted by the normal.

items.dz: 纹理自己往前走
items.de: The texture keeps walking
items.pz: texture.wrapS=RepeatWrapping，每帧加 offset.x。
items.pe: RepeatWrapping plus a per-frame offset.x increment.

items.dz: 半透明用噪点点开
items.de: Transparency by dither
items.pz: material.alphaHash=true，避免排序问题的伪透明。
items.pe: material.alphaHash avoids transparency sorting entirely.

items.dz: 一格一格播出动画
items.de: Frame-by-frame from one sheet
items.pz: steps() 或每帧改 texture.offset，帧率控制在 12fps 才有手感。
items.pe: Use steps() timing or offset per frame; 12fps reads best.

items.dz: 只留影子不留地板
items.de: Shadow without the floor
items.pz: ShadowMaterial + transparent 地面，合成到真实背景上。
items.pe: A ShadowMaterial plane composites shadow onto any background.

items.dz: 近处影子清楚，远处也不糊
items.de: Crisp near, still correct far
items.pz: 按相机距离分 3–4 级 shadow map（CSM），各级分辨率不同。
items.pe: Split the frustum into 3–4 cascades with separate shadow maps.

items.dz: 物体被环境的颜色染上
items.de: The room tints the object
items.pz: LightProbe / 球谐系数存环境光，成本远低于实时反射。
items.pe: Spherical-harmonic light probes cost far less than real-time reflection.

items.dz: 模型到齐前先给个交代
items.de: Tell them before the model lands
items.pz: LoadingManager.onProgress 驱动进度条，DRACO/KTX2 先压缩。
items.pe: Drive a bar from LoadingManager.onProgress; compress with DRACO/KTX2.

items.dz: 看不见的就不画
items.de: Offscreen means unrendered
items.pz: frustumCulled 默认开；大场景再加 BVH 或 octree 粗剔。
items.pe: frustumCulled is on by default; add a BVH for big scenes.

items.dz: 手靠近时目标发亮
items.de: Targets glow as the hand nears
items.pz: WebXR hand input 的关节位置算距离，距离映射到 emissive。
items.pe: Map WebXR joint distance to emissive intensity.

dz: GLSL 里那几十个反复用的小函数，就是全部的画面语言
de: A few dozen GLSL primitives account for most of what you see

items.dz: 边缘可以任意软硬
items.de: Edges as soft or hard as you like
items.pz: length(uv-.5)-r 得到距离，再 smoothstep 控制边缘宽度。
items.pe: length(uv - .5) - r, then smoothstep for edge width.

items.dz: 任意圆角都无锯齿
items.de: Any radius, no jaggies
items.pz: max(abs(p)-b,0) 的长度减 r，是 UI 圆角的通解。
items.pe: length(max(abs(p) - b, 0.0)) - r — the general rounded-rect.

items.dz: 两个形状黏成一个
items.de: Two shapes melt into one
items.pz: smin(a,b,k) 平滑并集，k 越大越黏。
items.pe: smin(a, b, k) — larger k, gooier blend.

items.dz: 没有几何也能有体积
items.de: Volume without geometry
items.pz: 沿视线累加 SDF 距离，命中即着色；步数 64 上限。
items.pe: March the SDF along the view ray, shade on hit, cap at 64 steps.

items.dz: 自然界的粗糙感
items.de: Nature-grade roughness
items.pz: 5–6 个 octave 的 noise 叠加，振幅每层 ×0.5、频率 ×2。
items.pe: Sum 5–6 octaves, amplitude ×0.5 and frequency ×2 each.

items.dz: 细胞状的分区
items.de: Cellular partitioning
items.pz: 按到最近特征点的距离着色，第二近距离给边界。
items.pe: Shade by nearest feature-point distance; use the second for borders.

items.dz: 噪声再喂给噪声
items.de: Noise fed back into noise
items.pz: noise(p + noise(p)*k)，一层就够，两层开始糊。
items.pe: noise(p + noise(p) * k) — one level is usually enough.

items.dz: 纹理沿指定方向淌
items.de: Texture flows where you point it
items.pz: 用一张 RG 贴图当方向，两次相位错开采样再混合。
items.pe: RG texture as direction; sample twice at offset phases and blend.

items.dz: 按噪声阈值一点点消失
items.de: It vanishes by noise threshold
items.pz: discard 或 alpha 用 step(noise, t)，t 从 0 走到 1。
items.pe: step(noise, t) into alpha or discard, t sweeping 0→1.

items.dz: 轮廓自己带一层光
items.de: The silhouette carries light
items.pz: 用 SDF 的绝对值窄带做发光带：exp(-abs(d)*k)。
items.pe: exp(-abs(d) * k) over the SDF gives a glow band.

items.dz: 一道线扫过整块屏
items.de: A line sweeps the panel
items.pz: fract(uv.y*n - t) 做重复线，再叠一条快速扫描。
items.pe: fract(uv.y * n - t) for the lines, plus one fast sweeper.

items.dz: 老显示器的桶形失真
items.de: Old-monitor barrel distortion
items.pz: uv = uv + uv*(len²)*k 做桶形，再叠暗角与扫描线。
items.pe: Barrel-distort the uv by length², then add vignette and scanlines.

items.dz: 重复对称的图案
items.de: Mirrored, repeating symmetry
items.pz: 极坐标下 mod(angle, TAU/n) 再取绝对值就得到镜像扇区。
items.pe: In polar space, mod the angle by TAU/n and mirror it.

items.dz: 直的变成绕的
items.de: Straight becomes circular
items.pz: vec2(length(p), atan(p.y,p.x)) 换到极坐标再采样。
items.pe: Sample in vec2(length(p), atan(p.y, p.x)) space.

items.dz: 中心被拧了一圈
items.de: The centre gets a twist
items.pz: 旋转角度随半径衰减：angle += (1-r)*strength。
items.pe: angle += (1 - r) * strength, so the twist fades outward.

items.dz: 一圈圈扩出去
items.de: Rings push outward
items.pz: sin(length(p)*f - t) 当高度扰动 uv，振幅随半径衰减。
items.pe: sin(length(p) * f - t) offsets the uv, amplitude falling with radius.

items.dz: 池底那些游动的光网
items.de: The dancing net on the pool floor
items.pz: 两层 domain-warp 噪声取 pow(x,6) 得到亮线。
items.pe: Two warped noise layers, pow(x, 6.0) to isolate the bright lines.

items.dz: 一个 dot 就有立体感
items.de: One dot product buys depth
items.pz: dot(normal, lightDir) 直接当亮度，环境项给 0.2 保底。
items.pe: dot(N, L) as brightness with a 0.2 ambient floor.

items.dz: 高光越小越贵气
items.de: Smaller highlight, richer surface
items.pz: pow(dot(N,H), shininess)，shininess 从 8 提到 128。
items.pe: pow(dot(N, H), shininess) — push shininess 8 → 128.

items.dz: 亮度只有三档
items.de: Light quantised to three steps
items.pz: floor(NdotL*steps)/steps，边缘再加一道描边。
items.pe: floor(NdotL * steps) / steps, plus an outline pass.

items.dz: 按明暗换线密度
items.de: Line density follows value
items.pz: 按亮度选不同密度的斜线图层（TAM），别用单张贴图。
items.pe: Pick from tonal art maps by luminance rather than one texture.

items.dz: 两色也能表现渐变
items.de: Two colours, still a gradient
items.pz: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值，比随机噪点更干净。
items.pe: A 4×4 Bayer threshold beats random noise.

items.dz: 颜色被砍成几档
items.de: Colour chopped into bands
items.pz: floor(c*n)/n，n=4 是海报感的甜点。
items.pe: floor(c * n) / n — n = 4 is the poster sweet spot.

items.dz: 灰度换成一条色带
items.de: Greyscale remapped to a ramp
items.pz: 亮度当 u 去查一张 1D 渐变贴图，一键换配色。
items.pe: Use luminance as u into a 1D ramp texture.

items.dz: RGB 三通道错开
items.de: RGB channels drift apart
items.pz: 三次采样各偏移几像素，偏移量随半径增长。
items.pe: Three samples at radius-scaled offsets.

items.dz: 大半径也不掉帧
items.de: Big radius, still cheap
items.pz: 横竖分两遍，半径 r 的代价从 r² 降到 2r。
items.pe: Separate horizontal and vertical passes: 2r instead of r².

items.dz: 虚化成六边形光斑
items.de: Out-of-focus points bloom hexagonal
items.pz: 按光圈形状采样（六边形核），高光要先做 pre-multiply。
items.pe: Sample with a hexagonal aperture kernel; pre-multiply highlights.

items.dz: 从中心炸开的速度感
items.de: Speed exploding from centre
items.pz: 沿 uv-center 方向多次采样并递减权重。
items.pe: Sample along (uv - centre) with falling weights.

items.dz: 只留下轮廓线
items.de: Only the contours survive
items.pz: 3×3 卷积求梯度幅值，阈值前先转灰度。
items.pe: 3×3 gradient magnitude on the luminance channel.

items.dz: 细节被提出来
items.de: Detail gets pulled forward
items.pz: 原图 + (原图-模糊)*k，k 别超过 0.6。
items.pe: original + (original − blur) * k, k under 0.6.

items.dz: 只让亮的部分参与
items.de: Only the bright part plays
items.pz: smoothstep(t-δ, t+δ, luma) 当 mask，比 step 少锯齿。
items.pe: smoothstep(t−δ, t+δ, luma) as the mask.

items.dz: 整块面料在飘
items.de: The cloth is breathing
items.pz: 顶点着色器里 position.z += sin(x*f + t)，法线要一起改。
items.pe: position.z += sin(x * f + t) in the vertex shader; fix the normals too.

items.dz: 模型沿法线炸散
items.de: The mesh bursts along its normals
items.pz: position += normal * t，t 用 easeOutQuint 收尾。
items.pe: position += normal * t with an ease-out-quint tail.

items.dz: 面片像纸一样折起来
items.de: Faces fold like paper
items.pz: 按 uv.y 分段旋转顶点，铰链要对齐面片边界。
items.pe: Rotate vertices per uv.y band with hinges on face edges.

items.dz: 纹理钉在屏幕上不跟物体走
items.de: Texture pinned to the screen
items.pz: 用 gl_FragCoord/resolution 当 uv，物体动纹理不动。
items.pe: uv = gl_FragCoord / resolution — the object moves, the texture stays.

items.dz: 交界处不再有硬边
items.de: No hard seam where things meet
items.pz: 读深度缓冲算差值，差越小 alpha 越低（soft particles）。
items.pe: Sample the depth buffer; fade alpha as the difference shrinks.

items.dz: 平面看起来真的有深度
items.de: A flat plane gains real depth
items.pz: 沿视线在高度图里步进找交点，比 normal map 更立体。
items.pe: March the view ray through the height map for a real intersection.

items.dz: 一张球图搞定所有光照
items.de: One sphere image is the whole lighting rig
items.pz: 把 view-space 法线的 xy 当 uv 去查那张球形贴图。
items.pe: Use the view-space normal xy as uv into the sphere image.

items.dz: 不规则形体贴图不接缝
items.de: No seams on irregular shapes
items.pz: 三次采样按 pow(abs(normal), 4) 归一化混合。
items.pe: Blend three samples weighted by pow(abs(N), 4.0), normalised.

items.dz: 来回但不突变
items.de: Back and forth, never a jump
items.pz: abs(fract(t)*2-1) 得到无缝往复，比 sin 更省。
items.pe: abs(fract(t) * 2 - 1) gives a seamless ping-pong.

items.dz: 硬边变成可控软边
items.de: A controllable soft edge
items.pz: smoothstep(a,b,x) 是抗锯齿的最小成本方案。
items.pe: smoothstep(a, b, x) is the cheapest antialiasing you get.

items.dz: 整体换色但不脏
items.de: Recolour without mud
items.pz: 转 HSV 只改 H，S/V 留着；别在 RGB 里乱乘。
items.pe: Convert to HSV and only touch H — never scale RGB directly.

items.dz: 中间色不再发灰
items.de: No grey dead zone in the middle
items.pz: 在 OKLab / oklch 里插值，感知均匀。
items.pe: Interpolate in OKLab / oklch for perceptual evenness.

items.dz: 大面积渐变不再有环
items.de: No rings in a big gradient
items.pz: 输出前加 ±0.5/255 的三角噪声，肉眼看不见但环消失。
items.pe: Add ±0.5/255 triangular noise before output.

items.dz: 半透明边缘不发黑
items.de: No black fringe on soft edges
items.pz: 混合前先乘 alpha，OneMinusSrcAlpha 才对。
items.pe: Multiply by alpha before blending with OneMinusSrcAlpha.

items.dz: 光叠光只会更亮
items.de: Light on light only brightens
items.pz: blending=AdditiveBlending 且 depthWrite=false。
items.pe: AdditiveBlending with depthWrite off.

items.dz: 影子不再有条纹
items.de: No more shadow acne
items.pz: normalBias 优于 constant bias；再不行调 shadow camera 近远面。
items.pe: Prefer normalBias; then tighten the shadow camera near/far.

items.dz: 远处纹理不再闪
items.de: Distant texture stops shimmering
items.pz: 开 anisotropy + 适度 mip bias，比降分辨率好。
items.pe: Anisotropic filtering plus a mild mip bias.

items.dz: 字放大也不糊
items.de: Type stays crisp at any size
items.pz: MSDF 字体贴图 + median 三通道，缩放不失真。
items.pe: MSDF atlas with a three-channel median — scale-free crispness.

items.dz: 不用贴图也能上色
items.de: Colour without a texture
items.pz: geometry 的 color attribute + material.vertexColors=true。
items.pe: A color attribute plus material.vertexColors.

items.dz: 像水银一样黏在一起
items.de: Mercury-like coalescing
items.pz: blur + 高 contrast 的滤镜组合，或 shader 里 smin。
items.pe: Blur then crank contrast — or smin in a shader.

items.dz: 一瞬间的分叉亮线
items.de: A branching flash
items.pz: 递归中点位移画折线，配 3 帧内的亮度爆闪。
items.pe: Midpoint-displacement polyline with a 3-frame flash.

items.dz: 底部亮、顶部撕碎
items.de: Bright base, torn tip
items.pz: 向上滚动的噪声乘一条纵向衰减，颜色走黑体色带。
items.pe: Upward-scrolling noise times a vertical falloff, blackbody ramp.

items.dz: 越升越散
items.de: It spreads as it rises
items.pz: 噪声 + 上升偏移，透明度随高度平方衰减。
items.pe: Noise plus rising offset; alpha falls with height squared.

items.dz: 穿过星星往前飞
items.de: Flying through stars
items.pz: 星点 z 递减，屏幕位置 = xy/z，越近越快越大。
items.pe: Decrement z; project xy / z so near stars move fastest.

items.dz: 半透明加横条抖动
items.de: Translucent with a scan jitter
items.pz: 菲涅尔 + 横条 mask + 轻微 y 抖动，别加彩虹色。
items.pe: Fresnel plus a stripe mask and a light y jitter — skip the rainbow.

items.dz: 溶解边缘带着火线
items.de: The dissolve edge burns
items.pz: 同一噪声阈值取两个 step 之差，中间那条带上暖色。
items.pe: Two thresholds on one noise field; tint the band between them.

items.dz: 用背面撑出一圈黑边
items.de: Backfaces make the ink line
items.pz: 复制一份放大、只画背面、颜色纯黑，成本极低。
items.pe: A scaled backface-only copy in black — nearly free.

items.dz: 手绘线像在呼吸
items.de: Hand-drawn lines breathe
items.pz: 每 3 帧换一张排线图（shake-shake 手法），别逐帧。
items.pe: Swap hatch textures every third frame, not every frame.

items.dz: 一眼看出拉伸
items.de: Stretching becomes obvious
items.pz: 开发期贴 UV 棋盘图，格子变形就是 UV 有问题。
items.pe: Ship a UV checker during dev — deformed squares mean bad UVs.

dz: 时间线、缓动库、ScrollTrigger——工业级动效的默认工具
de: Timelines, eases and ScrollTrigger — the industry default

items.dz: 一串元素依次进场
items.de: Elements arrive one after another
items.pz: tl.from(items,{y:24,opacity:0,stagger:.06,ease:"power3.out"})
items.pe: tl.from(items, { y: 24, opacity: 0, stagger: 0.06, ease: "power3.out" })

items.dz: 从中间往两边扩散
items.de: It spreads from the middle out
items.pz: stagger:{from:"center",each:.05}
items.pe: stagger: { from: "center", each: 0.05 }

items.dz: 像一道斜波扫过网格
items.de: A diagonal wave crosses the grid
items.pz: stagger:{grid:[3,3],from:"start",axis:null,each:.05}
items.pe: stagger: { grid: [3,3], from: "start", each: 0.05 }

items.dz: 起手极快、尾巴极长
items.de: Fast attack, long tail
items.pz: ease:"power4.out"，UI 进场的默认选择。
items.pe: ease: "power4.out" — the default for UI entrances.

items.dz: 比 power4 还要更急一点
items.de: Even snappier than power4
items.pz: ease:"expo.out"，适合"弹出即到位"的面板。
items.pe: ease: "expo.out" — for panels that must feel instant.

items.dz: 过一点头再回来
items.de: A small overshoot, then home
items.pz: ease:"back.out(1.7)"，1.7 是甜点值。
items.pe: ease: "back.out(1.7)" — 1.7 is the sweet spot.

items.dz: 弹两下才停
items.de: It rings before settling
items.pz: ease:"elastic.out(1,.35)"，第二参数越小弹得越久。
items.pe: ease: "elastic.out(1, 0.35)" — smaller means longer ring.

items.dz: 落地弹几下
items.de: It bounces on landing
items.pz: ease:"bounce.out"，只用在有重量的物体上。
items.pe: ease: "bounce.out" — only for things with weight.

items.dz: 两头都很稳
items.de: Calm at both ends
items.pz: ease:"circ.inOut"，适合大位移的镜头式移动。
items.pe: ease: "circ.inOut" for long, camera-like moves.

items.dz: 一格一格跳
items.de: It jumps cell by cell
items.pz: ease:"steps(8)"，做序列帧或计数器。
items.pe: ease: "steps(8)" for sprite frames and counters.

items.dz: 左右摇几下，幅度递减
items.de: A few decaying shakes
items.pz: CustomWiggle.create("w",{wiggles:6,type:"easeOut"})
items.pe: CustomWiggle.create("w", { wiggles: 6, type: "easeOut" })

items.dz: 弹跳还带压扁
items.de: Bounce with squash baked in
items.pz: CustomBounce.create("b",{strength:.6,squash:2})
items.pe: CustomBounce.create("b", { strength: 0.6, squash: 2 })

items.dz: 一条 tween 走多个路点
items.de: One tween, many waypoints
items.pz: gsap.to(el,{keyframes:[{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}]})
items.pe: gsap.to(el, { keyframes: [{x:100},{y:60},{x:0,y:0}] })

items.dz: 来回播放同一段
items.de: The same beat, back and forth
items.pz: repeat:-1, yoyo:true, repeatDelay:.2
items.pe: repeat: -1, yoyo: true, repeatDelay: 0.2

items.dz: 整段动效突然加速
items.de: The whole sequence speeds up
items.pz: gsap.to(tl,{timeScale:2.5,duration:.6})，改的是时间线本身。
items.pe: gsap.to(tl, { timeScale: 2.5 }) — you tween the timeline itself.

items.dz: 跟手但有阻尼
items.de: It follows your hand, with damping
items.pz: const x=gsap.quickTo(el,"x",{duration:.4,ease:"power3"})
items.pe: gsap.quickTo(el, "x", { duration: 0.4, ease: "power3" })

items.dz: 换布局但元素连续运动
items.de: Layout changes, motion stays continuous
items.pz: const s=Flip.getState(els); 改 DOM; Flip.from(s,{duration:.6})
items.pe: Flip.getState(els) → mutate DOM → Flip.from(state, { duration: 0.6 })

items.dz: 重排时每张卡都自己滑过去
items.de: Every card slides to its new slot
items.pz: Flip.from(state,{absolute:true,stagger:.03,ease:"power2.inOut"})
items.pe: Flip.from(state, { absolute: true, stagger: 0.03 })

items.dz: 缩略图长成大图
items.de: The thumbnail becomes the hero
items.pz: Flip.fit(target,source,{scale:true}) 或 Flip.from 带 targets 匹配。
items.pe: Flip.fit(target, source, { scale: true }).

items.dz: 沿一条曲线走
items.de: It travels a curve
items.pz: motionPath:{path:"#curve",align:"#curve",autoRotate:true}
items.pe: motionPath: { path: "#curve", align: "#curve", autoRotate: true }

items.dz: 车头始终朝着路的方向
items.de: The nose always points down the road
items.pz: autoRotate:true 会自动补角度，比手算切线可靠。
items.pe: autoRotate handles the tangent for you.

items.dz: 线条自己画出来
items.de: The line draws itself
items.pz: gsap.from(path,{drawSVG:0,duration:1.2,ease:"power2.inOut"})
items.pe: gsap.from(path, { drawSVG: 0, duration: 1.2 })

items.dz: 一个图形融成另一个
items.de: One shape becomes another
items.pz: gsap.to("#a",{morphSVG:{shape:"#b",shapeIndex:2}})
items.pe: gsap.to("#a", { morphSVG: { shape: "#b", shapeIndex: 2 } })

items.dz: 一个字一个字浮上来
items.de: Letters float up one by one
items.pz: new SplitText(h1,{type:"chars"}) 后对 chars 做 stagger。
items.pe: new SplitText(h1, { type: "chars" }) then stagger the chars.

items.dz: 整行从下方升起
items.de: Whole lines rise from behind a mask
items.pz: type:"lines", linesClass 加 overflow:hidden 的父层。
items.pe: Split into lines, wrap each in an overflow-hidden parent.

items.dz: 按词进场更好读
items.de: Word-level entry reads better
items.pz: type:"words"，长句用词而不是字，别把可读性做没了。
items.pe: Words, not chars, for long copy.

items.dz: 乱码里长出正文
items.de: Text resolves out of noise
items.pz: scrambleText:{text:"...",chars:"upperCase",speed:.4}
items.pe: scrambleText: { text: "…", chars: "upperCase", speed: 0.4 }

items.dz: 一个字一个字打出来
items.de: Typed out, character by character
items.pz: gsap.to(el,{text:{value:"…",delimiter:""},ease:"none"})
items.pe: gsap.to(el, { text: { value: "…" }, ease: "none" })

items.dz: 滚多少动多少
items.de: Scroll position drives the frame
items.pz: scrollTrigger:{scrub:1} —— 1 秒的追赶感最舒服。
items.pe: scrollTrigger: { scrub: 1 } — a one-second catch-up feels best.

items.dz: 钉住一屏讲完再放开
items.de: The panel holds while the story plays
items.pz: pin:true, end:"+=100%"，pinSpacing 记得留。
items.pe: pin: true, end: "+=100%", keep pinSpacing.

items.dz: 松手就吸到最近一屏
items.de: It settles onto the nearest section
items.pz: snap:{snapTo:1/(n-1),duration:.4,ease:"power1.inOut"}
items.pe: snap: { snapTo: 1 / (n - 1), duration: 0.4 }

items.dz: 滚得越快越歪
items.de: Faster scroll, more skew
items.pz: ScrollTrigger.getVelocity() 映射到 skewY，回弹用 quickTo。
items.pe: Map ScrollTrigger.getVelocity() to skewY and ease it back.

items.dz: 一批一起进场，不是一个个
items.de: Cards enter in batches
items.pz: ScrollTrigger.batch(".card",{onEnter:b=>gsap.from(b,{stagger:.08})})
items.pe: ScrollTrigger.batch with onEnter and a stagger.

items.dz: 纵滚变成横走
items.de: Vertical scroll moves you sideways
items.pz: x:-100*(n-1)+"vw" + pin + scrub 的经典组合。
items.pe: Pin the wrapper and tween x by -100vw per section.

items.dz: 远近层速度不同
items.de: Layers move at different rates
items.pz: 每层 yPercent 不同（-10/-25/-45）+ scrub。
items.pe: Different yPercent per layer with scrub.

items.dz: 环随进度收口
items.de: The ring closes with progress
items.pz: onUpdate:self=>gsap.set(circle,{strokeDashoffset:...})
items.pe: onUpdate: self => set strokeDashoffset from self.progress.

items.dz: 滚动像在拉片
items.de: Scroll acts as a shuttle
items.pz: 把帧序号 tween 成整数：{frame:n,snap:"frame",onUpdate:draw}
items.pe: Tween a frame index with snap: "frame" and redraw on update.

items.dz: 抛出去还会滑一段
items.de: Throw it and it keeps going
items.pz: Draggable.create(el,{inertia:true,bounds:parent})
items.pe: Draggable.create(el, { inertia: true, bounds: parent })

items.dz: 松手对齐到格子
items.de: It clicks onto the grid
items.pz: snap:{x:v=>Math.round(v/80)*80}
items.pe: snap: { x: v => Math.round(v / 80) * 80 }

items.dz: 拖过头会被拉回来
items.de: Overshoot gets pulled back
items.pz: edgeResistance:.65，越界位移乘阻尼。
items.pe: edgeResistance 0.65 damps the out-of-bounds delta.

items.dz: 抛出去自由落体
items.de: Thrown, then gravity takes it
items.pz: physics2D:{velocity:600,angle:-60,gravity:1400}
items.pe: physics2D: { velocity: 600, angle: -60, gravity: 1400 }

items.dz: 滚轮、触摸、拖拽一套接口
items.de: Wheel, touch and drag, one API
items.pz: Observer.create({type:"wheel,touch",onUp,onDown,tolerance:10})
items.pe: Observer.create({ type: "wheel,touch", onUp, onDown })

items.dz: 看不出接缝的循环
items.de: A loop with no visible seam
items.pz: 用 modifiers 把 x 取模；或 helper function 做 wrap。
items.pe: Wrap x with gsap.utils.wrap inside modifiers.

items.dz: 每次循环换一组随机值
items.de: New random values each loop
items.pz: repeat:-1, repeatRefresh:true, x:"random(-40,40)"
items.pe: repeat: -1, repeatRefresh: true, x: "random(-40, 40)"

items.dz: 任意两值之间取中间态
items.de: Blend any two values
items.pz: gsap.utils.interpolate(a,b)(p) 支持对象与颜色。
items.pe: gsap.utils.interpolate(a, b)(p) works on objects and colours.

items.dz: 值只落在允许的档位
items.de: Values land only on allowed steps
items.pz: gsap.utils.snap(0.25, v) 或 snap([...])。
items.pe: gsap.utils.snap(0.25, v), or snap to an array.

items.dz: 一个区间映到另一个
items.de: One range mapped onto another
items.pz: gsap.utils.mapRange(0,1,-20,20)(p)，常配 clamp。
items.pe: gsap.utils.mapRange(0, 1, -20, 20)(p), usually clamped.

items.dz: 按名字跳到某一段
items.de: Jump to a named beat
items.pz: tl.addLabel("open") 后 tl.tweenTo("open")。
items.pe: tl.addLabel("open") then tl.tweenTo("open").

items.dz: 把小段拼成大段
items.de: Compose beats into a sequence
items.pz: master.add(sectionTl(),"+=.2")，每段自己可复用。
items.pe: master.add(sectionTl(), "+=0.2") — each beat stays reusable.

items.dz: 动效跑到某点触发副作用
items.de: Side effects at a point in time
items.pz: onStart / onUpdate / onComplete，别在 onUpdate 里读布局。
items.pe: onStart / onUpdate / onComplete — never read layout in onUpdate.

items.dz: 动画前加、结束后撤
items.de: Add before, remove after
items.pz: gsap 会自动加 will-change；手写时 onComplete 里清掉。
items.pe: GSAP manages will-change; clear it in onComplete when hand-rolling.

items.dz: 按钮往指针方向偏一点
items.de: The button leans toward the cursor
items.pz: quickTo(x/y) + mousemove 里算相对偏移 ×0.25。
items.pe: quickTo x/y from the pointer delta, scaled 0.25.

items.dz: 跟着指针轻微翻
items.de: It tips toward the pointer
items.pz: rotationX/Y 由指针位置映射，perspective 给父层。
items.pe: Map pointer position to rotationX/Y; perspective on the parent.

items.dz: 一块色板扫过完成切页
items.de: A panel wipes the page over
items.pz: tl.to(cover,{yPercent:0}).add(swap).to(cover,{yPercent:-100})
items.pe: Cover in, swap content, cover out.

items.dz: 图从中间向两边掀开
items.de: The image opens from the middle
items.pz: clipPath 的 inset 从 50% 收到 0，配 power4.inOut。
items.pe: Tween a clip-path inset from 50% to 0.

items.dz: 形状本身在变
items.de: The shape itself animates
items.pz: GSAP 能补 clip-path，但两端点数要一致。
items.pe: GSAP tweens clip-path — keep the point count equal.

items.dz: 从模糊到清晰
items.de: Blur resolves into focus
items.pz: filter:"blur(0px)" 起手值必须带单位，不然不插值。
items.pe: Always include units in filter values or it will not interpolate.

items.dz: 数字滚到目标值
items.de: The number rolls to target
items.pz: gsap.to(obj,{val:2048,snap:"val",onUpdate:print})
items.pe: gsap.to(obj, { val: 2048, snap: "val", onUpdate })

items.dz: 像机场的翻牌
items.de: Airport split-flap
items.pz: 上下两半分别旋转，中间留一条黑缝。
items.pe: Rotate the two halves separately, keep the dark seam.

items.dz: 一直往前推的字条
items.de: Copy that never stops
items.pz: horizontalLoop helper + Observer 控制方向与速度。
items.pe: The horizontalLoop helper, steered by Observer.

items.dz: 指过去字先乱后定
items.de: Hover scrambles, then resolves
items.pz: hover 触发 scrambleText，离开时 revert。
items.pe: Fire scrambleText on hover, revert on leave.

items.dz: 菜单项一条条弹开
items.de: Items spring open in order
items.pz: stagger + back.out(2)，关闭时反向且更快。
items.pe: Stagger with back.out(2); reverse faster on close.

items.dz: 进入视口才开始动
items.de: It waits for the viewport
items.pz: scrollTrigger:{start:"top 80%",toggleActions:"play none none reverse"}
items.pe: start: "top 80%", toggleActions: "play none none reverse"

items.dz: 滚过阈值底栏才出现
items.de: The bar appears past a threshold
items.pz: onToggle 里 gsap.to(bar,{yPercent:isActive?0:100})
items.pe: Toggle the bar with yPercent on ScrollTrigger onToggle.

items.dz: 像镜头对上焦
items.de: Like a lens finding focus
items.pz: from:{filter:"blur(14px)",scale:1.06}，别超过 16px。
items.pe: from blur(14px) and scale 1.06 — keep blur under 16px.

items.dz: 滚轮翻卡片
items.de: The wheel flips cards
items.pz: Observer 的 onWheel 累加 index，tween 到目标 x。
items.pe: Accumulate an index in Observer onWheel and tween x.

items.dz: 换布局后动效不错位
items.de: Layout changes without drift
items.pz: 字体/图片加载完调 ScrollTrigger.refresh()，或用 invalidateOnRefresh。
items.pe: Call ScrollTrigger.refresh() after fonts and images load.

items.dz: 手机上换一套动效
items.de: A different motion set on mobile
items.pz: gsap.matchMedia().add("(min-width:768px)",fn)，自动清理。
items.pe: gsap.matchMedia().add("(min-width: 768px)", fn) — self-cleaning.

items.dz: 关掉位移只留淡入
items.de: Drop the movement, keep the fade
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion 下把 y/scale 全部置 0。
items.pe: Zero out y and scale under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.dz: 新指令立刻接管旧动效
items.de: A new command takes over cleanly
items.pz: overwrite:"auto"，或 gsap.killTweensOf(el) 再起新的。
items.pe: overwrite: "auto", or killTweensOf before the new tween.

items.dz: 像签名一样一笔写出
items.de: It writes itself like a signature
items.pz: drawSVG + 变宽笔画（stroke-width tween）更像手写。
items.pe: drawSVG plus a stroke-width tween reads as handwriting.

items.dz: 滚动带一点惯性
items.de: Scrolling carries inertia
items.pz: ScrollSmoother.create({smooth:1.2,effects:true})，别超 1.5。
items.pe: ScrollSmoother.create({ smooth: 1.2 }) — keep under 1.5.

items.dz: 标注一下就自动视差
items.de: Markup-only parallax
items.pz: ScrollSmoother 的 data-speed="0.8" / data-lag="0.3"。
items.pe: data-speed="0.8" and data-lag="0.3" with ScrollSmoother.

items.dz: 插件必须先注册
items.de: Register before you use
items.pz: gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger,Flip)，SSR 下放 useEffect。
items.pe: gsap.registerPlugin(...) — inside useEffect for SSR.

dz: motion、react-spring、View Transitions——组件世界里的动效语法
de: motion, react-spring, View Transitions — motion in component land

items.dz: 有质量的过渡，不是时长
items.de: Mass, not duration
items.pz: transition:{type:"spring",stiffness:300,damping:24}
items.pe: transition: { type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 24 }

items.dz: 父层一句话，子层依次动
items.de: One parent state, ordered children
items.pz: variants + staggerChildren:.06 + delayChildren:.1
items.pe: variants with staggerChildren 0.06 and delayChildren 0.1

items.dz: 删除时也要有交代
items.de: Removal gets its own beat
items.pz: <AnimatePresence> 包住条件渲染，写 exit={{opacity:0,y:-8}}。
items.pe: Wrap conditional renders in AnimatePresence and give exit props.

items.dz: 两处的同一个元素连起来动
items.de: The same element, two places
items.pz: 两个组件挂同一个 layoutId，motion 自动补 FLIP。
items.pe: Give both nodes the same layoutId and motion FLIPs between them.

items.dz: 尺寸变了自己滑过去
items.de: Size changes animate themselves
items.pz: 给节点加 layout，motion 会测量前后 rect 做 transform。
items.pe: Add `layout` and motion measures before/after rects.

items.dz: 删除时其他项不跳
items.de: Siblings do not jump on delete
items.pz: AnimatePresence mode="popLayout"，被删项脱离文档流。
items.pe: AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" takes the exiting node out of flow.

items.dz: 拖起来其他项自动让位
items.de: Others make room as you drag
items.pz: <Reorder.Group> + <Reorder.Item>，值必须是稳定 key。
items.pe: Reorder.Group / Reorder.Item with stable values.

items.dz: 能拖但拖不出框
items.de: Draggable, but bounded
items.pz: drag dragConstraints={ref} dragElastic={0.15}
items.pe: drag with dragConstraints={ref} and dragElastic 0.15

items.dz: 松手回原位
items.de: Let go and it returns
items.pz: dragSnapToOrigin + spring transition。
items.pe: dragSnapToOrigin with a spring transition.

items.dz: 按下去缩一点
items.de: It compresses under the press
items.pz: whileTap={{scale:.96}} 配 whileHover={{scale:1.02}}
items.pe: whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }} with whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}

items.dz: 指过去卡片抬起
items.de: The card lifts under the pointer
items.pz: whileHover={{y:-4,boxShadow:"0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12)"}}
items.pe: whileHover with y: -4 and a deeper shadow.

items.dz: 任何数值都能被弹簧化
items.de: Any number can be springed
items.pz: const x=useSpring(0,{stiffness:200,damping:20})
items.pe: useSpring(0, { stiffness: 200, damping: 20 })

items.dz: 一个源值驱动一堆属性
items.de: One source drives many properties
items.pz: useTransform(scrollY,[0,300],[0,-60])，clamp 默认开。
items.pe: useTransform(scrollY, [0, 300], [0, -60]).

items.dz: 滚动进度驱动一切
items.de: Scroll progress drives everything
items.pz: const {scrollYProgress}=useScroll({target,offset:["start end","end start"]})
items.pe: useScroll({ target, offset: ["start end", "end start"] })

items.dz: 进视口才播一次
items.de: Plays once when it enters
items.pz: const inView=useInView(ref,{once:true,margin:"-15%"})
items.pe: useInView(ref, { once: true, margin: "-15%" })

items.dz: 容器控制节奏，子项只管姿势
items.de: Container owns rhythm, children own pose
items.pz: variants 里 transition:{staggerChildren:.05,staggerDirection:-1}
items.pe: transition: { staggerChildren: 0.05, staggerDirection: -1 }

items.dz: 一个属性走多个值
items.de: One prop, several stops
items.pe: animate={{ scale: [1, 1.2, 0.95, 1] }} with times.

items.dz: 悬停→按压→释放三段连贯
items.de: Hover, press, release — one arc
items.pz: whileHover / whileTap / animate 三层状态互不打断。
items.pe: Layer whileHover, whileTap and animate; none should cancel the others.

items.dz: 路由切换像原生 App
items.de: Route changes feel native
items.pz: document.startViewTransition(()=>setRoute(next))，配 view-transition-name。
items.pe: document.startViewTransition(() => setRoute(next)) plus view-transition-name.

items.dz: 指定谁跟谁是同一个东西
items.de: Tell the browser what is "the same"
items.pz: 两个页面同名节点会被自动配对，名字要全局唯一。
items.pe: Same name across routes pairs the elements; names must be unique.

items.dz: 等数据时给骨架不是转圈
items.de: Skeletons, not spinners
items.pz: <Suspense fallback={<Skeleton/>}>，骨架形状要贴近真实内容。
items.pe: Suspense fallback with a skeleton shaped like the real content.

items.dz: 先显示成功，失败再回滚
items.de: Show success now, roll back if it fails
items.pz: useOptimistic：先插入半透明条目，服务端确认后转实。
items.pe: useOptimistic — insert a dimmed row, confirm it on response.

items.dz: 切页时旧内容先变淡
items.de: The old view dims while the new loads
items.pz: const [isPending,start]=useTransition()，isPending 只降不透明度。
items.pe: useTransition — dim, do not blank, while pending.

items.dz: 输入不卡，结果慢一拍
items.de: Typing stays smooth, results lag
items.pz: useDeferredValue 让重列表落后一帧，输入框永远跟手。
items.pe: useDeferredValue keeps the input responsive.

items.dz: 骨架不闪一下就换成正文
items.de: No flash between skeleton and content
items.pz: 相同尺寸的骨架层放在真实照片与文字上方，在 150ms 内淡出；低动态模式直接显示内容。本例用 CSS 演示视觉交接，不触发真实网络加载或 React Suspense。
items.pe: An equal-sized skeleton layer fades out over the photograph and text in 150ms. Reduced motion reveals content immediately. This CSS specimen does not trigger network loading or React Suspense.

items.dz: 展开收起的高度也能动
items.de: Even auto height animates
items.pz: motion 支持 height:"auto"；或用 grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr。
items.pe: motion animates height: "auto"; or use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr.

items.dz: 一开一合，只有一个是开的
items.de: One open at a time
items.pz: 受控 state + AnimatePresence，收起时先淡内容再收高度。
items.pe: Controlled state; fade content before collapsing height.

items.dz: 弹窗弹出来而不是滑出来
items.de: The dialog springs, not slides
items.pz: initial={{scale:.94,opacity:0}} + spring(300,26)
items.pe: initial scale 0.94 with a spring(300, 26).

items.dz: 可拖的半屏抽屉
items.de: A draggable half-sheet
items.pz: drag="y" dragConstraints={{top:0}} + onDragEnd 判定 velocity。
items.pe: drag="y" with a velocity check in onDragEnd.

items.dz: 新提示把旧的压下去
items.de: New toasts press the old ones down
items.pz: 按 index 给 scale 与 y 偏移，最多显示 3 条。
items.pe: Scale and offset by index; cap at three visible.

items.dz: 下划线滑到当前项
items.de: The underline slides over
items.pz: layoutId="tab-underline"，让 motion 自己算位移。
items.pe: layoutId="tab-underline" and let motion compute the slide.

items.dz: 滑动切页带速度判定
items.de: Velocity decides the page turn
items.pz: onDragEnd 里 offset.x + velocity.x*0.2 超阈值就翻页。
items.pe: Use offset.x plus velocity.x * 0.2 against a threshold.

items.dz: 卡片图比卡片慢一点
items.de: The art moves slower than the card
items.pz: useTransform 把父层滚动映射到内图的 y，比例 0.6。
items.pe: Map parent scroll to the inner image y at 0.6.

items.dz: 数字换位时滚动
items.de: Digits roll when they change
items.pz: 每位数字一个纵向轮盘，只动变化的那几位。
items.pe: A vertical reel per digit; only changed digits move.

items.dz: 进度条追着目标走
items.de: The bar chases its target
items.pz: useSpring 包住 progress，别直接 setState 硬跳。
items.pe: Wrap progress in useSpring instead of hard sets.

items.dz: 键盘导航看得见
items.de: Keyboard users can see where they are
items.pz: :focus-visible + 2px outline offset 2px，别用 outline:none。
items.pe: :focus-visible with a 2px offset ring — never outline: none.

items.dz: 换页只淡不跳
items.de: Pages cross-fade, never jump
items.pz: AnimatePresence mode="wait" + key={pathname}。
items.pe: AnimatePresence mode="wait" keyed by pathname.

items.dz: 前进往左，后退往右
items.de: Forward goes left, back goes right
items.pz: 用 custom={direction} 传给 variants，exit 用相反方向。
items.pe: Pass a direction via custom into variants; mirror it on exit.

items.dz: 遮罩比面板早一点出现
items.de: The scrim leads the panel
items.pz: 遮罩 120ms 淡入，面板 240ms 弹入，退场反序。
items.pe: Scrim 120ms in, panel 240ms; reverse on exit.

items.dz: 真想看才展开，划过不展开
items.de: Only real intent opens it
items.pz: 进入 120ms 后才展开，离开 240ms 才收，防误触。
items.pe: Open after 120ms of hover, close after 240ms of leave.

items.dz: 贴边时自动换方向
items.de: It flips at the edge
items.pz: Floating UI 的 flip + shift middleware，别自己算。
items.pe: Use Floating UI flip and shift middleware.

items.dz: 一万行也能有进场动效
items.de: Ten thousand rows, still animated
items.pz: react-virtual 只渲染可视行，进场动效挂在行内不在容器。
items.pe: Virtualise rows and animate inside the row, not the container.

items.dz: 一串元素像尾巴跟上来
items.de: A trail follows the first
items.pz: useTrail(n,{from,to,config:config.gentle})
items.pe: useTrail(n, { from, to, config: config.gentle })

items.dz: 四套配方覆盖九成场景
items.de: Four presets cover most needs
items.pz: config.stiff / gentle / wobbly / molasses，先选再调。
items.pe: config.stiff / gentle / wobbly / molasses — pick, then tune.

items.dz: 两段动效严格接力
items.de: Two springs, strict handoff
items.pz: useChain([refA,refB],[0,.3])，比 delay 更可靠。
items.pe: useChain([refA, refB], [0, 0.3]) beats manual delays.

items.dz: 事件里直接开动效
items.de: Fire motion straight from an event
items.pz: const [scope,animate]=useAnimate(); animate(scope.current,{x:20})
items.pe: useAnimate() gives you animate() inside handlers.

items.dz: 一串关键动作写成数组
items.de: The whole beat as an array

items.dz: 不用 JS 也能滚动驱动
items.de: Scroll-driven without JS
items.pz: animation-timeline:view() / scroll()，降级用 IntersectionObserver。
items.pe: animation-timeline: view() or scroll(), with an IO fallback.

items.dz: 尊重系统偏好
items.de: Respect the system preference
items.pz: const reduce=useReducedMotion()，reduce 时只留 opacity。
items.pe: useReducedMotion() — keep only opacity when true.

items.dz: 兄弟组件一起重算布局
items.de: Siblings re-measure together
items.pz: <LayoutGroup> 包住互相影响的可折叠项。
items.pe: Wrap mutually affecting collapsibles in LayoutGroup.

items.dz: 指一张，其他张退让
items.de: Hover one, the rest recede
items.pz: 父层 group hover 下给兄弟降 opacity/scale。
items.pe: On group hover, dim and shrink the siblings.

items.dz: 自定义光标带阻尼跟随
items.de: A damped custom cursor
items.pz: useSpring 包 pointer 坐标，damping 30 左右。
items.pe: Spring the pointer coords with damping ≈ 30.

items.dz: 按钮被指针吸过去
items.de: The button is drawn to the cursor
items.pz: 指针相对中心的偏移 ×0.3 喂给 useSpring。
items.pe: Feed pointer offset × 0.3 into useSpring.

items.dz: 整行从遮罩后升起
items.de: Lines rise from behind a mask
items.pz: 每行一个 overflow:hidden 包裹，内层 y:100%→0。
items.pe: Wrap each line, animate the inner y from 100% to 0.

items.dz: 进视口才开始数
items.de: It starts counting on entry
items.pz: useInView 触发 animate(count,target,{duration:1.2})。
items.pe: Trigger animate(count, target) from useInView.

items.dz: 错了抖一下并聚焦
items.de: Wrong input shakes and focuses
items.pz: ±6px 三次衰减 + aria-live 提示，别只靠红框。
items.pe: Three decaying ±6px shakes plus an aria-live message.

items.dz: 提交完成打一个勾
items.de: A check lands on success
items.pz: 勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出来，配 spring scale。
items.pe: Draw the check with stroke-dashoffset plus a spring scale.

items.dz: 滑块过一点头
items.de: The knob overshoots slightly
items.pz: spring(500,30) + 滑块宽度短暂拉长。
items.pe: spring(500, 30) with a brief knob stretch.

items.dz: 勾出现时盒子鼓一下
items.de: The box pops as it checks
items.pz: scale 1→1.15→1 配勾的 clip-path 揭示。
items.pe: scale 1 → 1.15 → 1 with a clip-path reveal on the tick.

items.dz: 选中态在选项间滑动
items.de: The selection slides between options
items.pz: 共享 layoutId 的圆点，不是各自 fade。
items.pe: One layoutId dot, not per-option fades.

items.dz: 底片滑到选中项
items.de: The pill slides to the choice
items.pz: 底片 layout 动画 + 文字颜色同帧切换。
items.pe: Animate the pill with layout; switch label colour on the same frame.

items.dz: 从触发点长出来
items.de: It grows from its trigger
items.pz: transform-origin 设在触发点，scale .95→1 + y -4→0。
items.pe: Set transform-origin at the trigger; scale 0.95 → 1.

items.dz: 呼出即聚焦，键盘全通
items.de: Opens focused, fully keyboard-driven
items.pz: 打开时 scale .96→1 + backdrop 淡入，输入框自动 focus。
items.pe: Scale 0.96 → 1 with a scrim; autofocus the input.

items.dz: 横滑丢掉提示
items.de: Swipe it away
items.pz: drag="x" + onDragEnd 超 100px 或速度超 500 就移除。
items.pe: drag="x"; dismiss past 100px or 500 velocity.

items.dz: 拉到阈值才触发
items.de: It fires past the threshold
items.pz: 位移 60px 触发，超出后阻尼变大给反馈。
items.pe: Trigger at 60px; raise damping past it.

items.dz: 上下键移动高亮块
items.de: Arrow keys move the highlight
items.pz: 高亮块用 layoutId 滑动，同时 scrollIntoView 的 block:"nearest"。
items.pe: Slide the highlight with layoutId; keep the row in view.

items.dz: 点缩略图放大成全屏
items.de: The thumb becomes the full frame
items.pz: layoutId 共享 + portal 到 body，退场反向。
items.pe: Shared layoutId plus a portal; reverse on close.

items.dz: 每个状态一套姿势
items.de: One pose per state
items.pz: animate={state} + variants 里 idle/loading/done 三态。
items.pe: animate={state} with idle / loading / done variants.

items.dz: 加载完才淡入，不闪
items.de: It fades in once decoded
items.pz: img.decode() 成功后再改 opacity，避免半张图。
items.pe: Await img.decode() before fading in.

items.dz: 下滚收起、上滚露出
items.de: Hides down, shows up
items.pz: 按 scrollY 方向切 y:0/-100%，加 8px 阈值防抖。
items.pe: Toggle y by scroll direction with an 8px threshold.

items.dz: 拖分隔条改布局
items.de: Drag the divider
items.pz: 拖动时只改 flex-basis，松手才落到 state。
items.pe: Only mutate flex-basis while dragging; commit on release.

items.dz: 成功时一下小爆发
items.de: A small burst on success
items.pz: 20–40 个粒子、1 秒内收尾，reduced-motion 下关掉。
items.pe: 20–40 particles, done in a second, off under reduced motion.

dz: 数据驱动形状：enter / update / exit 是全部动效的骨架
de: Data-driven shapes — enter, update, exit is the whole grammar

items.dz: 新数据长出来，旧数据缩回去
items.de: New data grows in, old shrinks out
items.pz: join() 里分别给 enter / update / exit 三条 transition。
items.pe: Give enter, update and exit their own transitions inside join().

items.dz: 同一条数据始终是同一根柱子
items.de: One datum keeps its bar
items.pz: join(el,fn,fn,fn) 的第二参数给 key，别用索引。
items.pe: Pass a key function to join — never the index.

items.dz: 重新排序时柱子横向滑
items.de: Bars slide to new ranks
items.pz: 先 transition x 再 transition 高度，两段别同时。
items.pe: Move x first, then height — not at once.

items.dz: 排名一直在换
items.de: Ranks keep swapping
items.pz: 每帧插值一次 rank 与 value，keyframes 数越多越顺。
items.pe: Interpolate rank and value per frame; more keyframes, smoother race.

items.dz: 刻度换的时候旧的淡出
items.de: Old ticks fade as new arrive
items.pz: axis 的 exit 淡出 + enter 从新位置淡入，别整轴重画。
items.pe: Fade exiting ticks; fade in new ones at their new positions.

items.dz: 扇形沿着角度长出来
items.de: The wedge sweeps out by angle
items.pz: attrTween("d") 里对 startAngle/endAngle 插值，不能插 path 字符串。
items.pe: Interpolate the angles in attrTween("d"), not the path string.

items.dz: 一圈扇形依次展开
items.de: Wedges open in sequence
items.pz: pie() 排序后按索引 delay，整圈 800ms 内完成。
items.pe: Delay by index after pie(); the full ring inside 800ms.

items.dz: 一个环讲一个百分比
items.de: One ring, one percentage
items.pz: arc().innerRadius 留 70%，中间放数字。
items.pe: arc() with innerRadius at 70% and the number inside.

items.dz: 柱子绕成一圈
items.de: Bars wrapped into a ring
items.pz: scaleRadial 才不会让面积说谎，别直接用线性半径。
items.pe: Use scaleRadial so areas do not lie.

items.dz: 换一种曲线换一种气质
items.de: The curve type is a voice
items.pz: curveMonotoneX 保单调，curveCatmullRom 更圆但会过冲。
items.pe: curveMonotoneX stays honest; curveCatmullRom rounds but overshoots.

items.dz: 线从左往右画出来
items.de: The line draws left to right
items.pz: stroke-dasharray = 总长，dashoffset 从总长到 0。
items.pe: Set dasharray to the path length and tween dashoffset to 0.

items.dz: 一层层叠上去
items.de: Layers stack up
items.pz: stack() 的 order 与 offset 决定叙事：wiggle 做 streamgraph。
items.pe: stack() order and offset carry the narrative; wiggle gives a streamgraph.

items.dz: 像河道一样宽窄变化
items.de: A river of changing width
items.pz: stackOffsetWiggle + stackOrderInsideOut，无基线更好看。
items.pe: stackOffsetWiggle with stackOrderInsideOut.

items.dz: 一叠密度曲线
items.de: A stack of density curves
items.pz: 各行留 -50% 的重叠，从后往前画。
items.pe: Overlap rows by half and draw back to front.

items.dz: 改箱宽时柱子重组
items.de: Bars regroup as bin width changes
items.pz: bin().thresholds(n) 变化时对高度与宽度同时 transition。
items.pe: Transition width and height together when thresholds change.

items.dz: 散点变成等高线
items.de: Points become contours
items.pz: contourDensity().bandwidth(20)，带宽决定平滑度。
items.pe: contourDensity().bandwidth(20) controls smoothness.

items.dz: 点挤开但不重叠
items.de: Dots push apart without overlap
items.pz: forceCollide + forceX(value)，y 只用来避让。
items.pe: forceCollide with forceX(value); y only resolves collisions.

items.dz: 节点自己找到位置
items.de: Nodes find their own places
items.pz: forceLink + forceManyBody(-160) + forceCenter，alphaDecay 别调太快。
items.pe: forceLink, forceManyBody(-160), forceCenter; keep alphaDecay gentle.

items.dz: 拖一个，整网跟着松动
items.de: Drag one, the web loosens
items.pz: drag 时 fx/fy 固定该点，松手置 null 让它回流。
items.pe: Pin fx/fy while dragging; release to null.

items.dz: 连线不打直，读得更清
items.de: Curved links read cleaner
items.pz: linkHorizontal() 或自定义 arc，双向边要错开。
items.pe: linkHorizontal(), or offset arcs for bidirectional edges.

items.dz: 两两之间的流量
items.de: Flows between every pair
items.pz: chord() + ribbon()，颜色按源节点，透明度 0.7。
items.pe: chord() with ribbon(); colour by source at 0.7 alpha.

items.dz: 流量在节点间分岔
items.de: Flow splits across nodes
items.pz: sankey().nodeAlign(sankeyJustify)，链接宽度=流量。
items.pe: sankey().nodeAlign(sankeyJustify); link width is the value.

items.dz: 面积就是大小
items.de: Area is the value
items.pz: treemap().tile(treemapSquarify)，padding 1px 才看得清层级。
items.pe: treemapSquarify with 1px padding to show hierarchy.

items.dz: 圆里套圆
items.de: Circles inside circles
items.pz: pack().padding(3) + hierarchy().sum()，别忘 sort。
items.pe: pack().padding(3) over a summed, sorted hierarchy.

items.dz: 点一层就放大一层
items.de: Click a ring to drill in
items.pz: partition() + arcTween，父节点角度归 0–2π。
items.pe: partition() with arcTween; the parent spans the full circle.

items.dz: 层级横着摊开
items.de: Hierarchy laid out flat
items.pz: partition().size([h,w]) 后交换 x/y 得到横向冰柱。
items.pe: Swap x and y after partition() for a horizontal icicle.

items.dz: 子节点从父节点长出来
items.de: Children grow out of the parent
items.pz: tree() 布局 + 新节点从父坐标进场（source→target）。
items.pe: Enter new nodes at the parent position, then transition out.

items.dz: 树绕成一圈
items.de: The tree curls into a circle
items.pz: tree().size([2π,r]) 后转极坐标，标签要沿切线翻转。
items.pe: tree().size([2π, r]) in polar space; flip labels past 180°.

items.dz: 离哪个点近就选哪个
items.de: Nearest point wins the pointer
items.pz: Delaunay.find(x,y) 做命中，比逐点距离快得多。
items.pe: Delaunay.find(x, y) beats looping over points.

items.dz: 几万点也能实时命中
