items.de: Real-time hits on 50k points
items.pz: quadtree().find(x,y,radius)，先建树再查询。
items.pe: quadtree().find(x, y, radius) — build once, query often.

items.dz: 放大后细节变多而不是变大
items.de: Zooming reveals detail, not size
items.pz: zoom 事件里按 k 换数据粒度，别只 transform scale。
items.pe: Swap data granularity by k instead of only scaling.

items.dz: 双指缩放不丢焦点
items.de: Pinch keeps the focal point
items.pz: d3.zoom().scaleExtent([1,8])，用 zoomIdentity 做程序化跳转。
items.pe: d3.zoom().scaleExtent([1, 8]); use zoomIdentity for programmatic moves.

items.dz: 刷一段，别的图跟着变
items.de: Brush here, everything responds
items.pz: brushX 的 on("brush end") 里 filter 数据再重绘其他视图。
items.pe: Filter on brushX end and redraw the linked views.

items.dz: 上面全貌，下面细节
items.de: Overview above, detail below
items.pz: 两个 scale 共享 domain，刷选区域驱动细节图。
items.pe: Two scales share a domain; the brush drives the detail chart.

items.dz: 指到哪读到哪
items.de: Read exactly where you point
items.pz: bisector 找最近数据点，线用 shape-rendering:crispEdges。
items.pe: Find the datum with a bisector; render the line crisp.

items.dz: 提示贴着指针但不挡数据
items.de: It follows without covering the data
items.pz: 偏移 12px 并在贴边时翻边，位置用 transform 不用 left/top。
items.pe: Offset 12px, flip at edges, move with transform.

items.dz: 图例本身就是色阶
items.de: The legend is the ramp
items.pz: scaleQuantize + 一排色块，阈值写在块之间。
items.pe: scaleQuantize with swatches; thresholds sit between them.

items.dz: 颜色也是一条尺子
items.de: Colour as a ruler
items.pz: interpolateViridis 之类感知均匀色标，别用 rainbow。
items.pe: Use a perceptually uniform ramp, never rainbow.

items.dz: 中间是零，两边反向
items.de: Zero in the middle, two directions
items.pz: scaleDiverging + 中点必须对齐 0，否则误导。
items.pe: scaleDiverging with the midpoint pinned to zero.

items.dz: 一年一眼看完
items.de: A year at a glance
items.pz: timeWeek 分列、timeDay 分行，每格 12px。
items.pe: Columns by week, rows by day, 12px cells.

items.dz: 行列都可重排
items.de: Rows and columns both reorder
items.pz: 按聚类结果重排行列，重排要有 transition 才看得懂。
items.pe: Reorder by clustering — with a transition, or nobody follows it.

items.dz: 多维度一起看
items.de: Many dimensions at once
items.pz: 每维一个 scale，刷选任一轴过滤全部线。
items.pe: One scale per axis; brushing any axis filters all lines.

items.dz: 名次线交叉起落
items.de: Rank lines cross and swap
items.pz: 排名用 scalePoint，线用 curveMonotoneX 防假拐点。
items.pe: scalePoint for rank, curveMonotoneX for honest lines.

items.dz: 只有两个时间点
items.de: Two points, one story
items.pz: 左右两条轴 + 直线，上升下降用两种颜色。
items.pe: Two axes and straight lines, coloured by direction.

items.dz: 一步步加减到总量
items.de: Each step adds or subtracts
items.pz: 每根柱的起点是上一根的终点，正负分色。
items.pe: Each bar starts where the last ended; colour by sign.

items.dz: 开高低收四个数
items.de: Open, high, low, close
items.pz: 影线用 1px line，实体最小 1px 高避免消失。
items.pe: One-pixel wicks; keep bodies at least 1px tall.

items.dz: 实际、目标、区间三合一
items.de: Actual, target and range in one row
items.pz: 背景分档 + 一根实际值条 + 一条目标标线。
items.pe: Banded background, one measure bar, one target tick.

items.dz: 一行文字里塞一条趋势
items.de: A trend inside a line of text
items.pz: 去掉坐标轴，只留最后一点的圆点与数值。
items.pe: No axes — just the last dot and its value.

items.dz: 同一张图重复很多遍
items.de: The same chart, many times
items.pz: 共享 y 轴刻度，否则比较无效。
items.pe: Share the y domain or the comparison is meaningless.

items.dz: 把结论写在图上
items.de: Put the conclusion on the chart
items.pz: d3-annotation 的 connector + note，别让引线穿过数据。
items.pe: Use connectors that avoid crossing the data.

items.dz: 投影之间平滑切换
items.de: One projection melts into another
items.pz: geoInterpolate 或 d3-geo-projection 的 interpolateProjection。
items.pe: interpolateProjection from d3-geo-projection.

items.dz: 区域按值填色
items.de: Regions coloured by value
items.pz: 面积会误导：小区高值要配点标或 cartogram。
items.pe: Area misleads — pair with dots or a cartogram.

items.dz: 面积按数据改
items.de: Area rewritten by data
items.pz: 格子式 cartogram 比连续变形更可读。
items.pe: A tile cartogram reads better than a continuous one.

items.dz: 两地之间画一条弧
items.de: An arc between two places
items.pz: geoInterpolate 取样后画路径，配 dashoffset 动画。
items.pe: Sample geoInterpolate, then draw with a dashoffset tween.

items.dz: 密度用六边形聚合
items.de: Density in hexagons
items.pz: d3-hexbin 的 radius 决定粒度，颜色映射 length。
items.pe: The hexbin radius sets granularity; map colour to length.

items.dz: 刻度随缩放换粒度
items.de: Ticks change unit as you zoom
items.pz: scaleTime 自动选 tick，但格式要自己按跨度换。
items.pe: scaleTime picks ticks; you still switch the format by span.

items.dz: 一段结束下一段开始
items.de: One ends, the next begins
items.pz: transition().transition() 自动接力，别用 setTimeout。
items.pe: transition().transition() chains natively — no setTimeout.

items.dz: 延迟随数据顺序递增
items.de: Delay grows with the datum index
items.pz: delay((d,i)=>i*40)，总时长控制在 1s 内。
items.pe: delay((d, i) => i * 40), total under a second.

items.dz: 两条折线之间平滑变形
items.de: One polyline melts into another
items.pz: 点数不同要先重采样（flubber / d3-interpolate-path）。
items.pe: Resample first when point counts differ.

items.dz: 数据动效别用弹簧
items.de: Data motion should not bounce
items.pz: easeCubicOut 是安全默认；避免 easeBounce 让人误读数据。
items.pe: easeCubicOut is the safe default; bounce misreads as data.

items.dz: 一份 SVG 适配所有宽度
items.de: One SVG, any width
items.pz: viewBox + preserveAspectRatio，别在 resize 里重画全图。
items.pe: viewBox plus preserveAspectRatio beats redrawing on resize.

items.dz: 点太多就别用 SVG
items.de: Past 10k points, drop SVG
items.pz: 超过 1 万个元素改画 canvas，命中检测用 quadtree。
items.pe: Beyond 10k marks, draw to canvas and hit-test with a quadtree.

items.dz: 轴的端点是整数
items.de: Axis ends on round numbers
items.pz: scale.domain(extent).nice()，零基线该留就留。
items.pe: domain(extent).nice(), and keep the zero baseline when it matters.

items.dz: 跨量级又含零
items.de: Orders of magnitude, zero included
items.pz: scaleSymlog 处理含 0 的长尾，比 log 安全。
items.pe: scaleSymlog handles zero-crossing long tails.

items.dz: 重叠严重就先聚合
items.de: Aggregate before overplotting
items.pz: 密度高的区域改画热力，保留少数离群点。
items.pe: Switch dense regions to a heatmap; keep the outliers.

items.dz: 同值点错开一点
items.de: Same-value points step aside
items.pz: 只在无意义的轴上加抖动，幅度不超过半个间距。
items.pe: Only jitter the meaningless axis, under half a step.

items.dz: 时间跨度横着画
items.de: Spans laid out in time
items.pz: 按开始时间排序，依赖关系用细连线。
items.pe: Sort by start; draw dependencies as hairlines.

items.dz: 两点之间的差
items.de: The gap between two points
items.pz: 连线细、端点圆，颜色区分前后。
items.pe: Thin connector, round ends, two colours.

items.dz: 柱子瘦成一根线
items.de: The bar becomes a stick
items.pz: 比柱状更清爽，适合类别多、值差小。
items.pe: Cleaner than bars for many categories with small deltas.

items.dz: 半圆表盘
items.de: A half-circle dial
items.pz: arc 从 -90° 到 90°，配 cornerRadius 更精致。
items.pe: Sweep -90° to 90° and add a cornerRadius.

items.dz: 一条线说明合格与否
items.de: One line separates pass and fail
items.pz: 阈值上下分色，别只画一条虚线了事。
items.pe: Colour above and below, not just a dashed line.

items.dz: 线周围有一条带
items.de: A band around the line
items.pz: area 上下界半透明填充，线在带上面。
items.pe: Fill the bounds with a translucent area; the line rides on top.

items.dz: 缺的地方要断开
items.de: Gaps must actually break
items.pz: defined(d=>d.v!=null) 让线断开，别插值假装有数据。
items.pe: line.defined() breaks the path — never interpolate over gaps.

dz: 逐帧画出来的那一类：Canvas 2D、Lottie、Rive
de: Everything drawn per frame — Canvas 2D, Lottie, Rive

items.dz: 每帧只画一次
items.de: Exactly one draw per frame
items.pz: requestAnimationFrame 里用 delta time，不要假设 60fps。
items.pe: Drive by delta time inside requestAnimationFrame.

items.dz: 物理稳定不看帧率
items.de: Physics stays stable at any frame rate
items.pz: 累加 delta，按 16.67ms 固定步进，余量做插值。
items.pe: Accumulate delta, step at 16.67ms, interpolate the remainder.

items.dz: 不糊也不虚
items.de: Crisp on retina, no soft edges
items.pz: canvas.width = css * devicePixelRatio，再 ctx.scale(dpr,dpr)。
items.pe: Size the backing store by DPR and scale the context.

items.dz: 旧笔迹慢慢消失
items.de: Old strokes fade away
items.pz: 每帧盖一层低 alpha 背景，而不是 clearRect。
items.pe: Paint a low-alpha background each frame instead of clearing.

items.dz: 静态部分只画一次
items.de: Draw the static layer once
items.pz: 把背景画到 OffscreenCanvas，主画布只 drawImage。
items.pe: Render the background to an OffscreenCanvas and blit it.

items.dz: 主线程不掉帧
items.de: The main thread stays free
items.pz: transferControlToOffscreen() 后在 worker 里跑循环。
items.pe: transferControlToOffscreen and run the loop in a worker.

items.dz: 只擦要改的那一小块
items.de: Only clear what changed
items.pz: 记录改动区域，clearRect 只清那块，省 90% 填充。
items.pe: Track changed regions and clear only those.

items.dz: 路径只构造一次
items.de: Build the path once
items.pz: 把常用形状存成 Path2D 对象，每帧只 fill。
items.pe: Keep shapes as Path2D objects and just fill them.

items.dz: 别每帧新建渐变
items.de: Do not recreate gradients per frame
items.pz: createLinearGradient 结果缓存起来，它是重对象。
items.pe: Cache gradient objects — creating them is expensive.

items.dz: 同一笔画出不同关系
items.de: One stroke, many relationships
items.pz: globalCompositeOperation: 'lighter' 做光累积，'destination-out' 做橡皮。
items.pe: 'lighter' accumulates light; 'destination-out' erases.

items.dz: 只在形状里画
items.de: Draw only inside the shape
items.pz: ctx.clip() 后所有绘制被限制，记得 save/restore 配对。
items.pe: ctx.clip() after save(), and always restore().

items.dz: 直接改像素
items.de: Touch the pixels directly
items.pz: getImageData 很慢：一次读取，用 typed array 批量改。
items.pe: getImageData is slow — read once, mutate a typed array.

items.dz: 不产生垃圾就不卡顿
items.de: No garbage, no hitches
items.pz: 粒子复用而不是 new，GC 峰值就消失了。
items.pe: Recycle particles instead of allocating; the GC spikes vanish.

items.dz: 上万粒子还能互相碰
items.de: Thousands of particles still collide
items.pz: 按格子分桶，只检查同桶与邻桶。
items.pe: Bucket by cell and only test neighbours.

items.dz: 按得重线就粗
items.de: Press harder, thicker line
items.pz: pointerEvents 的 pressure 映射线宽，两点间插值补点。
items.pe: Map pointer pressure to line width and interpolate between samples.

items.dz: 手抖也画得顺
items.de: Shaky hands, smooth line
items.pz: 对采样点做移动平均或 Catmull-Rom 拟合，别直连。
items.pe: Moving-average or Catmull-Rom fit the samples.

items.dz: 落笔处慢慢洇开
items.de: The ink bleeds outward
items.pz: 在笔迹上叠低 alpha 的模糊层，多次累积。
items.pe: Accumulate blurred low-alpha layers over the stroke.

items.dz: 成千条线顺着场走
items.de: Thousands of lines follow the field
items.pz: 每条线沿噪声场步进 200 步，alpha 0.05 叠出质感。
items.pe: March each line 200 steps at alpha 0.05.

items.dz: 一层活的胶片颗粒
items.de: A living film grain
items.pz: 预生成 3–4 张噪声，轮播比每帧算便宜。
items.pe: Pre-bake three or four noise tiles and cycle them.

items.dz: 一张图播一套动作
items.de: One sheet, one action
items.pz: drawImage 的 9 参形式裁格子，12fps 最有手感。
items.pe: The nine-argument drawImage crops the cell; 12fps feels best.

items.dz: 格子拼出整个世界
items.de: A world made of tiles
items.pz: 只画可视范围的瓦片，图集减少纹理切换。
items.pe: Draw only visible tiles from one atlas.

items.dz: 世界动，画布不动
items.de: The world moves, the canvas does not
items.pz: ctx.translate 相机偏移 + 缩放，命中检测要反变换。
items.pe: Translate/scale by the camera and inverse-transform hits.

items.dz: 远景走得慢
items.de: Far layers lag behind
items.pz: 每层乘不同系数（0.2 / 0.5 / 1）绘制。
items.pe: Multiply each layer by 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.

items.dz: 刮开才看得见
items.de: Scratch to reveal
items.pz: destination-out 擦除遮罩层，统计 alpha 判定进度。
items.pe: Erase the cover with destination-out and count alpha for progress.

items.dz: 一瞬间撒出去再落下
items.de: A burst, then gravity
items.pz: 每片自己的旋转与阻力，1.2 秒内清空。
items.pe: Per-piece spin and drag; clear within 1.2 seconds.

items.dz: 升空、炸开、余烬下坠
items.de: Rise, burst, embers fall
items.pz: 三段时间线：上升、爆炸、拖尾衰减。
items.pe: Three phases: ascent, burst, ember decay.

items.dz: 声音画成一排竖条
items.de: Sound as a row of bars
items.pz: AnalyserNode.getByteFrequencyData 每帧喂进柱高。
items.pe: Feed getByteFrequencyData into the bar heights.

items.dz: 一条抖动的绿线
items.de: One trembling trace
items.pz: getByteTimeDomainData 画折线，余像用低 alpha 清屏。
items.pe: Draw the time-domain data with a low-alpha clear for afterglow.

items.dz: 峰值慢慢回落
items.de: The peak decays slowly
items.pz: 瞬时值直接跟随，峰值线用 0.95 衰减保持。
items.pe: Follow the instant value; hold the peak with 0.95 decay.

items.dz: AE 做的动画直接跑
items.de: After Effects, straight to the web
items.pz: lottie-web 用 renderer:"svg"；性能吃紧改 canvas。
items.pe: lottie-web with renderer "svg"; switch to canvas when heavy.

items.dz: 只播其中几帧
items.de: Play only a slice
items.pz: playSegments([[0,40]],true)，做状态之间的短过渡。
items.pe: playSegments([[0, 40]], true) for state-to-state beats.

items.dz: 滚动进度就是播放头
items.de: Scroll is the playhead
items.pz: goToAndStop(progress*totalFrames,true)，别调 play()。
items.pe: goToAndStop(progress * totalFrames, true).

items.dz: 同一动画换品牌色
items.de: One animation, any brand colour
items.pz: 遍历 layer 的 shape 改 c.k，或导出时就用可替换色。
items.pe: Walk the shape layers and patch the colour keys.

items.dz: 一个文件里装所有状态
items.de: Every state in one file
items.pz: inputs 传布尔/数值，运行时自己在状态间过渡。
items.pe: Feed inputs; the runtime handles the transitions.

items.dz: 角色跟着指针看
items.de: The character tracks your pointer
items.pz: 把指针坐标喂给 number input，动画自己插值。
items.pe: Feed pointer coords into a number input.

items.dz: 一个画板适配所有尺寸
items.de: One artboard, every size
items.pz: fit:"contain" + alignment，别用固定像素画板。
items.pe: fit "contain" with an alignment, never fixed pixels.

items.dz: 矢量画到画布上
items.de: Vector, drawn per frame
items.pz: Path2D 直接吃 SVG path 字符串，省掉 DOM。
items.pe: Path2D accepts an SVG path string — no DOM needed.

items.dz: 画布里的字也要讲究
items.de: Type on canvas still needs care
items.pz: textBaseline 用 "alphabetic"，度量用 actualBoundingBox。
items.pe: Use the alphabetic baseline and actualBoundingBox metrics.

items.dz: 一句话就有软阴影
items.de: Soft shadow in one line
items.pz: shadowBlur 很贵：静态阴影预烘焙成图片。
items.pe: shadowBlur is costly — bake static shadows into an image.

items.dz: 画布里也能点中东西
items.de: Clickable canvas objects
items.pz: isPointInPath，或画一张 ID 色图读像素。
items.pe: isPointInPath, or read a pixel from an ID buffer.

items.dz: 一键存图
items.de: Save the frame
items.pz: toBlob 而不是 toDataURL；大图交给 OffscreenCanvas。
items.pe: Prefer toBlob over toDataURL.

items.dz: 把视频画到画布上再处理
items.de: Pipe video through canvas
items.pz: requestVideoFrameCallback 比 rAF 更贴帧。
items.pe: requestVideoFrameCallback beats rAF for video.

items.dz: 绿幕抠掉换背景
items.de: Key out the green
items.pz: 在 YCbCr 空间判距离，比 RGB 阈值干净。
items.pe: Threshold in YCbCr, not RGB.

items.dz: 画面变成字符
items.de: The frame becomes characters
items.pz: 按亮度查字符梯度表 " .:-=+*#%@"。
items.pe: Map luminance onto a character ramp.

items.dz: 按明暗改点的大小
items.de: Dot size follows value
items.pz: 按格取平均亮度，画半径 ∝ 亮度的圆。
items.pe: Average each cell and draw a radius-mapped dot.

items.dz: 时间被压进一张图
items.de: Time compressed into one frame
items.pz: 每帧只画一列，列位置随时间右移。
items.pe: Draw one column per frame, marching right.

items.dz: 一段段被排序的条纹
items.de: Bands of sorted pixels
items.pz: 按阈值切段，段内按亮度排序，只排一个方向。
items.pe: Segment by threshold and sort each run by luminance.

items.dz: 画布吃自己的上一帧
items.de: The canvas eats its last frame
items.pz: 把自己 drawImage 回来，稍微缩放旋转就成隧道。
items.pe: drawImage the canvas into itself, slightly scaled and rotated.

items.dz: 两团靠近就黏成一团
items.de: They fuse as they approach
items.pz: 场值求和后取等值线；CSS 侧用 blur+contrast 近似。
items.pe: Sum the fields and threshold; blur + contrast approximates it.

items.dz: 斑纹自己长出来
items.de: Patterns grow on their own
items.pz: Gray-Scott 两组浓度场，feed/kill 决定花纹类型。
items.pe: Gray-Scott with feed and kill rates.

items.dz: 规则简单，图案复杂
items.de: Simple rules, complex pattern
items.pz: 生命游戏或 rule 30，每帧只算邻域和。
items.pe: Life or rule 30 — just neighbour sums per frame.

items.dz: 一笔画出的迷宫
items.de: A maze carved in one pass
items.pz: 递归回溯或 Wilson 算法，生成过程本身就是动画。
items.pe: Recursive backtracking — the generation is the animation.

items.dz: 一条规则长出一棵树
items.de: One rule grows a tree
items.pz: 字符串重写 + turtle 绘制，迭代 5 次就够密。
items.pe: String rewriting plus turtle drawing; five iterations is plenty.

items.dz: 一帧只有 16ms
items.de: You get 16ms per frame
items.pz: 超预算就降粒子数或降 DPR，而不是掉帧。
items.pe: Over budget, cut particle count or DPR — not frames.

items.dz: 切走就别烧电
items.de: Stop burning battery in the background
items.pz: visibilitychange 时 cancelAnimationFrame，回来再启。
items.pe: Cancel the rAF loop on visibilitychange.

dz: Lenis、滚动时间线、滚动叙事——把滚动条当成播放头
de: Lenis, scroll timelines, scrollytelling — the scrollbar as a playhead

items.dz: 滚动带一点惯性但不失控
items.de: Inertia without losing control
items.pz: new Lenis({lerp:.1})，别把 lerp 调到 0.05 以下。
items.pe: new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1 }) — below 0.05 feels drunk.

items.dz: 跳锚点也是滑过去的
items.de: Anchors glide instead of jump
items.pz: lenis.scrollTo(target,{offset:-80,duration:1.2})
items.pe: lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -80, duration: 1.2 })

items.dz: 开弹窗时背景不动
items.de: The page freezes behind a modal
items.pz: lenis.stop() / start()，比 overflow:hidden 不跳版。
items.pe: lenis.stop() and start() — no layout jump like overflow: hidden.

items.dz: 整页进度驱动一个动效
items.de: Page progress drives one animation
items.pz: animation-timeline:scroll(root block)，纯 CSS 不掉帧。
items.pe: animation-timeline: scroll(root block) — no JS, no jank.

items.dz: 元素自己知道进出视口的进度
items.de: Each element knows its own entry progress
items.pz: animation-timeline:view(); animation-range:entry 0% cover 40%。
items.pe: animation-timeline: view() with an animation-range.

items.dz: 进场和退场分别控制
items.de: Entry and exit, separately
items.pz: animation-range 可写 entry / exit / cover / contain 四段。
items.pe: animation-range takes entry, exit, cover and contain.

items.dz: 滚动后头部变矮变实
items.de: The header compacts as you scroll
items.pz: position:sticky + view timeline 改高度与阴影，别监听 scroll。
items.pe: Sticky plus a view timeline, not a scroll listener.

items.dz: 顶部一条线告诉你还剩多少
items.de: A hairline says how far you are
items.pz: scroll(root block) 驱动 scaleX，transform-origin:left。
items.pe: scroll(root block) into scaleX with a left origin.

items.dz: 一屏钉住，内容分段推进
items.de: One screen, several beats
items.pz: 钉住容器，按 progress 切换段落与图形状态。
items.pe: Pin the section and switch beats by progress.

items.dz: 纵滚驱动横向长卷
items.de: Vertical scroll pulls a horizontal reel
items.pz: 钉住外层，内层 translateX 到 -(n-1)*100vw。
items.pe: Pin the wrapper and translate the strip by viewport widths.

items.dz: 每次滚动必停在一屏
items.de: It always lands on a section
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y mandatory，长内容页千万别用。
items.pe: y mandatory — never on long-form content.

items.dz: 接近了才吸
items.de: It snaps only when close
items.pz: scroll-snap-type:y proximity 对长文更友好。
items.pe: y proximity is kinder to long documents.

items.dz: 一次只能翻一屏
items.de: One section per gesture
items.pz: scroll-snap-stop:always 防止快滑跳过内容。
items.pe: scroll-snap-stop: always stops fling-throughs.

items.dz: 锚点不被吸顶头挡住
items.de: Anchors clear the sticky header
items.pz: scroll-padding-top 等于头部高度，一行解决。
items.pe: scroll-padding-top equal to the header height.

items.dz: 子区域滚完不带动整页
items.de: The page stays put when the panel ends
items.pz: overscroll-behavior:contain，弹窗内滚动的必需项。
items.pe: overscroll-behavior: contain — mandatory inside modals.

items.dz: 出现滚动条时不跳版
items.de: No jump when the scrollbar appears
items.pz: scrollbar-gutter:stable，比 overflow-y:scroll 优雅。
items.pe: scrollbar-gutter: stable beats forcing overflow.

items.dz: 背景比内容慢
items.de: The background trails the content
items.pz: 背景层 translateY 乘 0.3，用 scroll timeline 驱动。
items.pe: Multiply the background translate by 0.3.

items.dz: 三层不同速度造纵深
items.de: Three speeds make depth
items.pz: 前景 1.2×、中景 1×、远景 0.6×，别超过三层。
items.pe: Foreground 1.2×, mid 1×, far 0.6× — three layers max.

items.dz: 滚到就从下方揭开
items.de: It unmasks from below
items.pz: clip-path inset 由 view timeline 驱动，比 opacity 更有质感。
items.pe: Drive a clip-path inset from the view timeline.

items.dz: 图随滚动缓慢变大
items.de: The image grows as you pass
items.pz: scale 1→1.08 就够，超过 1.15 会显廉价。
items.pe: Scale 1 → 1.08; past 1.15 it looks cheap.

items.dz: 滚动就转一圈
items.de: Scroll spins it
items.pz: 整段滚动映射 0–360°，配 will-change:transform。
items.pe: Map the whole range to 360°.

items.dz: 往下滚整页换气质
items.de: The page changes mood downward
items.pz: 给 body 背景做 scroll timeline，两三个色阶就够。
items.pe: A scroll timeline on the body background, two or three stops.

items.dz: 读到哪句哪句变深
items.de: The current line darkens
items.pz: 每行一个 view timeline，非当前行降到 35% 灰。
items.pe: One view timeline per line; dim the rest.

items.dz: 一个词一个词被点亮
items.de: Words light up in turn
items.pz: 把句子拆词，每词 animation-range 错开 3%。
items.pe: Split into words and offset each range by 3%.

items.dz: 数字随滚动长大
items.de: The number grows with scroll
items.pz: 进度映射到数值，注意 tabular-nums 防抖。
items.pe: Map progress to the value; keep tabular numerals.

items.dz: 卡片一张压一张钉住
items.de: Cards pile up as you scroll
items.pz: 每张 position:sticky top 递增，配轻微 scale 递减。
items.pe: Sticky with increasing top and a slight scale down.

items.dz: 上一屏被下一屏推走
items.de: The next screen pushes the last away
items.pz: 上层 sticky + 下层正常流，上层做 scale/opacity 退场。
items.pe: Sticky upper layer exits with scale and opacity.

items.dz: 滚得快跑马灯也快
items.de: Scroll faster, the ticker runs faster
items.pz: 把滚动速度映射到 animation-duration 或 playbackRate。
items.pe: Map scroll velocity onto playbackRate.

items.dz: 上滚和下滚表现不同
items.de: Up and down behave differently
items.pz: 记录上一帧 scrollY 判方向，加 8px 死区防抖。
items.pe: Compare with the last scrollY, with an 8px dead zone.

items.dz: 停下来了才做重活
items.de: Heavy work waits for the stop
items.pz: scrollend 事件（或 150ms 防抖）里再取数、再排版。
items.pe: Do fetches and layout on scrollend, not on scroll.

items.dz: 滚到底自动接一页
items.de: The next page appends itself
items.pz: 哨兵元素 + IntersectionObserver，别监听 scroll。
items.pe: A sentinel element with IntersectionObserver.

items.dz: 返回时回到原来的位置
items.de: Back returns you to where you were
items.pz: history.scrollRestoration="manual" 后自己存取位置。
items.pe: Set scrollRestoration to manual and store it yourself.

items.dz: 看不见的先不排版
items.de: Offscreen content is not laid out
items.pz: content-visibility:auto + contain-intrinsic-size 防跳。
items.pe: content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size.

items.dz: 上方内容加载不推走视线
items.de: Late content above must not shove you
items.pz: overflow-anchor:auto 默认开；固定高度占位更稳。
items.pe: overflow-anchor is on by default; reserve height anyway.

items.dz: 还能滚就有一道阴影
items.de: A shadow says there is more
items.pz: 用 background-attachment:local 的渐变自动出现/消失。
items.pe: Local-attachment gradients appear only when scrollable.

items.dz: 首屏底部给一个下滑暗示
items.de: A hint to keep going
items.pz: 小箭头轻微上下浮动，滚动 1 屏后消失。
items.pe: A gently bobbing arrow that leaves after one screen.

items.dz: 右侧点标出你在第几节
items.de: Dots on the right mark your place
items.pz: 每节一个 view timeline，当前节的点放大。
items.pe: One view timeline per section; scale the active dot.

items.dz: 一路滚一路推进画面
items.de: Scrolling pushes into the image
items.pz: scale 与 clip-path 同时跟进度，比纯缩放有层次。
items.pe: Scale plus clip-path reads deeper than scale alone.

items.dz: 标题随滚动变大变紧
items.de: The headline grows and tightens
items.pz: font-size 与 letter-spacing 一起插值才自然。
items.pe: Interpolate size and tracking together.

items.dz: 线随滚动画出来
items.de: The line draws as you scroll
items.pz: stroke-dashoffset 绑定 scroll 进度，pathLength=1 好算。
items.pe: Bind stroke-dashoffset to progress with pathLength 1.

items.dz: 滚动过程中形状变了
items.de: The shape changes on the way
items.pz: border-radius 与 clip-path 都可跟进度，一次只变一个。
items.pe: Radius or clip-path — change one, not both.

items.dz: 横滚看图，纵滚翻章
items.de: Sideways for images, down for chapters
items.pz: 内层 overflow-x:auto + snap，别劫持纵向滚动。
items.pe: Inner overflow-x with snap; never hijack vertical scroll.

items.dz: 滚动就是拖时间轴
items.de: Scroll is the timeline
items.pz: currentTime = progress*duration；视频要 preload 且无音轨。
items.pe: currentTime = progress × duration; preload, no audio track.

items.dz: 别抢用户的滚动手感
items.de: Do not steal the scroll
items.pz: 要么完全接管一屏并可退出，要么彻底不改。
items.pe: Either fully own one screen with an exit, or leave it alone.

items.dz: 手机上别自己做平滑
items.de: Do not fake smoothing on phones
items.pz: 移动端关掉 Lenis，交给系统惯性最跟手。
items.pe: Disable smooth scrolling on touch — native inertia wins.

items.dz: 关掉视差只留淡入
items.de: Parallax off, fade stays
items.pz: prefers-reduced-motion 下取消所有位移与缩放。
items.pe: Drop translate and scale under reduced motion.

items.dz: 滚到附近才加载
items.de: Load just before it is needed
items.pz: loading="lazy" + fetchpriority，首屏图反而要 eager。
items.pe: loading="lazy" with fetchpriority; hero images stay eager.

items.dz: 章节之间要有硬切换
items.de: Chapters need a hard cut
items.pz: 整块背景色互换 + 一条 1px 线，别做渐变过渡。
items.pe: Swap the background and add a hairline — no gradient fade.

items.dz: 读到底按钮才升起
items.de: The button rises at the end
items.pz: 最后一屏用 view timeline 抬起 CTA，只做一次。
items.pe: Raise the CTA on the last screen, once.

items.dz: 目录高亮当前章节
items.de: The outline tracks your section
items.pz: 每节 view timeline 切高亮，点击用 scrollTo 平滑跳。
items.pe: Highlight by view timeline; jump with a smooth scrollTo.

items.dz: 滚动擦出对比图
items.de: Scroll wipes between two images
items.pz: clip-path 的 inset 右值跟进度，两图完全重合。
items.pe: Tie the clip inset to progress with the images aligned.

items.dz: 页脚从下方被拉出来
items.de: The footer is pulled up from under
items.pz: 正文 sticky 到底，页脚在其下方随滚动露出。
items.pe: Sticky the body; let the footer emerge underneath.

items.dz: 过去的内容变虚
items.de: Passed content softens
items.pz: exit 区间加 blur 与降低 opacity，别超过 6px。
items.pe: Blur and fade on the exit range, under 6px.

items.dz: 角落显示当前章节名
items.de: The corner names your chapter
items.pz: 进入某节时替换文字，用 200ms 交叉淡入。
items.pe: Cross-fade the label in 200ms on section change.

items.dz: 首屏元素滚动后变成导航项
items.de: The hero mark becomes the nav mark
items.pz: 同一元素两处位置之间插值，配 position:sticky。
items.pe: Interpolate one element between two anchors.

dz: Matter.js / Rapier：不写关键帧，写世界规则
de: Matter.js and Rapier — write world rules, not keyframes

items.dz: 东西自己往下掉
items.de: Things fall on their own
items.pz: engine.gravity.y=1，像素世界用 0.8–1.2 最像地球。
items.pe: engine.gravity.y around 1 reads as Earth.

items.dz: 弹得高还是啪一下就停
items.de: Bouncy or dead
items.pz: restitution 0 完全不弹，0.9 接近皮球。
items.pe: restitution 0 is dead, 0.9 is a rubber ball.

items.dz: 滑一段就停
items.de: It slides, then stops
items.pz: friction + frictionAir 一起调，空气阻力常被忘。
items.pe: Tune friction and frictionAir together.

items.dz: 重的推不动，轻的一碰就飞
items.de: Heavy resists, light flies
items.pz: density 决定质量，别用 mass 直接赋值。
items.pe: Set density and let mass follow.

items.dz: 堆高了就会塌
items.de: Stack it high and it falls
items.pz: 静止堆叠要开 sleeping，否则一直抖。
items.pe: Enable sleeping for resting stacks or they jitter.

items.dz: 一个推倒一串
items.de: One topples the rest
items.pz: 每块间距略小于高度，倒下才连锁。
items.pe: Spacing slightly under the height keeps the chain going.

items.dz: 吊着的东西自己摆
items.de: Hung things swing
items.pz: Constraint 的 stiffness=1 当刚性杆，<0.1 当橡皮筋。
items.pe: Constraint stiffness 1 is a rod, under 0.1 a rubber band.

items.dz: 两头交替摆，中间不动
items.de: The ends trade, the middle rests
items.pz: 等质量球排成一线，restitution 接近 1。
items.pe: Equal masses in a line with restitution near 1.

items.dz: 一串关节像绳子
items.de: Jointed segments read as rope
items.pz: Composites.stack + Composites.chain，节数别超 20。
items.pe: Composites.chain over a stack; keep under 20 links.

items.dz: 一张布被吹起来
items.de: Fabric catches the wind
items.pz: Composites.softBody 的行列弹簧，crossBrace 打开更稳。
items.pe: Composites.softBody with crossBrace enabled.

items.dz: 一坨可以被挤扁
items.de: A blob you can squash
items.pz: 内部压力约束 + 外圈弹簧，别用刚体近似。
items.pe: Pressure constraint inside, springs around.

items.dz: 能抓住物体拖走
items.de: You can grab and drag bodies
items.pz: MouseConstraint 的 stiffness 0.2 才有拉扯手感。
items.pe: MouseConstraint stiffness 0.2 gives the pull a feel.

items.dz: 松手时带着速度飞出去
items.de: Release carries the velocity
items.pz: 松手速度取最近 3 帧位移平均，避免抖动。
items.pe: Average the last three frames for release velocity.

items.dz: 有些物体互相穿过
items.de: Some bodies ignore each other
items.pz: collisionFilter 的 category / mask 位运算。
items.pe: Bitwise category and mask on collisionFilter.

items.dz: 进区域触发但不阻挡
items.de: It triggers without blocking
items.pz: isSensor:true 的 body 只报碰撞不产生反作用力。
items.pe: isSensor bodies report contacts without response.

items.dz: 看看这条线撞到什么
items.de: What does this ray hit
items.pz: Query.ray 或 Rapier 的 castRay，做视线与落点预测。
items.pe: Query.ray or Rapier castRay for line of sight.

items.dz: 一下把它打出去
items.de: One hit sends it flying
items.pz: applyForce 是持续力，冲量要一帧内给完。
items.pe: applyForce is continuous; an impulse lands in one step.

items.dz: 被拧着转起来
items.de: Twisted into a spin
items.pz: body.torque 累加角速度，注意 inertia 会抵抗。
items.pe: Torque accumulates angular velocity against inertia.

items.dz: 转着转着停下来
items.de: The spin winds down
items.pz: frictionAir 同时衰减线速度与角速度。
items.pe: frictionAir damps both linear and angular velocity.

items.dz: 沿斜面加速下滑
items.de: It accelerates down the ramp
items.pz: 静摩擦大于 tan(θ) 就不会动，先算再调。
items.pe: Static friction above tan(θ) means it never moves.

items.dz: 踩上去就被送走
items.de: Step on and be carried
items.pz: 每帧给接触物体设水平速度，不用移动地面。
items.pe: Set contact velocity each step; the belt itself stays put.

items.dz: 浮在水面上下起伏
items.de: It bobs on the surface
items.pz: 按浸没深度给向上力 ρ·g·V，再加水阻。
items.pe: Upward force by submerged volume, plus drag.

items.dz: 一阵阵地被吹歪
items.de: Gusts push it sideways
items.pz: 风是随时间变化的力场，别用常量。
items.pe: Wind is a time-varying field, not a constant.

items.dz: 靠近就被吸过去
items.de: It gets pulled in
items.pz: 力 ∝ 1/r²，要设最小距离防数值爆炸。
items.pe: Force ∝ 1/r² with a minimum distance clamp.

items.dz: 绕着中心不掉下去
items.de: It circles without falling in
items.pz: 初速度垂直于半径且等于 √(GM/r) 才是圆轨。
items.pe: A circular orbit needs v = √(GM/r) perpendicular to r.

items.dz: 中心炸开推走一切
items.de: Everything is pushed outward
items.pz: 对范围内每个 body 施加径向冲量，随距离衰减。
items.pe: Radial impulse to every body in range, falling with distance.

items.dz: 拉太狠就断了
items.de: Pull too hard and it snaps
items.pz: 每帧检查约束长度，超阈值就 remove。
items.pe: Check the constraint length each step and remove past a threshold.

items.dz: 一刀切成两半
items.de: One cut, two bodies
items.pz: 切线两侧顶点重建两个凸多边形，别切凹形。
items.pe: Rebuild two convex hulls from the split vertices.

items.dz: 关节乱晃地倒下去
items.de: It flops down by its joints
items.pz: 每关节设角度限制，否则会拧成麻花。
items.pe: Angle limits on every joint or it knots up.

items.dz: 车轮压过颠簸
items.de: Wheels absorb the bumps
items.pz: 轮子用 revolute 关节 + 悬挂用有阻尼的弹簧。
items.pe: Revolute joints for wheels, damped springs for suspension.

items.dz: 不动的就别算了
items.de: Stop simulating what has settled
items.pz: enableSleeping:true，静止 60 帧后进入睡眠。
items.pe: enableSleeping — bodies sleep after ~60 still frames.

items.dz: 高速物体不穿墙
items.de: Fast bodies stop tunnelling
items.pz: 每帧多跑 2–4 个子步，或开连续碰撞检测。
items.pe: Two to four substeps, or enable CCD.

items.dz: 同样输入必得同样结果
items.de: Same input, same outcome
items.pz: 固定步长 + 固定随机种子，才能录制回放。
items.pe: Fixed timestep plus a fixed seed makes replays possible.

items.dz: 物理 60Hz，画面 120Hz 也顺
items.de: Physics at 60Hz, display at 120
items.pz: 渲染时在上一步与当前步之间按余量插值。
items.pe: Interpolate between the last two physics states.

items.dz: 几千刚体还能实时
items.de: Thousands of bodies, real time
items.pz: Rapier 跑在 WASM 里，初始化是异步的。
items.pe: Rapier runs in WASM; init is async.

items.dz: 几块拼成一个物体
items.de: Several parts, one body
items.pz: Body.create({parts:[...]})，重心自动重算。
items.pe: Body.create with parts recomputes the centre of mass.

items.dz: 复杂形状用凸包代替
items.de: Approximate with a hull
items.pz: 凹形要分解成多个凸体（decomp），性能差很多。
items.pe: Concave shapes need decomposition — much costlier.

items.dz: 一个动作引发一串
items.de: One action, a cascade
items.pz: 碰撞事件里再施力，注意别在事件里改世界结构。
items.pe: Apply force in the collision event, but never mutate the world there.

items.dz: 界面元素也用弹簧不是曲线
items.de: UI motion by spring, not curve
items.pz: 把刚度/阻尼当设计参数，一套值贯穿全站。
items.pe: Treat stiffness and damping as design tokens.

items.dz: 拖完还滑一段再停
items.de: It coasts after the drag
items.pz: 速度 × 0.95 每帧衰减，低于 0.1px 归零。
items.pe: Decay velocity by 0.95 per frame, snap to zero under 0.1px.

items.dz: 一堆方块落进格子里
items.de: Blocks drop into their slots
items.pz: 物理落位后 snap 到网格，两段动效衔接。
items.pe: Let physics land it, then snap to the grid.

items.dz: 一坨会流动的液体
items.de: A liquid that actually flows
items.pz: SPH：邻域密度求压力，粒子数控制在 2k 内。
items.pe: SPH pressure from neighbour density; cap around 2k particles.

items.dz: 颗粒堆成一个锥
items.de: Grains pile into a cone
items.pz: 高摩擦小颗粒，休止角自然出现。
items.pe: High-friction small bodies find their own angle of repose.

items.dz: 手要够到某个点
items.de: The hand reaches the target
items.pz: FABRIK 迭代两三次就够，末端优先。
items.pe: Two or three FABRIK iterations is enough.

items.dz: 关节不能反折
items.de: Joints cannot bend backwards
items.pz: 给 revolute 设 min/max 角，UI 里也一样有效。
items.pe: Set min and max on revolute joints.

items.dz: 被驱动着匀速转
items.de: Driven at constant speed
items.pz: 设目标角速度与最大扭矩，别硬设角度。
items.pe: Target an angular velocity with a max torque.

items.dz: 别让东西飞出世界
items.de: Nothing escapes the world
items.pz: 四面静态墙 + 定期清理越界 body。
items.pe: Four static walls plus a periodic out-of-bounds sweep.

items.dz: 几百个就够讲故事
items.de: A few hundred bodies tells the story
items.pz: 视觉密度靠贴图与拖影，不靠更多刚体。
items.pe: Fake density with sprites and trails, not more bodies.

items.dz: 物理落位后交给 CSS 收尾
items.de: Physics lands it, CSS finishes
items.pz: 停下的瞬间读位置写成 transform，然后销毁世界。
items.pe: Read the resting transform, write it to CSS, drop the world.

items.dz: 关掉物理只留状态
items.de: Drop the simulation, keep the state
items.pz: reduced-motion 下直接给最终位置，不跑模拟。
items.pe: Under reduced motion, jump to the final layout.

dz: p5 那一派：写规则、给种子，让画面自己长出来
de: The p5 school — write rules, plant a seed, let the image grow

items.dz: 同一个种子永远长成同一张
items.de: One seed, always the same piece
items.pz: randomSeed(n) 或自带 PRNG，作品才可复现、可收藏。
items.pe: randomSeed(n) or your own PRNG makes the work reproducible.

items.dz: 随机但不抽搐
items.de: Random without the twitch
items.pz: 用 noise(t) 而不是 random()，路径才连续。
items.pe: noise(t) instead of random() keeps the path continuous.

items.dz: 每格的值来自同一片噪声
items.de: One noise field, sampled per cell
items.pz: noise(x*0.08, y*0.08) 决定大小/旋转，尺度别太大。
items.pe: Sample noise(x·0.08, y·0.08) for size or rotation.

items.dz: 几千条线顺着场走出纹理
items.de: Thousands of lines find the field
items.pz: 角度 = noise*TAU，每条线走 150 步、alpha 0.06。
items.pe: Angle = noise·TAU; 150 steps per line at alpha 0.06.

items.dz: 不重叠地塞满画面
items.de: Fill the frame without overlap
items.pz: 随机撒点、半径长到碰到别人就停（放松法）。
items.pe: Grow each radius until it touches a neighbour.

items.dz: 随机但间距均匀
items.de: Random, evenly spaced
items.pz: Bridson 算法保证任意两点距离 ≥ r。
items.pe: Bridson's algorithm guarantees a minimum spacing.

items.dz: 大块不停切成小块
items.de: Big blocks keep splitting
items.pz: 按概率决定继续切还是停，深度上限 5–6。
items.pe: Split by probability, cap the depth at five or six.

items.dz: 横竖切分 + 少量色块
items.de: Orthogonal splits, a few colour fields
items.pz: 只用三原色 + 黑白，色块占比别超过 25%。
items.pe: Three primaries plus black and white, under 25% colour.

items.dz: 斜线把网格串起来
items.de: Diagonals lace the grid
items.pz: 每格随机选一条对角线（10 PRINT 那一招）。
items.pe: Pick one diagonal per cell — the 10 PRINT trick.

items.dz: 四分之一圆拼出迷宫
items.de: Quarter arcs make a labyrinth
items.pz: 两种瓦片随机放置，接缝必须对齐。
items.pe: Two tile variants placed at random with aligned seams.

items.dz: 像向日葵那样排点
items.de: Sunflower seed packing
items.pe: Angle i × 137.5°, radius c√i.

items.dz: 两个圆滚出花纹
items.de: Two circles trace a rosette
items.pz: 内外半径比是有理数才闭合。
items.pe: The radius ratio must be rational to close.

items.dz: 两个正弦画出的结
items.de: A knot from two sines
items.pz: x=sin(at+δ), y=sin(bt)，a:b 决定形状。
items.pe: x = sin(at + δ), y = sin(bt); a:b sets the shape.

items.dz: 带衰减的摆线
items.de: Damped pendulum drawing
items.pz: 四个衰减正弦叠加，衰减率决定收敛速度。
items.pe: Four damped sines; the decay rate sets the collapse.

items.dz: 花瓣数由参数决定
items.de: The petal count is a parameter
items.pz: r = cos(kθ)，k 为整数时花瓣数是 k 或 2k。
items.pe: r = cos(kθ) — petals are k or 2k.

items.dz: 两层细纹叠出第三种图案
items.de: Two grids, a third pattern
items.pz: 两层间距接近、角度差 1–3° 时最明显。
items.pe: Strongest at a 1–3° offset between near-equal grids.

items.dz: 点越大越暗
items.de: Bigger dots, darker value
items.pz: 点半径 ∝ 目标灰度，网格角度 45° 最不显眼。
items.pe: Radius by value; a 45° screen angle hides the grid.

items.dz: 像地形图那样的层线
items.de: Contours like a topo map
items.pz: marching squares 提取等值线，层距要一致。
items.pe: Marching squares with an even interval.

items.dz: 几条吸引/排斥规则长出生态
items.de: Attraction rules grow an ecosystem
items.pz: 每种颜色对其他颜色有不同吸引力矩阵。
items.pe: A per-colour attraction matrix does all the work.

items.dz: 像霜一样长出枝
items.de: It branches like frost
items.pz: 随机漫步的粒子碰到就粘住，形成分形枝。
items.pe: Random walkers stick on contact and branch.

items.dz: 群体留下的轨迹本身是画
items.de: The flock draws the piece
items.pz: 给每只 boid 留低 alpha 拖影，跑 30 秒。
items.pe: Low-alpha trails, thirty seconds of runtime.

items.dz: 按邻接规则拼出连贯图案
items.de: Tiles resolve by adjacency rules
items.pz: 每格保留可能性集合，最低熵优先坍缩。
items.pe: Collapse the lowest-entropy cell first.

items.dz: 下一块取决于上一块
items.de: Each tile depends on the last
items.pz: 状态转移矩阵决定序列，比纯随机有节奏。
items.pe: A transition matrix gives rhythm that pure random lacks.

items.dz: 规整里加一点不规整
items.de: Order with a little disorder
items.pz: 每格位置加 ±10% 抖动，比完全随机好看。
items.pe: Jitter each cell ±10% — better than full randomness.

items.dz: 生成式作品最难的是配色
items.de: Colour is the hard part
items.pz: 固定 2 主 1 辅，色相差 30/150/180 三选一。
items.pe: Two dominants and one accent; hue gaps of 30, 150 or 180.

items.dz: 同一构图换配色就是新作
items.de: Same composition, new palette
items.pz: 把颜色抽成索引，色表可整体替换。
items.pe: Index the colours so the table can be swapped.

items.dz: 一层噪点让画面有实体感
items.de: Grain gives it a body
items.pz: 叠 4–8% 的噪点，混合模式用 overlay。
items.pe: Four to eight percent noise on overlay.

items.dz: 像印在纸上
items.de: It sits on paper
items.pz: 两层低对比噪声 + 极轻的暖色偏移。
items.pe: Two low-contrast noise layers and a warm cast.

items.dz: 两色错版印刷感
items.de: Two-colour print misregistration
items.pz: 两个色版各偏移 1–2px，混合模式 multiply。
items.pe: Offset each plate 1–2px and multiply.

items.dz: 色块叠出第三种颜色
items.de: Overlaps make a third colour
items.pz: 三个半透明色块 multiply 叠加，边缘略错位。
items.pe: Three translucent fields multiplied, edges slightly off.

items.dz: 灰度映射到两个色
items.de: Greyscale into two colours
items.pz: 暗部一色、亮部一色，中间线性插值。
items.pe: One colour for shadows, one for highlights.

items.dz: 整幅画由字符组成
items.de: The image is made of characters
items.pz: 按亮度选字符，等宽字体 + 行高 1 才不变形。
items.pe: Monospace at line-height 1 or the aspect breaks.

items.dz: 把字当图形用
items.de: Letters as pure shape
items.pz: 大字裁切 + 局部放大，别怕看不清全字。
items.pe: Crop and blow up — legibility is not the goal.

items.dz: 字形由参数生成
items.de: Letterforms from parameters
items.pz: 骨架 + 可变笔宽/衬线开关，一套参数一套字。
items.pe: A skeleton plus stroke and serif parameters.

items.dz: 有限模块组合出无限版式
items.de: A few modules, endless layouts
items.pz: 定义 4–6 个模块与放置规则，其余交给随机。
items.pe: Define four to six modules and placement rules.

items.dz: 一条重写规则长成树
items.de: A rewrite rule becomes a tree
items.pz: F→FF+[+F-F-F]-[-F+F+F]，角度 22–25° 最像植物。
items.pe: Angles of 22–25° read as plants.

items.dz: 每一枝再分两枝
items.de: Each branch splits again
items.pz: 递归 6 层就够密，长度每层 ×0.7。
items.pe: Six levels, each 0.7 the length.

items.dz: 一直放大都还有细节
items.de: Detail all the way down
items.pz: 双精度到 1e-14 就该换 perturbation 算法。
items.pe: Past 1e-14, switch to perturbation maths.

items.dz: 参数一动形状全变
items.de: One parameter, a whole new shape
items.pz: c 沿一条路径移动，形状连续变形。
items.pe: Move c along a path for continuous morphing.

items.dz: 混沌里的稳定形状
items.de: A stable shape inside chaos
items.pz: Lorenz / Clifford 迭代十万次，点越多越亮。
items.pe: Iterate a Clifford or Lorenz map 100k times.

items.dz: 随机跳一半，跳出谢尔宾斯基
items.de: Random half-steps draw Sierpiński
items.pz: 每次朝随机顶点走一半，十万点后成三角。
items.pe: Step halfway to a random vertex, 100k times.

items.dz: 一条线由无数细点组成
items.de: A line made of dust
items.pz: 沿路径撒点，垂直方向高斯抖动。
items.pe: Scatter along the path with a Gaussian normal offset.

items.dz: 边缘不规则、颜色不均
items.de: Ragged edge, uneven wash
items.pz: 多边形顶点递归扰动 + 多层 3% 透明叠加。
items.pe: Recursively perturb a polygon and stack 3% layers.

items.dz: 墨顺着纸纹爬
items.de: Ink crawls along the grain
items.pz: 各向异性扩散：沿纸纹方向的扩散率更高。
items.pe: Anisotropic diffusion, faster along the grain.

items.dz: 用点的密度表现明暗
items.de: Density carries the tone
items.pz: Lloyd relaxation 让点分布贴合灰度图。
items.pe: Lloyd relaxation fits the dots to the tone map.

items.dz: 排线方向跟着明暗走
items.de: Hatch direction follows the form
items.pz: 按梯度方向排线，交叉两层表现暗部。
items.pe: Hatch along the gradient; cross-hatch the shadows.

items.dz: 白线深底的工程感
items.de: White lines on a deep field
items.pz: 细网格 + 粗主线 + 单一强调色。
items.pe: Fine grid, heavier majors, one accent.

items.dz: 一笔到底的线稿
items.de: One continuous pen path
items.pz: 路径优化成最短单笔路线（TSP art）。
items.pe: Optimise into one shortest path — TSP art.

items.dz: 大字 + 大留白 + 一个色块
items.de: Big type, big space, one field
items.pz: 版面只放三样东西：标题、图形、一行小字。
items.pe: Three elements only: headline, shape, one line of small type.

items.dz: 一秒生成一百个版式
items.de: A hundred layouts a second
items.pz: 把网格位置、字号、色块当参数随机组合。
items.pe: Randomise slot, size and field as parameters.

items.dz: 同一份代码出 4K
items.de: The same code prints at 4K
items.pz: 所有尺寸用相对单位，导出时只改画布尺寸。
items.pe: Size everything relatively; export by changing the canvas.

items.dz: 看不出起点和终点
items.de: No visible start or end
items.pz: 所有参数用 sin(t·2π) 驱动，t 归一化到 0–1。
items.pe: Drive everything by sin(t·2π) with t in 0–1.

items.dz: 导成视频而不是录屏
items.de: Render frames, do not screen-record
items.pz: 固定 deltaTime 逐帧渲染再合成，才不掉帧。
items.pe: Render with a fixed delta and encode after.

items.dz: 把可能性摊开来看
items.de: Lay the possibilities out
items.pz: 同一算法排成网格，两个轴各扫一个参数。
items.pe: Grid the outputs, one parameter per axis.

items.dz: 生成一千张，挑三张
items.de: Generate a thousand, keep three
items.pz: 生成式的作者身份在于筛选，不在于随机。
items.pe: Authorship in generative work is curation, not randomness.

dz: pretext 那一派：断行、度量、基线都可计算，也都可以动起来
de: The pretext school — line breaking, metrics and baselines as computable, animatable state

items.dz: 整段一起算，不是一行一行贪心
items.de: The paragraph is optimised as a whole
items.pz: 给每个断点算 badness，动态规划求全段最小总代价。
items.pe: Score each breakpoint by badness and dynamic-program the paragraph.

items.dz: 两行长短接近才像标题
items.de: Lines of similar length read as a title
items.pz: text-wrap:balance，或自己二分栏宽求最小行长方差。
items.pe: text-wrap: balance, or binary-search the measure for minimal variance.

items.dz: 最后一行不能只剩一个词
items.de: The last line never holds one word
items.pz: text-wrap:pretty；引擎侧则给末行加惩罚项。
items.pe: text-wrap: pretty — engine-side, penalise short last lines.

items.dz: 窄栏靠断词救回来
items.de: Narrow columns need hyphens
items.pz: Liang 算法查词典给断点，最少留 2 / 3 个字母。
items.pe: Liang patterns for breakpoints; keep 2 before, 3 after.

items.dz: 别让空白连成一条河
items.de: No white river down the column
items.pz: 词距惩罚 + 相邻行空隙对齐检测，必要时改断点。
items.pe: Penalise word-space stretch and detect vertically aligned gaps.

items.dz: 排版前先量，量完一次成型
items.de: Measure first, lay out once
items.pz: canvas measureText 或一次性 Range.getClientRects，别循环读 layout。
items.pe: Use canvas measureText or one batched Range.getClientRects.

items.dz: 框贴着字，不多一像素
items.de: The box hugs the text exactly
items.pz: width:fit-content 或按最长行宽度定框，气泡才不虚胖。
items.pe: fit-content, or size the box by the longest line.

items.dz: 字号自动缩到刚好装满
items.de: Type scales to fill exactly
items.pz: 二分字号直到测量宽高刚好不溢出，缓存结果。
items.pe: Binary-search the size until it just fits; cache the result.

items.dz: 所有文字都落在同一套横线上
items.de: Every line lands on the same rails
items.pz: 行高取网格整数倍（如 4px 的 6 倍），首行做 half-leading 补偿。
items.pe: Line-height as a multiple of the grid; compensate the first line.

items.dz: 首行上方那点多余空白要去掉
items.de: Kill the extra space above the first line
items.pz: text-box-trim / leading-trim，或用 cap-height 手算偏移。
items.pe: text-box-trim, or offset by cap-height manually.

items.dz: 引号和 A 要挂到栏外一点
items.de: Quotes and A hang past the margin
items.pz: 按字形左右侧承（side bearing）负外移，别整体缩进。
items.pe: Nudge by side bearing, not by indenting the block.

items.dz: 行首标点挂出去
items.de: Leading punctuation hangs outside
items.pz: hanging-punctuation:first last，中文引号尤其需要。
items.pe: hanging-punctuation: first last — essential for CJK quotes.

items.dz: 中文全角标点该压掉一半
items.de: Full-width punctuation gives back half its width
items.pz: text-spacing-trim 或按字形类别压缩标点前后间距。
items.pe: text-spacing-trim, or compress by punctuation class.

items.dz: 汉字与英文之间要留四分之一空
items.de: A quarter space between Han and Latin
items.pz: text-autospace / 手动插 U+2009，别用普通空格。
items.pe: text-autospace, or insert a thin space — not a normal one.

items.dz: AV、To 这类组合要收紧
items.de: AV and To need pulling together
items.pz: font-kerning:normal 交给字体的 kern 表，别全局加 letter-spacing。
items.pe: font-kerning: normal — trust the font, not a global tracking value.

items.dz: 字越大字距越紧
items.de: Bigger type, tighter tracking
items.pz: letter-spacing 用 em 并随 clamp 递减：标题 -0.035em，正文 0。
items.pe: Track in em: −0.035em at display sizes, 0 in body.

items.dz: 用宽度轴而不是缩放
items.de: Use the width axis, not scale
items.pz: font-variation-settings 的 wdth 轴插值，字形不会变形。
items.pe: Interpolate the wdth axis so glyphs never distort.

items.dz: 字重连续变化，不跳档
items.de: Weight moves continuously
items.pz: wght 轴可插值：400→700 之间任意值都合法。
items.pe: The wght axis is continuous — 400 → 700 with no steps.

items.dz: 小字加粗一点才看得清
items.de: Small sizes need more weight
items.pz: opsz 轴让字体自己在小号时加粗、大号时收细。
items.pe: The opsz axis thickens small text and refines display sizes.

items.dz: 数字跳动时列不抖
items.de: Columns stop twitching
items.pz: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums，所有会变的数字都要开。
items.pe: tabular-nums on anything that changes.

items.dz: 真小型大写不是缩小的大写
items.de: Real small caps are not shrunk capitals
items.pz: font-variant-caps:small-caps，字体没这套就别硬做。
items.pe: font-variant-caps: small-caps — skip it if the font lacks them.

items.dz: fi、ffl 要连起来
items.de: fi and ffl should join
items.pz: font-variant-ligatures:common-ligatures；等宽代码字体反而要关。
items.pe: Enable common ligatures; disable them in code faces.

items.dz: 首字母占三行高
items.de: The first letter owns three lines
items.pz: initial-letter:3，配 initial-letter-align 对齐基线。
items.pe: initial-letter: 3 with initial-letter-align.

items.dz: 要么缩进，要么段间距，别都要
items.de: Indent or space — never both
items.pz: text-indent:1.5em 且段间距归零，是书籍排法。
items.pe: text-indent 1.5em with zero paragraph margin.

items.dz: 项目符号挂在文本外
items.de: Bullets hang outside the text block
items.pz: padding-left + text-indent 负值，或 list-style-position:outside。
items.pe: Positive padding with a negative text-indent.

items.dz: 最后一栏不能空一半
items.de: The last column must not be half empty
items.pz: column-fill:balance，或计算后强制断栏。
items.pe: column-fill: balance, or force breaks after measuring.

items.dz: 别让一行孤零零跑到下一栏
items.de: No single line stranded in the next column
items.pz: orphans / widows:2，分栏与分页都生效。
items.pe: orphans and widows: 2 — works for columns and print.

items.dz: 脚注跟着引用所在页
items.de: Notes stay with their reference
items.pz: 先排正文测高，再把脚注塞进剩余高度，超出则往后推。
items.pe: Lay out body first, then fit notes into the leftover height.

items.dz: 页眉写着当前章节
items.de: The header knows its section
items.pz: 排版时记录每页首个标题，回填到页眉。
items.pe: Record the first heading per page and back-fill the header.

items.dz: 字跟着曲线走
items.de: Letters ride the curve
items.pz: SVG textPath + startOffset；每字自转要单独算切线。
items.pe: SVG textPath with startOffset; per-glyph rotation needs tangents.

items.dz: 一圈字围成徽章
items.de: Type wrapped into a seal
items.pz: 每字 rotate(i*360/n) + translateY(-r)，字距按弧长算。
items.pe: rotate(i · 360/n) with translateY(−r); space by arc length.

items.dz: 中文竖着读
items.de: CJK read top to bottom
items.pz: writing-mode:vertical-rl，数字用 text-combine-upright。
items.pe: writing-mode: vertical-rl; combine digits upright.

items.dz: 阿拉伯语和数字混排不乱
items.de: Arabic and digits keep their order
items.pz: dir="auto" + Unicode 隔离符 U+2068/2069，别手动反转。
items.pe: dir="auto" with isolate marks — never reverse strings by hand.

items.dz: 窄屏行高大一点
items.de: Narrow screens need more leading
items.pz: line-height:calc(1.2 + .35*(60ch - 100%)/40ch) 之类的插值。
items.pe: Interpolate leading against the measure, not the viewport.

items.dz: 一行 45–75 个字符最好读
items.de: 45–75 characters per line
items.pz: max-width:65ch 是最省事的可读性修复。
items.pe: max-width: 65ch is the cheapest readability fix there is.

items.dz: 换栏宽时每行弹到新位置
items.de: Lines spring to their new places
items.pz: 断行结果变化时，对每行的 y 用弹簧插值而不是重绘。
items.pe: Spring each line to its new y instead of repainting.

items.dz: 两个字之间连续变形
items.de: One glyph melts into another
items.pz: 同一可变字体的两个实例插值，跨字体要先做轮廓匹配。
items.pe: Interpolate two instances of one variable font.

items.dz: 只重排改动的那几段
items.de: Only the touched paragraphs re-lay out
items.pz: 缓存每段的断行结果，脏标记驱动局部重排。
items.pe: Cache per-paragraph breaks and re-run only the dirty ones.

items.dz: 十万行也能秒滚
items.de: Instant scroll on 100k lines
items.pz: 按行高预估总高，只渲染可视窗口 ± 缓冲。
items.pe: Estimate total height by line height; render the window plus buffer.

items.dz: 读写分离，一帧只布局一次
items.de: Read then write, one layout per frame
items.pz: 先批量读 rect，再批量改样式，别交替。
items.pe: Batch all reads, then all writes — never interleave.

items.dz: 换字体不跳版
items.de: Swapping fonts must not reflow
items.pz: size-adjust + ascent-override 把回退字体对齐到主字体度量。
items.pe: size-adjust and ascent-override align the fallback metrics.

items.dz: 先看得见，再变漂亮
items.de: Readable first, refined second
items.pz: font-display:swap 配度量兼容回退，CLS 才为 0。
items.pe: font-display: swap plus metric-compatible fallbacks keeps CLS at zero.

items.dz: 首屏只下那几十个字形
items.de: Ship only the glyphs above the fold
items.pz: unicode-range 分片 + 中文按字频分包。
items.pe: Split by unicode-range; chunk CJK by frequency.

items.dz: 小字号笔画交叉处要留缝
items.de: Tiny type needs relief at the joins
items.pz: 选带 ink trap 的字体，或用 opsz 轴代劳。
items.pe: Pick a face with ink traps, or let the opsz axis handle it.

items.dz: 字号来自一条比例
items.de: Sizes come from one ratio
items.pz: 1.25 或 1.333 的等比数列，只用其中 5–6 级。
items.pe: A 1.25 or 1.333 ratio — use only five or six steps.

items.dz: 段距是行高的整数倍
items.de: Spacing in multiples of the leading
items.pz: 所有纵向间距取 line-height 的 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 倍。
items.pe: All vertical space at 0.5×, 1× or 1.5× the leading.

items.dz: 图标要对齐字的高度而非行盒
items.de: Icons align to cap height, not the line box
items.pz: 按 cap-height 计算偏移，别用 vertical-align:middle 敷衍。
items.pe: Offset by cap-height instead of vertical-align: middle.

items.dz: 位数变化时不推挤后面
items.de: Adding a digit must not shove the rest
items.pz: 数字容器给 min-width:Nch 并右对齐。
items.pe: Give the number min-width in ch and right-align it.

items.dz: 文件名要保住后缀
items.de: Keep the extension visible
items.pz: 按字符宽度从中间裁，别用 text-overflow 一刀切尾。
items.pe: Trim from the middle by measured width, not text-overflow.

items.dz: 第三行末尾接省略号
items.de: Ellipsis at the end of line three
items.pz: -webkit-line-clamp:3 配 overflow:hidden，行高必须固定。
items.pe: -webkit-line-clamp: 3 with a fixed line-height.

items.dz: 只在需要时才断
items.de: It only breaks when it must
items.pz: 在长复合词里插 ­，比 hyphens:auto 更可控。
items.pe: Insert soft hyphens in long compounds for precise control.

items.dz: 数字和单位不能被拆开
items.de: Never split a number from its unit
items.pz: 3 425 ha —— 单位、姓名缩写都该用 nbsp。
items.pe: Use nbsp between value and unit, and after initials.

items.dz: 直引号是错的
items.de: Straight quotes are a bug
items.pz: 排版时把直引号替换成 “ ” ‘ ’，代码块除外。
items.pe: Replace straight quotes with typographic ones — outside code.

items.dz: 连字号、短破折、长破折各有其用
items.de: Hyphen, en dash and em dash each have a job
items.pz: -连词、–范围、—插入语，中文用——占两格。
items.pe: Hyphen joins, en dash ranges, em dash interrupts.

items.dz: 按纸张高度切页
items.de: Break by paper height
items.pz: break-inside:avoid 保护卡片，标题后禁止断页。
items.pe: break-inside: avoid on cards; no break right after a heading.

items.dz: 改了哪一行看得见
items.de: You can see which line moved
items.pz: 两次断行结果做 diff，只给变化的行加过渡。
items.pe: Diff the two break solutions and transition only the changed lines.

dz: 不装库也能做的那一批：WAAPI、@starting-style、anchor、popover
de: What ships in the browser — WAAPI, @starting-style, anchor, popover

items.dz: 一行 JS 起一段动效
items.de: One line of JS, one animation
items.pz: el.animate(keyframes,{duration:300,easing,fill:"both"})
items.pe: el.animate(keyframes, { duration: 300, fill: "both" })

items.dz: 拿到正在跑的动效再改它
items.de: Grab what is running and retune it
items.pz: el.getAnimations({subtree:true}) 后改 playbackRate / currentTime。
items.pe: Mutate playbackRate or currentTime on the returned animations.

items.dz: 等动效结束再做下一步
items.de: Await the end, then continue
items.pz: await anim.finished 比 animationend 事件可靠。
items.pe: await anim.finished beats the animationend event.

items.dz: 动效结束后保留终态
items.de: Keep the end state
items.pz: anim.commitStyles() 后 cancel()，比 fill:forwards 干净。
items.pe: commitStyles then cancel — cleaner than fill: forwards.

items.dz: 同一段动效可快可慢可倒放
items.de: Same beat, any speed or direction
items.pz: anim.playbackRate=-1 就是倒放，UI 收起最常用。
items.pe: playbackRate −1 reverses — ideal for closing states.

items.dz: 中途打断就原路返回
items.de: Interrupt and it retraces
items.pz: anim.reverse() 从当前进度反向，不会跳。
items.pe: reverse() runs back from the current time — no jump.

items.dz: 多个元素严格同步
items.de: Several elements, one clock
items.pz: 多个 animation 共用 timeline 与 startTime。
items.pe: Share one timeline and startTime across animations.

items.dz: 刚出现的元素也能有过渡
items.de: Even newly added elements transition
items.pz: @starting-style 给初次渲染值，配 transition-behavior。
items.pe: @starting-style supplies the first-render value.

items.dz: display 与 visibility 也能过渡
items.de: Even display can transition
items.pz: transition-behavior:allow-discrete，配 @starting-style 才完整。
items.pe: allow-discrete plus @starting-style completes the pattern.

items.dz: 不写 JS 也能有浮层
items.de: Overlays without JS
items.pz: popover + popovertarget，自带 top-layer 与 ESC 关闭。
items.pe: popover with popovertarget gives you the top layer and ESC.

items.dz: 焦点陷阱和遮罩都自带
items.de: Focus trap and scrim included
items.pz: showModal() + ::backdrop 过渡，别再手搓遮罩。
items.pe: showModal() with a ::backdrop transition.

items.dz: 浮层贴着触发器，自动避让
items.de: The overlay sticks to its trigger
items.pz: anchor-name + position-anchor + position-try-fallbacks。
items.pe: anchor-name, position-anchor and position-try-fallbacks.

items.dz: 整页切换由浏览器补间
items.de: The browser tweens the page swap
items.pz: startViewTransition + ::view-transition-group 自定义曲线。
items.pe: startViewTransition, then style ::view-transition-group.

items.dz: 前进和后退用不同过渡
items.de: Forward and back differ
items.pz: startViewTransition({types:["forward"]}) 后按类型写 CSS。
items.pe: Pass types, then branch the CSS on them.

items.dz: 让自定义属性可以被补间
items.de: Custom properties become animatable
items.pz: @property --x{syntax:"<length>";inherits:false;initial-value:0px}
items.pe: @property declares the syntax so it can interpolate.

items.dz: 渐变本身在动
items.de: The gradient stop itself moves
items.pz: 把色标位置声明为 @property 的 <percentage>。
items.pe: Declare the stop position as a typed percentage.

items.dz: 锥形渐变可以真的转
items.de: A conic gradient that really turns
items.pz: @property --a{syntax:"<angle>"} 后直接 animate。
items.pe: Type the angle and animate it directly.

items.dz: 按容器宽度换布局
items.de: Layout by container, not viewport
items.pz: container-type:inline-size 后写 @container 断点。
items.pe: container-type: inline-size, then @container rules.

items.dz: 字号跟着容器不是视口
items.de: Type scales to its container
items.pz: cqi / cqb 单位，卡片复用时不会崩。
items.pe: cqi and cqb keep reusable cards sane.

items.dz: 子元素状态影响父层样式
items.de: A child state restyles the parent
items.pz: .card:has(:focus-visible){...} 不用 JS 加 class。
items.pe: .card:has(:focus-visible) — no class toggling needed.

items.dz: 状态样式写在一起
items.de: States live with the rule
items.pz: 原生嵌套 + &:hover，别再靠预处理器。
items.pe: Native nesting with &:hover — no preprocessor.

items.dz: 样式只在一段 DOM 里生效
items.de: Styles bounded to a subtree
items.pz: @scope (.card) to (.content) 精确划边界。
items.pe: @scope (.card) to (.content) draws the boundary.

items.dz: 覆盖顺序变成显式的
items.de: Override order becomes explicit
items.pz: @layer reset,base,components,utilities 一次定完。
items.pe: Declare the layer order once, up front.

items.dz: 同一色系自动派生
items.de: Derive a whole ramp from one colour
items.pz: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 70%, white) 生成浅色态。
items.pe: color-mix in oklab derives tints and shades.

items.dz: 从一个色算出整套
items.de: One token, a whole scale
items.pz: oklch(from var(--c) calc(l + .1) c h) 派生更可控。
items.pe: oklch(from …) derives with real control.

items.dz: 一行搞定双主题
items.de: Both themes in one declaration
items.pz: color:light-dark(#3a5f7a,#eef4f8)，配 color-scheme。
items.pe: light-dark() with color-scheme set.

items.dz: 原生控件也跟品牌色
items.de: Native controls take the brand colour
items.pz: accent-color:#e8879c 一行改掉勾选框与滑块。
items.pe: accent-color restyles checkboxes and ranges in one line.

items.dz: 输入框跟着内容长
items.de: The input grows with its content
items.pz: field-sizing:content，配 max-inline-size 兜底。
items.pe: field-sizing: content with a max-inline-size cap.

items.dz: 标题均衡、正文避免孤字
items.de: balance for titles, pretty for body
items.pz: 标题 balance，正文 pretty，其他别乱用。
items.pe: balance for headings, pretty for prose.

items.dz: 卡片内部也对齐外层网格
items.de: Card innards align to the outer grid
items.pz: grid-template-rows:subgrid，让卡片各行严格对齐。
items.pe: subgrid keeps every card row on the same rails.

items.dz: 媒体位提前占好，不跳版
items.de: Reserve the box, no shift
items.pz: aspect-ratio:16/9 + object-fit:cover 是标配。
items.pe: aspect-ratio with object-fit: cover.

items.dz: 背景内容彻底不可交互
items.de: The background truly goes cold
items.pz: 打开浮层时给主内容加 inert，比 tabindex=-1 彻底。
items.pe: Mark the page inert behind an overlay.

items.dz: 只给键盘用户看焦点环
items.de: The ring is for keyboard users
items.pz: 别用 outline:none；鼠标点击不会触发它。
items.pe: Never outline: none — mouse clicks do not trigger it.

items.dz: 吸顶后自动换样式
items.de: Stuck elements restyle themselves
items.pz: @container scroll-state(stuck:top) 里改阴影与高度。
items.pe: @container scroll-state(stuck: top) — no scroll listener.

items.dz: 轮播圆点由 CSS 生成
items.de: CSS generates the carousel dots
items.pz: scroll-marker-group + ::scroll-marker，无需 JS 同步。
items.pe: scroll-marker-group keeps the dots in sync for free.

items.dz: 前后翻页按钮自带状态
items.de: Prev and next know when to disable
items.pz: ::scroll-button(left/right) 自动处理禁用态。
items.pe: ::scroll-button handles its own disabled state.

items.dz: 一个展开另一个自动收起
items.de: Opening one closes the rest
items.pz: 给多个 <details> 同一个 name 属性即可。
items.pe: Give several <details> the same name.

items.dz: 展开有过渡不是硬跳
items.de: Disclosure gets a transition
items.pz: interpolate-size:allow-keywords 让 height:auto 可过渡。
items.pe: interpolate-size makes height: auto transitionable.

items.dz: 对 auto 也能做数学
items.de: Maths on auto
items.pz: height:calc-size(auto, size + 12px)。
items.pe: height: calc-size(auto, size + 12px).

items.dz: 手机地址栏收起时不跳
items.de: No jump when the URL bar hides
items.pz: 首屏高度用 dvh，固定元素用 svh 更稳。
items.pe: dvh for hero height, svh for fixed chrome.

items.dz: 刘海和小白条都躲开
items.de: Clear the notch and the home bar
items.pz: padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + viewport-fit=cover。
items.pe: env(safe-area-inset-*) with viewport-fit=cover.

items.dz: 关键操作给一下轻震
items.de: A short tick on commit
items.pz: navigator.vibrate(10)，只在确认类操作上用。
items.pe: navigator.vibrate(10) — commits only.

items.dz: 调起系统分享面板
items.de: Bring up the system sheet
items.pz: navigator.share({title,url})，必须由用户手势触发。
items.pe: navigator.share must come from a user gesture.

items.dz: 未读数落在图标上
items.de: Unread count on the icon
items.pz: navigator.setAppBadge(n)，清零别忘。
items.pe: navigator.setAppBadge(n) — and clear it.

items.dz: 点之前就已经加载好了
items.de: Loaded before the click
items.pz: <script type="speculationrules"> 声明 prerender 候选。
items.pe: Declare prerender candidates in speculationrules.

items.dz: 有人真的会因为动效难受
items.de: Motion makes some people ill
items.pz: 默认无动效、逐步增强，比反过来安全。
items.pe: Design motion-free first, then enhance.

items.dz: 高对比下加粗边界
items.de: Stronger borders under high contrast
items.pz: 别只靠颜色区分状态，加形状或边框。
items.pe: Never encode state in colour alone.

items.dz: 系统高对比主题下还能看
items.de: Survives forced-colors mode
items.pz: 关键边框用 CanvasText，别写死颜色。
items.pe: Use system colour keywords for critical borders.

items.dz: 别给几百个元素都加
items.de: Do not hint hundreds of nodes
items.pz: 每屏最多 2–3 个提升层，用完就撤。
items.pe: Two or three promoted layers per screen, then remove.

items.dz: 把重绘关在一个盒子里
items.de: Repaints stay in the box
items.pz: contain:paint layout style 能砍掉大量无关重排。
items.pe: contain: paint layout style cuts unrelated reflow.

items.dz: 只动 transform / opacity / filter
items.de: Transform, opacity, filter — nothing else
items.pz: 动 width / top / box-shadow 会每帧重排重绘。
items.pe: Animating width or top forces layout every frame.

items.dz: 背景由代码画出来
items.de: The background is a program
items.pz: registerPaint 后 background:paint(myPattern)。
items.pe: registerPaint, then background: paint(name).

items.dz: 自己定义两个状态怎么过渡
items.de: Define your own tween
items.pz: @property + 自定义属性驱动多个声明同步变化。
items.pe: One typed property can drive several declarations.

items.dz: 触屏就别做悬停效果
items.de: No hover effects on touch
items.pz: @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) 才挂 hover。
items.pe: Gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
