dz: 流式、思考、引用、工具调用的视觉表达
de: Streaming, thinking, citing, calling tools — made visible

items.dz: 文字一段段涌出来
items.de: Text arriving in bursts
items.pz: 按 token 分块追加，不要逐字符定时器；块间 20–60ms。
items.pe: Append by token chunk, not a per-character timer; 20–60ms between chunks.

items.dz: 末尾有个方块光标
items.de: A block caret at the tail
items.pz: 生成中显示光标，结束立刻移除，别留着闪。
items.pe: Show while generating, remove the instant it finishes.

items.dz: 还在想：文字上有光在走
items.de: Thinking — a light walks the words
items.pz: 灰字 + 一道亮色渐变平移，比 spinner 更贴“正在思考”。
items.pe: Grey type with a travelling highlight — better than a spinner for “thinking”.

items.dz: 三个点依次起伏
items.de: Three dots taking turns
items.pz: 错峰 160ms，幅度 4px，1.2s 一轮。
items.pe: 160ms stagger, 4px travel, 1.2s cycle.

items.dz: 思考过程可以收起来
items.de: The reasoning can be folded away
items.pz: 默认折叠、生成时自动展开、完成后自动收起。
items.pe: Collapsed by default, auto-open while generating, auto-close when done.

items.dz: 一条条推理逐个出现
items.de: Steps appearing one at a time
items.pz: 每步一行 + 左侧连线，出现后变灰、当前步高亮。
items.pe: A line per step with a spine; past steps grey, current one lit.

items.dz: 调用了什么、结果如何
items.de: What was called, and what came back
items.pz: 三态：调用中（脉冲）、成功（对勾）、失败（可重试）。
items.pe: Three states: running (pulse), done (tick), failed (retry).

items.dz: 长任务要有进度
items.de: A long job needs a bar
items.pz: 未知时长用不确定条，已知则显示步数 3/7。
items.pe: Indeterminate when unknown; otherwise “step 3 of 7”.

items.dz: 每一步的耗时长条
items.de: A bar per step, by duration
items.pz: 横条起点表示开始时间，长度表示耗时，可并行重叠。
items.pe: Offset by start time, length by duration; parallel steps overlap.

items.dz: 句末一个可点的小标
items.de: A small tappable marker at the sentence end
items.pz: 上标数字或小圆标，悬停出来源卡片。
items.pe: A superscript number or chip; hover reveals the source card.

items.dz: 悬停弹出原文片段
items.de: Hover shows the source snippet
items.pz: 延迟 300ms 出现、120ms 消失，内容限 3 行。
items.pe: 300ms in, 120ms out, three lines max.

items.dz: 答案下面列出依据
items.de: The evidence under the answer
items.pz: 来源要有站点名、标题、更新时间三层信息。
items.pe: Each source needs site, title and date.

items.dz: 模型有多确定
items.de: How sure the model is
items.pz: 用三档（高/中/低）而不是精确百分比，减少误读。
items.pe: Three bands beat a false-precision percentage.

items.dz: 还剩多少上下文
items.de: How much context is left
items.pz: 接近上限时变色并提示会截断，别静默丢历史。
items.pe: Recolour near the limit and say it will truncate — never drop silently.

items.dz: 文字被切成一块块
items.de: Text sliced into chunks
items.pz: 相邻 token 用交替底色，比画边框更易读。
items.pe: Alternate tints per token instead of drawing borders.

items.dz: 输入越多框越高
items.de: The box grows with the message
items.pz: 自增高到 6 行为止，然后内部滚动。
items.pe: Auto-grow to six lines, then scroll inside.

items.dz: 聚焦时浮起来一层
items.de: It lifts on focus
items.pz: 聚焦加 1px 主色边 + 一级阴影，不要发光。
items.pe: A 1px accent border and one shadow step — no glow.

items.dz: 发送变成停止
items.de: Send becomes stop
items.pz: 同一个按钮位置切换图标，避免误点。
items.pe: Swap the icon in place so muscle memory holds.

items.dz: 答案后给三个追问
items.de: Three follow-ups under the answer
items.pz: 最多三个、每个不超过 6 个词，点击即发送。
items.pe: Three max, six words each, tap sends immediately.

items.dz: 文件被贴进对话
items.de: A file pinned into the thread
items.pz: 显示类型图标、名称截断、大小，以及移除按钮。
items.pe: Type icon, truncated name, size, and a remove control.

items.dz: 拖文件进来时高亮
items.de: It lights up when you drag in
items.pz: dragover 时换实线 + 主色底，dragleave 要可靠还原。
items.pe: Solid border and tint on dragover; reset reliably on leave.

items.dz: 悬停才显示复制、重试
items.de: Copy and retry appear on hover
items.pz: 操作条绝对定位在气泡右上，别挤压文字。
items.pe: Float the bar over the bubble corner; never reflow the text.

items.dz: 旧回答淡出、新回答写入
items.de: The old answer fades as the new one writes
items.pz: 保留旧版本可切换，不要直接覆盖。
items.pe: Keep the previous version switchable — do not overwrite.

items.dz: 改了哪里一眼看出
items.de: What changed, at a glance
items.pz: 删除用浅红划线、新增用浅绿，行号列固定。
items.pe: Struck pale red for removals, pale green for additions.

items.dz: 生成物在侧边独立展示
items.de: The output gets its own panel
items.pz: 对话在左、产物在右，产物要能全屏与下载。
items.pe: Thread left, artifact right, with fullscreen and download.

items.dz: 等宽、可复制、带语言标
items.de: Mono, copyable, language-tagged
items.pz: 右上角复制按钮常驻，行号可选，别自动换行。
items.pe: Persistent copy button, optional line numbers, no soft wrap.

items.dz: 代码一行行长出来
items.de: Code arriving line by line
items.pz: 按行揭示而不是按字符，缩进要先到位。
items.pe: Reveal by line, not character, and settle indentation first.

items.dz: 生成时自动跟到底部
items.de: It follows the tail while generating
items.pz: 用户手动上滚就停止跟随，并显示“回到底部”。
items.pe: Stop following once the user scrolls up; offer “jump to latest”.

items.dz: 换模型的下拉
items.de: The model dropdown
items.pz: 每个模型给一行能力说明，别只有代号。
items.pe: One line of capability per model — codenames alone are useless.

items.dz: 快一点还是想久一点
items.de: Faster, or think longer
items.pz: 三档滑块 + 预期耗时说明，让代价可预期。
items.pe: A three-stop control plus expected latency.

items.dz: 波形随说话起伏
items.de: The waveform answers your voice
items.pz: 用真实音量驱动波形，静音时波形要平。
items.pe: Drive the waveform from real amplitude; silence must look flat.

items.dz: 暂定文字先浅色出现
items.de: Interim text arrives pale
items.pz: 临时结果浅灰、确定后转黑，别整段重排。
items.pe: Interim in grey, final in ink — and never reflow the block.

items.dz: 计划、执行、检查
items.de: Plan, act, verify
items.pz: 每步显示状态图标 + 耗时，失败步可展开日志。
items.pe: Status icon and duration per step; failures expand to logs.

items.dz: 危险操作要人点头
items.de: Risky actions wait for a human
items.pz: 把将要发生的事写清楚，确认按钮不要默认聚焦。
items.pe: Spell out what will happen; do not autofocus the confirm.

items.dz: 表格一行行填进来
items.de: Rows landing one by one
items.pz: 先渲染表头与骨架行，再逐行替换。
items.pe: Render header and skeleton rows first, then replace.

items.dz: 还没开始时给例子
items.de: Before anything happens, offer examples
items.pz: 空状态放三个真实可点的示例提问，不要写“开始聊天吧”。
items.pe: Three real, tappable example prompts — not “start chatting”.

items.dz: 出错要说清楚且能重来
items.de: Say what broke, and offer another go
items.pz: 错误文案写“发生了什么 + 怎么办”，重试保留输入。
items.pe: Say what happened and what to do; keep the user’s input.

items.dz: 好评差评两个小按钮
items.de: Two small buttons, up or down
items.pz: 点击后立刻给确认反馈，差评再问原因。
items.pe: Acknowledge instantly; ask for a reason only after a downvote.

items.dz: 气泡里三点在动
items.de: Dots inside a bubble
items.pz: 气泡宽度固定，避免文字到达时跳动。
items.pe: Fix the bubble width so arrival does not jump.

items.dz: 先给结论，细节可展开
items.de: Answer first, details on request
items.pz: 结论一句 + “查看推理/来源/代码”三个入口。
items.pe: One-sentence answer plus entries for reasoning, sources, code.

items.dz: 数据边来边画
items.de: The chart draws as data lands
items.pz: 新点加在右侧并整体左移，Y 轴范围要平滑过渡。
items.pe: Append right, shift left, and ease the axis rescale.

items.dz: 拒答也要有礼貌的形状
items.de: Even a refusal needs a shape
items.pz: 中性底色 + 说明原因 + 给替代路径，别用红色警告。
items.pe: Neutral tint, a reason, and an alternative — not a red alarm.

items.dz: 左侧历史会话
items.de: History down the side
items.pz: 当前会话高亮，标题自动摘要并单行截断。
items.pe: Highlight the active thread; auto-title and truncate to one line.

items.dz: 头像有个呼吸环
items.de: A breathing ring on the avatar
items.pz: 生成中给头像一圈脉冲，结束立刻停。
items.pe: Pulse the ring while generating; stop the moment it ends.

dz: 一个会自己干活的东西，界面要交代它在想什么、做到哪、能不能停
de: When software acts on its own, the UI must show intent, progress and a way to stop

items.dz: 答案一边生成一边出现
items.de: The answer appears as it is written
items.pz: 按 token 追加而不是整段替换，光标停在末尾。
items.pe: Append per token, keep a caret at the tail.

items.dz: 一个方块告诉你还在写
items.de: A block says it is still writing
items.pz: 末尾一个 1ch 方块，0.9s 闪；停止生成立刻移除。
items.pe: A 1ch block blinking at 0.9s; remove it the moment output stops.

items.dz: 还没出字但确实在动
items.de: Nothing yet, but clearly alive
items.pz: 文字上一层缓慢流过的高光，比转圈更安静。
items.pe: A slow sheen over the label — quieter than a spinner.

items.dz: 经典三点但节奏要慢
items.de: The three dots, but slower
items.pz: 间隔 180ms、幅度 3px，快了就显焦虑。
items.pe: 180ms apart, 3px travel — faster reads as anxious.

items.dz: 过程默认收起，想看再展开
items.de: Reasoning stays folded until asked
items.pz: 摘要一行 + 展开显示步骤，别默认铺开一屏。
items.pe: One summary line; expand for the steps.

items.dz: 过程用更淡的字滚动
items.de: The process scrolls in dimmer type
items.pz: 推理区用 85% 字号、60% 不透明度，与结论区分开。
items.pe: Dim and shrink the trace so the answer still leads.

items.dz: 它正在用哪个工具、传了什么
items.de: Which tool, with what arguments
items.pz: 工具名 + 参数摘要 + 状态点，参数默认折叠。
items.pe: Tool name, argument summary, status dot; args folded by default.

items.dz: 这一步还在跑
items.de: This step is still running
items.pz: 状态点用脉冲不用转圈，超过 10s 才给进度。
items.pe: A pulsing dot, not a spinner; add progress past ten seconds.

items.dz: 跑完了变成一条静态记录
items.de: It settles into a record
items.pz: 完成时收起动效、换静态勾选，别继续闪。
items.pe: Kill the motion on completion and show a static check.

items.dz: 失败要能看懂并能重试
items.de: Failure must be readable and retryable
items.pz: 错误摘要 + 原始输出可展开 + 一个重试按钮。
items.pe: Summary, expandable raw output, one retry.

items.dz: 先说要做几步，再一步步勾掉
items.de: It states the steps, then ticks them off
items.pz: 步骤数固定后别偷偷改；新增步骤要有插入动效。
items.pe: Do not silently mutate the plan — animate insertions.

items.dz: 当前步高亮，已完成变灰
items.de: Current step leads, done steps recede
items.pz: 只强调当前一步；完成的降到 60% 不透明度。
items.pe: Emphasise one step; fade the finished ones.

items.dz: 派出去几个并行干
items.de: It forks into parallel workers
items.pz: 主线一条竖线，子任务向右分叉再收回。
items.pe: One spine with branches that fork right and rejoin.

items.dz: 换一个 agent 接手
items.de: A different agent takes over
items.pz: 头像/名字交叉淡入 200ms，历史保留在同一条流里。
items.pe: Cross-fade the identity in 200ms; keep one thread.

items.dz: 危险动作先问一句
items.de: Destructive actions ask first
items.pz: 确认卡里写清副作用范围，主按钮不要默认聚焦。
items.pe: Spell out the blast radius; do not autofocus confirm.

items.dz: 动手之前先给你看 diff
items.de: See the diff before it lands
items.pz: 增删用背景色 + 前缀符号双编码，可逐块接受。
items.pe: Colour plus sign prefix, accepted hunk by hunk.

items.dz: 任何时候都能叫停
items.de: You can always stop it
items.pz: 生成中主按钮变成"停止"，别藏在菜单里。
items.pe: The primary button becomes Stop — never hide it in a menu.

items.dz: 中途插一句就改方向
items.de: You can steer mid-run
items.pz: 打断后保留已完成部分，新指令作为补充上下文。
items.pe: Keep completed work; treat the interjection as added context.

items.dz: 每句话都能点回原文
items.de: Every claim links back
items.pz: 上标数字 + 悬停显示片段，别只在末尾堆链接。
items.pe: Superscript markers with hover previews, not a link dump.

items.dz: 悬停引用时原文亮起来
items.de: Hovering a citation lights the source
items.pz: 双向联动：正文与来源互相高亮，色相一致。
items.pe: Two-way highlight with one shared hue.

items.dz: 不确定就说不确定
items.de: Say so when it is unsure
items.pz: 用文字与区间，别用百分比装精确。
items.pe: Words and ranges beat fake precision.

items.dz: 答案旁边就是原文
items.de: The source sits beside the answer
items.pz: 点引用滚动侧栏到对应段落，不要新开页。
items.pe: Scroll the panel to the passage; never open a new page.

items.dz: 它现在看得见哪些东西
items.de: What it can currently see
items.pz: 每个附件/文件一个可删除的 pill，超出折叠成 +N。
items.pe: One removable pill per attachment, overflow as +N.

items.dz: 还剩多少窗口
items.de: How much window is left
items.pz: 接近上限才出现并变色，平时不打扰。
items.pe: Only appears near the limit.

items.dz: 它记住了一件事，要让你知道
items.de: It remembered something — tell the user
items.pz: 写入时给一条可撤销的轻提示，别静默。
items.pe: A dismissible, undoable toast — never silent.

items.dz: 记住的东西可查可删
items.de: Memories are visible and removable
items.pz: 每条带来源与时间，删除立即生效。
items.pe: Show origin and time; deletion is immediate.

items.dz: 一次授权到什么边界
items.de: The exact boundary of consent
items.pz: 按资源与动作分开授权，默认最小权限。
items.pe: Scope by resource and verb; default to least privilege.

items.dz: 从"每步都问"到"放手跑"
items.de: From ask-every-step to full auto
items.pz: 三档就够：建议 / 确认后执行 / 自动执行。
items.pe: Three levels: suggest, confirm, auto.

items.dz: 整段任务的时间轴
items.de: The whole run on one axis
items.pz: 每步一条，宽度=耗时，慢的那步一眼看到。
items.pe: Bar width equals duration; the slow step stands out.

items.dz: 谁调了谁，一眼看清
items.de: Who called what
items.pz: 缩进 + 耗时条，超时的分支自动展开。
items.pe: Indent plus duration; auto-expand the slow branch.

items.dz: 这次跑了多少钱
items.de: What this run cost
items.pz: 实时累加但低调，结束后给一条汇总。
items.pe: Accumulate quietly, summarise at the end.

items.dz: 告诉我大概还要多久
items.de: Say roughly how long
items.pz: 超过 2s 给预估，超过 10s 给可离开提示。
items.pe: Estimate past 2s; offer to notify past 10s.

items.dz: 先给结构再填内容
items.de: Structure first, content after
items.pz: 骨架形状要贴近真实答案的段落结构。
items.pe: Shape the skeleton like the real answer.

items.dz: 先结论，再细节，再证据
items.de: Answer, then detail, then evidence
items.pz: 三层结构：一句话 / 要点 / 原始材料。
items.pe: Three tiers: sentence, bullets, raw material.

items.dz: 灰字建议，Tab 接受
items.de: Ghost text, Tab to accept
items.pz: 建议用 45% 灰、不换行，Esc 立即撤。
items.pe: Ghost text at 45% grey, Esc dismisses instantly.

items.dz: 接受时灰字变实
items.de: Ghost text turns solid
items.pz: 120ms 变色不移位，光标跳到末尾。
items.pe: 120ms colour change, no reflow, caret to the end.

items.dz: 打 / 就出命令表
items.de: Slash opens the command list
items.pz: 模糊匹配 + 键盘优先，第一项默认高亮。
items.pe: Fuzzy match, keyboard first, first item preselected.

items.dz: @ 一下把东西塞进上下文
items.de: Mention to attach context
items.pz: 分组显示（文件/人/工具），最近使用置顶。
items.pe: Group by kind with recents first.

items.dz: 答案落在一块可编辑的画布上
items.de: The answer lands on an editable canvas
items.pz: 左侧对话、右侧文档，改动实时打点。
items.pe: Chat left, artefact right, edits marked live.

items.dz: 每次修改都留一版
items.de: Every revision is kept
items.pz: 版本条可左右翻，diff 可开关。
items.pe: A version rail with a diff toggle.

items.dz: 表格一行行长出来
items.de: Rows arrive one at a time
items.pz: 表头先定列宽，后续行不许改列宽。
items.pe: Lock the column widths on the header row.

items.dz: 代码一边写一边高亮
items.de: Code highlights as it streams
items.pz: 未闭合的块先按纯文本渲染，闭合后再上色。
items.pe: Render unclosed blocks as plain text, colour on close.

items.dz: 答案里的代码能直接跑
items.de: The code in the answer runs
items.pz: 运行状态三态：待运行 / 运行中 / 有输出。
items.pe: Three states: idle, running, has output.

items.dz: 它在界面上自己动手
items.de: It moves the pointer itself
items.pz: 带名字标签的光标，动作前先移动过去让人跟得上。
items.pe: A labelled cursor that travels before it acts.

items.dz: 它要点哪里就先圈出来
items.de: It rings the target before clicking
items.pz: 目标周围一圈脉冲，250ms 后才真的点。
items.pe: Pulse the target, then click 250ms later.

items.dz: 它在看哪一页
items.de: Which page it is reading
items.pz: 域名 + 标题 + 缩略截图，一步一条。
items.pe: Domain, title and a thumbnail per step.

items.dz: 哪些文件被改了
items.de: Which files changed
items.pz: 路径 + 增删行数，点开是 diff。
items.pe: Path plus line delta, expanding into a diff.

items.dz: 跑太久就让你先去干别的
items.de: It tells you to go do something else
items.pz: 超过 60s 提供"完成后通知我"，标签页标题带角标。
items.pe: Offer notify-on-done past 60s and badge the tab title.

items.dz: 排着队的任务也要可见
items.de: Queued work stays visible
items.pz: 队列显示位次与预计开始，可拖拽改序。
items.pe: Show position and ETA; allow reordering.

items.dz: 同时在跑好几件事
items.de: Several things at once
items.pz: 每个任务一行进度，别用一个总进度糊过去。
items.pe: One row per task — not a single fake total.

items.dz: 做错了要能整段撤回
items.de: A wrong run can be undone whole
items.pz: 按运行分组撤销，不是一步步 undo。
items.pe: Undo by run, not step by step.

items.dz: 这条回答被验证过
items.de: This answer was checked
items.pz: 通过/未通过 + 检查项数量，可展开看细则。
items.pe: Pass state plus check count, expandable.

items.dz: 被拦下来要说清为什么
items.de: A refusal must explain itself
items.pz: 给原因、给边界、给可行的替代路径。
items.pe: Reason, boundary, and an alternative.

items.dz: 它现在跑在隔离环境里
items.de: It is running sandboxed
items.pz: 环境标识常驻，生产环境要用另一种颜色。
items.pe: Keep the environment badge pinned; production gets its own colour.

items.dz: 快超预算就先停下问
items.de: It stops before overspending
items.pz: 达到 80% 提醒，100% 暂停并等确认。
items.pe: Warn at 80%, pause at 100%.

items.dz: 好不好用一秒能说
items.de: One second to say if it worked
items.pz: 两个图标 + 可选原因标签，别弹问卷。
items.pe: Two icons and optional reason tags — never a survey.

items.dz: 再来一版并能对比
items.de: Another take, side by side
items.pz: 保留上一版，横向对比而不是覆盖。
items.pe: Keep the last one and compare — do not overwrite.

items.dz: 给三个下一步问法
items.de: Three ways to keep going
items.pz: 最多三条、都短，点了就填进输入框。
items.pe: Three short chips that fill the composer.

items.dz: 拖张图进去就能问
items.de: Drop an image and ask
items.pz: 拖入时整个输入区变成投放目标并说明支持格式。
items.pe: The whole composer becomes the drop target.

items.dz: 一个球表示在听/在说
items.de: One orb: listening or speaking
items.pz: 听时随音量起伏，说时匀速呼吸，两种节奏要分得开。
items.pe: Amplitude-reactive while listening, steady while speaking.

items.dz: 谁在说话要一眼看出
items.de: Who has the floor
items.pz: 双方用不同对齐与底色，别只靠头像。
items.pe: Different alignment and fill, not just avatars.

items.dz: 它先想到了，但不打断你
items.de: It offers without interrupting
items.pz: 角落轻提示，3 秒不理就自己收起。
items.pe: A corner hint that retires after three seconds.

items.dz: 同一个头像表达四种状态
items.de: One avatar, four states
items.pz: 空闲/思考/执行/出错，用环而不是换图。
items.pe: Idle, thinking, acting, error — as a ring, not a new image.

items.dz: 开发者要能看到全部原始事件
items.de: Raw events for the operator
items.pz: 事件流可暂停、可筛选、可复制为可复现脚本。
items.pe: Pausable, filterable, copyable as a repro script.

dz: 整页级的风格流派：从瑞士网格到深空中文排版。每条都给了定义、做法、关键词，和真实可点开的参考原站
de: Whole-page style movements, from Swiss grids to deep-space CJK type. Each one carries a definition, a recipe, keywords, and real reference sites you can open

items.dz: 把东西拿掉，直到只剩必须的那一句
items.de: Remove until only the necessary sentence is left
items.pz: 一个视觉焦点、一种字体两个字重、大面积留白当版面元素用；对比靠字号级差而不是颜色。首屏拒绝把自己填满。
items.pe: One focal point, one typeface in two weights, white space treated as a component. Contrast comes from scale, not colour — and the hero refuses to fill itself.

items.dz: 网格、无衬线、一条红斜线
items.de: Grid, grotesque, one red rule
items.pz: 严格模块网格 + Helvetica 类字体 + 齐左不齐右；单一强调色只出现在一个几何元素上，绝不铺满。
items.pe: A strict modular grid, a grotesque face, flush-left ragged-right text, and a single accent colour on exactly one geometric element.

items.dz: 圆方三角与三原色
items.de: Circle, square, triangle, primaries
items.pz: 基本几何形 + 红黄蓝 + 无衬线全大写；形体承担全部装饰，绝不加纹理与阴影。构成要能拆成尺规能画出来的元素。
items.pe: Primitive geometry, red/yellow/blue, uppercase sans. Form carries all decoration — no texture, no shadow. Everything drawable with compass and rule.

items.dz: 像一篇论文的图，而不是营销页
items.de: Figures from a paper, not a marketing page
items.pz: 白底细线 + 等宽数字 + 真坐标轴与图例 + 单一强调色；不要渐变、不要入场动画。数字自己会说话。
items.pe: White ground, hairlines, tabular numerals, real axes and legends, one accent. No gradients, no entrance animation — the numbers carry it.

items.dz: 像一张施工图
items.de: Reads like a construction drawing
items.pz: 蓝底白线或白底细蓝线 + 尺寸标注 + 剖面符号 + 等宽标签；线宽严格分级（0.25 / 0.5 / 1pt），标注比图形更重要。
items.pe: Blue ground with white lines, dimension callouts, section marks, monospace labels. Line weights strictly graded — the annotation matters more than the drawing.

items.dz: 像一本杂志的内页，而不是一个落地页
items.de: A magazine spread, not a landing page
items.pz: 衬线大标题 + 多栏正文 + 图注小字；靠栏宽变化与首字下沉建立阅读节奏，导航退成一行细字。
items.pe: Serif display, multi-column body, small captions. Rhythm comes from varying measure and a drop cap; the nav shrinks to one thin line.

items.dz: 报头、栏线、通栏大标题
items.de: A masthead, column rules, a banner headline
items.pz: 衬线报头 + 多栏细分栏线 + 报纸灰纸底 + 图注小字；标题层级用字号跨度而不是颜色，双线分隔是签名动作。
items.pe: A serif masthead, hairline column rules, newsprint grey, small captions. Hierarchy by size jumps, never colour; the double rule is the signature.

items.dz: 产品长得像一份文档
items.de: The product looks like a document
items.pz: 左侧目录 + 单栏正文 + 行内块编辑 + 极浅分隔线；字体层级少，靠间距分节，光标是唯一的动效。
items.pe: A sidebar outline, one text column, inline blocks, near-invisible rules. Few type levels; spacing does the sectioning and the caret is the only motion.

items.dz: 把汉字当成版面主体，不是英文版式的填空
items.de: Han characters as the subject, not filler in a Latin layout
items.pz: 大字号中文标题 + 字重只用两级 + 行高 1.5 以上 + 标点挤压；英文降为辅助行，字距靠字号而不是 letter-spacing。
items.pe: Large Han display type, only two weights, line-height above 1.5, punctuation kerned. Latin drops to a support line; rhythm from size, not letter-spacing.

items.dz: 近黑的夜空里挂着一颗会呼吸的球
items.de: A breathing orb hung in a near-black sky
items.pz: 近黑冷底 + 一颗大尺寸发光球体（月/星/环）+ 极简中文大字 + 一条细高光；渐变必须细，球体只有一个光源。
items.pe: A near-black cool ground, one oversized luminous orb, minimal large CJK type, one hairline specular. Faint gradients; the orb takes exactly one light.

items.dz: 半透明面板浮在彩色背景上
items.de: Frosted panels floating over colour
items.pz: backdrop-filter:blur + 8–16% 白底 + 1px 高光描边；必须有彩色或图像背景才成立，且要盯住正文对比度。
items.pe: backdrop-filter blur, an 8–16% white fill, a 1px light border. It only works over colour or imagery — and body contrast needs watching.

items.dz: 控件像从同色表面顶出来的
items.de: Controls extruded from a same-colour surface
items.pz: 同色底 + 一对相反方向的柔和内外阴影；对比天生偏低，交互态必须再加边框或色彩兜底，否则不可用。
items.pe: One surface colour with paired soft light/dark shadows. Contrast is inherently low — back every interaction state with a border or colour or it fails accessibility.

items.dz: 一切都像捏出来的软陶
items.de: Everything looks moulded from clay
items.pz: 超大圆角 + 双层柔和内外阴影 + 低饱和粉彩；形体要"胖"，描边为零，投影要软到看不出边界。
items.pe: Huge radii, layered soft inner and outer shadows, pastel fills. Forms are chubby, strokes are zero, shadows soft enough to have no edge.

items.dz: 界面模仿真实材质
items.de: The interface imitates real material
items.pz: 材质贴图、缝线、金属高光、真实投影；隐喻必须一致，别一半木纹一半扁平。光源方向全站统一。
items.pe: Textures, stitching, metal speculars, real shadows. Keep the metaphor consistent — no half wood-grain, half flat — and one light direction site-wide.

items.dz: 素材本身就是装饰
items.de: The material is the decoration
items.pz: 米白与灰褐 + 天然材质留痕 + 大量负空间 + 细字重；不对称构图，禁止纯黑与高饱和，动效慢到几乎察觉不到。
items.pe: Off-white and taupe, visible material grain, deep negative space, light weights. Asymmetric; no pure black, no saturation, motion slow to the edge of perception.

items.dz: 克制、高级、留白买不起
items.de: Restrained, expensive, space you can’t afford
items.pz: 暗色或米色底 + 细衬线大写标题 + 宽字距 + 金铜色细节；动效必须慢，任何弹跳都掉价。CTA 只用描边。
items.pe: Dark or ivory ground, light serif caps, wide tracking, brass details. Motion must be slow — any bounce cheapens it. CTAs are outline only.

items.dz: 不修饰，硬碰硬
items.de: Unfinished on purpose, hard against hard
items.pz: 默认字体、纯黑白、无圆角无阴影、超大字号压满版；把 HTML 的结构本身暴露出来当装饰。
items.pe: System type, pure black and white, no radius, no shadow, headline pushed to the edges. The raw HTML structure is the decoration.

items.dz: 粗黑描边 + 硬投影 + 高饱和色块
items.de: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows, loud blocks
items.pz: 2–3px 纯黑描边、4–6px 无模糊位移阴影、荧光色块；圆角可有可无，但阴影必须是硬的，按下时位移要真。
items.pe: A 2–3px black outline, a 4–6px zero-blur offset shadow, fluorescent fills. Radius optional; the shadow must stay hard and the press must really move.

items.dz: 像复印机印坏的小册子
items.de: A photocopier having a bad day
items.pz: 高对比二值化图 + 复印噪点 + 手写与打字机混排 + 歪斜贴纸；不对齐才是对的，边缘要有脏。
items.pe: Hard-threshold images, copier noise, typewriter and handwriting mixed, skewed stickers. Misalignment is the point, and the edges must be dirty.

items.dz: 故意打破所有惯例
items.de: Every convention broken on purpose
items.pz: 错位网格、冲突字体、诡异配色、非常规交互；必须留一条清晰的主动线，否则只是坏设计而不是反设计。
items.pe: Off-grid, clashing faces, awkward colour, unconventional interaction. Keep one clear path through — otherwise it is merely bad design.

items.dz: 字本身就是图像
items.de: The letterform is the image
items.pz: 可变字体极端轴值 + 字形变形拉伸叠印 + 破格网格；可读性只保住一个层级即可，其余交给张力。
items.pe: Extreme variable-font axes, distorted and overprinted glyphs, a broken grid. Only one level needs to stay legible; the rest is tension.

items.dz: 像 1998 年的网页
items.de: A page from 1998
items.pz: 系统窗口边框、蓝色带下划线的超链接、表格布局、访客计数器；克制地怀旧，不要真的用 <blink>。
items.pe: System window chrome, blue underlined links, table layout, a hit counter. Nostalgic on purpose — skip the actual <blink>.

items.dz: 镀铬、半透明、液态形体
items.de: Chrome, translucency, liquid forms
items.pz: 金属渐变文字 + 亚克力质感 + 气泡与光晕；冷色高光要有明确的光源方向，斜体是必需的。
items.pe: Metallic gradient type, acrylic surfaces, bubbles and bloom. Give the cool speculars one consistent light direction — and italics are mandatory.

items.dz: 上世纪想象的未来
items.de: The future as the last century imagined it
items.pz: 太空时代插画 + 橙棕配色 + 圆角科技造型；字体用宽体几何无衬线，别用现代科技风的窄体。
items.pe: Space-age illustration, burnt-orange palette, rounded techno forms, wide geometric sans. Never a modern narrow tech face.

items.dz: 粉紫落日与网格地平线
items.de: A magenta sunset over a grid horizon
items.pz: 粉紫青三色 + 透视网格地面 + 全角标题 + 石膏像；刻意的 VHS 噪点与色偏，标题要有 RGB 分离。
items.pe: Magenta/cyan/violet, a perspective grid floor, full-width type, plaster busts, deliberate VHS noise and an RGB-split headline.

items.dz: 每个像素都是手放的
items.de: Every pixel placed by hand
items.pz: 固定像素网格 + image-rendering:pixelated + 有限调色板；缩放必须整数倍，动画走 steps() 不走补间。
items.pe: A fixed pixel grid, image-rendering: pixelated, a limited palette. Scale by whole integers, and animate with steps() — never tween.

items.dz: 折线、圆点、撞色几何
items.de: Squiggles, dots, clashing geometry
items.pz: 80 年代孟菲斯派：饱和撞色 + 波浪与网格图案 + 随机散布几何；构图故意不对称，但底色必须统一。
items.pe: The 80s Memphis school — clashing saturated colour, squiggle and grid patterns, scattered geometry, deliberately asymmetric over one unifying ground.

items.dz: 黑底、细渐变、一条发光的线
items.de: Black ground, subtle gradients, one glowing line
items.pz: 近黑背景 + 极低饱和文字 + 单一冷光焦点；渐变必须细，一旦浓就变成廉价科技感。边框用 1px 微亮。
items.pe: Near-black ground, desaturated text, one cold light focus. Keep gradients faint — heavy ones read as cheap tech. Borders are 1px, barely lit.

items.dz: 大小不一的方块拼满一屏
items.de: Unequal tiles tiling the whole screen
items.pz: 一套统一圆角与间距的模块网格，每格一个信息单元；格子跨列跨行制造节奏，禁止格内再分栏。
items.pe: A modular grid with one radius and one gap; one idea per tile. Rhythm comes from spans — never sub-divide a tile.

items.dz: 一屏之内看完全部指标
items.de: Every metric on one screen
items.pz: 卡片化 KPI + 图表网格 + 状态色（升/降）；密度高但要有明确的视觉层级与对齐基线，数字用等宽。
items.pe: KPI cards, a chart grid, semantic up/down colour. High density still needs one hierarchy, one baseline, and tabular numerals.

items.dz: 纸片有厚度，光从上方来
items.de: Sheets with elevation, light from above
items.pz: 海拔阴影体系 + 主色/次色/表面色 token + 涟漪反馈；阴影只表示层级，不当装饰。
items.pe: An elevation shadow system, primary/secondary/surface tokens, ripple feedback. Shadows encode depth, never decoration.

items.dz: 整站像一个终端会话
items.de: The whole site is a terminal session
items.pz: 等宽字体 + 命令行提示符 + 光标 + 制表符边框；配色沿用 solarized / gruvbox / nord 这类既成主题，别自创。
items.pe: Monospace, a prompt, a cursor, box-drawing frames. Borrow an established scheme — solarized, gruvbox, nord — never invent one.

items.dz: 几团颜色互相渗透
items.de: Colour blooms bleeding into each other
items.pz: 多个 radial-gradient 叠加 + 大半径柔化 + 缓慢位移；颜色数控制在 3–4 个，超了就变脏。
items.pe: Stack radial gradients, soften them wide, drift slowly. Three or four hues maximum — more turns muddy.

items.dz: 整页就是一个可进入的场景
items.de: The page is a scene you enter
items.pz: WebGL 场景 + 滚动驱动相机 + DOM 只放少量文字；必须给静态首帧与降级路径，否则弱设备直接白屏。
items.pe: A WebGL scene with a scroll-driven camera and very little DOM text. Always ship a static first frame and a fallback, or weak devices see white.

items.dz: 看得见每一个三角面
items.de: Every triangle stays visible
items.pz: 刻意保留低面数 + 平面着色（flat shading）+ 明确的面间明暗差；绝不开平滑法线，那会毁掉整个语言。
items.pe: Keep the poly count low, use flat shading, let adjacent faces differ clearly. Never smooth the normals — that kills the whole language.

items.dz: 30° 斜轴上的小世界
items.de: A small world on a 30° axis
items.pz: 固定 30° 等轴投影、无透视收缩、三面明暗固定；所有物件共用一套光照与网格，一处破轴全盘就散。
items.pe: A fixed 30° axonometric projection, no perspective convergence, three constant face values. One light and one grid for everything — one broken axis ruins it.

items.dz: 霓虹、高密度信息、雨夜都市
items.de: Neon, dense information, a wet city at night
items.pz: 深色底 + 两种霓虹色（品红/青）+ 扫描线与故障；信息要"过载"，但正文仍需 4.5:1 对比。
items.pe: Dark ground, two neon hues (magenta/cyan), scanlines and glitch. Overload the information — but keep body text at 4.5:1.

items.dz: 照片去色，字压上去
items.de: Desaturate the photo, set type over it
items.pz: 全站灰度 + 一张主图占 60% 以上 + 大衬线标题压图；只允许一个彩色元素破局，那就是 CTA。
items.pe: Full greyscale, one image over 60% of the frame, a serif headline across it. Exactly one colour element may break it — the CTA.

items.dz: 像时装杂志的封面
items.de: A fashion cover, not a homepage
items.pz: 超大细衬线标题压人像 + 极少 UI + 大量出血图；导航退成一行小字，CTA 只是一条下划线。
items.pe: An oversized light serif over a portrait, almost no UI, full-bleed imagery. The nav shrinks to one small line; the CTA is just an underline.

items.dz: 像手撕纸片贴出来的版面
items.de: Torn paper, taped down
items.pz: 纸质纹理 + 撕边遮罩 + 轻微旋转与投影 + 手写标注；每片素材角度不同才有拼贴感，白色缝隙要清脆。
items.pe: Paper texture, torn-edge masks, slight rotations with shadows, handwritten notes. Vary every angle and keep the white gutters crisp.

items.dz: 滚动就是翻页
items.de: Scrolling is turning the page
items.pz: 滚动位置驱动章节切换：sticky 画面 + 递进文字；每屏只推进一个信息，进度必须可见。
items.pe: Scroll position drives chapters — a sticky visual with advancing text. One idea per screen, and always show progress.

items.dz: 一半字，一半图，中缝就是版式
items.de: Half type, half image — the seam is the layout
items.pz: 50/50 或 40/60 硬分割 + 两侧独立滚动或对比材质；分割线位置全站保持一致，缝隙不加圆角。
items.pe: A hard 50/50 or 40/60 split, each side its own material or scroll. Keep the seam in the same place site-wide, and never round it.

items.dz: 几何形当图像用
items.de: Geometry standing in for imagery
items.pz: 大块几何形 + 一个饱和色 + 图形与字重叠；形体裁切要跨出容器边界才有张力。
items.pe: Big geometric masses, one saturated hue, shapes overlapping the type. Let forms bleed past the container edge or the tension dies.

items.dz: 一张会动的海报当首页
items.de: A poster that moves, used as a homepage
items.pz: 整屏一张海报构图 + 循环动效（字距/位移/遮罩）+ 极少导航；所有节奏对齐同一个循环长度。
items.pe: One poster composition filling the viewport, a looping motion (tracking, shift, mask), almost no nav. All timing on one loop length.

items.dz: 动效是主角，不是点缀
items.de: Motion is the subject, not the garnish
items.pz: 入场/滚动/悬停三层动效编排成一条线，用统一的缓动与时长阶梯；必须尊重 reduced-motion。
items.pe: Entrance, scroll and hover choreographed as one line with a shared easing and duration ladder. Honour reduced-motion.

items.dz: 没有一条直线
items.de: Not a single straight line
items.pz: blob 形状 + 不规则圆角 + 柔和低饱和色；用 border-radius 四值或 SVG 路径造形，别用对称椭圆。
items.pe: Blob forms, asymmetric radii, soft muted colour. Shape with four-value radii or SVG paths — symmetric ellipses read as clip-art.

items.dz: 线条有抖动，颜色出框
items.de: Wobbling strokes, colour outside the lines
items.pz: 不规则手绘线 + 蜡笔质感填色 + 手写体标注；线宽要有粗细变化，否则像矢量描边而不是手绘。
items.pe: Irregular strokes, crayon fills, handwritten notes. Vary stroke weight — even weight reads as vector outline, not hand.

items.dz: 统一线宽的插画
items.de: Illustration at one stroke weight
items.pz: 全站插画同一线宽（1.5–2px）与同一端点形状；填色只作为线稿背后的色块，绝不替代线。
items.pe: One stroke weight (1.5–2px) and one cap style everywhere. Colour sits behind the line, never replaces it.

items.dz: 真实的绿，不是品牌绿
items.de: Real green, not brand green
items.pz: 实景摄影 + 森林绿与土色 + 手写点缀；关键是照片真实，避免图库式"可持续插画"和柔焦绿。
items.pe: Documentary photography, forest greens and earth tones, one handwritten accent. Real photos — skip stock sustainability art and soft-focus green.

items.dz: 乐观的绿色未来
items.de: An optimistic green future
items.pz: 植物 + 明亮金绿 + 装饰性新艺术曲线 + 通透玻璃；和赛博朋克相反：明亮、有机、可持续。
items.pe: Plants, bright gold-greens, art-nouveau curves, clear glass. The inverse of cyberpunk — bright, organic, sustainable.

items.dz: 填满、堆叠、喧闹但有序
items.de: Full, stacked, loud — and still ordered
items.pz: 多色多字体多图层，但用一套网格与一个统一底色收住；阅读焦点仍然只留一个。
items.pe: Many colours, faces and layers held by one grid and one ground colour. Still exactly one reading focus.

items.dz: 一张抖出来的黑白点阵图当整页主角，字是等宽，颜色只有黑与白
items.de: One dithered black-and-white image carries the page; monospace type, no colour at all
items.pz: 把照片压成 1bit：阈值抖动或网点半调，全站只留黑白两色加一款等宽字，标题和正文靠字号拉开层级。抖动是刻意的，不是压缩失真。
items.pe: Reduce photography to 1-bit with order dithering or halftone, hold the palette to black and white, and let one monospace face carry display and body copy through size alone. The dither is deliberate, not a compression artefact.

items.dz: 一块点阵屏加一个旋钮，像硬件面板而不是网页
items.de: A dot-matrix display and a knob — a hardware panel, not a web page
items.pz: 主视觉用 LED 点阵屏，背景是细网格，标签一律等宽大写；按钮画成实体键，带按下位移和轻微投影。整体直角、低饱和、金属灰。
items.pe: Lead with an LED matrix, lay a hairline grid behind everything, set every label in uppercase mono, and draw buttons as physical keys that travel when pressed. Right angles, desaturated grey, no ornament.

items.dz: 一张满幅人物大片顶在最上面，标题粗到有点过分
items.de: A full-bleed campaign photo on top, headline heavier than it needs to be
items.pz: 首屏就是一张满幅人物照，粗黑无衬线标题压在图上；商品用横滑一排在下面。动效只做位移和缩放，不玩花活。
items.pe: Open with a full-bleed photo, set the headline in the heaviest grotesque you can justify, and put products in a single horizontal rail under it. Motion is limited to translate and scale.

items.dz: 白墙、黑字、大留白，标题大而中性，说明字小到几乎听不见
items.de: White walls, black type, vast margins — big neutral headline, whisper-small captions
items.pz: 底色接近纯白但不刺眼；标题用中性无衬线或过渡衬线，字距收一点。展览信息、票务、赞助人一律小字排在底部，中间只放一件作品。
items.pe: Near-white ground, one neutral sans or transitional serif at display size with tight tracking, and everything logistical — dates, tickets, credits — set small along the base. The middle belongs to a single work.

items.dz: 栏目多、字号小、行距松，用细边框把每一块分开
items.de: Many columns, small type, generous leading — every block fenced by a hairline
items.pz: 信息密度高但不挤：正文 12–13px、行高 1.9，块与块之间只用 1px 细线分隔；配色克制到近乎无色，重点靠加粗和缩进。
items.pe: Dense but unhurried: 12–13px body at 1.9 leading, blocks separated only by hairlines, a palette that is almost no palette. Emphasis comes from weight and indent, never from colour.

items.dz: 一列窄栏、大量留白，链接是深蓝不是亮色
items.de: A single narrow column, a lot of margin, links in navy rather than a bright accent
items.pz: 正文一栏不超过 60 字符，中线对齐；链接用深蓝加下划线，激活态才变色。图片小、少、方，其余交给留白。
items.pe: Keep the measure under 60 characters on the centre line. Links are navy with an underline and only change on activation. Images stay small, few and square; everything else is margin.

items.dz: 深底加一块高饱和色，节目单是列表，播放器常驻底部
items.de: A dark ground, one saturated block, a schedule as a plain list, a player that never leaves
items.pz: 背景近黑，主色只用一个高饱和色；节目按时间排成无边框列表，当前节目用色块标出。底部常驻一条播放器，字号收紧、字距拉近。
items.pe: Near-black ground, exactly one saturated accent. The schedule is an unfenced list ordered by time, the current slot marked by a colour block, and a player bar that stays put. Type tight, tracking tighter.

items.dz: 近黑的底、金色细线、衬线标题，产品放正中间
items.de: Near-black ground, gold hairlines, a serif headline and the product dead centre
items.pz: 底色压到近黑，分隔线用 1px 香槟金；标题是衬线，正文小到 9px 并拉开字距。产品永远居中，四周全是留白。
items.pe: Push the ground to near-black and draw every divider in a 1px champagne gold. Serif headline, 9px body with open tracking, the product always centred and nothing crowding it.

items.dz: 表格优先，行高固定，字号极小，颜色只用来标状态
items.de: Table first: fixed row heights, tiny type, colour used only to mark state
items.pz: 一切对齐到列：站名、时间、站台三列，行高恒定 22px；红蓝是功能色不是装饰色。信息层级靠字重和灰阶，不靠色块。
items.pe: Everything snaps to columns — name, time, platform — at a fixed 22px row height. Red and blue are functional signals, never decoration. Hierarchy comes from weight and grey level, not fills.

items.dz: 半透明彩色叠在一起，圆角很大，阴影很浅
items.de: Translucent colour layers stacked, generous rounding, barely-there shadow
items.pz: 彩色层用 40%–70% 透明叠加，背景是柔和渐变；圆角 18–22px，阴影浅到几乎看不见。文字压在玻璃上，靠字重而不是描边保证可读。
items.pe: Stack colour layers at 40–70% opacity over a soft gradient, round corners to 18–22px, and keep shadows almost invisible. Type sits on the glass and stays readable through weight, not outlines.

items.dz: 米白纸底、手绘标本、拉丁学名用小字排在下面
items.de: Cream paper, drawn specimens, Latin binomials set small beneath
items.pz: 底色偏米黄像旧纸；插画用细线平涂，不描边不渐变。每张卡下方是中文学名 + 拉丁双名 + 采集地，字小但整齐。
items.pe: A cream ground that reads as old paper, plates drawn in flat fills with hairline outlines, and each card footed by local name, Latin binomial and locality in small orderly type.

items.dz: 页面本身就是一张字体样本：大字试样、极窄行距、等宽小字标注
items.de: The page is the specimen: giant glyphs, razor-tight leading, mono metadata
items.pz: 主视觉直接排大字试样，行距压到 0.86；字重、字号、字距用等宽小字标在旁边。不放大图，页面说的一切都由字承担。
items.pe: Set the specimen itself as the hero at 0.86 leading, and annotate weight, size and tracking in mono down the side. No imagery: the type carries every claim on the page.

dz: 用字符和点当像素：真实地理数据生成的字符地球与点阵地图、抖动灰阶、终端图形
de: Characters and dots used as pixels — a real-geometry ASCII globe and dot-matrix map, dithered ramps, terminal graphics

items.dz: 真实的大陆在自转，不是贴图
items.de: Real continents, actually rotating
items.pz: 正射投影（orthographic）逐帧把经纬网格投到圆盘上：每个屏幕点反解出经纬度，查陆海掩膜决定画不画，再按 cos(角距) 做球面明暗。这里把 36 帧（每 10° 经度）烤成一张 6×6 精灵图，用 steps() 切帧——横向步进列、纵向步进行，两条动画各管一个 background-position 分量。
items.pe: Orthographic projection, frame by frame: invert each screen point to lon/lat, test it against a land mask, then shade by cos of the angular distance. Here 36 frames (10° of longitude each) are baked into a 6×6 sprite and stepped with steps() — one animation walks the columns, another the rows.

items.zh: 点阵地图 · 节点与航线
items.dz: 干净的点阵底图，上面跑一条航线
items.de: A clean dot plate with one route drawn across it
items.pz: 底图是等距圆柱投影的规则点阵：先把陆地栅格化，再按单元格覆盖率（≥34%）决定是否落点，孤点剔除，南极裁掉——点距约为点径的四倍才够干净。节点用同心 box-shadow 做脉冲环，航线用 border-radius 的一段圆弧配 clip-path 逐段画出。
items.pe: The plate is a regular grid in equirectangular projection: rasterise the land, keep a cell only if ≥34% covered, drop orphans, clip Antarctica. Pitch should be about four times the dot radius. Nodes pulse with concentric box-shadows; the route is an arc of a rounded box revealed by clip-path.

items.dz: 同一份地理数据，落到字符网格上
items.de: The same geometry, resampled onto a character grid
items.pz: 字符格不是正方形（约 1:2），所以纵向要多压一倍才不变形。每格取陆地覆盖率，≥42% 给 █，≥18% 给 ·，其余留空——两级就够，三级以上开始显脏。
items.pe: Character cells are about 1:2, so squash twice as much vertically. Take land coverage per cell: ≥42% gets █, ≥18% gets ·, the rest stays blank. Two levels is enough — three starts to look dirty.

items.dz: 一道斜波扫过整片字符
items.de: One diagonal wave sweeping the field
items.pz: 整片同一个字形，只用 animation-delay 沿索引递增制造相位差；delay 用负值动画就不必等第一轮跑完。
items.pe: One glyph everywhere; phase comes from an animation-delay that grows with the cell index. Negative delays start the field mid-cycle.

items.dz: 从左到右越来越"重"
items.de: Ink weight climbing left to right
items.pz: 按列给不同的字重与透明度，就得到一条可读的密度梯度——字符版的灰阶条。
items.pe: Weight and alpha per column give a readable density ramp — the character-grid version of a greyscale wedge.

items.dz: 越暗的地方字符越"重"
items.de: Darker areas take heavier glyphs
items.pz: 把亮度 0–255 映射到一张按笔画密度排序的字符表（" .:-=+*#%@"），这一步叫 luminance ramp。表的单调性比长度重要。
items.pe: Map luminance 0–255 onto a glyph table ordered by ink density (" .:-=+*#%@") — the luminance ramp. Monotonicity matters more than length.

items.dz: 只有四级墨，看着是连续渐变
items.de: Four ink levels reading as a smooth gradient
items.pz: 4×4 Bayer 矩阵做阈值抖动，用 ░▒▓█ 表现灰阶。它的花纹是确定性的，所以放大不会像噪点抖动那样"沙沙"。
items.pe: A 4×4 Bayer threshold matrix over ░▒▓█. The pattern is deterministic, so it never fizzes the way noise dithering does when scaled.

items.dz: 同样一格字符，四倍分辨率
items.de: Four times the resolution per cell
items.pz: U+2800 盲文块每格 2×4 点，是终端里能拿到的最高有效分辨率；btop、gnuplot 的字符图都靠它。
items.pe: U+2800 braille cells pack 2×4 dots — the highest usable resolution in a terminal. btop and gnuplot lean on it.

items.dz: 一列列字符往下掉
items.de: Columns of glyphs falling
items.pz: 每列一个独立速度与偏移的字符流，头部最亮、尾部指数衰减；尾迹用一层 mask 渐变，比逐字设透明度便宜得多。
items.pe: One stream per column, each with its own speed and offset: bright head, exponential tail. A single gradient mask is far cheaper than per-glyph opacity.

items.dz: 用字符拼出的巨大标题
items.de: A headline built out of characters
items.pz: FIGlet / toilet 字体把每个字母展开成多行字符网格，标准 banner 高 6 行；CI 日志与 CLI 欢迎页的常见开场。
items.pe: FIGlet fonts expand each letter into a multi-row grid; the standard banner is six rows. Ubiquitous in CI logs and CLI splash screens.

items.dz: 纯字符画出来的面板
items.de: A panel drawn entirely in glyphs
items.pz: U+2500 制表符（─│┌┐└┘├┤┬┴┼）拼边框与分栏，是 ncurses / TUI 的基本材料；宽度必须按字符数算，不能按像素。
items.pe: The U+2500 box-drawing range builds frames and splits — the raw material of ncurses and every TUI. Size everything in characters, never pixels.

items.dz: 一个字符位上的旋转
items.de: Rotation inside a single cell
items.pz: 一组等宽帧（⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏ 或 |/-\）用 steps() 逐帧切换，80–120ms 一帧最不晃眼。
items.pe: A ring of equal-width frames stepped with steps(); 80–120ms per frame reads best.

items.dz: 方块一格一格填满
items.de: Blocks filling one cell at a time
items.pz: 整格用 █，余数用 ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ 做八分之一细分——tqdm / pv 就是这么画的，比像素条更容易对齐日志。
items.pe: Full cells in █, the remainder in the ▏▎▍▌▋▊▉ eighths — how tqdm and pv draw it, and it aligns with log text.

items.dz: 那个方块一直在呼吸
items.de: The block that never stops blinking
items.pz: VT100 光标是 530ms 硬切（steps(1)），不是淡入淡出；软光标才用 opacity 过渡。
items.pe: A VT100 cursor hard-switches about every 530ms with steps(1) — only soft cursors fade.

items.dz: 一行行日志自己往上走
items.de: Log lines climbing on their own
items.pz: 定高容器 + 整体 translateY，进入时给一档 opacity 台阶；时间戳与数字用等宽对齐，日志才不抖。
items.pe: A fixed-height box, one translateY on the block, an opacity step as rows enter. Tabular figures keep timestamps from jittering.

items.dz: 一行字符里的趋势线
items.de: A trend line inside one line of text
items.pz: 把序列归一化到 ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ 八级块字符，一行字就是一张图；状态栏里最省地方的可视化。
items.pe: Normalise the series onto the ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ eighths — one line of text becomes a chart. The cheapest viz in any status bar.

items.dz: 用方块排出来的排行榜
items.de: A ranking drawn in blocks
items.pz: 标签左对齐、条形用 █ 重复、数值右对齐等宽——CLI 报表的标准三栏，宽度按最长标签定。
items.pe: Left-aligned labels, repeated █ bars, right-aligned tabular values — the standard three columns of a CLI report, sized by the longest label.

items.dz: 字符组成的流动色场
items.de: A flowing colour field made of glyphs
items.pz: 多个正弦叠加（sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t)）求值后查字符表，是 demoscene 的入门题；这里用一层渐变裁进字里。
items.pe: Sum a few sines — sin(x)+sin(y)+sin(x+y+t) — and look the value up in the ramp. The demoscene starter exercise; here a gradient is clipped into the glyphs.

items.dz: 像老显示器那样有横纹和辉光
items.de: Old-monitor stripes and phosphor glow
items.pz: 偶数行叠半透明黑（repeating-linear-gradient），再加 text-shadow 磷光与极轻的桶形畸变；扫描线间距必须是整像素，否则会摩尔纹。
items.pe: Overlay a repeating-linear-gradient on alternate rows, add a phosphor text-shadow and a touch of barrel distortion. Keep the stripe pitch on whole pixels or it moirés.

items.dz: 一个字一个字打出来
items.de: One character at a time
items.pz: 等宽字体 + ch 单位宽度配 steps(n)，才不会露出半个字；变宽字体必须改成逐字 span。
items.pe: Monospace plus a ch-unit width stepped with steps(n) — anything else shows half a glyph. Proportional type needs per-character spans.

items.dz: 字符被替换成乱码再复原
items.de: Glyphs corrupt into noise, then resolve
items.pz: 随机替换（scramble）配 steps 抽帧，替换池只取同宽字符，字段宽度才不会跳。
items.pe: Scramble on stepped frames, drawing only from same-width glyphs so the field never reflows.

items.dz: 半圆表盘也能用字符画
items.de: Even a dial can be typed
items.pz: 半圆刻度用 ╱╲│ 排布，指针一格反色；htop / btop 的资源表就是这套，读数必须等宽。
items.pe: Arrange ╱╲│ into a half-circle scale and invert one cell for the needle — the htop / btop resource dial. Keep the readout tabular.

items.dz: git log --graph 那种分叉线
items.de: The branching lines of git log --graph
items.pz: 用 │╱╲├ 表示分支与合并，节点 ● ○；顺序由拓扑排序决定，不是时间——这也是它常让人看错的原因。
items.pe: Branches and merges in │╱╲├ with ● ○ nodes, ordered topologically rather than chronologically — which is exactly why people misread it.
